### [1] [DefocusTrackerAI -- A Generalized Framework for the Automatic Detection of Defocused Particle Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00076)
*Gonçalo Coutinho,Ana S. Moita,António L. N. Moreira,Massimiliano Rossi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DefocusTrackerAI，一个基于深度学习的通用框架，用于自动检测和位置估计离焦粒子图像。通过比较Faster R-CNN和YOLOv9，发现YOLOv9在召回率、不确定性和空间分辨率上均优于前者，并在多种光学配置和真实DPT实验中表现出色。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有离焦粒子跟踪方法在通用性、召回率和不确定性方面存在局限，缺乏一个能在不同光学配置下自动检测离焦粒子图像且不影响精度和召回率的通用框架。

Method: 采用YOLOv9和Faster R-CNN两种目标检测模型进行对比，在包含像散和非像散离焦粒子图像的多样化合成图像集上训练，最终选定YOLOv9作为核心模型，构建DefocusTrackerAI框架。

Result: 1) YOLOv9在召回率和不确定性上优于Faster R-CNN，尤其在高粒子图像密度下；2) YOLOv9的空间分辨率提升，不确定性在0.1-0.4像素之间（N_s≤0.5），优于现有算法；3) 模型能检测多种光学配置下的像散和非像散离焦粒子图像；4) 成功应用于荧光和阴影图等真实DPT实验。

Conclusion: DefocusTrackerAI是一个通用、高精度的离焦粒子图像自动检测框架，基于YOLOv9的预训练版本可直接使用，结合适当的深度位置校准方法可作为三维离焦粒子跟踪的有效第一步。

Original Abstract: The present work introduces DefocusTrackerAI, a generalized deep-learning framework for the automatic detection and position estimation of defocused particle images from any kind of optical configuration without compromising uncertainty and recall, intended as a follow-up of the open-source project DefocusTracker. We selected the deep neural network architecture from the direct comparison of two well-known object detection models, Faster R-CNN and YOLOv9, trained on a diverse and feature-rich synthetic image set containing astigmatic and non-astigmatic defocused particle images of varying diameters. The model evaluation on synthetic data showed that, first, YOLOv9 outperforms Faster R-CNN, achieving higher recall and lower uncertainty, particularly at high particle image densities; and second, that YOLOv9 provides enhanced spatial resolution, with uncertainty values between 0.1 and 0.4 pixels for particle image densities N_s up to 0.5, outperforming state-of-the-art algorithms. We demonstrated that our models are able to detect astigmatic and non-astigmatic defocused particle images in multiple optical setups with varying lighting conditions. In addition, we successfully applied our models on real DPT experiments, including fluorescence and shadowgraph data, showing that they can be used beyond conventional DPT applications, including the tracking of sprays and droplets. A pre-trained, ready-to-use version of DefocusTrackerAI based on YOLOv9 is available at https://gitlab.com/goncalo.coutinho/defocustrackerAI-main/-/tree/7e0f11f649ebad50e20dca5b9545f26ca303ebe0 and can be used for automatic detection of defocused particle images of any kind with high accuracy. In combination with a suitable calibration approach for the depth position, it can be used as an effective first step for three-dimensional defocusing particle tracking.

中文摘要翻译: 本文介绍了DefocusTrackerAI，这是一个通用的深度学习框架，用于自动检测和位置估计来自任意光学配置的离焦粒子图像，且不影响不确定度和召回率，旨在作为开源项目DefocusTracker的后续工作。我们通过直接比较两种知名的目标检测模型——Faster R-CNN和YOLOv9——来选定深度神经网络架构，这两种模型均在包含不同直径的像散和非像散离焦粒子图像的多样化、特征丰富的合成图像集上进行了训练。在合成数据上的模型评估表明：第一，YOLOv9优于Faster R-CNN，实现了更高的召回率和更低的不确定度，尤其是在高粒子图像密度条件下；第二，YOLOv9提供了增强的空间分辨率，在粒子图像密度N_s高达0.5时，不确定度值在0.1至0.4像素之间，优于现有算法。我们证明了我们的模型能够在多种光学配置和不同照明条件下检测像散和非像散离焦粒子图像。此外，我们成功地将模型应用于真实的DPT实验，包括荧光和阴影图数据，表明它们可以超越传统DPT应用场景，包括喷雾和液滴的跟踪。基于YOLOv9的预训练即用版DefocusTrackerAI可在https://gitlab.com/goncalo.coutinho/defocustrackerAI-main/-/tree/7e0f11f649ebad50e20dca5b9545f26ca303ebe0获取，可用于高精度自动检测任意类型的离焦粒子图像。结合适当的深度位置校准方法，它可作为三维离焦粒子跟踪的有效第一步。

</details>


### [2] [Improved Belief-Attention in Vision Task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00077)
*Guoqiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文在Belief-Attention基础上提出Belief2-Attention，同时利用垂直分量和投影分量，并引入额外的内积矩阵ZZ^T以捕获更丰富的token相关性，在图像分类和分割任务上验证了有效性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 已有的Belief-Attention仅使用垂直分量作为残差信号，而消融研究表明投影分量也携带token相关性的信息，不应被忽略，因此需要同时利用两个分量。

Method: 提出Belief2-Attention：(1) 同时利用Belief-Attention中的垂直分量和投影分量，投影分量经过激活函数和线性映射后与当前token融合；(2) 引入额外的内积矩阵ZZ^T叠加到QK^T上，以捕获更丰富的token相关性。

Result: 理论分析表明Belief2-Attention比标准Attention更具表达能力；在图像分类和分割等视觉任务上验证了有效性。

Conclusion: Belief2-Attention通过充分利用投影分量和引入额外内积矩阵，提升了注意力机制的表达能力，在视觉任务上表现优异。

Original Abstract: Recently, Belief-Attention \cite{Guoqiang25BeliefAttention} has been proposed by first performing an orthogonal projection of the softmax-based weighted summation of $V$ vectors with respect to the original $V$ vectors and then taking the perpendicular component as the residual signal in Transformer for performance improvement. In this paper, we first conduct an ablation study showing the projected component also carries information about the token correlation, which should not be ignored. We then propose to extend Belief-Attention by making use of both the perpendicular and projected components. In particular, the projected component goes through certain activation function and then a linear mapping before merging with the considered token. Conceptually speaking, the neural block for the projected component can be viewed as a two-layer feedforward network (FFN) within the new attention block. It is also noted that standard attention captures the token correlation via the inner-product matrix $QK^T$. We propose to introduce an additional inner-product matrix $ZZ^T$ to $QK^T$ to capture richer token correlation. We refer to the new module as Belief2-Attention. It can be easily shown that Belief2-Attention is more expressive than standard Attention. We then verify the effectiveness of Belief2-Attention for vision tasks of image classification and segmentation.

中文摘要翻译: 最近，Belief-Attention \cite{Guoqiang25BeliefAttention} 被提出，其首先对基于softmax的V向量加权求和进行相对于原始V向量的正交投影，然后将垂直分量作为Transformer中的残差信号以提升性能。本文首先进行消融研究，表明投影分量也携带有关token相关性的信息，不应被忽略。随后，我们提出扩展Belief-Attention，同时利用垂直分量和投影分量。具体而言，投影分量经过一定的激活函数，然后通过线性映射，再与所考虑的token融合。从概念上讲，投影分量的神经块可视为新注意力模块内的两层前馈网络。此外，标准注意力通过内积矩阵QK^T来捕获token相关性。我们提出引入额外的内积矩阵ZZ^T到QK^T中，以捕获更丰富的token相关性。我们将新模块称为Belief2-Attention。可以很容易地证明，Belief2-Attention比标准注意力具有更强的表达能力。最后，我们在图像分类和分割等视觉任务上验证了Belief2-Attention的有效性。

</details>


### [3] [Flow-Based Generative Modeling for Optimizing Sampling Policies in Compressed Sensing Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00078)
*Roman Pavelkin,Luis A. Zavala-Mondragon,Christiaan G. A. Viviers,Fons van der Sommen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种任务感知的基于流的生成框架，通过学习优化子采样掩码，显著提升了压缩感知在图像分类、图像重建和MRI加速中的性能，并在低采样率下实现了SOTA结果。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统采样理论要求测量数量与信号维度成正比，成本高昂且不切实际；压缩感知虽能在较少测量下恢复稀疏信号，但现有方法缺乏任务感知能力，无法针对具体下游任务优化采样策略。

Method: 将Flow Matching训练范式进行重构，训练一个流模型来优化压缩感知中的子采样掩码，实现任务感知的采样方案学习。

Result: 在图像重建任务中，CelebA数据集上以5%子采样率达到25.17 dB的PSNR；在fastMRI数据集上实现8倍加速MRI重建，PSNR达29.24 dB，计算开销极小。

Conclusion: 任务条件化在生成流模型中具有显著效果，该框架为数据驱动和任务驱动的感知方案设计提供了一种统一、灵活的方法，可推广到广泛的逆问题中。

Original Abstract: Numerous modern applications in signal processing and medical imaging necessitate acquiring high-dimensional signals under tight resource constraints. Traditional sampling theory suggests that accurate signal reconstruction requires a number of measurements proportional to the signal's ambient dimension, a requirement often too expensive or impractical. Compressed sensing challenges this notion by demonstrating that sparse signals can be recovered with fewer measurements, provided the measurement operator meets certain conditions. This proof-of-concept study presents a task-aware flow-based generative framework -- a reformulation of the conventional Flow Matching training paradigm with a flow model trained to optimize subsampling in compressed sensing applications. We establish the fundamental feasibility of the proposed framework of learning subsampling masks that substantially enhance the performance of compressed sensing for image classification, image reconstruction, and MRI acceleration. For the image reconstruction task, our method demonstrated state-of-the-art performance, achieving Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio of 25.17 dB at the subsampling rate of 5\% on the CelebA dataset and 29.24 dB when reconstructing $8\times$ accelerated MRI measurements (fastMRI dataset) with the minimal computational overhead. These results highlight the effectiveness of task-conditioning within generative flow models and reveal a promising direction for representation learning strategies. Overall, the proposed framework offers a unified, flexible approach to designing data- and task-driven sensing schemes that can be potentially adapted to a broad range of inverse problems.

中文摘要翻译: 现代信号处理和医学成像中的众多应用需要在严格的资源约束下获取高维信号。传统采样理论表明，精确的信号重建所需的测量数量与信号的维度成正比，这一要求通常成本过高或难以实现。压缩感知通过证明在测量算子满足特定条件时，稀疏信号可以用更少的测量来恢复，从而挑战了这一观念。这项概念验证研究提出了一种任务感知的基于流的生成框架——对传统Flow Matching训练范式的重构，其中流模型被训练用于优化压缩感知应用中的子采样。我们建立了所提出的学习子采样掩码框架的基本可行性，该框架显著提升了压缩感知在图像分类、图像重建和MRI加速中的性能。在图像重建任务中，我们的方法展示了最先进的性能，在CelebA数据集上以5%的子采样率实现了25.17 dB的峰值信噪比，并在最小的计算开销下重建8倍加速的MRI测量（fastMRI数据集）时达到了29.24 dB。这些结果突显了生成流模型中任务条件化的有效性，并揭示了表示学习策略的一个有前景的方向。总体而言，所提出的框架提供了一种统一、灵活的方法来设计数据驱动和任务驱动的感知方案，该方法有望适应广泛的逆问题。

</details>


### [4] [Planktonzilla: Multimodal dataset and models for understanding plankton ecosystems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00080)
*Alan Gerson Contreras Montanares,Luis Valenzuela,Luis Martí,Nayat Sanchez-Pi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文构建了迄今最大、最全面的浮游生物图像数据集Planktonzilla-17M（1740万张图像，602个分类类别），并通过监督学习与CLIP-style对比实验发现：当使用分类学谱系作为文本时，监督分类器表现优于或持平CLIP-style训练，而现有的生物基础模型（BioCLIP/BioCLIP2）在海洋浮游生物领域的零样本和少样本场景下表现不佳。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有浮游生物分类模型在单一数据集上表现良好，但由于训练数据孤立且标签不一致，难以跨仪器和环境泛化，亟需一个统一的大规模数据集和系统性基准来推动该领域的进展。

Method: 1) 整合13个成像系统的公开浮游生物图像，构建Planktonzilla-17M统一数据集（1740万张图像，含标准化分类学和地理环境元数据）；2) 在共享ViT骨干网络上，进行监督学习与CLIP-style图文对比训练的受控实验；3) 评估BioCLIP和BioCLIP2在零样本和少样本设置下的表现。

Result: 1) 当使用分类学谱系作为文本时，监督分类器达到或超过CLIP-style训练效果；2) BioCLIP和BioCLIP2在浮游生物零样本和少样本场景下表现很差；3) 使用Planktonzilla-17M显著提升了浮游生物分类性能，揭示了当前生物基础模型在海洋成像领域的局限性。

Conclusion: Planktonzilla-17M能够有效提升浮游生物分类性能，而现有的生物基础模型（如BioCLIP）在海洋浮游生物领域存在显著不足，未来需要针对该领域专门优化的方法。

Original Abstract: Marine plankton underpin aquatic food webs and play a key role in global CO2 sequestration, making reliable species identification critical for understanding ocean health and climate feedbacks. Existing classification models perform well on individual collections but fail to generalize across instruments and environments due to isolated training datasets and inconsistent labels. To address this, we introduce Planktonzilla-17M, a unified dataset consolidating publicly available plankton image collections spanning thirteen imaging systems. It comprises 17.4 million images with standardized taxonomy and geo-environmental metadata, including 3.74 million plankton images spanning over 602 taxonomic classes, of which 201 are identified at the species level, making it the largest and most comprehensive plankton image dataset to date. Using this large-scale dataset, we perform a controlled comparison between supervised and CLIP-style image--text training on a shared ViT backbone. We find that a supervised classifier matches or exceeds CLIP-style training when trained using taxonomic lineage as text. We further observe that BioCLIP and BioCLIP2 perform poorly on plankton in zero-shot and few-shot settings. Leveraging Planktonzilla-17M improves plankton classification performance, highlighting the limitations of current biological foundation models in marine imaging domains.

中文摘要翻译: 海洋浮游生物支撑着水生食物网，并在全球二氧化碳封存中发挥关键作用，因此可靠的物种识别对于理解海洋健康和气候反馈至关重要。现有的分类模型在单一数据集上表现良好，但由于训练数据孤立且标签不一致，难以跨仪器和环境泛化。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Planktonzilla-17M，这是一个统一的数据集，整合了涵盖13个成像系统的公开浮游生物图像集合。该数据集包含1740万张图像，配有标准化的分类学和地理环境元数据，其中374万张浮游生物图像涵盖602多个分类类别，201个类别达到了物种级别识别精度，是迄今为止最大、最全面的浮游生物图像数据集。利用这一大规模数据集，我们在共享ViT骨干网络上进行了监督学习与CLIP-style图文训练的受控对比实验。我们发现，当使用分类学谱系作为文本时，监督分类器的表现达到或超过了CLIP-style训练。我们进一步观察到，BioCLIP和BioCLIP2在零样本和少样本设置下对浮游生物的表现较差。利用Planktonzilla-17M能够提升浮游生物分类性能，凸显了当前生物基础模型在海洋成像领域的局限性。

</details>


### [5] [Structured Visual Evidence Decomposition for Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Screening of Obstructive Sleep Apnea-Hypopnea Syndrome](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00087)
*Chen Zhan,Yingchen Wei,Xiaoyu Tan,Jingjing Huang,Xihe Qiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EviOSAHS是一个证据驱动的多模态推理框架，通过将面部图像分解为七个解剖学查询并生成结构化证据卡，再结合临床资料进行二分类筛查，在OSAHS预多导睡眠监测筛查中实现了88.47%准确率和94.86%灵敏度，提供了可审计、高灵敏度的筛查工作流。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有的通用多模态基础模型在直接用于医学二分类决策时输出不稳定且校准不良，而OSAHS筛查需要结合临床风险因素与可见的颅面和颈部线索，因此需要一个更可靠、可审计的多模态推理框架。

Method: 将正面面部图像分解为七个固定解剖学查询（颈部、下巴、口部、面/颈部肥胖、下颌、面中部、鼻子），通过视觉模型获取结构化证据卡（记录目标解剖结构、可见性、风险方向、证据强度、置信度和摘要），再与清洗后的临床资料结合，由大语言模型进行平衡的二分类筛查判定。

Result: 在642名受试者队列中，EviOSAHS取得88.47%准确率、94.86%灵敏度、93.74% F1分数和5.14%假阴性率，优于临床仅提示、直接多模态提示和朴素两阶段基线。消融实验表明七问题视觉分解和平衡最终判定对高灵敏度至关重要。4494个视觉输出的审计显示100%结构化解析率和93.88%高可见率。

Conclusion: EviOSAHS为预多导睡眠监测的二分类OSAHS筛查提供了可审计、高灵敏度的工作流，但应作为分诊辅助工具而非诊断系统，临床部署前需要前瞻性验证、外部测试和校准的工作点控制。

Original Abstract: Effective pre-polysomnography screening for obstructive sleep apnea-hypopnea syndrome (OSAHS) requires combining clinical risk factors with visible craniofacial and neck cues. Directly prompting general-purpose multimodal foundation models for medical yes/no decisions can yield unstable, poorly calibrated outputs. We propose EviOSAHS, an evidence-grounded multimodal reasoning framework that separates image-only anatomical evidence acquisition from final clinical adjudication. Each frontal facial image is decomposed into seven fixed anatomical queries covering the neck, chin, mouth, face/neck fat, lower jaw, midface, and nose. Visual responses are converted into structured evidence cards recording target anatomy, visibility, risk direction, evidence strength, confidence, and a concise summary. These cards are combined with a cleaned clinical profile only in the final stage, where a large language model performs balanced binary screening adjudication. We evaluated EviOSAHS on a 642-subject cohort, mapping normal subjects to screening-negative and mild, moderate, or severe OSAHS subjects to screening-positive. EviOSAHS achieved 88.47% accuracy, 94.86% sensitivity, 93.74% F1-score, and a 5.14% false-negative rate, outperforming clinical-only prompting, direct multimodal prompting, and naive two-stage pipelines under a unified protocol. Ablations showed that seven-question visual decomposition and balanced final adjudication were critical to the high-sensitivity operating point. A question-level audit of 4,494 visual outputs showed a 100% structured parse rate and 93.88% high-visibility rate. EviOSAHS provides an auditable, high-sensitivity workflow for binary pre-polysomnography OSAHS screening, but should be viewed as a triage assistant rather than a diagnostic system. Prospective validation, external testing, and calibrated operating-point control are needed before clinical deployment.

中文摘要翻译: 有效的阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停低通气综合征（OSAHS）预多导睡眠监测筛查需要将临床风险因素与可见的颅面和颈部线索相结合。直接提示通用多模态基础模型进行医学二分类决策会产生不稳定且校准不良的输出。我们提出EviOSAHS，一个证据驱动的多模态推理框架，将仅基于图像的解剖学证据获取与最终的临床判定分离。每张正面面部图像被分解为七个固定解剖学查询，涵盖颈部、下巴、口部、面/颈部肥胖、下颌、面中部和鼻子。视觉响应被转换为结构化证据卡，记录目标解剖结构、可见性、风险方向、证据强度、置信度和简洁摘要。这些证据卡仅在最终阶段与清洗后的临床资料结合，由大语言模型执行平衡的二分类筛查判定。我们在一个642名受试者队列上评估了EviOSAHS，将正常受试者映射为筛查阴性，将轻度、中度或重度OSAHS受试者映射为筛查阳性。EviOSAHS取得了88.47%的准确率、94.86%的灵敏度、93.74%的F1分数和5.14%的假阴性率，在统一协议下优于临床仅提示、直接多模态提示和朴素两阶段流程。消融实验表明，七问题视觉分解和平衡的最终判定对实现高灵敏度工作点是关键。对4494个视觉输出的问题级审计显示，100%的结构化解析率和93.88%的高可见率。EviOSAHS为二分类预多导睡眠监测OSAHS筛查提供了可审计、高灵敏度的工作流，但应被视为分诊辅助工具而非诊断系统。临床部署前需要前瞻性验证、外部测试和校准的工作点控制。

TL;DR: 本文提出MIND框架，通过将离散补丁标记化集成到连续扩散模型的得分函数中，显式建模数据流形几何。该方法结合了离散标记的结构量化能力与连续扩散的并行生成灵活性，并在ImageNet 256×256上取得了显著优于DiT和SiT等基线的性能，MIND-XL（715M参数）FID降至1.95。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Original Abstract: Image generative models aim to sample data points from the underlying data manifold, a task that requires learning and decoding a dense, low-dimensional, and compact parameterization space. To achieve this, we propose the Data Manifold-aware Image diffusioN moDel (MIND), a novel framework that explicitly models manifold geometry by integrating discrete patch tokenization into the score function of a continuous diffusion model. This approach successfully leverages both the structural quantification capabilities of discrete tokens and the parallel generation flexibility of continuous diffusion. Moreover, we enable end-to-end differentiable training via a novel soft top-$k$ aggregation mechanism and introduce dual-branch high-frequency feature embedding layers to alleviate the spectral bias of transformer backbones on low-dimensional inputs. Furthermore, for inference, we design a multi-stage transition sampling scheme that dynamically adjusts the sampling scheme based on timestep. After 80-epoch training, our base model achieves an FID of 22.73 without guidance, nearly halving the 43.47 FID of the vanilla DiT-B/2 baseline. The proposed method reduces FID by 15.95 and 9.06 on average compared with the baselines DiT and SiT, respectively. For image generation on ImageNet-256$\times$256 with guidance, the proposed MIND-B with only 130M parameters achieves an FID of 2.06, superpassing the LlamaGen-3B with 3.1B parameters. The proposed MIND-XL with 715M parameters further reduces the FID to 1.95. Our MIND introduces a fresh perspective on diffusion-based image generation, paving the way for future research and innovation in this community. The code will be publicly available.

中文摘要翻译: 图像生成模型旨在从底层数据流形中采样数据点，这需要学习并解码一个密集、低维且紧凑的参数化空间。为实现这一目标，我们提出了数据流形感知的图像扩散模型（MIND），这是一种通过将离散补丁标记化集成到连续扩散模型的得分函数中来显式建模流形几何的新框架。该方法成功利用了离散标记的结构量化能力与连续扩散的并行生成灵活性。此外，我们通过一种新颖的软top-k聚合机制实现了端到端的可微训练，并引入双分支高频特征嵌入层以缓解Transformer骨干网络在低维输入上的谱偏差。同时，在推理阶段，我们设计了一种多阶段过渡采样方案，根据时间步动态调整采样策略。在ImageNet 256×256上的大量实验证明了MIND的有效性。经过80轮训练，我们的基模型在无引导条件下实现了22.73的FID，相比原始DiT-B/2基线的43.47 FID几乎减半。与DiT和SiT基线相比，所提方法平均分别降低了15.95和9.06的FID。在有引导的ImageNet 256×256图像生成任务中，仅130M参数的MIND-B实现了2.06的FID，超越了拥有3.1B参数的LlamaGen-3B。所提出的MIND-XL（715M参数）进一步将FID降至1.95。我们的MIND为基于扩散的图像生成引入了全新视角，为该领域的未来研究和创新铺平了道路。代码将公开提供。

### [8] [Bridging the 2D-3D Gap: A Hierarchical Semantic-Geometric Map for Vision Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00095)
*Kailing Li,Tianwen Qian,Lijin Yang,Yuqian Fu,Jingyu Gong,Xiaoling Wang,Liang He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出分层语义-几何地图（HSGM），将3D几何信息转化为VLM可理解的结构化表示，实现零样本视觉-语言导航，在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上达到SOTA，甚至超越部分有监督方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有VLM擅长语言和2D视觉理解，但在3D空间推理和动作-空间转移的因果动力学方面存在不足，导致零样本导航不可靠。为弥合语义-几何鸿沟，需将3D几何信息与VLM语义能力有效桥接。

Method: 提出HSGM，一种多通道自顶向下地图，包含三个层级：(1)几何层记录可通行区域和障碍物；(2)语义层表示物体及其关系；(3)决策层支持高层任务推理和目标选择。VLM作为高层语义规划器，基于HSGM选择几何有效路径点；底层由经典路径规划算法执行无碰撞运动。复杂指令分解为子任务缓解长程导航中的遗忘或幻觉问题。

Result: 在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准上的大量实验表明，该零样本框架达到了SOTA性能，甚至优于若干有监督方法。

Conclusion: 通过HSGM将3D几何信息结构化表示，使VLM能进行可靠的空间推理与导航规划，同时将语义推理与动作执行解耦，显著提升了零样本VLN的性能。

Original Abstract: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) enables embodied agents to reach target locations in unseen environments by following language instructions. Despite recent progress with vision-language models (VLMs), a critical semantic-geometric gap remains: while VLMs excel at language and 2D visual understanding, they struggle with 3D spatial reasoning and fail to capture the causal dynamics between actions and spatial transitions, resulting in unreliable navigation, particularly in zero-shot settings. To bridge this gap, we propose a Hierarchical Semantic-Geometric Map (HSGM) that transforms 3D geometric information into a structured representation compatible with VLMs, effectively linking them to the physical world. Specifically, HSGM is represented as a multi-channel top-down map organized into three levels: (1) geometric level that records navigable regions and obstacles, (2) semantic level that represents objects and their relations, and (3) decision level that supports high-level task reasoning and goal selection. During navigation, the VLM acts as a high-level semantic planner, interpreting the spatial layout encoded in the HSGM to select geometrically valid waypoints, while low-level, collision-free movements between waypoints are executed by a classical path-planning algorithm, fully decoupling semantic reasoning from action execution. Additionally, complex instructions are decomposed into subtasks to alleviate the problem of progress forgetting or hallucinating in long-horizon navigation. Extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks demonstrate that our zero-shot framework achieves state-of-the-art performance and even outperforms several supervised methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Teacher-Tom/HSGM_public.

中文摘要翻译: 视觉-语言导航（VLN）使具身智能体能够通过遵循语言指令在未知环境中到达目标位置。尽管近年来视觉-语言模型（VLM）取得了进展，但一个关键的语义-几何鸿沟仍然存在：VLM擅长语言和二维视觉理解，但在三维空间推理方面存在不足，无法捕捉动作与空间转移之间的因果动力学，导致导航不可靠，尤其是在零样本场景下。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出分层语义-几何地图（HSGM），将三维几何信息转化为与VLM兼容的结构化表示，有效将其与物理世界连接。具体而言，HSGM被表示为多通道自顶向下地图，组织为三个层级：（1）几何层，记录可通行区域和障碍物；（2）语义层，表示物体及其关系；（3）决策层，支持高层任务推理和目标选择。在导航过程中，VLM作为高层语义规划器，解读HSGM中编码的空间布局以选择几何有效的路径点，而底层路径点之间的无碰撞运动由经典路径规划算法执行，从而将语义推理与动作执行完全解耦。此外，复杂指令被分解为子任务，以缓解长程导航中的进展遗忘或幻觉问题。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准上的大量实验表明，我们的零样本框架达到了最先进的性能，甚至优于若干有监督方法。代码可在https://github.com/Teacher-Tom/HSGM_public获取。

</details>


### [9] [Diversity Over Frequency: Rethinking Tool Use in Visual Chain-of-Thought Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00096)
*Dong-Hee Kim,Reuben Tan,Donghyun Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现视觉推理智能体在训练中会出现“工具使用崩溃”现象——模型逐渐停止使用外部视觉工具，但任务准确率反而提升。通过熵正则化鼓励多样化探索，可在工具使用下降的情况下取得最佳性能，表明工具应被视为训练阶段的“脚手架”。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有工作主要研究视觉工具在简单视觉搜索任务中的作用，而在更复杂的视觉推理任务（如3D空间推理、医学视觉问答）中，工具的作用尚未被充分探索。作者希望超越简单搜索任务，研究智能体如何整合工具获取的局部证据与全局上下文进行复杂推理。

Method: 识别出“工具使用崩溃”现象后，作者通过对比实验发现：(i)完全消除工具使用会降低性能，(ii)鼓励工具使用仅带来边际收益。进一步分析表明，普通训练和工具使用鼓励都会降低轨迹多样性。为此，作者引入熵正则化项来鼓励多样化的轨迹探索，以在工具使用下降的情况下提升推理性能。

Result: 核心发现：(1) 存在工具使用崩溃现象——模型渐进停止使用工具但准确率上升；(2) 完全消除工具会损害性能，而鼓励工具使用只会带来边际收益；(3) 普通训练和工具使用鼓励均降低了轨迹多样性；(4) 熵正则化在工具使用逐渐下降的情况下取得了最佳性能。

Conclusion: 工具应被视为训练阶段的“脚手架”（scaffolding）：在训练时通过更广泛的探索（包括语言生成和视觉工具调用）来提升推理能力，即使推理时工具使用逐渐减少，模型也能受益于训练阶段的多样化探索。

Original Abstract: Visual agents employ external visual tools within visual chains of thought to incorporate fine-grained evidence. While prior work has mainly studied these tools in visual search tasks, their role in more complex visual reasoning remains underexplored. In this paper, we move beyond simple visual search tasks to investigate more challenging tasks, including 3D spatial reasoning and medical visual question answering, where agents must integrate tool-acquired local evidence with the global context.
  We identify a {tool-use collapse phenomenon: models progressively stop using tools while still achieving higher task accuracy.
  Moreover, we observe a clear asymmetry: (i) completely eliminating tool use degrades performance, whereas (ii) incentivizing tool use yields only marginal gains despite substantially increasing usage.
  We find that vanilla training and tool-use encouragement both reduce rollout diversity, explaining why higher tool use does not yield stronger reasoning performance.
  Motivated by these findings, we add an entropy regularization term to encourage diverse rollout exploration, achieving the best performance despite gradually declining tool usage.
  % We further observe similar dynamics on medical VQA, suggesting that tool-use collapse is not limited to 3D spatial reasoning.
  Overall, our findings suggest a training-time view of tools as scaffolding, where broader exploration over language generation and visual tool invocation improves reasoning despite tool-use collapse.
  Project page: https://scaffolded-exploration.github.io

中文摘要翻译: 视觉智能体在视觉思维链中借助外部视觉工具来融入细粒度证据。虽然先前的工作主要研究了这些工具在视觉搜索任务中的应用，但它们在更复杂视觉推理中的作用仍未得到充分探索。在本文中，我们超越简单的视觉搜索任务，研究更具挑战性的任务，包括3D空间推理和医学视觉问答，在这些任务中智能体必须将工具获取的局部证据与全局上下文进行整合。
我们发现了一种“工具使用崩溃”现象：模型逐步停止使用工具，同时任务准确率反而提升。
此外，我们观察到一种明显的不对称性：(i) 完全消除工具使用会降低性能，而(ii) 鼓励工具使用尽管显著增加了使用频率，却仅带来边际收益。
我们发现，普通训练和工具使用鼓励均降低了轨迹多样性，这解释了为什么更高的工具使用率并未带来更强的推理性能。
受这些发现的启发，我们添加了熵正则化项以鼓励多样化的轨迹探索，在工具使用逐渐下降的情况下取得了最佳性能。
总体而言，我们的发现表明，工具在训练阶段应被视为“脚手架”——对语言生成和视觉工具调用的更广泛探索能够改善推理能力，尽管存在工具使用崩溃现象。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Original Abstract: We introduce segmentation-guided spatial indexing for generalizable and explainable deepfake detection. A frozen FaRL parser assigns each DINOv3 ViT-L/16 patch token a semantic label; non-target tokens are discarded; a linear probe classifies the retained region. This spatial indexing exploits DINOv3's patch-level spatial consistency, the same property that enables emergent segmentation, to present the probe with a purer regional subspace where manipulation-relevant evidence is less diluted by whole-face cues. Region attribution is structural: when the mouth model predicts fake, the decision used only mouth tokens, not an overlaid saliency map. Ablations isolate the mechanism: replacing regional selection with DINOv3's CLS token drops Celeb-DF v2 AUC by 26.4 pp; replacing DINOv3 with FaRL features drops it by 20.9 pp. Both DINOv3 representation and the spatial index are independently necessary; neither alone approaches the full system.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出了一种基于分割引导的空间索引方法，用于实现可泛化且可解释的深度伪造检测。其核心思想颠倒了标准设计顺序：不是先对所有面部令牌进行池化再分类，而是先选择具有语义意义的补丁令牌，然后仅对这些令牌进行池化。一个冻结的FaRL解析器为每个DINOv3 ViT-L/16补丁令牌分配语义标签；丢弃非目标令牌；线性探针对保留的区域进行分类。这种空间索引利用了DINOv3的补丁级空间一致性（即催生涌现分割的同一特性），向探针呈现一个更纯净的区域子空间，其中与操纵相关的证据不易被全脸线索稀释。区域归因是结构化的：当口部模型预测为伪造时，决策仅使用了口部令牌，而非叠加的显著性图。在Celeb-DF v2上，口部索引探针的AUC达到0.905，优于LipForensics（+8.1个百分点）和Xception（+16.9个百分点），且无需对DINOv3或FaRL进行微调，也没有使用目标域数据。消融实验隔离了这一机制：用DINOv3的CLS令牌替代区域选择使Celeb-DF v2 AUC下降26.4个百分点；用FaRL特征替代DINOv3则下降20.9个百分点。DINOv3的表示和空间索引两者都是独立必要的；单独其中任何一个都无法接近完整系统的性能。

*Tongxi Song,Ziyu Li,Zihan Li,Wen Zhong,Congyu Liao,Yang Yang,Hua Guo,Wenchuan Wu,Qiyuan Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CoilDrop-MRI，一种基于线圈维度随机丢弃的自监督并行MRI重建方法，通过在线圈维度对输入数据进行dropout并构建自监督训练对，在多个数据集上达到与监督方法相当的重建质量。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有自监督MRI重建方法仅将采集数据在k空间域划分为两个不相交子集来构建输入-目标对，忽略了多接收线圈维度中蕴含的信号相关性，未能充分利用线圈间的冗余信息。

Method: CoilDrop-MRI提出在线圈维度对输入进行随机dropout，将被丢弃的线圈数据作为训练目标，构建自监督训练框架；该方法可集成到图像域（SENSE）和k空间域（SPIRiT）的展开式架构中，并扩展至多激发、相位校正的弥散MRI重建。

Conclusion: CoilDrop-MRI通过探索线圈维度的信号相关性，建立了一个实用且通用的自监督并行MRI重建框架，无需全采样参考数据即可获得高质量重建结果。

Original Abstract: Self-supervised deep learning-based methods have shown great promise for accelerated magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) reconstruction, achieving high image quality without requiring fully sampled data for training. These methods typically partition the acquired data into two disjoint subsets to construct input-target pairs for optimizing the reconstruction network. However, existing approaches perform this partition exclusively within the spatial frequency (k-space) domain, leaving the coil dimension unexplored. To enforce full exploitation of signal correlation across receiver coils, we propose CoilDrop-MRI, which applies coil-wise dropout to the input and uses the dropped data as training targets in a self-supervised framework. This method is integrated into unrolled architectures in both image-domain (SENSE) and k-space (SPIRiT) formulations. We further demonstrate its versatility by extending CoilDrop-MRI to multi-shot, phase-corrected diffusion MRI (dMRI) reconstruction. CoilDrop-MRI is extensively validated on multi-site, multi-field-strength (0.3T, 0.55T, and 3T), and multi-modality (T1-weighted, T2-weighted, T2-FLAIR, and dMRI) datasets and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art self-supervised methods, achieving quality comparable to supervised reconstruction methods without requiring fully sampled reference training data. Moreover, CoilDrop-MRI exhibits strong data efficiency and robust generalization across imaging conditions, establishing it as a practical and versatile framework for self-supervised parallel MRI reconstruction.

中文摘要翻译: 基于自监督深度学习的方法在加速磁共振成像（MRI）重建中展现出巨大潜力，无需全采样数据进行训练即可实现高图像质量。这些方法通常将采集数据划分为两个不相交的子集来构建输入-目标对，以优化重建网络。然而，现有方法仅在空间频率（k空间）域进行划分，未探索线圈维度。为了充分利用接收线圈间的信号相关性，我们提出CoilDrop-MRI，该方法对输入应用线圈维度的随机丢弃，并将丢弃的数据作为自监督框架中的训练目标。该方法被集成到图像域（SENSE）和k空间域（SPIRiT）的展开式架构中。我们进一步通过将CoilDrop-MRI扩展到多激发、相位校正的弥散MRI（dMRI）重建来证明其通用性。CoilDrop-MRI在多站点、多场强（0.3T、0.55T和3T）和多模态（T1加权、T2加权、T2-FLAIR和dMRI）数据集上进行了广泛验证，持续优于最先进的自监督方法，达到了与监督重建方法相当的质量，且无需全采样参考训练数据。此外，CoilDrop-MRI展现出强大的数据效率和跨成像条件的鲁棒泛化能力，使其成为自监督并行MRI重建的一个实用且通用的框架。

</details>

*Huidong Feng,Wentao Chen,Jie Chen,Xinqi Cai,Ruolong Ma,Yinglin Zheng,Yuxin Lin,Ming Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了CoCoVideo-26K数据集（涵盖13个主流商业AIGC视频生成器）和CoCoDetect检测框架（结合对比学习与置信度门控的MLLM推理），在高保真AIGC视频伪造检测上取得了SOTA性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有AIGC视频伪造检测数据集主要基于开源视频生成模型，质量远低于商业AIGC系统，且包含商业样本的数据集常留有可见水印，影响真实性和模型向高保真AIGC视频的泛化能力。

Method: 构建CoCoVideo-26K数据集，包含13个主流商业生成器的语义对齐真实-伪造视频对；提出CoCoDetect框架，使用R3D-18提取时空表征，并通过置信度门控将不确定样本路由至MLLM进行物理合理性与场景一致性推理。

Conclusion: 对比学习与MLLM推理相结合的方法能有效提升高保真AIGC视频伪造检测的性能与泛化性。

Original Abstract: With the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence generated content (AIGC) technologies, video forgery has become increasingly prevalent, posing new challenges to public discourse and societal security. Despite remarkable progress in existing deepfake detection methods, AIGC forgery detection remains challenging, as existing datasets mainly rely on open-source video generation models with quality far below that of commercial AIGC systems. Even datasets containing a few commercial samples often retain visible watermarks, compromising authenticity and hindering model generalization to high-fidelity AIGC videos. To address these issues, we introduce CoCoVideo-26K, a contrastive, commercial-model-based AIGC video dataset covering 13 mainstream commercial generators and providing semantically aligned real-fake video pairs. This dataset enables deeper exploration of the differences between authentic and high-quality synthetic videos and establishes a new benchmark for highly realistic video forgery detection. Building on this dataset, we propose CoCoDetect, a detection framework integrating contrastive learning with confidence-gated multimodal large language model (MLLM) inference. An R3D-18 backbone extracts spatio-temporal representations, while a confidence gate routes uncertain cases to an MLLM for reasoning about physical plausibility and scene consistency. Extensive experiments on CoCoVideo-26K and public benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, validating the framework's robustness and generalizability. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/DonoToT/CoCoVideo.

中文摘要翻译: 随着人工智能生成内容（AIGC）技术的快速发展，视频伪造变得越来越普遍，对公共讨论和社会安全构成了新的挑战。尽管现有的深度伪造检测方法取得了显著进展，但AIGC伪造检测仍然面临困难，因为现有数据集主要依赖于开源视频生成模型，其质量远低于商业AIGC系统。即使包含少量商业样本的数据集也常常保留可见水印，损害了真实性并阻碍了模型向高保真AIGC视频的泛化。为解决这些问题，我们引入了CoCoVideo-26K，一个对比性的、基于商业模型的AIGC视频数据集，涵盖13个主流商业生成器，并提供语义对齐的真实-伪造视频对。该数据集能够更深入地探索真实视频与高质量合成视频之间的差异，并为高逼真度视频伪造检测建立了新的基准。基于该数据集，我们提出了CoCoDetect，一个将对比学习与置信度门控的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）推理相结合的检测框架。R3D-18骨干网络提取时空表示，而置信度门控将不确定的样本路由至MLLM进行物理合理性和场景一致性的推理。在CoCoVideo-26K和公开基准上的大量实验证明了该框架的SOTA性能，验证了其鲁棒性和泛化能力。我们的代码和数据集可在https://github.com/DonoToT/CoCoVideo获取。

</details>


### [13] [Visual-Noise Guided In-Context Distillation for Multimodal Large Language Model Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00105)
*Junkai Chen,Yuhao He,Junxiang You,Ruiqi Liu,Chenyu Wang,Shu Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出视觉噪声引导的上下文知识蒸馏框架(VGID)，通过双模态干预（视觉扰动+文本上下文遗忘）构建教师分布，引导学生模型在参数层面实现多模态大语言模型的知识遗忘，兼顾遗忘效果与模型效用。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有MLLM遗忘方法存在不足：基于训练的方法难以平衡遗忘效果与模型效用；基于上下文的无训练方法虽保持模型效用，但未在参数层面消除记忆知识，易受逆向工程攻击，且在视觉输入可作为强条件信号的多模态场景下效果不足。

Method: 提出视觉噪声引导的上下文知识蒸馏(VGID)框架：通过视觉扰动（如加噪）与文本上下文遗忘的双模态干预，从冻结基模型动态构建面向遗忘的教师分布；将该教师分布作为蒸馏信号，引导学生模型在参数层面实现遗忘，无需外部教师模型或显式不良响应标注。

Result: 在代表性设定下，遗忘集ROUGE-L降低0.371，保留集ROUGE-L仅下降0.055，表明VGID在实现强遗忘效果的同时保持了竞争性的模型效用。

Conclusion: VGID通过双模态干预驱动的蒸馏框架，有效解决了多模态大语言模型遗忘中遗忘效果与模型效用之间的权衡问题，实现了参数层面的知识移除。

Original Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress on vision-language tasks, but they may also memorize and expose sensitive or restricted knowledge, raising concerns about privacy and broader safety risks. Machine Unlearning (MU) provides a promising way to remove targeted undesirable knowledge from trained models without retraining from scratch while preserving general model utility. Nevertheless, effective unlearning in MLLMs remains particularly challenging. Existing training-based methods often struggle to balance unlearning effectiveness and model utility. In contrast, training-free methods such as in-context unlearning preserve model utility by avoiding parameter updates, but they do not remove memorized knowledge at the parameter level and may remain vulnerable to reverse-engineering attacks. More importantly, in-context unlearning is insufficient in multimodal settings, where visual inputs can provide strong conditioning signals and induce undesirable outputs. To address these challenges, we propose Visual-Noise Guided In-Context Distillation (VGID), a distillation-based framework for MLLM unlearning. VGID dynamically constructs an unlearning-oriented teacher distribution from the frozen base model through dual-modal intervention that combines visual perturbation with textual in-context unlearning. The resulting intervention-induced distribution serves as a teacher signal for distillation, guiding the student model toward parameter-level unlearning without requiring external teacher models or explicit undesirable response annotations. Experimental results show that VGID achieves strong unlearning effectiveness while preserving competitive model utility, reducing forget set ROUGE-L by 0.371 with only a 0.055 drop in retain set ROUGE-L in a representative setting.

中文摘要翻译: 多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)在视觉-语言任务上取得了显著进展，但它们也可能记忆并暴露敏感或受限制的知识，引发了隐私和更广泛的安全风险。机器遗忘(MU)提供了一种有前景的方法，可以在不从头重新训练的情况下，从训练好的模型中移除目标不良知识，同时保持通用模型效用。然而，在MLLMs中实现有效遗忘仍然特别具有挑战性。现有的基于训练的方法常常难以平衡遗忘效果与模型效用。相比之下，基于上下文遗忘等无训练方法通过避免参数更新来保持模型效用，但它们未在参数层面消除记忆知识，可能仍然容易受到逆向工程攻击。更重要的是，在多模态设置中，上下文遗忘是不够的，因为视觉输入可以提供强条件信号并诱导产生不良输出。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了视觉噪声引导的上下文知识蒸馏(VGID)，一种用于MLLM遗忘的基于蒸馏的框架。VGID通过结合视觉扰动与文本上下文遗忘的双模态干预，从冻结基模型动态构建面向遗忘的教师分布。由此产生的干预诱导分布作为教师信号用于蒸馏，引导学生模型在参数层面实现遗忘，无需外部教师模型或显式不良响应标注。实验结果表明，VGID在保持竞争性模型效用的同时实现了强遗忘效果，在代表性设定中遗忘集ROUGE-L降低0.371，保留集ROUGE-L仅下降0.055。

</details>


### [14] [VDSB-GWSyn: Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge for Controllable and Anatomically Feasible Guidewire Synthesis in Coronary Angiography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00109)
*Haoyuan Tang,Zhuo Zhang,Jialin Li,Shuai Xiao,Jiachen Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VDSB-GWSyn框架，基于扩散薛定谔桥模型实现可控、高保真的冠脉导丝合成，以解决导丝端点定位中标注数据稀缺和现有合成模型适应性有限的问题。合成数据结合预训练-微调策略将端点定位MPE从16.01像素降至7.71像素，PCK@3px从52.63%提升至86.27%。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 计算机辅助/机器人辅助PCI手术中，导丝端点定位是核心能力，但标注的冠脉造影图像数据稀缺，且现有导丝合成模型适应性有限，成为主要瓶颈。

Method: 基于扩散薛定谔桥（DSB）模型，首先通过形状先验算法学习导丝基本几何形状，然后利用血管分割掩码约束生成导丝掩码并输出端点坐标，最后使用SPADE条件化的DSB在真实CAG图像上合成逼真导丝样本。

Result: 合成样本在ROI-FID、ROI-KID和IPR指标上表现优异；使用合成数据预训练+真实数据微调，将导丝端点定位MPE从16.01像素降至7.71像素，PCK@3px从52.63%提升至86.27%。

Conclusion: VDSB-GWSyn能有效生成高保真可控导丝样本，显著提升下游导丝端点定位性能，且其核心设计思想（可控设备合成、严格背景保留和解剖可行性约束）可推广至其他标注稀缺的介入设备感知任务。

Original Abstract: Coronary guidewire endpoint localization is a fundamental capability for computer-assisted PCI, and its importance increases as robot-assisted PCI is progressively adopted to reduce operator radiation exposure. However, the scarcity of annotated CAG images with guidewires and the limited adaptability of existing guidewire synthesis models remain key bottlenecks for guidewire endpoint localization. To address this issue, we propose VDSB-GWSyn, a Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge (DSB) model-based framework, enabling synthesis of controllable, high-fidelity guidewire samples under complex anatomical backgrounds. VDSB-GWSyn first uses our shape prior algorithm to learn the basic guidewire geometry. It then generates guidewire masks under constraints imposed by the vessel segmentation masks and outputs the corresponding endpoint coordinates. Finally, it synthesizes realistic guidewire samples on real CAG images using DSB conditioned with SPADE. Experimental results show that the guidewire samples synthesized by VDSB-GWSyn achieve favorable ROI-FID and ROI-KID, as well as high IPR scores. In addition, incorporating our synthesized data for synthetic pre-training followed by real fine-tuning substantially improves downstream guidewire endpoint localization, reducing MPE from 16.01~px to 7.71~px and increasing PCK at 3~px from 52.63\% to 86.27\%, leading to more clinically reliable deployment of robot-assisted guidewire delivery systems. Moreover, the core design philosophy of controllable device synthesis with strict background preservation and anatomical feasibility constraints has the potential to transfer to other interventional device perception tasks where annotated data are scarce.

中文摘要翻译: 冠脉导丝端点定位是计算机辅助经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）的基础能力，随着机器人辅助PCI逐渐推广应用以减少操作者辐射暴露，其重要性日益提升。然而，带有导丝标注的冠脉造影（CAG）图像稀缺，以及现有导丝合成模型适应性有限，仍是导丝端点定位的关键瓶颈。针对这一问题，我们提出VDSB-GWSyn——一种基于扩散薛定谔桥（DSB）模型的框架，能够在复杂解剖背景下合成可控、高保真的导丝样本。VDSB-GWSyn首先使用形状先验算法学习导丝基本几何形态；然后在血管分割掩码约束下生成导丝掩码并输出对应的端点坐标；最后，利用SPADE条件化的DSB在真实CAG图像上合成逼真的导丝样本。实验结果表明，VDSB-GWSyn合成的导丝样本在ROI-FID和ROI-KID指标上表现优异，并取得了高IPR分数。此外，将合成数据用于预训练再进行真实数据微调，显著提升了下游导丝端点定位性能，平均定位误差（MPE）从16.01像素降至7.71像素，3像素阈值下的关键点正确率（PCK）从52.63%提升至86.27%，推动了机器人辅助导丝输送系统向更临床可靠的部署迈进。更重要的是，所提出的在严格背景保持和解剖可行性约束下的可控设备合成核心设计理念，有望迁移至其他标注数据稀缺的介入设备感知任务中。

</details>


### [15] [General Covariant Action Modeling: Constructing Generalized Manifolds via Spatio-Temporal Decoupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00110)
*Huaihai Lyu,Chaofan Chen,Mingyu Cao,Yuheng Ji,Changsheng Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出广义动作流形（GAM）框架，通过结构解耦实现时间不变性和几何不变性，使策略从有限演示中鲁棒泛化，在具身智能任务上优于几何无关的基线方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有方法通过回归绝对坐标来实现具身智能的泛化，这违背了广义协变性原理，将任务的内在几何结构与刚性的执行模式相混淆，导致策略被绑定到特定的运动风格和固定速度上。

Method: 提出GAM框架，通过两个正交维度的不变性强制实现广义协变性：(1) 时间不变性——使用弧长参数化器将空间路径几何与时间动力学解耦，实现速度变化下的鲁棒性；(2) 几何不变性——通过Schema-Affine-Factorization机制将轨迹映射到姿态归一化坐标系中的规范"世界线"，区分不变几何模式与仿射调制。将GAM集成到结构化VLA架构中，使稀疏演示密集地填充连续有效的动作流形。

Result: GAM展现出优越的迁移和鲁棒能力，在性能上超越了几何无关的基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过结构解耦实现广义协变性是解决具身智能从有限数据中鲁棒泛化的有效途径，GAM框架通过时间与几何两个维度的不变性设计，成功实现了这一目标。

Original Abstract: Achieving robust generalization from limited data is a central challenge in embodied intelligence. Prevailing methods fail by regressing absolute coordinates, which violates the principle of general covariance. Fundamentally, this conflates the intrinsic task geometry with rigid execution patterns, binding policies to specific motion styles and fixed speeds. To resolve this, we propose the Generalized Action Manifold (GAM) framework that enforces general covariance through structural disentanglement. Specifically, GAM realizes the manifold by enforcing invariance across two orthogonal dimensions: (1) Temporal Invariance, utilizing an Arc-Length Parameterizer to orthogonalize the spatial path geometry from temporal dynamics, ensuring robustness to velocity variations; (2) Geometric Invariance, where a Schema-Affine-Factorization mechanism maps trajectories to canonical ``world lines'' in a pose-normalized coordinate frame. This distinguishes invariant geometric schemas from affine modulations, ensuring spatial generalizability. By integrating GAM within a structured Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architecture, we enable sparse demonstrations to densely populate a continuous, valid action manifold. Empirical results demonstrate that GAM enables superior transfer and robustness capabilities, outperforming geometry-agnostic baselines.

中文摘要翻译: 从有限数据中实现鲁棒的泛化是具身智能的一项核心挑战。现有方法通过回归绝对坐标来尝试解决该问题，但这违背了广义协变性原理。从根本上说，这混淆了任务的内在几何结构与刚性的执行模式，将策略绑定到特定的运动风格和固定的速度上。为解决这一问题，我们提出了广义动作流形（GAM）框架，通过结构解耦来强制实现广义协变性。具体而言，GAM通过在两个正交维度上强制不变性来构建该流形：（1）时间不变性——利用弧长参数化器将空间路径几何与时间动力学正交解耦，确保对速度变化的鲁棒性；（2）几何不变性——通过模式-仿射-分解机制将轨迹映射到姿态归一化坐标系中的规范"世界线"，从而区分不变的几何模式与仿射调制，确保空间泛化能力。通过将GAM集成到结构化的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）架构中，我们使得稀疏的演示能够密集地填充一个连续且有效的动作流形。实验结果表明，GAM展现出卓越的迁移和鲁棒性能，优于几何无关的基线方法。

</details>


### [16] [Recursive Vision Transformer with Dynamic Depth and Width Adjustment for Resource-Efficient Image Semantic Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00114)
*Zhilong Zhang,Xinhui Zhang,Gongyu Jin,Sihua Wang,Danpu Liu,Changchuan Yin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于递归视觉Transformer（ViT）的图像语义通信系统，通过递归结构减少参数量，并设计了三种动态调整策略（动态深度、动态宽度、联合宽深优化）来降低计算复杂度，在资源受限设备上实现了更高效的部署。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有图像语义通信系统通常具有较大的内存占用和高计算复杂度，难以部署在资源受限的设备上。

Method: 采用递归结构迭代细化语义特征并减少参数量；设计了三种动态调整策略：动态深度调整（根据图像内容和信道条件自适应决定递归模块数量）、动态宽度调整（选择性保留重要神经元和注意力头）、联合宽度-深度优化（提供灵活的计算配置）。

Result: 在相当的计算复杂度下，参数量减少48.7%，且重建质量优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 所提出的递归ViT架构结合三种动态调整策略，有效降低了模型参数量和计算复杂度，同时保持了较高的重建质量，适合部署在资源受限设备上。

Original Abstract: Image semantic communication is a critical component in next-generation wireless communication systems. However, such systems typically suffer from large memory footprints and high computational complexity, making them difficult to deploy on resource-constrained devices. To address these challenges, we propose a vision transformer (ViT)-enabled image semantic communication system. In this system, a recursive structure is introduced to iteratively refine semantic features and reduce the parameter count. In addition, three dynamic adjustment strategies are designed to adaptively reduce computational complexity: dynamic depth adjustment, dynamic width adjustment, and joint width-depth optimization. Dynamic depth adjustment adaptively determines the number of recursive modules according to image content and channel conditions, while dynamic width adjustment selectively preserves important neurons and attention heads. The joint width-depth optimization further enables flexible computation configurations. Simulation results verify that the proposed recursive ViT-based system, combined with the three dynamic adjustment strategies, reduces the parameter count by 48.7% and achieves higher reconstruction quality than existing baselines under comparable computational complexity.

中文摘要翻译: 图像语义通信是下一代无线通信系统中的关键组成部分。然而，此类系统通常存在内存占用大和计算复杂度高的问题，难以部署在资源受限的设备上。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种基于视觉Transformer（ViT）的图像语义通信系统。在该系统中，引入递归结构以迭代细化语义特征并减少参数量。此外，设计了三种动态调整策略来自适应降低计算复杂度：动态深度调整、动态宽度调整以及联合宽度-深度优化。动态深度调整根据图像内容和信道条件自适应地确定递归模块的数量，而动态宽度调整则选择性保留重要的神经元和注意力头。联合宽度-深度优化进一步实现了灵活的计算配置。仿真结果验证，所提出的基于递归ViT的系统结合三种动态调整策略，在相当的计算复杂度下，参数量减少了48.7%，并且取得了比现有基线方法更高的重建质量。

</details>


### [17] [Physics from Video: Identifiability of Time-Invariant Second-Order ODEs under Minimal Trajectory Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00115)
*Yuanyuan Wang,Wenjie Wang,Kun Zhang,Mingming Gong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究从原始像素视频中识别连续时间物理定律的结构可辨识性，证明在水平集斜率覆盖条件下，仅编码器管道可局部仿射恢复二阶线性ODE参数，并给出了不同阻尼 regime 的最小数据需求，提出方差地板正则化器防止潜在坍塌。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 弥合视觉真实感与物理理解之间的鸿沟，探索能否在不依赖像素重建的情况下，仅从视频像素中可靠地恢复物理定律的参数。

Method: 提出一种仅编码器（decoder-free）管道，利用水平集斜率覆盖条件确保潜在空间与真实物理状态局部仿射；引入方差地板正则化器（variance-floor regularizer）稳定目标函数并防止潜在坍塌。

Result: 理论上首次刻画了不同阻尼 regime 下的最小数据需求：欠阻尼系统仅需单个视频片段即可识别，其他 regime 需要三个不同轨迹。在合成数据和真实数据上验证了方法有效性。

Conclusion: 可解释的物理常数可以无需计算密集的像素重建直接从视频中可靠估计，在确保物理正确性和透明性的同时降低了计算成本。

Original Abstract: Bridging the gap between visual realism and physical understanding is a core challenge for video-based world models. We study the structural identifiability of continuous-time physical laws from raw pixels, focusing on whether an encoder-only pipeline can uniquely recover the parameters of second-order linear ODEs. We prove that a level-set slope-coverage condition ensures the learned latent space is locally affine to the true physical state, enabling exact parameter recovery. Our theory provides the first characterization of minimal data requirements across damping regimes, establishing that underdamped systems are identifiable from a single video clip, whereas other regimes require three diverse trajectories. We further introduce a variance-floor regularizer to stabilize the decoder-free objective and prevent latent collapse. Validated on synthetic and real-world data, our approach demonstrates that interpretable physical constants can be reliably estimated from video without the need for compute-intensive pixel reconstruction, ensuring both physical correctness and transparency. Code is available at https://github.com/wenjiewang3/PhysicsFromVideo.

中文摘要翻译: 弥合视觉真实感与物理理解之间的鸿沟是基于视频的世界模型面临的核心挑战。本文研究从原始像素中识别连续时间物理定律的结构可辨识性，重点关注仅编码器管道能否唯一恢复二阶线性常微分方程的参数。我们证明，水平集斜率覆盖条件可确保所学潜在空间与真实物理状态局部仿射，从而实现精确的参数恢复。我们的理论首次刻画了不同阻尼 regime 下的最小数据需求，证实欠阻尼系统可从单个视频片段中识别，而其他 regime 则需要三个不同的轨迹。我们进一步引入方差地板正则化器，以稳定无解码器目标函数并防止潜在坍塌。在合成数据和真实数据上的验证表明，无需计算密集的像素重建，即可从视频中可靠地估计可解释的物理常数，从而确保物理正确性和透明性。代码参见 https://github.com/wenjiewang3/PhysicsFromVideo。

</details>


### [18] [Hist2Style: Histogram-Guided Stylization with Bilateral Grids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01819)
*Dekel Galor,Adam Pikielny,Zhoutong Zhang,Ke Wang,Laura Waller,Jiawen Chen,Ilya Chugunov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Hist2Style提出了一种基于双边网格的快速边缘感知风格化方法，通过蒸馏大模型为轻量网络，利用直方图嵌入实现可交互的高分辨率真实感风格迁移，避免了幻觉并支持实时调整。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有的大图像模型虽然能进行外观编辑，但存在计算开销大、易产生幻觉（伪影）以及用户控制能力有限的问题，难以满足高分辨率实时工作流的需求。

Result: 该方法在结构上保持内容不变，避免了幻觉，支持实时、高分辨率的逼真风格化，并允许交互式用户可控的颜色和色调调整。

Conclusion: Hist2Style通过双边网格约束和直方图嵌入，在保持内容结构的同时实现了高效、可控的真实感风格迁移，解决了大模型计算成本高和不可控的问题。

Original Abstract: Photorealistic style transfer aims to match the color and tone of an input image to that of a style target while preserving the content and details of the original scene. Although existing large image models can facilitate these kinds of appearance edits, their high computational demands, potential for hallucinations, and limited user control make them unsuitable for high-resolution, real-time workflows. We introduce Hist2Style, a bilateral-grid formulation for fast, edge-aware stylization that preserves visual fidelity by constraining operations to locally affine transforms in bilateral space. Our model distills a large image editing model into a lightweight network by training on a large supervised corpus generated with language and vision-language models, targeting spatially varying color edits. The network conditions on a histogram-based embedding of the style target to provide an interpretable interface for adjusting the output style by modifying the target color distribution. Overall, Hist2Style maintains content structure by construction, avoids hallucinations, and supports real-time, high-resolution photorealistic stylization with interactive user-controllable color and tone adjustments.

中文摘要翻译: 逼真的风格迁移旨在将输入图像的颜色和色调与风格目标匹配，同时保留原始场景的内容和细节。虽然现有的大图像模型可以促进这类外观编辑，但其高计算需求、潜在的幻觉问题以及有限的用户控制使其不适合高分辨率的实时工作流。我们提出了Hist2Style——一种基于双边网格的快速边缘感知风格化方法，通过将操作约束为双边空间中的局部仿射变换来保持视觉保真度。我们的模型通过在大规模监督语料（由语言模型和视觉-语言模型生成）上训练，将大图像编辑模型蒸馏为轻量网络，专注于空间变化的颜色编辑。该网络以基于直方图的风格目标嵌入为条件，提供一种可解释的接口，允许用户通过修改目标颜色分布来调整输出风格。总体而言，Hist2Style在结构上保持内容不变，避免了幻觉，并支持实时、高分辨率的逼真风格化，同时允许交互式用户可控的颜色和色调调整。

### [19] [Versatile Framework with Semantic and Structural guidance for Image Reconstruction from Brain Activity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00121)
*Yizhuo Lu,Changde Du,Qiongyi Zhou,Liuyun Jiang,Huiguang He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MindDiffuser，一种两阶段图像重建框架，利用CLIP文本和视觉特征从脑记录（fMRI、EEG、MEG）中重建视觉刺激，解决了现有方法在细粒度结构信息（位置、方向、大小）上与原刺激一致性不足的问题。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有基于文本到图像生成模型的脑解码方法虽能在语义上接近原始视觉刺激，但在位置、方向和大小等细粒度结构信息上难以保持一致，影响了模型的可控性和可解释性。

Method: 两阶段框架：Stage 1将脑信号解码得到的CLIP文本嵌入输入Stable Diffusion生成含语义信息的初步图像；Stage 2利用解码的浅层CLIP视觉特征作为监督信号，通过反向传播迭代优化Stage 1的特征向量以对齐结构信息。

Result: 在fMRI、EEG、MEG三种模态的脑响应数据集上，MindDiffuser显著优于现有最先进模型，空间和时间可视化结果进一步支持了该框架的神经生物学合理性。

Conclusion: MindDiffuser实现了语义与结构信息的一致性重建，提升了模型的可控性和可解释性，为未来跨模态脑信号解码提供了指导。

Original Abstract: Reconstructing visual stimuli from brain recordings has been a meaningful and challenging task in brain decoding. Especially, the achievement of precise and controllable image reconstruction bears great significance in propelling the progress and utilization of brain-computer interfaces. Recent methods, leveraging advances in the power of text-to-image generation models, have reconstructed images that closely approximate complex natural stimuli in terms of semantics (e.g., concepts and objects). However, they struggle to maintain consistency with the original stimuli in fine-grained structural information (e.g., position, orientation and size), which undermines both the controllability and interpretability of the models. To address the aforementioned issues, we propose a two-stage image reconstruction framework, termed MindDiffuser. In Stage 1, Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) text embeddings decoded from brain responses are input into Stable Diffusion, generating a preliminary image containing semantic information. In Stage 2, we use decoded shallow CLIP visual features as supervisory signals, iteratively refining the feature vectors from Stage 1 via backpropagation to align structural information. We conducted extensive experiments on brain response datasets across three modalities (fMRI, EEG, MEG) elicited by visual stimuli, demonstrating that our framework significantly enhances the performance of previous state-of-the-art models, highlighting the effectiveness and versatility of our approach. Spatial and temporal visualization results further support the neurobiological plausibility of our framework, providing guidance for future neural decoding efforts across different brain signal modalities.

中文摘要翻译: 从脑记录中重建视觉刺激一直是脑解码领域一项有意义且具有挑战性的任务。特别是，实现精确且可控的图像重建对于推动脑机接口的进步与应用具有重要意义。近年来，借助文本到图像生成模型能力的提升，现有方法已能重建出在语义（如概念和物体）上高度近似复杂自然刺激的图像。然而，这些方法在细粒度结构信息（如位置、方向和大小）上难以与原刺激保持一致，这削弱了模型的可控性和可解释性。针对上述问题，我们提出了一种两阶段图像重建框架，称为MindDiffuser。在第一阶段，将从脑响应中解码得到的对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）文本嵌入输入到Stable Diffusion中，生成包含语义信息的初步图像。在第二阶段，我们利用解码得到的浅层CLIP视觉特征作为监督信号，通过反向传播迭代优化来自第一阶段的特征向量，以对齐结构信息。我们在由视觉刺激诱发的三种模态（fMRI、EEG、MEG）脑响应数据集上进行了大量实验，结果表明我们的框架显著提升了现有最先进模型的性能，验证了我们方法的有效性和多模态适用性。空间和时间可视化结果进一步支持了我们框架的神经生物学合理性，为未来不同脑信号模态的神经解码工作提供了指导。

</details>

*Jingyun Liang,Min Wei,Shikai Li,Yizeng Han,Hangjie Yuan,Lei Sun,Weihua Chen,Fan Wang*

  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 探究视频扩散模型是否真正理解底层3D结构，而非仅生成合理的2D投影；现有方法依赖渲染的2D运动引导视频，存在视角依赖伪影和轨迹-姿态不匹配问题。

Original Abstract: Diffusion models have shown remarkable success in video generation. However, whether such models are truly aware of the 3D structure underlying visual observations, rather than simply reproducing plausible 2D projections, remains an open question. In this work, we investigate this question through human motion control, a task that requires precise modelling of 3D human geometry, motion, camera viewpoint, and scene context. Unlike prior methods that rely on rendered 2D motion guidance videos, we propose a render-free framework that conditions video generation directly on compressed 3D human mesh tokens. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance on human motion control benchmarks, while reducing artifacts induced by view-dependent 2D guidance and trajectory-pose mismatches during editing. These findings suggest that video diffusion models, when equipped with mesh tokenization, can better capture complex 3D human structures and their interactions with the surrounding environment.

中文摘要翻译: 扩散模型在视频生成领域取得了显著成功。然而，这类模型是否真正意识到视觉观测背后的3D结构，而仅仅是复现合理的2D投影，仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。本文通过人体运动控制任务来探究这一问题，该任务需要对3D人体几何、运动、相机视角和场景上下文进行精确建模。不同于以往依赖渲染的2D运动引导视频的方法，我们提出了一种无渲染框架，直接以压缩的3D人体网格令牌作为视频生成的条件。该表示保留了完整的3D几何信息，同时支持基于令牌的统一生成流水线，该流水线在DiT架构中联合处理视频令牌和运动令牌。这种设计要求模型在视频生成过程中同时推理外观、3D结构和相机视角。实验结果表明，该方法在人体运动控制基准上取得了强劲性能，同时减少了由视角依赖的2D引导和编辑过程中轨迹-姿态不匹配所引入的伪影。这些发现表明，配备了网格令牌化的视频扩散模型能够更好地捕捉复杂3D人体结构及其与周围环境的交互。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Original Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong performance on public medical benchmarks, yet existing evaluations often remain weak proxies for clinical use, relying on isolated inputs and simplified recognition-style tasks. We introduce CardioLens, a leakage-resistant evaluation testbed for multi-sequence Cardiovascular Magnetic Resonance (CMR), constructed from private hospital archives through a rigorous report-to-QA construction and verification pipeline. CardioLens contains 473,896 slices and 13,494 verified QA pairs across 4D Cine, LGE, perfusion, and T2-weighted imaging, and evaluates three stages of CMR interpretation: image understanding, report generation, and disease diagnosis. Across 24 state-of-the-art MLLMs, CardioLens reveals a substantial clinical reality gap: models perform poorly overall, with performance degrading along the real CMR workflow. Confusion analysis further shows a category-collapse failure mode, where models default to frequent abnormal categories rather than distinguishing clinically distinct findings. To rule out MLLM-compatible input construction as the primary cause, we compare random, clinically motivated, and data-driven slice selection protocols under different slice budgets; performance changes only marginally, typically by about 1%. These results show that current MLLMs remain far from reliable CMR interpretation, where clinical decisions require integrating distributed evidence across sequences, views, and temporal phases. ### [22] [Positional Encodings Anchor Spatial Structure in Vision Transformers: A Geometric Perspective on Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00124)
*Mahmoud Mannes*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了视觉Transformer中不同位置编码对内部空间表征几何结构的影响，提出了空间相似性距离相关（SSDC）指标，发现位置编码通过建立稳定的索引锚定空间组织来提升模型在内容破坏性分布偏移下的鲁棒性，且鲁棒性主要依赖稳定的位置参考框架而非具体编码机制。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 尽管已知位置编码会影响ViT的性能和鲁棒性，但其如何塑造内部空间表征尚不清楚，本文旨在从几何角度理解不同位置编码对ViT内部表征空间结构的影响及其与鲁棒性的关系。

Result: （1）无位置编码的ViT仍能发展出非平凡的空间结构，但该结构由视觉内容驱动且会在token置换下崩溃；（2）所有位置编码都会使表征向索引锚定的空间组织一致偏移，在内容破坏扰动下保持稳定并显著提升鲁棒性；（3）不同位置编码产生不同的深度方向空间结构轨迹，但鲁棒性大体相似，表明鲁棒性更依赖稳定的位置参考框架而非具体编码机制。

Conclusion: 位置编码通过建立稳定的索引锚定空间参考框架来塑造ViT的内部表征几何，这种框架的存在而非具体编码方式是实现内容破坏性分布偏移下鲁棒性的关键因素，为未来编码方案的原理性设计提供了启示。

Original Abstract: Positional embeddings (PEs) in Vision Transformers (ViTs) are known to impact performance and robustness, but their role in shaping internal spatial representations is not well understood. In this work, we study how different forms of PEs influence the representational geometry of ViTs and how these changes relate to robustness under content-disrupting distribution shifts. We introduce a metric, the Spatial Similarity Distance Correlation (SSDC), to quantify spatial structure in token representations. Using this metric, we show that ViTs trained without PEs still develop non-trivial spatial structure, but this structure is driven by visual content and collapses under token permutation. In contrast, we find that all PEs considered (learned absolute, sinusoidal, and rotary) are associated with a consistent shift toward an index-anchored spatial organization. Representations in these models remain stable under perturbations that disrupt content, and exhibit substantially improved robustness to such distributional shifts. We further show that while different PEs produce distinct depth-wise trajectories of spatial structure, their robustness properties are largely similar (with secondary variation across encoding schemes), suggesting that robustness appears to depend on the presence of a stable positional reference frame more than it depends on the specific encoding mechanism. These results offer a geometric account of how positional encodings shape internal representations, with implications for the principled design of future encoding schemes.

中文摘要翻译: 视觉Transformer（ViT）中的位置编码已知会影响性能和鲁棒性，但其在塑造内部空间表征中的作用尚未被充分理解。本文研究了不同形式的位置编码如何影响ViT的表征几何，以及这些变化如何与内容破坏性分布偏移下的鲁棒性相关联。我们引入了一个度量指标——空间相似性距离相关（SSDC），用于量化token表示中的空间结构。通过该指标，我们展示了未使用位置编码训练的ViT仍然能发展出非平凡的空间结构，但这种结构由视觉内容驱动，且会在token置换下崩溃。相比之下，我们发现所有被考虑的位置编码（可学习绝对位置编码、正弦位置编码和旋转位置编码）都与朝向索引锚定的空间组织的一致偏移相关。这些模型中的表征在破坏内容的扰动下保持稳定，并呈现出对此类分布偏移显著提升的鲁棒性。我们进一步表明，尽管不同位置编码产生了不同的深度方向空间结构轨迹，但其鲁棒性属性大体相似（编码方案间存在次要差异），这表明鲁棒性似乎更依赖于稳定的位置参考框架的存在，而非具体编码机制。这些结果为位置编码如何塑造内部表征提供了几何层面的解释，并对未来编码方案的原理性设计具有启示意义。

Conclusion: 为学习驱动的3D网格纹理化提供了结构化视角，有助于指导该领域的未来发展方向。

Original Abstract: Texturing 3D meshes plays a vital role in determining the visual realism of digital objects and scenes. Although recent generative 3D approaches based on Neural Radiance Fields and Gaussian Splatting can produce textured assets directly, polygonal meshes remain the core representation across modeling, animation, visual effects, and gaming pipelines. Neural 3D mesh texturing therefore continues to be an essential and active area of research. In this survey, we present a comprehensive review of recent advances in neural 3D mesh texturing, covering methods for texture synthesis, transfer, and completion. We first summarize key foundations in mesh geometry, texture mapping, differentiable rendering, and neural generative models, and then organize the literature into a unified taxonomy spanning early GAN-based methods to modern diffusion-based pipelines. We further analyze common architectures and supervision strategies, review datasets and evaluation protocols, and discuss emerging applications, practical/commercial systems, and open challenges. Together, these insights provide a structured perspective on the current landscape and help guide future developments in learning-based 3D mesh texturing.

中文摘要翻译: 纹理化3D网格在决定数字对象和场景的视觉真实感方面起着至关重要的作用。尽管近年来基于神经辐射场和3D高斯泼溅的生成式3D方法可以直接生成带纹理的资产，但多边形网格仍然是建模、动画、视觉特效和游戏管线中的核心表示。因此，神经3D网格纹理化仍然是一个重要且活跃的研究领域。在本综述中，我们对神经3D网格纹理化的最新进展进行了全面回顾，涵盖了纹理合成、迁移和补全方法。我们首先总结了网格几何、纹理映射、可微渲染和神经生成模型等关键基础，然后将文献组织成一个统一的分类法，涵盖从早期基于GAN的方法到现代基于扩散的管线。我们进一步分析了通用架构和监督策略，回顾了数据集和评估协议，并讨论了新兴应用、实际/商业系统及开放挑战。这些见解共同为当前领域的格局提供了结构化视角，并有助于指导学习驱动的3D网格纹理化的未来发展。

Method: 在方向提升空间（orientation-lifted space）中直接定义切线可容许性，将路径切线限制在由内在形状代表（ISR，如骨架或内部标志点）导出的空间变化角度扇区内；构造切线约束的Finsler度量族，扩展经典曲率惩罚测地线模型；通过Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman偏微分方程及快速行进法变体实现高效数值求解，保持单次遍历计算复杂度。

Original Abstract: Curvature-penalized geodesic models have proven their effectiveness in image segmentation by computing globally optimal curves. Unfortunately, these models remain susceptible to shortcuts when delineating objects with complex shapes and image intensity distributions, as they lack mechanisms to enforce shape-aware tangent constraints. To address this limitation, we propose a unified geodesic framework that integrates tangent-constrained priors with curvature penalization. The key idea is to formulate tangent admissibility directly within the orientation-lifted space, where path tangents are restricted to spatially varying angular sectors derived from intrinsic shape representatives (ISR) such as skeletons or interior landmarks. This formulation gives rise to a family of tangent-constrained Finslerian metrics, extending the classical curvature-penalized geodesic models while enforcing mandatory tangent constraints. The resulting Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) partial differential equations (PDEs) admit efficient numerical solutions via variants of the fast marching method, preserving the single-pass computational complexity. Experiments on synthetic, natural, and medical images demonstrate that the proposed geodesic framework indeed improves robustness against weak boundaries and topological shortcuts, yielding segmentation results with enhanced shape fidelity compared to existing geodesic models.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有AVR基准将感知、规则归纳和答案选择合并为一个对错信号，无法检测模型“知道规则但选错答案”的现象，需要将最终错误归因到具体子步骤。

Method: 构建StemBind基准：基于同一视觉主干设计三个对齐问题（P感知/R规则/F完整），涵盖9种可审计视觉操作、2298个主干、19533个任务；每个完整项标注Sternberg四阶段（S1编码、S2推断、S3映射、S4应用）。

Result: (i) 22/24模型规则准确率高于完整项准确率（R-F鸿沟）；(ii) 即使P和R都正确，模型在51.2%情况下F仍错误（持久绑定差距）；(iii) 瓶颈在S3映射阶段；(iv) 更大模型和思维链推理无法可靠缩小差距，思维链甚至降低准确率。

Conclusion: AVR评估应从最终答案排名转向定位推理断裂点，规则到实例的绑定是视觉推理的具体下一步目标。

Original Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often know the rule but pick the wrong answer: on abstract visual reasoning (AVR) tasks, a model can describe what it sees and name the underlying pattern, yet still fail to choose the matching candidate. Existing AVR benchmarks cannot detect this because they collapse perception, rule induction, and answer selection into a single right-or-wrong signal. We introduce StemBind, a shared-stem diagnostic benchmark that probes the same visual stem with three aligned questions: Perception (what is in the image), Rule (what pattern governs it), and Full (which option completes it), so a final-answer error can be attributed to a specific sub-step on the same evidence. StemBind contains 2,298 curated knowledge-light stems across nine auditable visual operations, totaling 19,533 P/R/F tasks, with each full item annotated by Sternberg's four reasoning stages (S1 Encode, S2 Infer, S3 Map, S4 Apply). Evaluating 24 frontier MLLM configurations yields four findings. (i) The R-F chasm: rule accuracy exceeds full-item accuracy on 22 of 24 models, so most failures happen after the rule is identified. (ii) A persistent binding gap: even when P and R are both correct on the same stem, models still answer F incorrectly 51.2% of the time. (iii) The bottleneck is S3: process diagnostics and Stage-wise Stimulus Augmentation localize the dominant failure to rule-to-instance mapping. (iv) Scaling and thinking do not help: neither larger models nor explicit thinking mode reliably closes the gap, and thinking even lowers rule and full-item accuracy. StemBind reframes AVR evaluation from final-answer ranking to locating where abstract visual reasoning breaks down, identifying rule-to-instance binding as a concrete next target for vision-grounded reasoning.

中文摘要翻译: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）常常"知道规则但选错答案"：在抽象视觉推理（AVR）任务中，模型可以描述所看到的内容并命名底层规律，却仍然无法选出匹配的候选答案。现有AVR基准无法检测这一问题，因为它们将感知、规则归纳和答案选择压缩为一个单一的对错信号。我们提出StemBind——一个共享主干的诊断基准，基于同一视觉主干提出三个对齐的问题：感知（图像中有什么）、规则（支配图像的规律是什么）和完整（哪个选项能补全它），从而将最终答案的错误归因到同一证据下的特定子步骤。StemBind包含2,298个经过精心挑选、知识需求低的视觉主干，涵盖九种可审计的视觉操作，总计19,533个P/R/F任务，每个完整项均按Sternberg的四个推理阶段（S1编码、S2推断、S3映射、S4应用）进行标注。对24种前沿MLLM配置的评估得出四项发现：（i）R-F鸿沟：22/24个模型的规则准确率高于完整项准确率，说明大多数失败发生在规则被识别之后；（ii）持久的绑定差距：即使在同一主干上P和R都正确，模型在51.2%的情况下F仍然回答错误；（iii）瓶颈在S3阶段：过程诊断和分阶段刺激增强将主要失败定位于规则到实例的映射；（iv）缩放与思维无效：更大的模型和显式思维链模式均无法可靠地缩小这一差距，思维链甚至降低了规则和完整项的准确率。StemBind将AVR评估从最终答案排名重新定义为定位抽象视觉推理的断裂点，并将规则到实例的绑定确定为视觉推理下一步的具体目标。

</details>


### [26] [DiffCrossGait: Trajectory-Level Alignment for 2D-3D Cross-Modal Gait Recognition via Latent Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00153)
*Zhiyang Lu,Ming Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DiffCrossGait，利用潜在扩散空间中的轨迹级对齐来解决跨模态2D-3D步态识别中的域差异问题，通过共享高斯噪声驱动两种模态实现生成过程中的连续对齐，并在推理时消除迭代去噪的计算开销，在SUSTech1K和FreeGait基准上达到SOTA性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有跨模态步态识别方法仅在最终嵌入层面进行对齐，忽略了2D轮廓与3D LiDAR距离视图之间的固有多模态域差异，无法充分弥合模态鸿沟。

Method: 提出DiffCrossGait框架，将跨模态匹配重新定义为身份相关潜在扩散空间中的轨迹级对齐。通过共享高斯噪声驱动2D和3D两种模态，引入三阶段对齐策略（Tri-Phase Alignment Strategy），利用不同噪声强度强制实现身份锚定、动力学一致性和跨模态结构可恢复性。扩散机制仅作为训练目标，推理时无需迭代去噪，保持高效推理。

Result: 在SUSTech1K和FreeGait两个基准数据集上达到了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: 所提出的轨迹级对齐方法能有效弥合2D与3D步态表征之间的域差异，且扩散机制作为训练目标的设计保证了推理效率，为跨模态步态识别提供了新的有效范式。

Original Abstract: Cross-modal 2D-3D gait recognition is impeded by inherent domain discrepancies between 2D silhouette and 3D LiDAR range-view representations. While prior methods align only final embeddings, we propose DiffCrossGait, which reformulates cross-modal matching as trajectory-level alignment in an identity-relevant latent diffusion space, rather than assuming full equivalence between 2D and 3D observations. By driving both modalities with shared Gaussian noise within a latent space, we enable continuous alignment throughout the generative evolution. We introduce a Tri-Phase Alignment Strategy that exploits varying noise intensities to enforce identity anchoring, dynamics consistency, and cross-modal structural recoverability, thereby constraining both modalities to share denoising dynamics and bottleneck structure, which promotes modality-invariant gait features. Crucially, our framework decouples generative alignment from the discriminative backbone; the diffusion mechanism serves exclusively as a training objective, ensuring high inference efficiency by eliminating the computational overhead of iterative denoising. Extensive experiments on the SUSTech1K and FreeGait benchmarks demonstrate that DiffCrossGait achieves state-of-the-art performance.

中文摘要翻译: 跨模态2D-3D步态识别受到2D轮廓与3D激光雷达距离视图表征之间固有多模态域差异的阻碍。虽然先前的方法仅在最终嵌入层面进行对齐，但我们提出的DiffCrossGait将跨模态匹配重新定义为身份相关潜在扩散空间中的轨迹级对齐，而非假设2D和3D观测完全等价。通过在潜在空间中用共享高斯噪声驱动两种模态，我们实现了生成进化过程中的连续对齐。我们引入了一种三阶段对齐策略，利用不同的噪声强度来强制实现身份锚定、动力学一致性和跨模态结构可恢复性，从而约束两种模态共享去噪动力学和瓶颈结构，促进模态不变的步态特征。最关键的是，我们的框架将生成式对齐与判别性主干网络解耦；扩散机制仅作为训练目标，通过消除迭代去噪的计算开销来确保高推理效率。在SUSTech1K和FreeGait基准上的大量实验表明，DiffCrossGait达到了最先进的性能。

</details>


### [27] [Digital-to-Physical Transfer of Adversarial Patches for Aerial Vehicle Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00159)
*Jung Heum Woo,Eun-Kyu Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了针对航空目标检测器的物理对抗补丁攻击，通过数字域优化与物理域部署的桥接，发现OFF补丁在数字域效果最佳（85.51% AORR），而ON补丁在物理环境中鲁棒性更强（OSR 0.197-0.343），并指出天气增强对补丁优化帮助有限。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 深度神经网络目标检测器在航空和卫星图像分析中广泛应用，但已知易受对抗样本攻击，使用可打印图案的物理对抗攻击构成现实安全威胁。本文旨在评估物理对抗补丁攻击对航空目标检测器的实际威胁。

Method: 在数字域中使用损失函数优化对抗补丁，该函数最小化最大目标性分数，并引入不可打印性分数（NPS）和总变差（TV）约束以确保可打印性和空间平滑性。优化后的补丁被打印并以三种配置（ON、OFF、OFF-Side）部署在物理环境中进行测试。

Result: 使用YOLOv3检测器的实验表明：OFF补丁在数字域效果最佳（85.51%平均目标性降低率AORR），但ON补丁在物理环境中鲁棒性更强（目标性分数比OSR为0.197-0.343）。此外，基于天气的数据增强并不一定能改善该领域的补丁优化。

Conclusion: 这些发现为航空目标检测系统的实际漏洞提供了关键见解，表明数字域性能最优的补丁在物理环境中未必表现最好，物理域中补丁的持续可见性对攻击鲁棒性至关重要。

Original Abstract: Deep neural network (DNN)-based object detectors are widely used for analyzing aerial and satellite imagery in applications such as environmental monitoring and urban analytics. Despite their strong performance, these models are known to be vulnerable to adversarial examples, and physical adversarial attacks using printable patterns pose realistic security threats. In this paper, we evaluate physical adversarial patch attacks against an aerial vehicle detector by bridging digital optimization and real-world deployment. Adversarial patches are optimized in the digital domain using a loss function that minimizes the maximum objectness score while incorporating non-printability score (NPS) and total variation (TV) constraints to ensure both printability and spatial smoothness. The optimized patches are printed and deployed in three configurations: ON, OFF, and OFF-Side. Experiments using a YOLOv3 detector show that while the OFF patch achieves the highest effectiveness in the digital domain (85.51% Average Objectness Reduction Rate (AORR)), the ON patch demonstrates superior robustness in physical environments (0.197-0.343 Objectness Score Ratio (OSR)) due to its consistent visibility. Furthermore, our results indicate that weather-based augmentation does not necessarily improve patch optimization in this domain. These findings provide critical insights into the practical vulnerabilities of aerial object detection systems.

中文摘要翻译: 基于深度神经网络的目标检测器广泛应用于环境监测和城市分析等应用中的航空和卫星图像分析。尽管性能强劲，但这些模型已知易受对抗样本攻击，使用可打印图案的物理对抗攻击构成了现实的安全威胁。在本文中，我们通过桥接数字优化和实际部署，评估了针对航空飞行器检测器的物理对抗补丁攻击。对抗补丁在数字域中使用损失函数进行优化，该函数最小化最大目标性分数，同时引入不可打印性分数（NPS）和总变差（TV）约束以确保可打印性和空间平滑性。优化后的补丁被打印并以三种配置部署：ON、OFF和OFF-Side。使用YOLOv3检测器的实验表明，虽然OFF补丁在数字域中实现了最高效果（85.51%平均目标性降低率AORR），但由于其一致的可见性，ON补丁在物理环境中表现出更强的鲁棒性（0.197-0.343目标性分数比OSR）。此外，我们的结果表明，基于天气的数据增强并不一定能改善该领域的补丁优化。这些发现为航空目标检测系统的实际漏洞提供了关键见解。

</details>


### [28] [MyoSem: Aligning Electromyography to Natural-Language Action Semantics for Hand Action Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00174)
*Chiyue Wang,Dong She,Yang Gao,Zhanpeng Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MyoSem提出了一种EMG信号与动作文本描述的双向语义对齐框架，将肌电动作理解从固定标签分类扩展为可查询的语义检索范式。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有EMG方法将手势动作理解建模为固定标签的分类问题，难以支持基于动作描述的查询、检索和泛化，限制了EMG在人机交互中的灵活应用。

Method: MyoSem包含三个核心模块：多视角动作语义构建（从多视角文本描述构建共享语义空间）、激活感知EMG编码（关注肌肉激活区域的信号编码）、语义查询对齐（实现EMG信号与文本描述的双向检索）。

Conclusion: MyoSem将基于EMG的手部动作理解从固定标签识别推进到可查询的双向语义检索，为语言介导的EMG动作理解提供了新的建模范式。

Original Abstract: Electromyography (EMG) directly reflects muscle activation and is a key sensing modality for gesture recognition, prosthetic control, and wearable interaction. Existing EMG methods, however, commonly formulate hand action understanding as classification over fixed labels, making it difficult to support querying, retrieval, and generalization based on action descriptions. We present MyoSem, an EMG--action semantic alignment framework that maps low-level EMG signals into a shared semantic space constructed from multi-view action descriptions. MyoSem combines multi-view action-semantic construction, activation-aware EMG encoding, and semantic query alignment, enabling bidirectional retrieval between EMG signals and text descriptions. We systematically evaluate MyoSem on EMG2Pose and NinaPro-series datasets. Results show that MyoSem performs well on EMG--text bidirectional retrieval, generally outperforms most baselines, and shows favorable generalization to unseen users, held-out action classes, and amputee-user transfer scenarios. Ablations and visualizations further validate the effectiveness of each module. Overall, MyoSem advances EMG-based hand action understanding from fixed-label recognition toward queryable bidirectional semantic retrieval, providing a new modeling paradigm for language-mediated EMG action understanding.

中文摘要翻译: 肌电图（EMG）直接反映肌肉激活状态，是手势识别、假肢控制和可穿戴交互的关键感知模态。然而，现有的EMG方法通常将手部动作理解建模为固定标签的分类问题，这使得难以支持基于动作描述的查询、检索和泛化。我们提出MyoSem——一个EMG-动作语义对齐框架，该框架将低层EMG信号映射到由多视角动作描述构建的共享语义空间中。MyoSem结合了多视角动作语义构建、激活感知EMG编码和语义查询对齐，实现了EMG信号与文本描述之间的双向检索。我们在EMG2Pose和NinaPro系列数据集上系统评估了MyoSem。结果表明，MyoSem在EMG-文本双向检索任务上表现良好，总体上优于大多数基线方法，并在未见用户、未见动作类别和截肢者迁移场景中展现出良好的泛化能力。消融实验和可视化分析进一步验证了各模块的有效性。总体而言，MyoSem将基于EMG的手部动作理解从固定标签识别推进到可查询的双向语义检索，为语言介导的EMG动作理解提供了新的建模范式。

### [29] [APE: Agentic Prompt Enhancer for Image Generation and Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00204)
*Zijian Huang,Jay Zhangjie Wu,Zian Wang,Tianshi Cao,Jiasi Chen,Sanja Fidler,Huan Ling,Xuanchi Ren*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Agentic Prompt Enhancer (APE)，一种通过后训练小型语言模型（SLM）作为提示增强代理的轻量级框架，支持单代理（SAPE）和多代理（MAPE）两种模式，在图像生成和编辑任务中有效提升视觉对齐和指令跟随能力，缩小了与闭源大型提示增强器之间的性能差距。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有文本引导的视觉系统对提示表述高度敏感，语义相似的请求因措辞不同而产生不同输出；而现有的强提示增强器依赖ChatGPT、Gemini等大型闭源LLM，增加了成本、延迟和部署依赖性，因此需要一种轻量级、可训练的提示增强组件。

Method: 提出APE框架，对小型语言模型进行后训练，使其成为提示增强代理。单代理版本SAPE一次性重写提示；多代理版本MAPE将增强过程分解为路由器（Router）、重写器（Rewriter）和组合器（Composer）三个阶段，处理包含对象、属性、空间关系和编辑等组合约束的复杂提示。采用任务感知奖励和后训练协议进行优化。

Result: 在图像生成和编辑基准测试上，后训练的小型提示增强器显著优于其基础版本，缩小了与闭源提示增强器的差距；MAPE在复杂组合任务中表现尤为突出。

Conclusion: 通过后训练小型语言模型作为提示增强代理，可以在不修改下游视觉模型的情况下有效提升视觉对齐和指令跟随能力，提供了一种轻量级、高效且不依赖大型闭源LLM的替代方案。

Original Abstract: Natural language has become a powerful interface for image generation and editing, yet text-guided visual systems remain highly sensitive to prompt formulation. Semantically similar requests can produce different outputs depending on wording, specificity, and how explicitly visual constraints are stated, motivating prompt enhancement as a trainable component rather than a peripheral user choice. Existing strong enhancers often rely on large, proprietary LLMs such as ChatGPT or Gemini, adding cost, latency, and deployment dependence to the visual generation pipeline. We propose Agentic Prompt Enhancer (APE), a lightweight framework that post-trains small language models (SLMs) as prompt-enhancement agents. APE supports both single-agent rewriting and role-specialized multi-agent enhancement. Its single-agent instantiation, SAPE, rewrites the prompt in one pass, while its multi-agent instantiation, MAPE, decomposes enhancement into a router--rewriter--composer process for handling compositional constraints over objects, attributes, spatial relations, and edits. With task-aware rewards and post-training protocols, APE improves visual alignment and prompt following without modifying the downstream visual model. Experiments on challenging image generation and editing benchmarks demonstrate that post-trained small prompt enhancers reliably outperform their base counterparts, narrowing the gap to closed-source prompt enhancers; in addition, MAPE proves particularly strong on complex compositional tasks within these benchmarks.

中文摘要翻译: 自然语言已成为图像生成和编辑的强大接口，但文本引导的视觉系统对提示表述仍然高度敏感。语义相似的请求可能因措辞、具体程度以及视觉约束表述的明确性而产生不同的输出，这促使提示增强应作为一个可训练的组件，而非外围的用户选择。现有的强增强器通常依赖大型专有LLM（如ChatGPT或Gemini），给视觉生成流程增加了成本、延迟和部署依赖性。我们提出Agentic Prompt Enhancer (APE)，一种轻量级框架，通过对小型语言模型（SLM）进行后训练，使其成为提示增强代理。APE支持单代理改写和角色专业化的多代理增强。其单代理实例SAPE一次性重写提示，而多代理实例MAPE将增强过程分解为路由器-重写器-组合器流程，用于处理涉及对象、属性、空间关系和编辑的组合约束。通过任务感知奖励和后训练协议，APE在不修改下游视觉模型的情况下提升了视觉对齐和指令跟随能力。在具有挑战性的图像生成和编辑基准测试上的实验表明，经过后训练的小型提示增强器可靠地优于其基础版本，缩小了与闭源提示增强器的差距；此外，MAPE在这些基准测试中的复杂组合任务上表现尤为出色。

</details>


### [30] [LastAct: Trajectory-Guided Latest-Activity Localization for Real-Time Smart-Home Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00260)
*Zishuai Liu,Ruili Fang,Jin Lu,Fei Dou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LastAct提出了一个以轨迹为中心的流式智能家居人体活动识别框架，通过将传感器事件投影到房屋平面图上生成布局对齐的轨迹图像序列来建模空间结构，并利用边界污染检测与边界引导掩码机制处理滑动窗口中的混合活动问题，在多个数据集上取得了优异的性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有流式智能家居人体活动识别方法面临两个主要问题：(1) 滑动窗口推理会产生跨越活动边界的窗口，包含混合活动（边界污染），违背了大多数基准和模型使用的预分割实例假设；(2) 许多管线将传感器ID视为独立标记，未能充分利用空间上下文信息。

Method: LastAct包含三个核心组件：(1) 将传感器事件投影到房屋平面图上，形成布局对齐的轨迹图像序列，保持空间连续性；(2) 轻量级门控机制识别受污染的窗口，边界定位器估计最近一次活动边界，实现边界引导掩码，增强边界后证据并抑制过时上下文；(3) 复用预计算的布局对齐模板缓存，避免重复渲染以提高效率。

Result: 在四个公开智能家居数据集上，采用接近真实的混合活动协议进行实验，LastAct在纯净窗口上达到竞争性或更优的性能，在交叉/混合窗口上取得显著的Macro-F1增益，证明了在接近真实的滑动窗口机制下的鲁棒性提升。

Conclusion: LastAct通过显式建模空间结构和处理边界污染问题，有效提升了流式智能家居人体活动识别在混合窗口场景下的鲁棒性和性能。

Original Abstract: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) from ambient sensors enables smart-home applications such as health monitoring and assisted living. In realistic deployments, however, sensor events arrive as a continuous stream and activity boundaries are unknown. Sliding-window inference therefore produces many windows that straddle transitions and contain mixed activities, creating boundary contamination that violates the pre-segmented instance assumption used by most benchmarks and models. Moreover, many pipelines under-use spatial context by treating sensor IDs as independent tokens. We present LastAct, a trajectory-centric framework for streaming smart-home HAR that targets the most recent activity under mixed windows while explicitly modeling spatial structure. LastAct projects sensor events onto the home floorplan to form a layout-aligned trajectory image sequence that preserves spatial continuity. A lightweight gate identifies contaminated windows, and a boundary localizer estimates the last transition to enable boundary-guided masking that emphasizes post-boundary evidence and suppresses stale context. For efficiency, we reuse a precomputed layout-aligned template cache to avoid repeated rendering. Empirically, across four public smart-home datasets under near-realistic mixed-activity protocols, LastAct achieves competitive or superior performance on pure windows and yields substantial Macro-F1 gains on cross/mixed windows, demonstrating improved robustness under near-realistic sliding-window regimes.

中文摘要翻译: 基于环境传感器的人体活动识别（HAR）能够实现健康监测和辅助生活等智能家居应用。然而，在实际部署中，传感器事件以连续流的形式到达，活动边界是未知的。因此，滑动窗口推理会产生许多跨越边界的窗口，其中包含混合活动，造成边界污染，违背了大多数基准和模型所使用的预分割实例假设。此外，许多管线将传感器ID视为独立标记，未能充分利用空间上下文。本文提出LastAct，一个以轨迹为中心的流式智能家居HAR框架，专注于处理混合窗口下的最近活动，同时显式建模空间结构。LastAct将传感器事件投影到房屋平面图上，形成布局对齐的轨迹图像序列，保持空间连续性。轻量级门控识别受污染的窗口，边界定位器估计最近一次活动边界，实现边界引导掩码，增强边界后证据并抑制过时上下文。为了提高效率，我们复用预计算的布局对齐模板缓存，避免重复渲染。在四个公开智能家居数据集上，采用接近真实的混合活动协议进行实验，LastAct在纯净窗口上取得了竞争性或更优的性能，在交叉/混合窗口上获得了显著的Macro-F1增益，证明了在接近真实的滑动窗口机制下鲁棒性的提升。

*Andrea La Grotteria,Paolo Santi,Titus Venverloo,Umberto Fugiglando,Carlo Ratti*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究利用米兰市超过420万辆车载设备的高分辨率远程信息处理数据，结合TomTom交通指标、OpenStreetMap路网与基础设施属性以及街景语义分割特征，分析了城市道路网络中剧烈加速/制动事件的空间分布规律，发现更宽的车行道、交叉口、公交站点及开阔视野与更高剧烈事件强度相关，而密集建筑临街面则相反；此外，仅标线的自行车道比物理隔离自行车道的剧烈事件得分高19.5%，混合交通配置高11.5%，支持因地制宜的道路安全干预策略。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 警方报告的碰撞统计数据存在不完整和报告滞后的局限性，难以支持及时、精细化的道路安全干预设计。虽然剧烈加速/制动事件被广泛用作替代安全指标，但此前研究仅局限于较小的城市样本，缺乏大规模城市尺度的系统分析。

Method: 采用结合非参数Mann-Whitney U检验（比较高/低剧烈事件组之间的路段特征分布差异）与有监督机器学习回归器的分析框架；数据来源包括超过420万辆车载设备的高分辨率远程信息处理数据、TomTom路段级交通指标、OpenStreetMap路网与基础设施属性，以及通过OneFormer模型对Google街景图像进行语义分割提取的视觉特征。

Result: 在控制暴露量后，更宽的车行道、交叉口和公交站点、更开阔的视觉视野（天空和路面像素比例更高）与更高剧烈事件强度相关，而密集建筑临街面与较低强度相关。自行车基础设施案例研究发现，与物理隔离自行车道相比，仅标线自行车道的剧烈事件得分高19.5%，混合交通配置高11.5%。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持因地制宜而非统一的城市安全干预策略，并展示了大规模远程信息处理数据结合开放地理空间与视觉数据如何在都市尺度为"零死亡愿景"决策提供信息支撑。

Original Abstract: Police-reported crash statistics remain the standard input for urban road-safety assessment, but their incompleteness and reporting lag limit their usefulness for timely, fine-grained intervention design. Harsh acceleration and braking events are widely used as surrogate safety indicators, but have so far been studied only in comparatively small urban samples. This study analyses harsh events across the urban road network of Milan, combining high-resolution telematics from more than 4.2 million vehicles equipped with On-Board Units, segment-level traffic metrics from TomTom, street-network and infrastructure attributes from OpenStreetMap, and visual streetscape features extracted from Google Street View via semantic segmentation using a OneFormer model. We employ an analytical framework combining non-parametric Mann--Whitney U tests of segment-feature distributions between high- and low-harshness groups with supervised machine-learning regressors. We find that, once exposure is controlled for, wider carriageways, crossings and transit stops, and more open visual fields (higher sky- and road-pixel proportions) are associated with higher harsh-event intensity, while denser built frontage is associated with lower intensity. Finally, the cycling-infrastructure case study identifies a gradient in harsh-event intensity across facility types: markings-only cycle lanes are associated with a 19.5% higher harshness score, and mixed-traffic configurations with an 11.5% higher score, relative to physically separated cycle paths, conditional on the included controls. These results support context-specific rather than uniform urban-safety interventions and illustrate how large-scale telematics combined with open geospatial and visual data can inform Vision Zero decision-making at the metropolitan scale.
