### [32] [StressDream: Steering Video World Models for Robust Policy Evaluation and Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00267)
*Junwon Seo,Sushant Veer,Ran Tian,Wenhao Ding,Apoorva Sharma,Karen Leung,Edward Schmerling,Marco Pavone,Andrea Bajcsy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: StressDream通过优化扩散世界模型的初始噪声，将想象导向指定语义的高影响但合理的未来结果，实现鲁棒的策略评估与改进。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有的视频世界模型在策略评估与改进中通常依赖名义上的想象（nominal imaginations），需大量采样才能捕捉到机器人动作的高影响结果。为在有限采样下实现对高影响事件的鲁棒评估，需要一种能在推理时按文本指定将想象导向高影响但合理结果的方法。

Method: 提出StressDream，通过优化扩散世界模型的初始噪声来引导想象。包含两个互补目标：1）语义目标，利用视觉-语言模型对生成视频进行推理以提供信息性梯度；2）合理性目标，防止优化后的噪声漂移至分布外导致不合理想象。

Result: 在自动驾驶和机器人操控的最先进视频世界模型上，StressDream能有效将想象导向文本指定的高影响但合理的结果（如任务失败），从而识别出可能导致不良后果的动作，实现鲁棒的策略评估与改进。

Conclusion: 通过推理时优化噪声，可有效引导世界模型想象高影响且合理的未来事件，为策略评估和改进提供更可靠的依据。

Original Abstract: Video world models (WMs) have shown promise for policy evaluation and improvement by imagining realistic future observations conditioned on ego-robot actions. While WMs can model distributions over futures, policy evaluation and improvement typically rely on nominal imaginations, which can miss high-impact outcomes of robot actions unless prohibitively many samples are drawn. To enable robust policy evaluation and improvement over WM imaginations, we propose StressDream, which steers imaginations toward high-impact yet plausible outcomes specified at inference time by optimizing the initial noise of diffusion-based WMs. However, optimizing high-dimensional noise is challenging: the optimization must reason about nuanced, scene-dependent target events in generated videos while avoiding out-of-distribution (OOD) noise that yields implausible imaginations. We address this with two complementary objectives: a semantic objective with a Vision-Language Model that provides informative gradients by reasoning about the generated video, and a plausibility objective that prevents the optimized noise from drifting OOD. With state-of-the-art video world models for autonomous driving and robotic manipulation, we show that StressDream effectively steers imaginations toward high-impact yet plausible outcomes specified by text at inference time, such as task failures, enabling robust policy evaluation and improvement by identifying actions whose plausible futures include undesirable outcomes. Video results are available at https://junwon.me/StressDream/.

中文摘要翻译: 视频世界模型通过想象以机器人自身动作为条件的逼真未来观测，在策略评估与改进方面展现了潜力。虽然世界模型可以对未来的分布进行建模，但策略评估与改进通常依赖于名义上的想象，这可能会遗漏机器人动作的高影响结果，除非抽取大量样本。为使世界模型的想象能支持鲁棒的策略评估与改进，我们提出StressDream，它在推理时通过优化扩散式世界模型的初始噪声，将想象导向由文本指定的高影响但合理的结果。然而，优化高维噪声具有挑战性：优化过程必须在生成的视频中推理细腻的、场景相关的目标事件，同时避免产生导致不合理想象的分布外噪声。我们通过两个互补目标来解决这一问题：一个是语义目标，利用视觉-语言模型对生成的视频进行推理以提供信息性梯度；另一个是合理性目标，防止优化后的噪声漂移至分布外。利用用于自动驾驶和机器人操控的最先进视频世界模型，我们证明StressDream能有效将想象导向推理时由文本指定的高影响但合理的结果，例如任务失败，从而通过识别那些可能在未来导致不良后果的动作来实现鲁棒的策略评估与改进。视频结果见https://junwon.me/StressDream/。

</details>


### [33] [Hyperbolic and Evidence-Prioritized Experts for Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00275)
*Zijie Zhou,Dandan Zhu,Hangxiangpan Wang,Heng Zhang,Huishen Jiao,Yi Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出AsyMoE，一种显式建模视觉与语言模态非对称性的大视觉-语言模型MoE架构，通过双曲几何捕捉层级跨模态关系并抑制参数记忆依赖，在减少25.45%参数激活的同时提升性能，尤其对幻觉敏感任务提升3.8%。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有MoE方法将视觉和语言模态以对称架构处理，忽视了二者固有的非对称性：文本查询通常只描述完整视觉场景的部分方面，形成层级而非平行关系；深层语言专家逐渐从基于证据的处理转向参数记忆依赖，丢失了对输入视觉和语言信息的 grounding。

Method: 提出AsyMoE架构，包含三类专家组：(1) 模态内专家（Intra-modality experts）处理各自模态的特定处理；(2) 双曲模态间专家（Hyperbolic inter-modality experts）通过负曲率几何捕捉层级性的跨模态关系；(3) 证据优先语言专家（Evidence-priority language experts）抑制参数记忆激活，在整个网络深度中维持上下文 grounding。

Result: 在多项实验上取得一致改进，平均提升1.5%（相较于MoE变体），在幻觉敏感任务上提升高达3.8%。与密集模型相比，激活参数减少25.45%。

Conclusion: 显式建模视觉与语言模态之间的非对称性能够显著提升LVLMs的性能和计算效率，尤其能有效缓解幻觉问题。

Original Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance on multimodal tasks through scaled architectures and extensive training. Recent studies introduce Mixture of Experts (MoE) into LVLMs for improved computational efficiency. However, existing MoE approaches treat visual and linguistic modalities with symmetric architectures, overlooking the inherent asymmetry in how these two modalities are processed. This asymmetry causes two critical issues. First, text and vision form hierarchical rather than parallel relationships, as text queries typically describe partial aspects of complete visual scenes. Euclidean expert space struggles to encode such containment structures. Second, language experts in deeper layers progressively shift from evidence-based processing to parametric memory dependence, losing grounding in the provided visual and linguistic information. To address these issues, we propose AsyMoE, a novel architecture that explicitly models this asymmetry through three specialized expert groups. Intra-modality experts handle modality-specific processing. Hyperbolic inter-modality experts capture hierarchical cross-modal relationships through negative curvature geometry. Evidence-priority language experts suppress parametric memory activation and maintain contextual grounding throughout network depth. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AsyMoE achieves consistent improvements over baseline methods, with average gains of 1.5\% over MoE variants and up to 3.8\% on hallucination-sensitive tasks. AsyMoE activates 25.45\% fewer parameters compared to dense models.

中文摘要翻译: 大视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）通过大规模架构和广泛训练在多模态任务上展现出令人瞩目的性能。近期研究将混合专家（MoE）引入LVLMs以提升计算效率。然而，现有的MoE方法以对称架构处理视觉和语言模态，忽视了这两种模态在处理方式上的固有非对称性。这种非对称性导致两个关键问题。第一，文本和视觉形成层级而非平行关系，因为文本查询通常描述完整视觉场景的部分方面。欧几里得专家空间难以编码这种包含结构。第二，深层语言专家逐渐从基于证据的处理转向参数记忆依赖，丧失了对提供的视觉和语言信息的 grounding。为解决这些问题，我们提出AsyMoE，一种通过三类专门专家组显式建模这种非对称性的新颖架构。模态内专家处理模态特定处理。双曲模态间专家通过负曲率几何捕捉层级性的跨模态关系。证据优先语言专家抑制参数记忆激活，并在整个网络深度中维持上下文 grounding。大量实验表明，AsyMoE相比基线方法取得了一致改进，相较于MoE变体平均提升1.5%，在幻觉敏感任务上提升高达3.8%。与密集模型相比，AsyMoE激活参数减少了25.45%。

</details>


### [34] [Real2SAM2Real: Generative 3D Caches as Complementary Context for Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00299)
*Jiayi Wu,Haoming Cai,Cornelia Fermuller,Christopher Metzler,Yiannis Aloimonos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Real2SAM2Real框架，通过3D提升模型提取可编辑的3D缓存作为几何支架，实现对视频扩散模型的精确摄像机轨迹和多实体运动解耦控制，克服高动态运动下的结构崩溃问题。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型依赖隐式扩散先验生成未观测区域，在高动态运动或复杂遮挡下容易发生结构崩溃，缺乏精确的摄像机与场景控制能力。

Method: 利用3D提升模型（如SAM3D）提取前景实体的完整3D体积作为可编辑的3D缓存，注入整体空间先验到VDM中；设计Soft Spatial-Aligned Injection机制和最小侵入式微调策略来有效利用3D引导；采用掩码法线图作为跨模态桥梁构建无3D标注的数据增强与扰动流程。

Result: 实现了对摄像机轨迹和多实体运动的精确解耦控制；在大的摄像机移位和严重遮挡下保持优异的时空一致性；消除了由结构空洞、错误立面以及反射折射引起的视角模糊问题。

Conclusion: 通过将几何与外观解耦，利用生成式3D缓存的互补上下文，克服了对扩散先验过度依赖导致的典型崩溃，实现了复杂场景动态下的鲁棒3D感知引导。

Original Abstract: While Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) excel at synthesizing high-fidelity videos, enabling precise camera and scene control remains challenging. Existing methods predominantly rely on implicit diffusion priors to generate unobserved regions, inevitably leading to structural collapse during high-dynamic movements or complex occlusions. To address this challenge, we propose Real2SAM2Real, a framework that leverages 3D lifting models (e.g., SAM3D) to extract an explicitly editable 3D cache, serving as a robust geometric scaffold for the VDM. By capturing the entire 3D volume of foreground entities rather than just their visible shells, this cache injects holistic spatial priors into the VDM, providing dependable 3D-aware guidance for complex scene dynamics. To effectively leverage this 3D guidance while preserving pre-trained priors, we design a Soft Spatial-Aligned Injection mechanism alongside a minimally invasive fine-tuning strategy tailored for VDMs. Furthermore, we employ masked normal maps as a cross-modal bridge to construct a 3D-free data curation and perturbation pipeline. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Real2SAM2Real enables precise, decoupled control over both camera trajectories and multi-entity motions. By utilizing the complementary context from generative 3D caches, our framework overcomes typical breakdowns caused by over-reliance on diffusion priors, maintaining exceptional spatiotemporal consistency under large camera shifts and severe occlusions. Crucially, by decoupling geometry from appearance, our VDM-tailored 3D cache eradicates perspective ambiguities caused by structural holes and erroneous facades, as well as misleading cues from reflections and refractions. Project website is available at https://jiayi-wu-leo.github.io/real2sam2real

中文摘要翻译: 尽管视频扩散模型（VDMs）在合成高保真视频方面表现出色，但实现精确的摄像机与场景控制仍然具有挑战性。现有方法主要依赖隐式扩散先验来生成未观测区域，这不可避免地导致高动态运动或复杂遮挡期间的结构崩溃。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了Real2SAM2Real，一个利用3D提升模型（如SAM3D）提取显式可编辑3D缓存的框架，该缓存作为VDM的鲁棒几何支架。通过捕获前景实体的完整3D体积而不仅仅是其可见外壳，该缓存将整体空间先验注入VDM，为复杂场景动态提供可靠的3D感知引导。为了有效利用这一3D引导同时保留预训练先验，我们设计了软空间对齐注入机制以及针对VDM量身定制的微侵入式微调策略。此外，我们采用掩码法线图作为跨模态桥梁，构建了一个无3D标注的数据整理与扰动流程。大量实验表明，Real2SAM2Real能够实现对摄像机轨迹和多实体运动的精确解耦控制。通过利用生成式3D缓存的互补上下文，我们的框架克服了因过度依赖扩散先验而导致的典型崩溃，在大摄像机移位和严重遮挡下保持了优异的时空一致性。至关重要的是，通过将几何与外观解耦，我们针对VDM定制的3D缓存消除了由结构空洞和错误立面引起的视角模糊，以及反射和折射产生的误导性线索。项目网站：https://jiayi-wu-leo.github.io/real2sam2real

</details>


### [35] [Where to Refine, When to Stop: Rethinking Redundancy via Latent Discrepancy for Efficient Visual Autoregressive Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00310)
*Changwang Mei,Peisong Wang,Zekun Li,Changsheng Li,Shuang Qiu,Qinghao Hu,Gang Li,Yifan Zhang,Zhihui Wei,Jian Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LD-Pruning，一种无需训练的去冗余框架，通过潜在差异（Latent Discrepancy）量化token贡献，在Infinity-8B上实现最高2.35倍加速，同时保持高质量图像生成。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有VAR模型加速方法依赖启发式度量进行token剪枝，对复杂语义上下文敏感，导致冗余计算识别不准确且跨提示适应性差。作者从冗余对像素空间生成的影响角度重新思考，希望找到更准确的冗余识别指标。

Method: 提出潜在差异（Latent Discrepancy）统一度量，通过测量生成过程中模型状态的变化量化token贡献；结合解码无关区域选择（decoding-free region selection）和自适应无条件分支跳过（adaptive unconditional-branch skipping），构建无需训练的LD-Pruning框架。

Result: LD-Pruning显著降低推理延迟并保持高质量生成，在Infinity-8B上实现最高2.35倍加速。实验表明，以图像潜在或像素空间信号引导时，冗余识别更准确；CFG中条件与无条件分支的差异收敛趋势在不同提示下呈现高度动态性。

Conclusion: LD-Pruning通过潜在差异有效识别冗余并加速VAR模型推理，是一种训练免费、跨提示适应性强的通用加速方法。

Original Abstract: Visual Autoregressive (VAR) models deliver high-quality image generation but suffer from significant inference latency at high resolutions. Recent acceleration approaches most rely on heuristic measures with layer features to prune tokens. Such heuristics are sensitive to complex contextual semantics, leading to inaccurate identification of redundant computation and poor adaptability across prompts. We rethink redundancy in VAR from the perspective of its impact on pixel-space generation and introduce Latent Discrepancy. This unified metric quantifies a token's contribution by measuring the change in model states during generation. Our analysis shows that redundancy is more accurately identified when guided by image latent or pixel-space signals. We further observed that in classifier-free guidance (CFG), the convergence trend of the discrepancy between conditional and unconditional branches exhibits high dynamics with different prompts. Based on these findings, we propose LD-Pruning (Latent Discrepancy Pruning), a training-free framework that removes redundancy via latent discrepancy by integrating decoding-free region selection and adaptive unconditional-branch skipping. Extensive experiments show that LD-Pruning substantially reduces inference latency while maintaining high generation quality, achieving up to 2.35x speedup on Infinity-8B.

中文摘要翻译: 视觉自回归（VAR）模型能生成高质量图像，但在高分辨率下存在显著的推理延迟。现有的加速方法大多依赖启发式度量，利用层特征来剪枝token。此类启发式方法对复杂上下文语义敏感，导致冗余计算的识别不准确，且跨提示的适应性较差。我们从冗余对像素空间生成的影响这一角度重新思考VAR中的冗余问题，并引入潜在差异（Latent Discrepancy）。这一统一度量通过测量生成过程中模型状态的变化来量化token的贡献。我们的分析表明，当以图像潜在或像素空间信号为引导时，冗余识别更加准确。我们进一步观察到，在无分类器引导（CFG）中，条件分支与无条件分支之间差异的收敛趋势在不同提示下表现出高度动态性。基于这些发现，我们提出了LD-Pruning（潜在差异剪枝），这是一种无需训练的框架，通过整合解码无关的区域选择（decoding-free region selection）和自适应无条件分支跳过（adaptive unconditional-branch skipping），利用潜在差异消除冗余。大量实验表明，LD-Pruning在保持高质量生成的同时显著降低了推理延迟，在Infinity-8B上实现了最高2.35倍的加速。

</details>


### [36] [Training-Free Object-Agnostic Jam Detection in Fulfillment Centers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00321)
*Ruiliang Liu,Tina Dongxu Li,Joshua Migdal,Fernando Ruch,Kenneth Meszaros,Moses Trevor Dardik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种无需训练、与物体类别无关的堵塞检测方法AllTracker，通过监控参考点是否被持续遮挡来判断堵塞，在1069个视频上达到100%精度和93.33% F1分数，无需任何标注数据。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统堵塞检测依赖目标检测模型和跟踪算法，需要数千条人工标注（约两周工作量），且只能检测已标注类别的物体。为消除对标注数据的依赖并实现通用检测，提出无需训练、与物体类别无关的堵塞检测方法。

Method: 在监控区域内无物体时均匀采样参考点；当物体经过时遮挡这些参考点，若足够比例的参考点被持续遮挡超过时间阈值，则判定为堵塞事件。将传统点跟踪中视为失败情况的遮挡重新利用为检测信号。

Result: 在1069个视频上评估，AllTracker达到100.00%精度和93.33% F1分数，显著优于经典稀疏跟踪方法，且无需训练即可部署。

Conclusion: 该方法具有三大优势：（1）无需训练数据或人工标注；（2）可泛化到任意物体类型；（3）大幅缩短开发时间。

Original Abstract: In fulfillment centers, diverse objects move continuously from inbound to outbound operations and can become jammed due to excessive conveyor friction, incorrect orientation, or mechanical failures. Traditional jam detection approaches rely on object detection models to identify objects, followed by tracking algorithms (such as IoU overlap and Kalman filtering) to monitor motion over time. This pipeline requires thousands of manual annotations, consuming approximately two weeks of effort, and is limited to annotated object classes. We present a training-free, object-agnostic jam detection method that eliminates the need for labeled data. Our approach uniformly samples reference points within the monitoring region when no objects are present. As objects occlude these points, we detect motion. When a sufficient fraction remains occluded beyond a temporal threshold, we classify the event as a jam. Unlike conventional point tracking--which treats occlusion as a failure case--our approach repurposes occlusion as a detection signal, monitoring whether reference points remain persistently occluded rather than tracking where they move. Our experimental evaluation on 1,069 videos demonstrates that AllTracker achieves 100.00% precision and 93.33% F1 score, significantly outperforming classical sparse tracking methods while maintaining training-free deployment. This approach offers three key advantages: (1) no training data or manual annotations, (2) object-agnostic generalization to arbitrary object types, and (3) significantly reduced development time.

中文摘要翻译: 在配送中心中，各类物体从入库到出库连续不断地移动，可能因传送带摩擦力过大、朝向不正确或机械故障而发生堵塞。传统的堵塞检测方法依赖目标检测模型识别物体，再结合跟踪算法（如IoU重叠和卡尔曼滤波）来监控运动状态。该流程需要数千条人工标注，耗时约两周，且仅能检测已标注类别的物体。我们提出一种无需训练、与物体类别无关的堵塞检测方法，消除了对标注数据的需求。我们的方法在监控区域内无物体时均匀采样参考点。当物体遮挡这些参考点时，我们检测到运动；当足够比例的参考点被持续遮挡超过时间阈值时，我们将该事件分类为堵塞。与将遮挡视为失败情况的传统点跟踪不同，我们的方法将遮挡重新利用为检测信号——监控参考点是否持续被遮挡，而非跟踪它们移动到哪里。我们在1069个视频上的实验评估表明，AllTracker达到了100.00%的精度和93.33%的F1分数，显著优于经典稀疏跟踪方法，同时保持无需训练即可部署的特性。该方法具有三大优势：（1）无需训练数据或人工标注；（2）可泛化到任意物体类型；（3）大幅缩短开发时间。

</details>


### [37] [UniVerse: A Unified Modulation Framework for Segmentation-Free,Disentangled Multi-Concept Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00351)
*Quynh Phung,Sandesh Ghimire,Minsi Hu,Chung-Chi Tsai,Jia-Bin Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniVerse提出了一种统一调制框架，用于扩散Transformer中无需分割的多概念个性化，能够实现对复杂场景中目标概念的精确定位和表示。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有方法在输入图像包含多个对象时难以定位和提取特定概念，且大多依赖分割掩码监督或存在组合泛化能力差的问题，限制了准确解耦和操作个体概念的能力。

Method: 提出UniVerse统一调制框架，通过可组合与可分解的概念提取，在无需显式分割掩码的情况下实现对目标对象的细粒度定位和表示；学习将复杂场景分解为概念特定表示，再以统一方式组合，实现跨不同视觉上下文的鲁棒个性化。

Result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，UniVerse在定位精度和视觉保真度方面显著优于当前最先进的基线方法；定性和定量结果均证明该方法能在杂乱场景中精确提取目标概念。

Conclusion: UniVerse为更灵活、可解释和个性化的视觉生成与理解铺平了道路。

Original Abstract: Personalized visual understanding has advanced significantly, yet existing approaches struggle to localize and extract specific concepts when input images contain multiple objects. Many prior methods rely heavily on segmentation-based supervision or exhibit poor compositional generalization, limiting their ability to accurately disentangle and manipulate individual concepts. In this work, we propose UniVerse, a Unified Modulation Framework for segmentation-free, disentangled multi-concept personalization in diffusion transformers. Our method allows for composable and decomposable concept extraction, enabling fine-grained localization and representation of target objects without explicit segmentation masks. UniVerse learns to decompose complex scenes into concept-specific representations and then compose them in a unified manner, enabling robust personalization across diverse visual contexts. Through extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks, we demonstrate that UniVerse significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both localization accuracy and visual fidelity. Qualitative and quantitative results show that our approach can precisely extract target concepts in cluttered scenes, paving the way for more flexible, interpretable, and personalized visual generation and understanding.

中文摘要翻译: 个性化视觉理解已取得显著进展，然而现有方法在输入图像包含多个对象时，仍难以定位和提取特定概念。许多先前方法严重依赖基于分割的监督或表现出较差的组合泛化能力，限制了其准确解耦和操作个体概念的能力。在本工作中，我们提出UniVerse——一种用于扩散Transformer中无需分割、解耦的多概念个性化的统一调制框架。我们的方法支持可组合与可分解的概念提取，能够在无需显式分割掩码的情况下实现对目标对象的细粒度定位和表示。UniVerse学习将复杂场景分解为概念特定的表示，然后以统一方式将其组合，从而实现对多样化视觉上下文的鲁棒个性化。通过在多个基准上的大量实验，我们证明UniVerse在定位精度和视觉保真度方面均显著优于当前最先进的基线方法。定性和定量结果表明，我们的方法能够在杂乱场景中精确提取目标概念，为更灵活、可解释和个性化的视觉生成与理解铺平了道路。

</details>


### [38] [HiGS: A Hierarchical Rendering Architecture for Real-Time 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00352)
*Dawid Pająk,Martin Bisson,Rodolfo Lima*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出层次化平铺高斯泼溅(HiGS)，通过将空间划分和光栅化解耦到不同尺度（粗宏块 vs 细渲染块），在保持精确前端到后端alpha合成的同时，实现高达15.8x的加速，并优于所有对比的栅格化器。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 3DGS中空间划分（分箱和深度排序）和光栅化共享同一个tile尺寸，但二者的最优尺度相悖：大tile降低划分成本，小tile降低光栅化成本。少量密集tile主导帧时间，现有加速工作仅优化单个阶段但未解耦尺度。

Method: 提出层次化平铺（Hierarchical Tiling）：粗粒度宏块（macro-tiles）负责空间划分，细粒度渲染块（render tiles）负责光栅化；光栅化工作按每个宏块内的高斯分布数量按比例分发，使密集区域分散到多个并行单元而非串行化。

Result: 在多个测试场景中，HiGS比原始3DGS渲染速度快15.8倍，优于所有对比的栅格化器，同时保持精确的前端到后端alpha合成。

Conclusion: 通过解耦划分与光栅化的尺度，HiGS实现了显著的加速，证明了层次化平铺策略在3DGS中的有效性。

Original Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become the standard for real-time novel view synthesis on commodity GPUs. Its pipeline ties spatial partitioning and rasterization to one tile size, yet the two pull in opposite directions: partitioning, which bins and depth-sorts gaussians, grows cheaper with larger tiles, while rasterization gets cheaper with smaller ones. Prior acceleration work reduces the cost of individual stages but keeps both locked to that single scale, where a few dense tiles dominate frame time. We present Hierarchically Tiled Gaussian Splatting (HiGS), which gives each its own scale: partitioning runs over coarse macro-tiles, while rasterization runs over the fine render tiles within them. Rasterization work is then issued in proportion to the gaussians in each macro-tile rather than per tile, so dense regions spread across many parallel units instead of serializing through one. Across tested scenes, HiGS renders up to 15.8x faster than the original 3DGS and outperforms every other rasterizer we evaluate, while preserving exact front-to-back alpha compositing.

中文摘要翻译: 3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）已成为在商用GPU上实现实时新视角合成的标准方法。其管线将空间划分和光栅化绑定到同一个tile尺寸上，然而这两者需求相反：划分（对高斯体进行分箱和深度排序）在大tile下成本更低，而光栅化在小tile下更高效。先前的加速工作降低了单个阶段的开销，但两者仍被锁定在同一尺度上，少量密集tile主导了帧时间。我们提出层次化平铺高斯泼溅（HiGS），为每个阶段赋予各自的尺度：划分在粗粒度宏块上运行，而光栅化在宏块内部的细粒度渲染块上运行。光栅化工作量根据每个宏块中的高斯体数量按比例分发，因此密集区域可分散到多个并行单元中，而非串行通过一个单元。在测试场景中，HiGS的渲染速度相比原始3DGS提升了15.8倍，并且优于我们评估的所有其他栅格化器，同时保持了精确的前端到后端alpha合成。

</details>


### [39] [LFA: Layer Feature Attention for Run-Time Introspection of 2D Object Detectors in Automated Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00372)
*Mert Keser,Alois Knoll*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出层特征注意力（LFA）方法，通过注意力机制聚合多骨干层特征实现自动驾驶目标检测器的错误预测，在KITTI和BDD100K上达到SOTA性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有检测器自省方法仅依赖最后一层特征或手工统计量，丢弃了早期层中不同视觉抽象层次的有价值信息，而检测错误在不同特征层级上表现各异。

Method: 提出层特征注意力（LFA）机制，通过可学习的端到端注意力机制聚合来自多个骨干网络层的特征，自动学习各层的贡献权重，从而实现既提升错误预测能力又可解释分析各特征层对检测失败的影响。

Result: 在KITTI和BDD100K数据集上的大量实验表明，LFA达到了最先进的检测器自省性能，在多种检测器架构上均优于单层基线方法。

Conclusion: LFA通过注意力机制有效融合多层级特征，既提升了检测器错误预测的准确性，又提供了可解释性分析，验证了不同特征层级信息对检测失败预测的互补价值。

Original Abstract: Reliable object detection is critical for automated driving, yet even state-of-the-art detectors inevitably make errors that can compromise safety. Introspection methods that predict detector failures enable safer deployment by triggering fallback mechanisms or alerting human operators. However, existing approaches rely solely on last-layer features or hand-crafted statistics, discarding valuable information from earlier layers that capture different levels of visual abstraction. We propose Layer Feature Attention (LFA), a lightweight introspection method that learns to aggregate features from multiple backbone layers through an attention mechanism. Our key insight is that detection errors manifest differently across feature hierarchies: low-level layers capture fine-grained details essential for detecting small or occluded objects, while high-level layers encode semantic information for scene understanding. LFA learns layer importance weights end-to-end, enabling both improved error prediction and interpretable analysis of which feature levels are most indicative of detector failures. Extensive experiments on KITTI and BDD100K demonstrate that LFA achieves state-of-the-art introspection performance, outperforming single-layer baselines across multiple detector architectures.

中文摘要翻译: 可靠的目标检测对于自动驾驶至关重要，然而即使是最先进的检测器也不可避免地会出现可能危及安全的错误。能够预测检测器失败的自省方法通过触发后备机制或提醒人类操作员，实现了更安全的部署。然而，现有方法仅依赖最后一层特征或手工统计量，丢弃了来自早期层中捕获不同视觉抽象层次的有价值信息。我们提出层特征注意力（LFA），一种轻量级的自省方法，通过注意力机制学习聚合来自多个骨干网络层的特征。我们的关键洞察在于，检测错误在特征层级中表现各异：低层特征捕获对于检测小目标或被遮挡目标至关重要的细粒度细节，而高层特征编码用于场景理解的语义信息。LFA以端到端方式学习层重要性权重，既能改进错误预测，又能对哪些特征层级最指示检测器失败进行可解释分析。在KITTI和BDD100K上的大量实验表明，LFA达到了最先进的自省性能，在多种检测器架构上均优于单层基线方法。

</details>


### [40] [Score-Control for Hallucination Reduction in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00377)
*Mahesh Bhosale,Naresh Kumar Devulapally,Abdul Wasi,Chau Pham,Vishnu Suresh Lokhande,David Doermann*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现扩散模型中得分函数的平滑性会导致生成图像出现幻觉（超出真实数据分布支撑集的不可信样本），通过将幻觉概率与得分函数的Lipschitz常数建立理论联系，提出了一种方差引导的得分调制（VSM）策略来控制得分雅可比矩阵，从而降低得分平滑性、更逼近真实得分函数以减少幻觉。在合成和真实数据集上，该方法在保持高保真度和多样性的同时，将幻觉减少了约25%，并提出了两个用于系统评估幻觉的极端语义变化基准数据集。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 扩散模型作为现代生成AI的基础，在多种模态中取得了成功，但其生成的样本存在幻觉问题（即生成位于真实数据分布支撑集之外的不可信样本），这降低了模型的可靠性和可信度。先前研究假设得分平滑性会导致幻觉，作者希望从理论和实践上验证这一假设，并提供密度视角的解释。

Method: 本文提出了一种方差引导的得分调制（Variance-Guided Score Modulation, VSM）策略。该策略通过控制得分函数的雅可比矩阵（score Jacobian），降低得分平滑性，使学习到的得分函数更逼近真实得分函数，从而减少幻觉。

Result: 在合成和真实世界数据集上的实验表明，该方法能在保持高保真度和多样性的同时，将幻觉减少约25%。此外，作者还提出了两个具有极端语义变化的基准数据集，用于系统性地评估幻觉。

Conclusion: 本文从理论上将扩散模型中的幻觉概率与得分函数的Lipschitz常数建立了联系，提出VSM策略有效减少了幻觉，为构建更可靠的扩散模型图像生成提供了原则性的方法。

Original Abstract: Diffusion models have emerged as the backbone of modern generative AI, powering advances in vision, language, audio and other modalities. Despite their success, they suffer from hallucinations, implausible samples that lie outside the support of true data distribution, which degrade reliability and trust. In this work, we first empirically confirm previously proposed hypothesis that score smoothness causes hallucinations in Image Generation diffusion models and provide a density-based perspective. We further formalize this notion by linking the hallucinations probability mass to lipschitz constant of the learned score function. Motivated by this, we introduce a Variance-Guided Score Modulation (VSM) strategy that controls the score Jacobian, in turn reducing score smoothness and better approximating the ground truth score that decreases hallucinations. Empirical results on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach reduces hallucinations (up to ~25%) while maintaining high fidelity and diversity, providing a principled step toward more reliable diffusion-based image generation. We also propose two benchmark datasets with extreme semantic variation for systematic hallucination evaluation. Code and Datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/bhosalems/VSM.

中文摘要翻译: 扩散模型已成为现代生成式AI的支柱，推动了视觉、语言、音频及其他模态的进步。尽管取得了成功，它们仍存在幻觉问题——生成位于真实数据分布支撑集之外的不可信样本，这降低了可靠性和信任度。在这项工作中，我们首先通过实验验证了先前提出的假设：得分平滑性导致图像生成扩散模型中的幻觉，并提供了基于密度的视角。我们进一步通过将幻觉概率与学习到的得分函数的Lipschitz常数建立联系，形式化了这一概念。受此启发，我们引入了一种方差引导的得分调制（VSM）策略，该策略通过控制得分雅可比矩阵，降低得分平滑性，从而更好地逼近真实得分函数以减少幻觉。在合成和真实世界数据集上的实验结果表明，我们的方法在保持高保真度和多样性的同时减少了幻觉（最多约25%），为构建更可靠的基于扩散的图像生成迈出了原则性的一步。我们还提出了两个具有极端语义变化的基准数据集，用于系统性地评估幻觉。代码和数据集已在https://github.com/bhosalems/VSM公开。

</details>

Original Abstract: Accurately modeling soft boundaries, e.g., hair and defocus blur, is a fundamental challenge in stereo conversion due to the ambiguous blending of foreground and background. Specifically, we first resolve mixed color and depth ambiguity by estimating layered color and depth values at soft boundaries. Considering complex multi-target scenes, we design a Circular Alpha Representation (CAR) that shifts the paradigm from global target extraction to local boundary decomposition. Unlike prior matting methods restricted to a single foreground/background, CAR enables efficient scene-level inference without manual guidance. 中文摘要翻译: 准确建模软边界（例如头发和散焦模糊）是立体转换中的一个基本挑战，原因在于前景与背景的模糊混合。现有的深度模型主要预测单层深度，导致软边界处的深度对应存在歧义。虽然抠图技术可以捕获不透明度以进行分层建模，但在包含多个目标的复杂场景中常常表现不佳，且通常需要用户干预。本文提出了αDepth，一种通过分解软边界进行高保真立体转换的分层表示方法。具体来说，我们首先通过估计软边界处的分层颜色和深度值来解决混合颜色和深度歧义。针对复杂多目标场景，我们设计了圆形阿尔法表示（Circular Alpha Representation, CAR），将范式从全局目标提取转变为局部边界分解。与受限于单前景/背景的现有抠图方法不同，CAR能够在无需人工引导的情况下实现高效的场景级推理。大量评估表明，αDepth在立体转换中达到了最先进的性能，消除了软边界处的背景渗色和结构畸变。

Original Abstract: We present Zamba2-VL, a suite of vision-language models built on Zamba2, a hybrid language-model architecture combining Mamba2 state-space layers with a small number of shared transformer blocks. Across a broad range of image understanding, reasoning, OCR, grounding, and counting benchmarks, Zamba2-VL is competitive with leading Transformer-based open-weight VLMs of comparable scale, including the Molmo2, Qwen3-VL, and InternVL3.5 families, and substantially outperforms prior SSM-based and hybrid VLMs such as VL-Mamba, Cobra, and mmMamba. Inheriting the near-linear prefill compute and small, near-constant recurrent state of its Zamba2 backbone, Zamba2-VL delivers roughly an order of magnitude lower time-to-first-token (TTFT) than these Transformer baselines at matched parameter scale, with the efficiency gap most pronounced at the smaller 1.2B and 2.7B scales most relevant to on-device and edge deployment. Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对地形高程数据，提出HUVR+SIREN方法，将HUVR的坐标解码器替换为平滑可解析微分的SIREN，在1m/像素地形数据集上取得最优的高度和导数保真度，且支持后训练量化压缩。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 通过替换坐标解码器为SIREN可有效弥合自然图像与地形数据之间的跨域差距，超网络架构本身仍有改进空间，而每瓦片瓶颈已接近其可用极限。

Original Abstract: Implicit neural representations (INRs) model a signal as a continuous coordinate-to-value function. For terrain elevation data, this supports analytic derivatives, arbitrary-resolution decoding, and a smooth surface model of the underlying heightfield. However, fitting and storing a separate INR for every tile does not scale to large terrain datasets. Amortized neural representations reduce this cost with a shared network: a new tile is mapped to a compact per-tile payload, and a shared decoder reconstructs the heightfield from it. Most such methods are hypernetworks that predict the payload in a single forward pass, while others recover it through a short per-tile optimization. These methods were developed primarily for natural images, and their suitability for terrain heightfields remains unclear. We introduce a controlled benchmark on a 1 m/pixel terrain dataset and evaluate three representative methods under a unified protocol. Observing a clear cross-domain gap, we propose HUVR+SIREN, a hypernetwork that adapts the strongest benchmarked method (HUVR) by replacing its coordinate decoder with a smooth, analytically differentiable one. It attains the best height and derivative fidelity on the benchmark with no additional per-tile storage and lower decode cost, and tolerates aggressive post-training quantization with negligible quality loss, giving a compact terrain neural format. Ablations and diagnostics further identify which design choices transfer to terrain and show that the per-tile bottleneck is already near its useful limit, leaving the remaining gap in the shared hypernetwork's architectural design.

中文摘要翻译: 隐式神经表示（INR）将信号建模为连续的坐标到数值函数。对于地形高程数据，这支持解析导数、任意分辨率解码以及底层高度场的平滑曲面模型。然而，为每个瓦片单独拟合和存储单独的INR无法扩展到大规模地形数据集。摊销神经表示通过共享网络降低了这一成本：新瓦片被映射为紧凑的每瓦片载荷，共享解码器从中重建高度场。此类方法多数是超网络，通过单次前向传播预测载荷，而其他方法则通过短时每瓦片优化来恢复载荷。这些方法主要针对自然图像开发，其在地形高度场上的适用性尚不明确。我们在1m/像素的地形数据集上引入了受控基准，并在统一协议下评估了三种代表性方法。观察到明显的跨域差距后，我们提出了HUVR+SIREN，这是一种超网络，通过将坐标解码器替换为平滑、可解析微分的解码器来适配最强的基准方法（HUVR）。该模型在基准上取得了最佳的高度和导数保真度，无需额外的每瓦片存储，解码成本更低，并且能够容忍激进的后训练量化且质量损失可忽略，从而形成紧凑的地形神经格式。消融实验和诊断进一步揭示了哪些设计选择可迁移至地形领域，并表明每瓦片瓶颈已接近其有用极限，剩余差距在于共享超网络的架构设计。

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有协同感知方法依赖摄像头和LiDAR，但这些传感器在恶劣天气（雾、雨）下性能会严重退化，缺乏天气鲁棒的感知方案。

Method: 将4D成像雷达作为天气鲁棒模态集成到协同感知中，设计多普勒引导的空间注意力机制用于多智能体融合，并扩展到两种代表性骨干架构：雷达-摄像头流水线（雷达替代LiDAR）和LiDAR-雷达流水线（雷达补充LiDAR）。同时发布雷达增强的基准数据集OPV2V-R和Adver-City-R，并引入基于物理的LiDAR退化模拟。

Result: 在雾和雨天气下展现出强大的鲁棒性提升，当雷达替代退化的LiDAR时改进显著；在MAN TruckScenes上的额外验证证明了其可迁移性超出仿真环境。

Conclusion: 4D成像雷达是一种适用于全天候协同感知的鲁棒模态。

Original Abstract: Cooperative perception is important for autonomous driving but remains fragile when cameras and LiDAR degrade in adverse weather. We address this challenge by integrating 4D imaging radar as a weather-robust modality into collaborative perception and introducing a Doppler-guided spatial attention mechanism for multi-agent fusion. Our approach extends two representative backbones: a radar-camera pipeline where radar substitutes LiDAR, and a LiDAR-radar pipeline where radar complements LiDAR. To support evaluation, we release radar-augmented benchmarks, OPV2V-R and Adver-City-R, with physics-based LiDAR degradation. Experiments show strong robustness gains in fog and rain, including substantial improvements when radar replaces degraded LiDAR. Additional validation on MAN TruckScenes demonstrates transfer beyond simulation. Overall, our results highlight 4D imaging radar as a robust modality for all-weather collaborative perception. Dataset and code are available at: https://url.fzi.de/SlimComm.

中文摘要翻译: 协同感知对于自动驾驶至关重要，但当摄像头和激光雷达在恶劣天气下性能退化时，协同感知仍然脆弱。我们通过将4D成像雷达作为一种天气鲁棒模态集成到协同感知中，并引入一种用于多智能体融合的多普勒引导空间注意力机制来解决这一挑战。我们的方法扩展了两种代表性骨干架构：雷达-摄像头流水线（雷达替代激光雷达）和激光雷达-雷达流水线（雷达补充激光雷达）。为支持评估，我们发布了雷达增强的基准数据集OPV2V-R和Adver-City-R，并包含基于物理的激光雷达退化模拟。实验表明，在雾和雨天气下取得了强大的鲁棒性提升，包括当雷达替代退化激光雷达时的显著改进。在MAN TruckScenes上的额外验证证明了其可迁移性超出仿真环境。总体而言，我们的结果突出了4D成像雷达作为一种适用于全天候协同感知的鲁棒模态。数据集和代码可在https://url.fzi.de/SlimComm获取。

### [47] [Detect Before You Leap: Mirage Detection in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00435)
*Sayeed Shafayet Chowdhury,Md. Shaown Miah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TC-LIA方法，通过探测CLIP ViT视觉编码器各层中图像块token与文本查询的对齐轨迹，在VLM生成回答前检测是否存在幻象（mirage），在五个VQA域中实现约94.6-94.7%的三类检测准确率，幻象率低于3%。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 视觉-语言模型(VLM)即使缺乏相关视觉证据也会生成自信的视觉回答，这种被称为"mirage"的失败模式在医疗和文档视觉问答中尤为危险，因为看似合理但无视觉依据的响应可能被误认为基于图像的证据。因此，需要在VLM产生响应之前检测是否应该回答或弃权。

Method: 提出文本条件逐层内部对齐(TC-LIA)方法，这是一种模型无关的方法。具体包括：(1) 将CLIP ViT-H/14视觉编码器各层的图像块token投影到最终CLIP嵌入空间，测量其与问题嵌入的相似度；(2) 使用最终图像-文本余弦相似度、后层top-k块-文本对齐、早层到后层的增益和逐层斜率等特征总结对齐轨迹；(3) 结合像素统计的空白/噪声检测、零样本领域路由和结构化VLM自我评估，构建集成系统。

Result: 在五个VQA域、三种输入条件和十二个VLM骨干网络上，最佳系统实现了约94.6-94.7%的三类检测准确率，幻象率低于3%，而基线幻象率范围为21.7%至66.6%。

Conclusion: TC-LIA方法能够有效地在VLM生成响应前检测幻象，显著降低幻象率（低于3%），具有模型无关性，在多种VQA领域和VLM骨干网络上都表现优异。

Original Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can produce confident visual answers even when the required visual evidence is missing, blank, or unrelated to the question. This failure mode, known as mirage (Asadi et al. 2026), is especially concerning in medical and document visual question answering, where plausible but visually ungrounded responses may be mistaken for image-based evidence. We study pre-release mirage detection: given an image-question pair, the goal is to determine whether a VLM should answer or abstain before producing a response. We propose Text-Conditioned Layer-wise Internal Alignment (TC-LIA), a model-agnostic method that probes patch-token representations across the layers of a CLIP ViT-H/14 vision encoder. TC-LIA projects layer-wise image patch tokens into the final CLIP embedding space and measures their similarity to the question embedding, allowing the method to track whether question-relevant visual evidence emerges across vision layers. The resulting alignment trajectory is summarized using final image-text cosine similarity, late-layer top-k patch-text alignment, early-to-late gain, and layer-wise slope. These features are combined with pixel-statistic blank/noise detection, zero-shot domain routing, and structured VLM self-assessment in an ensemble. Across five VQA domains, three input conditions, and twelve VLM backbones, the best systems achieve approximately 94.6-94.7% three-class detection accuracy with mirage rates below 3%, while baseline mirage rates range from 21.7% to 66.6%.

中文摘要翻译: 视觉-语言模型(VLM)即使所需的视觉证据缺失、为空白或与问题无关，也能生成自信的视觉回答。这种被称为幻象(mirage)的失败模式(Asadi et al. 2026)在医疗和文档视觉问答中尤其令人担忧，因为看似合理但缺乏视觉依据的响应可能被误认为基于图像的证据。我们研究预发布幻象检测：给定一个图像-问题对，目标是在VLM产生响应之前确定其应该回答还是弃权。我们提出文本条件逐层内部对齐(TC-LIA)，这是一种模型无关的方法，用于探测CLIP ViT-H/14视觉编码器各层中的块token表示。TC-LIA将逐层图像块token投影到最终CLIP嵌入空间，并测量它们与问题嵌入的相似度，从而使该方法能够追踪问题相关视觉证据是否在视觉各层中涌现。所得的对齐轨迹通过最终图像-文本余弦相似度、后层top-k块-文本对齐、早层到后层的增益以及逐层斜率来总结。这些特征与像素统计的空白/噪声检测、零样本领域路由和结构化VLM自我评估相结合，构成集成系统。在五个VQA域、三种输入条件和十二个VLM骨干网络上，最佳系统实现了约94.6-94.7%的三类检测准确率，幻象率低于3%，而基线幻象率范围为21.7%至66.6%。

### [48] [Physical Object Understanding with a Physically Controllable World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00439)
*Rahul Venkatesh,Klemen Kotar,Lilian Naing Chen,Wanhee Lee,Gia Ancone,Seungwoo Kim,Luca Thomas Wheeler,Jared Watrous,Honglin Chen,Daniel Bear,Stefan Stojanov,Daniel LK Yamins*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一类新的概率世界模型，通过自回归序列建模训练，能够从原始视频中学习场景的物理结构——包括物体形成及其交互规律，并支持在3D空间中操纵物体以及计算物体间的物理关系。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 当前架构无法从部分观测中推断世界分布状态，缺乏能够估计任意视觉变量概率的概率世界模型，而这对于理解场景中区域如何形成物体以及支配其交互的物理规律至关重要。

Method: 提出一类新的概率世界模型，通过自回归序列建模进行高效训练，支持以任意视觉变量（如外观和动态）为条件估计其他变量的概率分布。模型通过顺序推断生成多个合理的未来世界状态，并分析这些未来帧中的运动相关性来提取物体及其关节子部件。

Result: 1) 模型能捕捉物体运动的物理定律，生成多个合理的未来世界状态；2) 通过分析未来帧的运动相关性，成功提取出物体及 articulated subparts；3) 发现物体后可在3D空间中操纵它们；4) 可计算物体间的物理关系，实现 Visual Jenga 等应用。

Conclusion: 该概率世界模型不仅能够从视频中学习物体的形成和物理交互规律，还能在3D中操纵物体并计算其物理关系，为视觉智能中的物理场景理解提供了一种新的范式。

Original Abstract: A central challenge in visual intelligence is learning the physical structure of scenes from raw videos: how regions form objects and the laws that govern their interactions. Solving these tasks requires world models capable of inferring distributional states of the world from partial observations - capabilities that current architectures do not provide. We introduce a new class of probabilistic world models that support estimation of the probability of any visual variable, such as appearance and dynamics, conditioned on any other variables. Here, we identify that these models can be trained efficiently with autoregressive sequence modeling, yielding world models from which rich object understanding emerges. First, we demonstrate that our model captures the physical laws governing how objects move by generating multiple plausible future states of the world through sequential inference. Then, by analyzing motion correlations across these futures, we extract objects and articulated object subparts. Having discovered these objects, we show that our world model can manipulate them in 3D. Finally, we demonstrate how physical relationships between objects can be computed from the world model, enabling applications such as Visual Jenga.

中文摘要翻译: 视觉智能的核心挑战在于从原始视频中学习场景的物理结构：区域如何形成物体，以及支配它们交互的法则。解决这些任务需要能够从部分观测中推断世界分布状态的世界模型——这是当前架构所不具备的能力。我们引入了一类新的概率世界模型，该模型支持以任意其他变量为条件，估计任何视觉变量（如外观和动态）的概率。我们发现，这类模型可以通过自回归序列建模高效训练，从而得到涌现出丰富物体理解的世界模型。首先，我们证明模型能够捕捉物体运动的物理定律，通过顺序推断生成多个合理的未来世界状态。然后，通过分析这些未来状态中的运动相关性，我们提取出物体及其关节子部件。在发现这些物体后，我们展示了该世界模型可以在3D中操纵它们。最后，我们展示了如何从世界模型中计算物体之间的物理关系，从而实现了诸如 Visual Jenga 等应用。

</details>


### [49] [Real-Time Physics Simulation with Dynamic Mesh-Gaussian Reconstructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00444)
*Adrian Ramlal,John S. Zelek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究将动态3D重建（如DG-Mesh）集成到物理仿真中的拓扑转换问题，提出了一种结合固定拓扑网格（用于物理）和高斯泼溅（用于渲染）的双表示框架，发现拓扑转换会导致65-80%的几何退化，证明高质量重建与物理兼容拓扑是根本冲突的目标。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 动态3D重建（如DG-Mesh）生成的网格拓扑结构多变，虽然几何质量高，但无法直接用于需要固定拓扑网格的物理仿真（如碰撞检测）。现有方法缺乏对拓扑转换能否在保持重建保真度的同时实现物理集成的系统性研究。

Method: 提出一个双表示框架：使用固定拓扑网格处理物理仿真，结合高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splatting）进行渲染。通过运行时顶点缓冲区更新实现加速。评估了两种转换策略——时间对应跟踪和基于模板的投影，并与原生固定拓扑方法（MaGS）在DG-Mesh数据集上进行比较。

Result: 双表示框架相比变拓扑基线实现了4.65倍加速。但两种拓扑转换方法均导致65-80%的几何质量退化，表现甚至不如直接使用原生固定拓扑方法MaGS，尽管DG-Mesh的初始几何质量更高。

Conclusion: 高质量重建与物理兼容的固定拓扑是根本冲突的目标，无法通过后处理（拓扑转换）来调和。该发现为未来开发物理感知的重建方法提供了指导，所提框架可兼容任何固定拓扑方法实现实时仿真。

Original Abstract: Integrating dynamic 3D reconstructions into physics simulation requires fixed mesh topology for efficient collision detection, but state-of-the-art methods like DG-Mesh produce varying topology optimized for geometric quality. We investigate whether topology conversion can enable physics integration while preserving reconstruction fidelity. We propose a dual-representation framework combining fixed-topology meshes for physics with Gaussian splatting for rendering, achieving 4.65$\times$ speedup over varying-topology baselines through runtime vertex buffer updates. We evaluate two conversion strategies, temporal correspondence tracking and template-based projection, against native fixed-topology methods (MaGS) on the DG-Mesh dataset. Our evaluation reveals that both conversion approaches incur 65-80% geometric degradation, producing results inferior to MaGS despite DG-Mesh's superior initial quality. This demonstrates that high-quality reconstruction and physics-compatible topology represent fundamentally distinct objectives that cannot be reconciled through post-processing. Our findings inform future development of physics-aware reconstruction methods and our framework enables real-time simulation with any fixed-topology approach.

中文摘要翻译: 将动态三维重建集成到物理仿真中需要固定网格拓扑以实现高效的碰撞检测，然而像DG-Mesh这样的最先进方法生成的是拓扑不断变化、以几何质量优先的重建结果。本文研究了拓扑转换是否能在保持重建保真度的同时实现物理集成。我们提出了一种双表示框架，将固定拓扑网格用于物理仿真，结合高斯泼溅用于渲染，通过运行时顶点缓冲区更新实现了相比变拓扑基线4.65倍的加速。我们在DG-Mesh数据集上评估了两种转换策略——时间对应跟踪和基于模板的投影，并与原生固定拓扑方法MaGS进行了比较。评估结果表明，两种转换方法均导致65-80%的几何质量退化，即便DG-Mesh的初始质量更高，其转换结果仍不如MaGS。这表明高质量重建与物理兼容的拓扑从根本上代表了两种不同的目标，无法通过后处理加以调和。我们的发现为未来开发物理感知的重建方法提供了指导，所提框架可兼容任何固定拓扑方法实现实时仿真。

</details>


### [50] [An explainable hierarchical self attention-based approach for tremor detection in the time domain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00461)
*Timothy Odonga,Jeanne M. Powell,Mark Saad,Richa Tripathi,Christine D. Esper,Stewart A. Factor,Hyeokhyen Kwon,J. Lucas Mckay*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个可解释的两阶段分层框架，直接在时域中从3D运动学标记时间序列数据学习震颤模式，使用深度卷积-LSTM网络提取局部时间片段特征，再通过视觉转换器建模长期时间动态进行试验级分类。该方法在9个身体部位上平均F1-score为0.765，低于频域最先进方法的0.909，但实现了端到端时域学习和事后可解释性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统震颤检测依赖临床专家评估或基于专家知识的频域特征，本文旨在探索一种数据驱动的时域建模方法，减少对专家工程化频谱特征的依赖，同时提供模型可解释性以揭示震颤的时域和空间模式。

Method: 提出一个两阶段分层框架：第一阶段使用深度卷积神经网络结合长短期记忆网络（CNN-LSTM）从短的非重叠时间片段中学习震颤表示；第二阶段使用视觉转换器（Vision Transformer）对这些时间片段特征的长时序动态进行建模，实现整次试验（session）级别的震颤分类。模型可解释性通过注意力权重和梯度加权类激活映射（Grad-CAM）实现。

Result: 在9个身体部位上评估，F1-score范围为0.594–0.947（平均0.765），低于频域最先进方法的0.909。模型仅需最小预处理，并通过注意力权重和Grad-CAM识别了不同身体部位的时域震颤特征。

Conclusion: 该概念验证研究证明了数据驱动的时域震颤检测框架在多个解剖部位上的可行性，能够减少对专家工程化频谱特征的依赖，并提供震颤时域和空间模式的事后可解释性，但当前性能尚未超越频域方法。

Original Abstract: Tremor is a common movement disorder associated with conditions like Parkinson's disease and Essential tremor, traditionally diagnosed through expert clinician assessment. Current automated detection methods rely on frequency-domain features informed by clinical expertise. In this work, we present an explainable, two-stage hierarchical framework for tremor detection in the time domain that learns tremor patterns directly from 3D kinematic marker time-series data across entire tremor-provoking trials. Our framework combined a deep convolutional and long short-term memory network to learn tremor representations from short, discrete, non-overlapping time segments of kinematic time series data from trials, which are then processed by a vision transformer that models their long-term temporal dynamics of time segment features for trial (session) level classification. Evaluated across nine body parts, the framework achieved F1-scores of 0.594 - 0.947 depending on body parts (average: 0.765), falling short of the frequency-domain state-of-the-art performance (0.909) while requiring minimal preprocessing. Attention weights and gradient-based class activation maps (Grad-CAM) identified time-domain features of tremor across body parts. This proof of concept demonstrated the feasibility of data-driven time-domain modeling for tremor detection across anatomically diverse body parts, while reducing reliance on expert-engineered spectral features and providing posthoc interpretability of temporal and anatomical patterns of tremor.

中文摘要翻译: 震颤是与帕金森病和特发性震颤等疾病相关的常见运动障碍，传统上通过临床专家评估进行诊断。当前的自动检测方法依赖于基于临床经验的频域特征。在本工作中，我们提出了一种可解释的两阶段分层框架，用于在时域中检测震颤，该框架直接从3D运动学标记时间序列数据中学习震颤模式，覆盖整个诱发震颤的试验过程。我们的框架结合了深度卷积和长短期记忆网络，从试验中运动学时间序列数据的短时、离散、非重叠时间段中学习震颤表示，随后由视觉转换器处理这些时间段特征的长时序动态，以进行试验（会话）级别分类。在九个身体部位上的评估结果显示，框架的F1-score因身体部位不同而在0.594–0.947之间（平均：0.765），虽然低于频域最先进方法的性能（0.909），但所需预处理极少。注意力权重和梯度加权类激活映射识别了不同身体部位的时域震颤特征。这一概念验证证明了数据驱动的时域建模在解剖学上多样的身体部位上进行震颤检测的可行性，同时减少了对专家工程化频谱特征的依赖，并提供了震颤时域和空间模式的事后可解释性。

</details>


### [51] [DarkVesselNet: Multi-Modal Remote Sensing and Trajectory Reasoning for Dark Vessel Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00445)
*Arun Sharma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DarkVesselNet是一个多模态遥感系统，融合AIS数据与Sentinel-1 SAR及Sentinel-2光学影像，通过地理空间基础模型骨干、TGARD式间隙检测和Pi-DPM启发的异常检测头，实现暗船检测。系统以Python包和Hugging Face Space形式发布，当前验证基于软件测试。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 暗船（未通过AIS报告自身位置的船只）检测需要融合多源遥感数据（AIS、SAR、光学影像），但目前缺乏一个统一、可测试的多模态融合框架。

Method: 提出DarkVesselNet多模态遥感堆栈，包含：(1) Sentinel-1 SAR与Sentinel-2光学影像的传感器融合；(2) 地理空间基础模型骨干网络；(3) AIS轨迹推理；(4) TGARD式间隙检测；(5) Pi-DPM启发的异常检测头。系统以Python包和Hugging Face Space形式提供。

Result: 当前验证为软件层面的测试，涵盖：SAR散斑滤波、光学波段比、Haversine距离、TGARD间隙发射、传感器配准、骨干网络token形状以及可微异常评分等模块的测试。

Original Abstract: Dark vessel detection requires fusing what vessels report through AIS with what satellites observe through radar and optical sensors. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有开放词汇3D场景分割通常依赖RGB-D视频、标定多视图图像或重建网格，设置较重。GeoSAM-3D旨在研究更轻量的设置：仅需单目视频和用户的一次点击/命名，即可实现3D分割传播，降低使用门槛。

Method: 结合冻结的图像和视频基础模型（如SAM）与单目3D高斯泼溅重建，在高斯质心上构建场景图，利用可微的图-测地线传播核（基于热核距离）替代欧氏最近邻，实现提示在3D场景中的传播。从SAM掩码中训练特征头，增强语义一致性。

Result: 验证了热核距离相比欧氏最近邻在弯曲表面上的连续性保持更好，并能减少近邻但非连接物体间的泄漏。评估协议覆盖了实现验证、图传播质量、泄漏控制和交互延迟。

Conclusion: 基于热核距离的图传播在轻量单目视频设置下有效提升了3D场景分割的连续性和抗泄漏能力，验证了方法的可行性和代码库的完整性。

Original Abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D scene segmentation usually assumes RGB-D video, calibrated multi-view imagery, or a reconstructed mesh. GeoSAM-3D studies a lighter setting: a user uploads a short monocular video, clicks or names an object in one frame, and receives a propagated 3D mask over a Gaussian scene. The implementation combines frozen image and video foundation models with a monocular 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction and a differentiable graph-geodesic propagation kernel over Gaussian centroids. The central design choice is to propagate prompts by heat-kernel distance on the reconstructed scene graph, rather than by Euclidean nearest neighbors in 3D. This preserves continuity around curved surfaces and reduces leakage across nearby but disconnected objects. This paper describes the repository state, the mathematical kernel implemented in geosam3d.propagate, the feature head trained from Segment Anything masks, and the validation already present in the codebase. The evaluation protocol separates implementation validation, graph propagation quality, leakage control, and interactive latency.

</details>


### [53] [Optimizing 3D Gaussian Splatting via Point Cloud Upsampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00450)
*Adrian Ramlal,Yan Song Hu,John S. Zelek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了多种点云上采样方法（线性插值、三角插值、样条曲面重建、移动最小二乘曲面拟合、Voronoi点生成）以及一种深度引导的点提升方法，用于改进3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的初始化质量。实验表明，不同上采样策略在不同场景中各有优劣，深度引导方法在无纹理区域尤其有效。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 3DGS的性能严重依赖于初始种子点的质量，而现有初始化方法存在局限。本研究旨在通过系统评估多种点云上采样方法，提升3DGS的初始化质量，从而改善整体重建效果。

Method: 1）评估五种点云上采样方法：线性插值、三角插值、基于样条的曲面重建、移动最小二乘曲面拟合、Voronoi点生成；2）提出一种深度引导的点提升方法，利用深度图保持与SfM重建的几何一致性。

Result: 在Mip-NeRF360和Replica数据集上的实验表明：曲面重建方法在有机、细节丰富的场景中表现更好；简单插值方法更适合分段平滑几何场景；深度引导方法在无纹理区域添加几何感知点方面表现突出。

Conclusion: 不同上采样策略在不同场景中各有优势，提供了根据场景特征和计算约束选择合适上采样方法的初步实用指南，增进了对点云初始化如何影响3DGS质量的理解。

Original Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is a technique for creating and rendering 3D scenes, however its performance depends heavily on the quality of initial seed points. To improve 3DGS initialization, this study presents and evaluates several point cloud upsampling approaches: linear interpolation, triangular interpolation, spline-based surface reconstruction, moving least squares surface fitting, and Voronoi-based point generation. Additionally, this research introduces a depth-guided point lifting method that leverages depth maps to maintain geometric consistency with Structure-from-Motion (SfM) reconstructions. Through extensive experiments on the Mip-NeRF360 and Replica datasets, the proposed methods demonstrate improvements in reconstruction quality across diverse scene types. Results indicate that different upsampling strategies excel in different scenarios: surface reconstruction methods perform better with organic, detailed scenes, while simpler interpolation approaches are more suited for scenes dominated by piecewise-smooth geometries. In comparison, the depth-guided approach shows promise for adding geometry-aware points across the entire scene, importantly in texture-less regions. These findings, which provide preliminary practical guidelines for selecting appropriate upsampling methods based on scene characteristics and computational constraints, advances the understanding of how point cloud initialization affects 3DGS quality.

中文摘要翻译: 3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）是一种用于创建和渲染3D场景的技术，然而其性能严重依赖于初始种子点的质量。为了改进3DGS的初始化，本研究评估了多种点云上采样方法：线性插值、三角插值、基于样条的曲面重建、移动最小二乘曲面拟合以及Voronoi点生成。此外，本研究还提出了一种深度引导的点提升方法，利用深度图保持与运动恢复结构（SfM）重建的几何一致性。通过在Mip-NeRF360和Replica数据集上进行大量实验，所提出的方法在不同场景类型中均展现了重建质量的提升。结果表明，不同的上采样策略在不同场景中各有优势：曲面重建方法在有机的、细节丰富的场景中表现更优，而简单的插值方法更适合以分段平滑几何为主的场景。相比之下，深度引导方法在跨场景添加几何感知点方面展现出潜力，尤其是在无纹理区域。这些发现为根据场景特征和计算约束选择合适的上采样方法提供了初步的实用指南，增进了对点云初始化如何影响3DGS质量的理解。

</details>


### [54] [Beyond Static Gaussians: An Empirical Investigation of Architectural Paradigms for Dynamic 3D Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00452)
*Adrian Ramlal,John S. Zelek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文全面分析了动态3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）方法，将其分为结构引导和高斯中心两种范式，揭示了重建质量/紧凑性与渲染速度之间的根本权衡。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 动态场景重建领域方法众多，但不同方法之间的权衡尚不清晰，需要系统性的分析来指导后续研究和应用开发。

Method: 将动态3DGS方法归为两类：结构引导方法（利用变形场、规范空间、网格等辅助表示建模时间变化）和高斯中心方法（通过连续函数或4D表示将动态直接编码到高斯原语中）。在D-NeRF基准上对两类代表性方法进行对比评估。

Result: 结构引导方法在重建保真度和模型紧凑性上更优；高斯中心方法渲染速度显著更快，可实现实时性能，但质量波动较大且存储开销可能较大。

Conclusion: 动态场景重建中存在重建质量/紧凑性与渲染速度之间的根本性权衡，这一发现为未来研究和应用开发提供了重要指导。

Original Abstract: Dynamic scene reconstruction via 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a compelling approach for representing evolving environments, yet understanding trade-offs between methodologies remains crucial. This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of dynamic 3DGS methods, categorizing them into two paradigms: structure-guided methods employing auxiliary representations (deformation fields, canonical spaces, grids) to model temporal changes, and gaussian-centric methods encoding dynamics directly into primitives via continuous functions or 4D representations. We evaluate representative methods from both paradigms on the D-NeRF benchmark. Our findings reveal that structure-guided methods achieve superior reconstruction fidelity and compact model sizes, while gaussian-centric approaches demonstrate significantly higher rendering speeds enabling real-time performance, though with greater quality variability and potentially substantial storage overhead. This analysis highlights a fundamental trade-off between reconstruction quality/compactness versus rendering speed, providing insights to guide future research and application development in dynamic scene reconstruction.

中文摘要翻译: 基于3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的动态场景重建已成为表示演化环境的一种引人注目的方法，但理解不同方法之间的权衡仍然至关重要。本文对动态3DGS方法进行了全面分析，将其分为两种范式：结构引导方法利用辅助表示（变形场、规范空间、网格）来建模时间变化，而高斯中心方法通过连续函数或4D表示将动态直接编码到原语中。我们在D-NeRF基准上评估了两种范式的代表性方法。我们的发现表明，结构引导方法在重建保真度和模型紧凑性方面更优，而高斯中心方法则展现出显著更高的渲染速度，可实现实时性能，但质量变异性较大且可能产生大量存储开销。本分析揭示了重建质量/紧凑性与渲染速度之间的根本性权衡，为动态场景重建领域的未来研究和应用开发提供了指导性见解。

</details>


### [55] [MUSCLE-NET: Predicted-Multiscale-Aware Network for Pedestrian Trajectory Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00471)
*Yu Liu,Ming Huang,Xiao Ren,Zhijie Liu,Youfu Li,He Kong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为MUSCLE-NET的多尺度多模态融合网络，通过结合互补的多模态线索和尺度自适应预测机制，解决了行人轨迹预测中对多样化观测信息利用不充分以及对未来运动尺度依赖性的忽视问题，在JAAD和PIE基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有行人轨迹预测方法未能充分利用多样化的观测信息（如边界框、速度、姿态等多模态数据），且在处理未来运动时忽略了尺度依赖性，将多尺度特征统一对待而不考虑底层运动动态，导致对不同行人行为的鲁棒性受限。

Method: 提出MUSCLE-NET，包含两个核心模块：(1) 多尺度多模态特征提取模块（MMFE），结合多尺度表示、模态感知重标定和方向性跨模态融合，从边界框、速度和姿态信息中构建语义对齐的表征；(2) 多尺度增强层次预测模块（MEHP），通过概率粗预测器、尺度对齐融合和渐进式精炼，自适应选择尺度相关线索以减轻空间漂移。

Result: 在JAAD和PIE两个行人轨迹预测基准数据集上，MUSCLE-NET相比现有最先进的轨迹预测方法取得了有竞争力的性能和一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: MUSCLE-NET通过多尺度多模态融合和尺度自适应预测机制，有效提升了行人轨迹预测的准确性和鲁棒性。

Original Abstract: Accurate pedestrian trajectory prediction is essential for safe navigation in autonomous driving and intelligent transportation systems. Despite substantial progress made by recent methods, most existing approaches are limited in fully exploiting diverse observations and often overlook the scale dependency of future motion, treating multiscale features uniformly regardless of underlying motion dynamics. This limits their robustness across diverse pedestrian behaviors. To address these challenges, we propose a Predicted-MUltiSCale-Aware Network (MUSCLE-NET) for Pedestrian Trajectory Forecasting that integrates complementary multimodal cues with scale-adaptive prediction mechanisms. The proposed framework is built upon a Multiscale Multimodal Feature Extraction (MMFE) module, which combines multiscale representation, modality-aware recalibration, and directional cross-modal fusion to construct semantically aligned representations from bounding boxes, velocities, and pose information. Building on these features, a Multiscale Enhanced Hierarchical Prediction (MEHP) module performs prediction-aware future-motion refinement via a probabilistic coarse predictor, scale-aligned fusion, and progressive refinement, adaptively selecting scale-relevant cues to mitigate spatial drift. Extensive experiments on the JAAD and PIE benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed MUSCLE-Net achieves competitive performance and consistent gains compared with state-of-the-art trajectory prediction methods.

中文摘要翻译: 准确的行人轨迹预测对于自动驾驶和智能交通系统中的安全导航至关重要。尽管近期方法取得了实质性进展，但大多数现有方法在充分利用多样化观测信息方面存在局限，并且常常忽视未来运动的尺度依赖性，将多尺度特征统一对待而不考虑底层运动动态。这限制了它们在不同行人行为中的鲁棒性。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种预测感知的多尺度网络（MUSCLE-NET）用于行人轨迹预测，该网络将互补的多模态线索与尺度自适应预测机制相结合。所提出的框架基于多尺度多模态特征提取（MMFE）模块构建，该模块结合了多尺度表示、模态感知重标定和方向性跨模态融合，从边界框、速度和姿态信息中构建语义对齐的表征。在这些特征的基础上，多尺度增强层次预测（MEHP）模块通过概率粗预测器、尺度对齐融合和渐进式精炼执行预测感知的未来运动精化，自适应地选择与尺度相关的线索以减轻空间漂移。在JAAD和PIE基准上的大量实验表明，所提出的MUSCLE-Net与最先进的轨迹预测方法相比，取得了有竞争力的性能和一致的性能提升。

</details>


### [56] [CodeCytos: AI-assisted spatial molecular imaging analysis via code-augmented agent action space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00472)
*Hung Q. Vo,Huy Q. Vo,Son T. Ly,Zhihao Wan,Anh-Vu Nguyen,Hong Zhao,Jianting Sheng,Stephen T. C. Wong,Hien V. Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CodeCytos，一个基于编码的推理代理框架，通过可编程的动态交互实现空间分子成像数据的自动化定制分析，在多种组织类型数据集上优于基线方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统组织图像分析软件需要人工干预、与代码驱动的自动化集成度低、且仅支持固定的预置空间细胞特征集，缺乏灵活性和可扩展性，难以满足复杂空间组织研究中定制化分析的需求。

Method: 提出CodeCytos，一个编码驱动的推理代理框架，支持动态可编程的交互式空间分子成像数据分析；采用最小提示设置，结合领域无关的小样本上下文编码推理示例，利用具有强编码能力的大语言模型作为骨干。

Result: 在额叶皮层、非小细胞肺癌、胰腺和扁桃体四种组织类型数据集上，CodeCytos在最小提示设置下优于基线方法；引入领域无关的小样本上下文编码推理示例(随机抽取的非空间分析领域样本)可显著提升性能，无需昂贵的专家标注领域内示例。

Conclusion: CodeCytos展示了代码行动代理在空间分子成像中辅助定制特征探索和加速生物标志物发现的潜力，通过可编程交互和领域无关的小样本学习实现了更高效、更灵活的空间组织分析。

Original Abstract: Conventional tissue image analysis software provides foundational capabilities for cellular analysis, including segmentation, basic morphological feature extraction, and spatial organization analysis. However, these tools often require manual intervention and are not well integrated with code-driven automation, limiting efficiency and scalability for complex spatial tissue studies. In addition, they offer limited flexibility for custom analyses, as they typically support only a fixed set of pre-implemented spatial cellular features. To address these limitations, we propose CodeCytos, a coding-based reasoning agent framework that enables dynamic, programmable interaction with spatial molecular imaging data to improve automation and customization. CodeCytos is designed to streamline the exploration of custom spatial cellular features and adapt to diverse research needs. We demonstrate its utility through case studies on four expert-curated datasets from distinct tissue types: frontal cortex, non-small-cell lung cancer, pancreas, and tonsil. We evaluate CodeCytos under a realistic minimal prompt setting, where bioscientists pose simple questions without task-specific instructions or contextual information about spatial cellular analysis, and benchmark multiple LLM backbones with strong coding capabilities. We further show that incorporating tailored, domain-agnostic few-shot in-context coding-reasoning examples (randomly sampled demonstrations outside the spatial analysis domain) can substantially improve performance without requiring costly, expert-crafted in-domain demonstrations. Overall, CodeCytos outperforms baseline approaches, highlighting the potential of code-action agents to assist with custom feature exploration in spatial molecular imaging and to accelerate biomarker discovery.

中文摘要翻译: 传统的组织图像分析软件为细胞分析提供基础功能，包括分割、基本形态特征提取和空间组织分析。然而，这些工具通常需要人工干预，且与代码驱动的自动化集成度不高，限制了复杂空间组织研究的效率和可扩展性。此外，它们对定制化分析的灵活性有限，通常仅支持一组固定的预置空间细胞特征。为解决这些局限性，我们提出CodeCytos——一种基于编码的推理代理框架，能够实现与空间分子成像数据的动态、可编程交互，以提升自动化和定制化能力。CodeCytos旨在简化定制化空间细胞特征的探索，并适应多样化的研究需求。我们通过在四种专家精选的不同组织类型数据集（额叶皮层、非小细胞肺癌、胰腺和扁桃体）上的案例研究来展示其实用性。我们在真实的极小提示设置下评估CodeCytos，其中生物科学家提出简单问题，而无需任务特定指令或空间细胞分析的上下文信息，并基准测试了多个具有强编码能力的大语言模型骨干。我们进一步证明，引入定制的、领域无关的小样本上下文编码推理示例（空间分析领域以外随机抽取的示范）可以显著提升性能，而无需昂贵、专家精心制作的领域内示范。总体而言，CodeCytos优于基线方法，凸显了代码行动代理在空间分子成像中辅助定制特征探索和加速生物标志物发现的潜力。

</details>


### [57] [3D Segment Anything Model with Visual Mamba for Diagnosing Placenta Accreta Spectrum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00489)
*Yuliang Zhang,Fang He,Lulu Peng,Tianyu Yan,Pingping Zhang,Ting Song,Lili Du,Dunjin Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个MRI-based PAS数据集及3DSAMba框架，通过3D SAM、Mamba状态空间模型和多层级特征融合实现胎盘植入谱的自动分割与诊断。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 胎盘植入谱（PAS）是罕见但高危的产科疾病，早期准确诊断至关重要。传统诊断依赖经验丰富的医生分析剖宫产史和MRI数据，而区级医院缺乏相应专家和资源，亟需自动化诊断方法。

Method: 提出3DSAMba框架：1）设计3D Segment Anything Model (SAM)并通过高效适配器机制融入医学领域信息；2）引入多层级聚合Mamba（MLAM）聚合不同层级特征图；3）设计融合状态空间模型（FSSM）融合编码器和解码器的多尺度特征；4）通过逐元素乘法将分割掩码应用于原始MRI图像，隔离病灶区域辅助诊断。

Result: 大量实验验证该框架显著提升了PAS诊断性能；同时建立了首个带精细分割和分类标注的MRI-based PAS数据集并开源。

Conclusion: 3DSAMba框架能有效实现PAS病灶自动分割，提升诊断准确性，数据集和代码已开源以促进该领域研究。

Original Abstract: Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) is a rare but highly dangerous obstetric disease. Early and accurate PAS diagnosis is critical for maternal health. Traditional PAS diagnosis relies on experienced doctors by analyzing the cesarean history and Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) data. However, district-level hospitals often lack the expertise and resources for accurate PAS diagnosis. To address these challenges, we establish the first MRI-based PAS dataset, which includes both fine-grained segmentation and classification annotations. Meanwhile, diagnosing PAS can be significantly enhanced by segmenting lesion areas from MRI images of the uterus. To achieve automatic PAS diagnosis, we propose 3DSAMba, a novel feature learning framework for effective lesion segmentation. More specifically, we first design a 3D Segment Anything Model (SAM) and incorporate medical domain information into the model through an efficient adapter mechanism. In addition, we introduce a Multi-Level Aggregation Mamba (MLAM) to aggregate feature maps across different levels and a Fusion State Space Model (FSSM) to fuse multi-scale features from both the encoder and decoder. Finally, we apply segmentation masks to the original MRI images through element-wise multiplication, effectively isolating lesion areas for more accurate PAS diagnosis. Extensive experiments validate that our framework significantly improves the PAS diagnostic performance. To facilitate further research in PAS diagnosis, we have released the dataset and source code at https://github.com/Drchip61/PASD.

中文摘要翻译: 胎盘植入谱（Placenta Accreta Spectrum, PAS）是一种罕见但极度危险的产科疾病。早期准确诊断PAS对孕产妇健康至关重要。传统的PAS诊断依赖经验丰富的医生分析剖宫产史和磁共振成像（MRI）数据。然而，区级医院往往缺乏准确诊断PAS所必需的专业知识和资源。为了应对这些挑战，我们建立了首个基于MRI的PAS数据集，该数据集包含精细的分割和分类标注。同时，通过从子宫MRI图像中分割病灶区域，可显著增强PAS诊断能力。为实现PAS的自动诊断，我们提出了3DSAMba——一种用于有效病灶分割的新型特征学习框架。具体而言，我们首先设计了3D Segment Anything Model（SAM），并通过高效的适配器机制将医学领域信息融入模型。此外，我们引入了多层级聚合Mamba（Multi-Level Aggregation Mamba, MLAM）来聚合不同层级的特征图，以及融合状态空间模型（Fusion State Space Model, FSSM）来融合来自编码器和解码器的多尺度特征。最后，我们通过逐元素乘法将分割掩码应用于原始MRI图像，有效隔离病灶区域以实现更准确的PAS诊断。大量实验验证了我们的框架显著提升了PAS诊断性能。为了促进PAS诊断的进一步研究，我们已在 https://github.com/Drchip61/PASD 开源了数据集和源代码。

</details>


### [58] [Pre-Deployment Robustness Stress Testing for CT Segmentation Systems Using Clinically Motivated Multi-Corruption Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00491)
*CholMin Kang,Jonghyun Chung,Amanpreet Kaurb,Nagesh Gulkotwarb,Arthi Sivasankaranb*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RAMP框架，通过多类型图像退化增强训练，显著提升CT分割模型在临床异构成像条件下的鲁棒性，将噪声基准上的平均受损Dice从0.610提升至0.753，鲁棒性差距从0.264缩小至0.064。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 基于深度学习的CT分割系统在干净基准图像上表现优异，但在临床异构环境中（噪声、分辨率损失、对比度变化、强度偏移、伪影等）性能显著下降，限制了实际部署的可靠性，亟需提升模型对临床图像退化的鲁棒性。

Method: 提出鲁棒性增强框架RAMP（Robustness via Augmented Multi-corruption Pipeline），包含三部分：解剖约束的空间扰动、CT强度变换、以及随机多退化组合策略，在训练阶段让模型暴露于临床可能的图像退化场景。

Result: 在两个CT分割评估场景中，RAMP均取得最强受损图像性能与最小干净-受损鲁棒性差距。五器官噪声基准：平均受损Dice从0.610提升至0.753，鲁棒性差距从0.264降至0.064；Abdomen1K基准：平均受损Dice从0.633提升至0.789，鲁棒性差距从0.290降至0.070。虽未达到最高干净图像Dice，但显著缓解了严重退化下的最差分割崩溃。

Conclusion: 多退化数据增强可以作为实用的部署前策略，提升CT分割系统在异构临床环境中的可靠性。

Original Abstract: Deep learning-based CT segmentation systems often achieve high accuracy on clean benchmark images, but their performance may degrade under heterogeneous clinical imaging conditions such as noise, resolution loss, contrast variation, intensity shift, and artifacts. This instability can limit reliable deployment in real-world medical imaging workflows.
  We propose Robustness via Augmented Multi-corruption Pipeline (RAMP), a robustness-oriented augmentation framework for CT segmentation. RAMP combines anatomically constrained spatial perturbations, CT intensity transformations, and stochastic multi-corruption composition to expose models to clinically plausible image degradation during training.
  Across two CT segmentation evaluation settings, RAMP achieved the strongest corrupted-image performance and the smallest clean-to-corrupted robustness gap. In the five-organ noisy evaluation benchmark, RAMP improved mean corrupted Dice from 0.610 to 0.753 and reduced the robustness gap from 0.264 to 0.064 compared with the nnU-Net baseline. In Abdomen1K, RAMP improved mean corrupted Dice from 0.633 to 0.789 and reduced the robustness gap from 0.290 to 0.070. Although RAMP did not achieve the highest clean-image Dice, it substantially mitigated worst-case segmentation collapse under severe image degradation.
  These results suggest that multi-corruption augmentation can serve as a practical pre-deployment strategy for improving the reliability of CT segmentation systems in heterogeneous clinical environments.

中文摘要翻译: 基于深度学习的CT分割系统在干净基准图像上通常能达到高准确率，但在噪声、分辨率损失、对比度变化、强度偏移和伪影等异构临床成像条件下，其性能可能会下降。这种不稳定性可能限制其在真实医疗成像工作流程中的可靠部署。
我们提出了鲁棒性增强框架RAMP（Robustness via Augmented Multi-corruption Pipeline），一种面向CT分割的鲁棒性导向数据增强框架。RAMP将解剖约束的空间扰动、CT强度变换和随机多退化组合相结合，在训练期间让模型暴露于临床可行的图像退化场景。
在两个CT分割评估场景中，RAMP均取得了最强的受损图像性能以及最小的干净-受损鲁棒性差距。在五器官噪声评估基准中，与nnU-Net基线相比，RAMP将平均受损Dice从0.610提升至0.753，并将鲁棒性差距从0.264缩小至0.064。在Abdomen1K上，RAMP将平均受损Dice从0.633提升至0.789，并将鲁棒性差距从0.290缩小至0.070。虽然RAMP未取得最高的干净图像Dice，但它显著缓解了严重图像退化下的最差分割崩溃。
这些结果表明，多退化数据增强可以作为实用的部署前策略，用于提升CT分割系统在异构临床环境中的可靠性。

</details>


### [59] [OptiWorld: Optimal Control for Video World Generation under Physical Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00499)
*Yu Yuan,Jianhao Yuan,Xijun Wang,Daiqing Li,Liu He,Lu Ling,Stanley H. Chan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OptiWorld 是一个在视频生成推理阶段引入经典最优控制的框架，通过提取紧凑世界状态、在物理约束下规划最优轨迹、并基于该轨迹渲染视频，使生成视频具有更优的动态特性，适用于目标条件图像到视频生成、视频动态编辑和反事实生成等任务。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽能生成合理的运动，但无法主动控制或优化底层动力学，导致生成视频中物体的轨迹可能不安全、不光滑、低效或物理不一致。

Method: OptiWorld 首先提取紧凑的任务相关世界状态，然后在物理约束下规划最优轨迹（将规划转化为连续流形上的几何问题，统一处理3D几何和任务相关的物理约束），最后基于该轨迹渲染视频。

Result: OptiWorld 能够生成具有更优动力学的视频，在目标条件图像到视频生成、视频动态编辑和反事实生成等多个任务上表现出强大的潜力。

Conclusion: 通过在视频生成推理阶段添加最优控制层，可以有效改善生成视频的动力学质量，使生成结果更符合物理约束和任务需求。

Original Abstract: Video generation models are becoming a scalable form of world models, but they mainly generate plausible motion rather than proactively control or optimize the underlying dynamics. As a result, an object in the generated video may follow trajectories that are unsafe, not smooth, inefficient, or physically inconsistent. In this work, we propose \textbf{OptiWorld}, a framework that brings classical optimal control into video generation at inference time. OptiWorld first extracts a compact, task-relevant world state, then plans an optimal trajectory under physical constraints, and finally renders the video conditioned on this trajectory. We formulate planning as a geometric problem on a continuous manifold, which converts 3D geometry and task-dependent physical constraints into a unified planning geometry. By adding this optimal-control layer, OptiWorld generates videos with preferable dynamics, demonstrating strong potential in multiple tasks including goal-conditioned image-to-video generation, video dynamics editing, and counterfactual generation.

中文摘要翻译: 视频生成模型正逐渐成为一种可扩展的世界模型形式，但它们主要生成看似合理的运动，而非主动控制或优化底层动力学。因此，生成视频中的物体可能沿着不安全、不光滑、低效或物理不一致的轨迹运动。在这项工作中，我们提出\textbf{OptiWorld}，一个在推理阶段将经典最优控制引入视频生成的框架。OptiWorld 首先提取紧凑的、与任务相关的世界状态，然后在物理约束下规划最优轨迹，最后基于该轨迹渲染视频。我们将规划问题形式化为连续流形上的几何问题，将3D几何和任务相关的物理约束转化为统一的规划几何。通过添加这一最优控制层，OptiWorld 能够生成具有更优动力学的视频，在包括目标条件图像到视频生成、视频动态编辑以及反事实生成在内的多个任务中展现出强大的潜力。

</details>


### [60] [V-LynX: Token Interface Alignment for Video+X LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00508)
*Jungin Park,Jiyoung Lee,Kwanghoon Sohn*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现Video LLMs中存在一种“token接口”连续流形，并基于此提出V-LynX框架，通过轻量级辅助路径和未配对单模态数据对齐，将新模态高效集成到Video LLMs中，在多项音视频、3D、高帧率及多视角视频理解任务上达到SOTA。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有Video LLMs集成新模态通常需要繁重的专用编码器或成对监督数据，成本高昂。本文受Video LLMs中存在视觉token可作为独立实体运行的连续流形这一发现启发，旨在以更轻量、可扩展的方式将新模态融入Video LLMs。

Method: V-LynX在冻结的视觉编码器旁并行添加一个轻量级辅助通路，通过对齐注意力响应和统计分布，利用未配对的单模态数据将新感官输入与视频内在先验对齐，从而保持流形兼容性，无需成对监督或重型编码器。

Result: 在音视频问答、3D推理、高帧率及多视角视频理解等多项基准上达到SOTA，且效率优异。

Conclusion: V-LynX验证了利用Video LLMs内部token接口流形特性来高效集成新模态的可行性，为多模态Video LLMs的轻量级扩展提供了新范式。

Original Abstract: This study introduces an intriguing phenomenon in Video LLMs: rather than merely translating frames into textual embeddings, Video LLMs establish a continuous manifold, token interface, allowing visual tokens to operate as standalone entities within the architecture. Exploiting this discovery, we propose V-LynX, a scalable framework that integrates novel modalities into Video LLMs by repurposing the internalized interface. Departing from conventional paradigms that necessitate heavy modality-specific encoders or paired supervision, V-LynX employs a lightweight auxiliary pathway in parallel with the frozen vision encoder. Our method integrates new sensory inputs with intrinsic video priors by aligning both attention responses and statistical distributions using unpaired unimodal data sets. This ensures manifold compatibility while preserving the integrity of the Video LLMs. Extensive benchmarks demonstrate that V-LynX achieves SOTA and efficiency across audio-visual QA, 3D reasoning, high-frame-rate, and multi-view video understanding. The code is available at https://github.com/park-jungin/lynx.

中文摘要翻译: 本研究在视频大语言模型中发现了一个有趣的现象：Video LLMs并非仅仅将帧翻译为文本嵌入，而是建立了一个连续的流形——token接口，使得视觉token能够在架构内作为独立实体运行。基于这一发现，我们提出了V-LynX，一个可扩展的框架，通过重用这一内部化接口将新模态集成到Video LLMs中。与需要繁重的模态专用编码器或成对监督的传统范式不同，V-LynX在冻结的视觉编码器旁并行采用了一个轻量级辅助通路。我们的方法通过使用未配对的单模态数据对齐注意力响应和统计分布，将新感官输入与视频内在先验相整合，从而在保持Video LLMs完整性的同时确保流形兼容性。广泛的基准测试表明，V-LynX在音视频问答、3D推理、高帧率及多视角视频理解任务上达到了SOTA性能且效率优异。代码开源地址：https://github.com/park-jungin/lynx。

</details>


### [61] [Structure-Aware Consistency Priors for Shape from Polarization in Complex Media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00509)
*Kaimin Yu,Puyun Wang,Huayang He,Xianyu Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对复杂介质（以冰为例）的单视角偏振图像表面法线恢复方法。通过自相关函数的结构感知偏振先验捕捉AoLP局部空间一致性，并设计双分支网络IceSfP融合原始偏振特征与先验信息，在构建的首个真实冰SfP数据集上实现了MAE为16.01°的最优性能，比第二名低2.74°。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 复杂介质（如冰）中，光与物质的复杂相互作用导致偏振观测与表面法线之间存在非线性映射关系，使得从单视角偏振图像中恢复表面法线极具挑战性，现有方法难以有效处理这种复杂介质的几何感知问题。

Method: 提出一种基于自相关函数的结构感知偏振先验，用于捕捉偏振角（AoLP）的局部空间一致性；在此基础上设计双分支网络IceSfP，通过跨模态注意力机制和多尺度特征融合，将原始偏振特征与先验信息进行集成，从而实现复杂介质条件下的精确表面法线估计。

Result: 构建了首个真实世界的冰SfP数据集。实验结果表明，该方法在所有评估指标上均优于现有方法，MAE达到16.01°，比第二名方法低2.74°。

Conclusion: 该框架为复杂介质中的高精度几何感知提供了一种可泛化的解决方案。

Original Abstract: Recovering surface normals from single view polarization images in complex media remains challenging. This paper focuses on ice as a representative complex medium, where intricate light matter interactions lead to a nonlinear mapping between polarization observations and surface normals. To address this, a structure-aware polarization prior based on autocorrelation functions is proposed to capture the local spatial consistency of AoLP. Building on this, a dual-branch network (IceSfP) is designed to integrate raw polarization features with priors via cross modal attention and multi-scale feature fusion, enabling accurate surface normal estimation under complex media conditions. To evaluate the method, the first real-world ice SfP dataset is constructed. Experimental results show that the method outperforms existing approaches across all metrics, achieving a MAE of 16.01 deg, which is 2.74 deg lower than the second-best method. The framework provides a generalizable solution for high-precision geometric perception in complex media.

中文摘要翻译: 在复杂介质中，从单视角偏振图像恢复表面法线仍然具有挑战性。本文以冰作为代表性复杂介质进行研究，其中复杂的光与物质相互作用导致偏振观测与表面法线之间存在非线性映射。为解决这一问题，本文提出了一种基于自相关函数的结构感知偏振先验，用于捕捉偏振角（AoLP）的局部空间一致性。在此基础上，设计了双分支网络IceSfP，通过跨模态注意力机制和多尺度特征融合将原始偏振特征与先验信息进行集成，从而在复杂介质条件下实现精确的表面法线估计。为评估该方法，本文构建了首个真实世界的冰SfP数据集。实验结果表明，该方法在所有评估指标上均优于现有方法，平均绝对误差（MAE）达到16.01°，比第二名方法低2.74°。该框架为复杂介质中的高精度几何感知提供了一种可泛化的解决方案。

</details>


### [62] [An Effective Solution for the CVPR 2026 8th UG2+ Challenge Track 3: Dynamic Object Segmentation in Turbulence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00522)
*Hongzhen Li,Miao Yu,Leilei Cao,Youwei Pan,Yingfang Zhu,Fengjie Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对CVPR 2026 UG2+挑战赛Track 3的动态目标分割任务，本文基于SegAnyMo基线框架，通过数据域自适应（引入DAVIS和DOST数据子集并施加模拟大气波动退化）和时空后处理模块（去除边界连接假前景和短时碎片噪声，保留真实小目标及原始标签），在严重大气畸变下提升了分割性能，最终获得挑战赛第二名。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 在严重大气畸变条件下，现有的动态目标分割方法性能显著下降，需要提升模型对复杂几何失真的鲁棒性并有效去除噪声伪影。

Method: 1）数据驱动的域自适应策略：从DAVIS数据集中选取序列，结合DOST数据集子集，施加模拟大气波动退化来增强对复杂几何畸变的鲁棒性；2）时空后处理模块：去除边界连接假前景和短时碎片噪声，同时保留真实小目标并保持帧间原始个体标签不变。

Result: 所提方法在UG2+挑战赛Track 3中取得了第二名。

Conclusion: 结合数据域自适应与时空后处理可以有效提升大气畸变下的动态目标分割性能，方法在挑战赛中取得优异成绩验证了其有效性。

Original Abstract: In this work, we present our solution for the 8th UG2+ Challenge (CVPR 2026) Track 3: Dynamic Object Segmentation in Turbulence (DOST). Our method is built upon the strong baseline framework Segment Any Motion (SegAnyMo), which provides powerful mask generation and motion tracking capabilities. To further boost the segmentation performance under severe atmospheric distortions, we propose two key improvements. First, we employ a data-centric domain adaptation strategy. We significantly expand our training data by incorporating selected sequences from the DAVIS dataset alongside a subset of the DOST dataset, and apply simulated atmospheric fluctuation degradations to enhance the model's robustness against complex geometric distortions. Second, we introduce a spatio-temporal post-processing module. This refinement step effectively removes persistent boundary-connected false foregrounds and short-lived fragmented noise, while strictly preserving genuine small targets and maintaining original individual labels across frames. With these combined strategies, our proposed method ranks the 2st place in the challenge.

中文摘要翻译: 本文介绍了我们在第8届UG2+挑战赛（CVPR 2026）Track 3：湍流中动态目标分割（DOST）中的解决方案。我们的方法基于强大的基线框架Segment Any Motion（SegAnyMo），该框架提供了强大的掩码生成和运动跟踪能力。为了进一步提升在严重大气畸变下的分割性能，我们提出了两个关键改进。首先，我们采用了一种数据驱动的域自适应策略。通过引入来自DAVIS数据集的选定序列以及DOST数据集的一个子集，并施加模拟大气波动退化来增强模型对复杂几何失真的鲁棒性，从而显著扩展了训练数据。其次，我们引入了一个时空后处理模块。这一细化步骤能有效去除持续与边界相连的假前景以及短时碎片噪声，同时严格保留真实小目标并保持帧间原始个体标签不变。通过这些组合策略，我们的方法在挑战赛中取得了第二名。

</details>


### [63] [ETC: Extreme Token Compression via Task-aware Visual Information Distillation in VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00543)
*Yiling Gao,Hongchen Wei,Zhenzhong Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出极端令牌压缩框架ETC，基于变分信息蒸馏原理，在视觉-语言模型中将高分辨率图像令牌压缩至极少数甚至单个令牌，显著降低KV缓存开销且保持任务性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 高分辨率图像在视觉-语言模型中产生大量视觉令牌，导致推理时高计算成本和KV缓存开销，亟需一种能大幅压缩令牌数量同时最小化任务损失的解决方案。

Method: 从信息论角度证明最小化任务损失需要压缩表示保留指令感知的充分统计量；利用文本到图像的交叉注意力对原始视觉特征加权以近似潜在指令感知预测统计量；引入变分信息蒸馏使压缩表示保留恢复该预测统计量的必要信息。

Result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B和Qwen3-VL-2B上实验表明，ETC即使在单令牌压缩下依然有效，大幅降低KV缓存开销的同时保持较强任务性能。

Conclusion: ETC框架通过变分信息蒸馏实现了极端的视觉令牌压缩，在几乎不损失任务性能的前提下显著降低推理成本，为高分辨率VLM的高效部署提供了可行方案。

Original Abstract: In Vision-Language Models (VLMs), high-resolution images produce a large number of visual tokens, resulting in high computational costs and KV-cache overhead during inference. To address this problem, we propose an Extreme Token Compression (ETC) framework that minimizes task loss when reducing the number of input tokens based on the principle of variational information distillation. Specifically, from an information-theoretic perspective, we show that minimizing task loss requires the compact representation to preserve the instruction-aware sufficient statistic of the task-relevant visual information for prediction. In practice, ETC leverages text-to-image cross-attention to weight the original visual features to approximate the latent instruction-aware predictive statistic. Moreover, ETC introduces a variational information distillation, enabling the compact representation to preserve the essential information to recover this predictive statistic. Experiments on LLaVA-1.5-7B and Qwen3-VL-2B show that ETC remains effective even under single-token compression, substantially reducing KV-cache overhead while retaining strong task performance.

中文摘要翻译: 在视觉-语言模型（VLM）中，高分辨率图像会产生大量视觉令牌，导致推理过程中计算成本高、KV缓存开销大。为解决这一问题，我们提出极端令牌压缩（ETC）框架，该框架基于变分信息蒸馏原理，在减少输入令牌数量时最小化任务损失。具体而言，从信息论角度我们证明：最小化任务损失要求压缩表示保留用于预测的、指令感知的任务相关视觉信息的充分统计量。在实践中，ETC利用文本到图像的交叉注意力对原始视觉特征进行加权，以近似潜在的指令感知预测统计量。此外，ETC引入变分信息蒸馏，使压缩表示能够保留恢复该预测统计量的必要信息。在LLaVA-1.5-7B和Qwen3-VL-2B上的实验表明，即使在单令牌压缩条件下，ETC依然有效，在显著降低KV缓存开销的同时保持强大的任务性能。

</details>


### [64] [CAFOSat: A Strongly Annotated Dataset for Infrastructure-Aware CAFO Mapping Using High-Resolution Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00548)
*Oishee Bintey Hoque,Nibir Chandra Mandal,Mandy L Wilson,Samarth Swarup,Madhav Marathe,Abhijin Adiga*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了CAFOSat——一个面向美国集中型动物养殖场（CAFO）大规模遥感制图的强标注、基础设施感知数据集，包含45,000多张影像块、20个州、4大类CAFO，并引入人工参与的人机协同标注流程和合成数据增强管道，显著提升了CAFO分类与泛化性能。
