TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的4D动态形状生成方法，通过解耦运动与形状的潜在空间，利用条件神经符号距离场和基于蒙皮权重与刚性变换的形变表示，结合扩散模型，在生成质量和效率上优于现有方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有4D生成工作（如HyperDiffusion）将运动表示与形状表示耦合在4D占用场中，导致时间一致性差且渲染速度慢。本文旨在解决这一问题，实现高质量且高效的4D动态形状生成。

Method: 1）提出一种新的神经形变表示，通过预测多部位的蒙皮权重和刚性变换来解耦运动与形状的潜在空间；2）与条件神经符号距离场结合，构建4D表示架构；3）设计扩散模型训练过程，利用该4D表示提取的形状和运动特征作为数据点进行生成。

Result: 无条件生成、条件生成和运动重定向实验均表明，本方法在4D动态形状生成上优于先前工作，且具有多种潜在应用。

Conclusion: 本文提出的解耦运动与形状的4D表示架构，配合扩散模型，显著提升了4D动态形状的生成质量和效率，并展示了在运动重定向等任务中的实用性。

Original Abstract: Recent developments in 3D shape representation opened new possibilities for generating detailed 3D shapes. Despite these advances, there are few studies dealing with the generation of 4D dynamic shapes that have the form of 3D objects deforming over time. To bridge this gap, we focus on generating 4D dynamic shapes with an emphasis on both generation quality and efficiency in this paper. HyperDiffusion, a previous work on 4D generation, proposed a method of directly generating the weight parameters of 4D occupancy fields but suffered from low temporal consistency and slow rendering speed due to motion representation that is not separated from the shape representation of 4D occupancy fields. Therefore, we propose a new neural deformation representation and combine it with conditional neural signed distance fields to design a 4D representation architecture in which the motion latent space is disentangled from the shape latent space. The proposed deformation representation, which works by predicting skinning weights and rigid transformations for multiple parts, also has advantages over the deformation modules of existing 4D representations in understanding the structure of shapes. In addition, we design a training process of a diffusion model that utilizes the shape and motion features that are extracted by our 4D representation as data points. The results of unconditional generation, conditional generation, and motion retargeting experiments demonstrate that our method not only shows better performance than previous works in 4D dynamic shape generation but also has various potential applications.

中文摘要翻译: 3D形状表示的最新进展为生成精细的3D形状开辟了新的可能性。尽管取得了这些进展，但关于生成随时间变形的3D物体——即4D动态形状——的研究仍然很少。为了弥合这一差距，本文聚焦于生成4D动态形状，同时强调生成质量和效率。此前关于4D生成的工作HyperDiffusion提出了一种直接生成4D占用场权重参数的方法，但由于其运动表示未与4D占用场的形状表示解耦，导致时间一致性差且渲染速度慢。因此，我们提出一种新的神经形变表示，并将其与条件神经符号距离场相结合，设计了一种运动潜在空间与形状潜在空间解耦的4D表示架构。所提出的形变表示通过预测多部位的蒙皮权重和刚性变换来工作，在理解形状结构方面相较于现有4D表示的形变模块也具有优势。此外，我们设计了一个扩散模型的训练过程，利用由我们提出的4D表示提取的形状和运动特征作为数据点。无条件生成、条件生成和运动重定向实验的结果表明，我们的方法不仅在4D动态形状生成上表现出优于先前工作的性能，还具有多种潜在的应用场景。

</details>


### [121] [ProductWebGen: Benchmarking Multimodal Product Webpage Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01022)
*Zhihong Liu,Siqi Kou,Zheng Li,Ye Ma,Quan Chen,Peng Jiang,Kai Yu,Zhijie Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ProductWebGen基准，系统评估多模态生成模型在商品展示网页生成任务上的能力，包含500个测试样本和13个商品类别，并设计了两种评估工作流（基于编辑和基于统一模型）。实验表明基于编辑的方法在网页指令遵循和内容吸引力上领先，而基于统一模型的方法在视觉内容指令执行上更有优势。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 产品展示网页生成任务要求严格的视觉一致性和高保真指令遵循，这与先进多模态生成模型（如图像编辑模型和统一模型）的核心能力高度契合，但目前缺乏系统性的基准来评估这些模型在该任务上的表现。

Method: 构建ProductWebGen基准（500个测试样本，13类商品），设计两种工作流：1）基于编辑的方法：用大语言模型生成HTML代码，用图像编辑模型生成图像；2）基于统一模型的方法：用单一统一模型同时生成HTML和图像。另构建ProductWebGen-1k微调数据集（1000组真实商品图像+LLM生成的HTML代码）并在开源统一模型BAGEL上验证其有效性。

Result: 基于编辑的方法在网页指令遵循和内容吸引力上取得领先结果；基于统一模型的方法在视觉内容指令执行上更有优势。ProductWebGen-1k微调数据集在BAGEL模型上验证有效。

Conclusion: 产品展示网页生成任务可用于系统评估多模态生成模型，不同类型模型各具优势；所构建的数据集对提升开源统一模型能力有效。

Original Abstract: Crafting a product display webpage from a source product image, along with layout and visual content instructions, holds significant practical value for domains such as marketing, advertising, and E-commerce. Intuitively, this task demands strict visual consistency across product displays and high-fidelity instruction following to jointly generate renderable HTML code. These requirements on controllability and instruction-following are closely aligned with the core features of advanced multimodal generative models, such as image editing models and unified models. To this end, this paper introduces ProductWebGen to systematically benchmark the product webpage generation capacities of these models. We organize ProductWebGen with 500 test samples covering 13 product categories; each sample consists of a source image, a visual content instruction, and a webpage instruction. The task is to generate a product showcase webpage including multiple consistent images in accordance with the source image and instructions. Given the mixed-modality input-output nature of the task, we design and systematically compare two workflows for evaluation -- one uses large language models and image editing models to separately generate HTML code and images (editing-based), while the other relies on a single UM to generate both, with image generation conditioned on the preceding multimodal context (UM-based). Empirical results show that editing-based approaches achieve leading results in webpage instruction following and content appeal, while UM-based ones may display more advantages in fulfilling visual content instructions. We also construct a supervised fine-tuning dataset, ProductWebGen-1k, with 1,000 groups of real product images and LLM-generated HTML code. We verify its effectiveness on the open-source UM BAGEL. The data and code are available at https://github.com/SJTU-DENG-Lab/ProductWebGen.

中文摘要翻译: 从源商品图像以及布局和视觉内容指令出发，制作产品展示网页在营销、广告和电子商务等领域具有重要的实用价值。直观上，这一任务要求产品展示之间保持严格的视觉一致性，并具备高保真度的指令遵循能力，以联合生成可渲染的HTML代码。这些对可控性和指令遵循的要求与先进多模态生成模型（如图像编辑模型和统一模型）的核心能力高度契合。为此，本文引入ProductWebGen来系统性地基准测试这些模型的产品网页生成能力。我们构建了包含500个测试样本的ProductWebGen基准，覆盖13个商品类别；每个样本由一张源图像、一条视觉内容指令和一条网页指令组成。任务要求根据源图像和指令生成包含多张一致图像的产品展示网页。鉴于该任务具有混合模态输入输出的特点，我们设计并系统比较了两种评估工作流——一种利用大语言模型和图像编辑模型分别生成HTML代码和图像（基于编辑的方法），另一种则依赖单一统一模型同时生成两者，图像生成以前序多模态上下文为条件（基于统一模型的方法）。实验结果表明，基于编辑的方法在网页指令遵循和内容吸引力方面取得了领先结果，而基于统一模型的方法在完成视觉内容指令方面可能更具优势。我们还构建了包含1000组真实商品图像和LLM生成的HTML代码的监督微调数据集ProductWebGen-1k，并在开源统一模型BAGEL上验证了其有效性。数据和代码发布在https://github.com/SJTU-DENG-Lab/ProductWebGen。

</details>


### [122] [Data Collection for Training Quality-Control AI in Carpet Manufacturing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01023)
*Akbar Erkinov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种用于机织和簇绒地毯生产的在线机器视觉系统设计方案，集成了实时缺陷检测与系统性图像数据收集功能，基于六西格玛DMAIC项目，采用线扫描相机与组合照明，分阶段建模策略从无监督异常检测演进到有监督检测分割，将数据收集作为一等工程目标。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 地毯生产中的视觉检测仍以人工目检为主，存在速度慢、主观性强、一致性差等问题，尤其在现代化织机的高速宽幅生产条件下更为突出。同时，一个生产设施因增加织机即将出现生产瓶颈，且基线缺陷率高、质量故障带来的财务风险显著，亟需自动化的在线检测方案。

Method: 基于同步线扫描相机结合明场与掠射照明的成像子系统；推导满足多米幅宽下精细结构缺陷检测所需的分辨率和吞吐量要求；定义地毯专用缺陷分类体系；采用分阶段建模策略：先以无监督异常检测（在无缺陷材料上训练）起步，再通过人在回路标注飞轮演进为有监督检测与分割模型。

Result: 将检测性能与DMAIC目标关联，展示了缺陷逃逸率的降低如何转化为过程质量和过程西格玛水平的提升，给出了一个端到端的可部署蓝图。

Conclusion: 本方案的贡献在于提供了一个端到端的、可部署的蓝图，将数据收集视为一等工程目标而非事后补充，从而支持在整个安装生命周期内持续训练更高质量控制模型。

Original Abstract: Visual inspection remains the dominant quality-control practice in woven and tufted carpet production, yet it is slow, subjective, and inconsistent at the line speeds and widths of modern looms. We present a design proposal for an in-line machine-vision system whose primary purpose is twofold: to inspect the carpet web in real time and, equally importantly, to systematically collect and label images of defect patterns so that increasingly capable quality-control models can be trained over the life of the installation.The proposal is grounded in a concrete industrial setting: a Six Sigma (DMAIC) project at a woven-carpet production facility that anticipated a production bottleneck following the installation of additional weaving machines, with a substantial baseline defect rate and significant financial exposure associated with quality failures. We describe an imaging subsystem based on synchronized line-scan cameras with combined bright-field and grazing illumination, derive the resolution and throughput requirements needed to resolve fine structural defects across a multi-metre web, and define a carpet-specific defect taxonomy.We then lay out a staged modelling strategy that begins with unsupervised anomaly detection trained on defect-free material, following the paradigm exemplified by the carpet category of the MVTec Anomaly Detection benchmark, and matures through a human-in-the-loop annotation flywheel into supervised detection and segmentation models. Finally, we connect detection performance to the DMAIC objectives, showing how reductions in escaped defects translate into improved process quality and process sigma levels. The contribution is an end-to-end, deployable blueprint that treats data collection as a first-class engineering objective rather than an afterthought.

中文摘要翻译: 视觉检测仍然是机织和簇绒地毯生产中占主导地位的质量控制实践，但在现代织机的线速度和幅宽条件下，它速度慢、主观性强且不一致。我们提出了一种在线机器视觉系统的设计方案，其首要目的有两个：实时检测地毯幅面，以及同样重要地，系统地收集和标注缺陷模式图像，以便在安装的整个生命周期内训练日益强大的质量控制模型。该方案基于一个具体的工业场景：在一个机织地毯生产设施中开展的六西格玛（DMAIC）项目，该设施在增加额外的织机后预计会出现生产瓶颈，且基线缺陷率较高，质量故障带来的财务风险显著。我们描述了基于同步线扫描相机并结合明场和掠射照明的成像子系统，推导了在多米宽幅幅面上解析精细结构缺陷所需的分辨率和吞吐量要求，并定义了地毯专用的缺陷分类体系。然后，我们提出了一种分阶段建模策略，该策略从在无缺陷材料上训练的无监督异常检测开始，遵循MVTec异常检测基准中地毯类别所体现的范式，并通过人在回路标注飞轮演进到有监督的检测和分割模型。最后，我们将检测性能与DMAIC目标联系起来，展示了缺陷逃逸率的降低如何转化为过程质量和过程西格玛水平的提升。本文的贡献在于提供了一个端到端的、可部署的蓝图，该蓝图将数据收集视为一等工程目标，而不是事后补充。

</details>


### [123] [Ask4VG: Risk-Aware Question Selection for Reducing Prior-Driven Answers in Medical VQA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01044)
*Xiaorong Zhu,Qiang Li,Zibo Xu,Weijie Wang,Weizhi Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Ask4VG框架，通过反事实视觉探针估计问题引起的幻觉风险，并利用该风险对候选问题改写进行重排序，从而在医学VQA中选择更依赖图像证据的问题，减少幻觉响应。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 医学VQA中许多问题是通用、模板化的，容易让模型学习问题-答案捷径而非基于图像的推理，导致幻觉响应风险增加。

Method: 通过反事实视觉探针（将同一问题置于原始、扰动、空白、不匹配图像下）评估答案关系，转化为弱监督信号训练风险估计器，再对候选问题改写进行重排序，优先选择对缺失或不匹配视觉证据鲁棒性更低的问题。

Result: 在VQA-RAD上用Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct，仅提示改写增加反事实风险，而预测风险重排序将保留风险从0.658降至0.623，精确准确率从0.337提升至0.356；PMC-VQA外部验证同样显示风险降低与轻微准确率提升。

Conclusion: 问题选择是响应级幻觉缓解的有效补充手段，能够提升医学VQA的可靠性。

Original Abstract: Medical visual question answering requires models to ground their responses in image evidence, because visually unsupported answers can mislead downstream interpretation. However, many medical VQA questions are generic, template-like, or highly similar in form, which can encourage models to learn question-answer shortcuts instead of image-dependent reasoning and thereby increase the risk of hallucinated responses. We propose Ask4VG, a label-free pilot framework for risk-aware question selection. Ask4VG estimates question-induced hallucination risk through counterfactual visual probing: the same question is asked under the original image, a perturbed image, a blank image, and a mismatched image, and the resulting answer relations are converted into weak supervision for a counterfactual risk estimator. The learned estimator then reranks candidate question rewrites to favor intent-preserving questions that are less invariant to missing or mismatched visual evidence before final answer generation. On VQA-RAD with Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct, prompt-only rewriting increases counterfactual risk, whereas predicted-risk reranking reduces held-out risk from 0.658 to 0.623 and improves exact accuracy from 0.337 to 0.356. A 300-sample PMC-VQA external check shows the same direction of risk reduction with a small accuracy gain. These results suggest that question selection is a promising complement to response-level hallucination mitigation for reliable medical VQA.

中文摘要翻译: 医学视觉问答要求模型将其回答扎根于图像证据，因为缺乏视觉支持的答案可能误导下游解读。然而，许多医学VQA问题是通用的、模板化的或形式高度相似，这可能会鼓励模型学习问题-答案捷径而非基于图像的推理，从而增加幻觉响应的风险。我们提出Ask4VG，一个无标签的用于风险感知问题选择的初步框架。Ask4VG通过反事实视觉探针估计问题引发的幻觉风险：在同一问题下，依次使用原始图像、扰动图像、空白图像和不匹配图像进行提问，将得到的答案关系转化为反事实风险估计器的弱监督信号。然后，训练好的估计器对候选问题改写进行重排序，优先选择那些对缺失或不匹配视觉证据变化不敏感的、保持原意的改写，再进行最终答案生成。在VQA-RAD上使用Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct，仅提示改写会增加反事实风险，而基于预测风险的重排序将保留风险从0.658降至0.623，并将精确准确率从0.337提升至0.356。在PMC-VQA上的300样本外部验证显示相同的风险降低趋势以及小幅准确率提升。这些结果表明，问题选择是响应级幻觉缓解的一个有前景的补充方法，有助于实现可靠的医学VQA。

</details>


### [124] [Decoupled Residual Denoising Diffusion Models for Unified and Data Efficient Image-to-Image Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01048)
*Ziyue Lin,Jiahe Hou,Hongyu Xia,Xinrui Xie,Feifei Wang,Yuyin Zhou,Wei Wang,Jiawei Liu,Liangqiong Qu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出解耦残差去噪扩散模型(DRDD)，将扩散过程分解为随机的噪声扩散（域协调与流形提升）和确定性的残差扩散（核心语义映射），实现统一且数据高效的图像到图像翻译。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有扩散模型将噪声和残差在单一耦合的扩散过程中同时去除，过早地削弱了注入高斯噪声带来的域协调效应（隐式对齐跨域特征分布），不利于统一的图像到图像翻译。

Method: 将扩散过程解耦为两个独立阶段：(1)随机噪声扩散，仅在大量无配对的**目标域**图像上训练，实现域协调和流形提升；(2)确定性残差扩散，在固定的噪声域内学习核心语义映射，保持协调效应贯穿整个变换过程。

Result: 理论分析与实验证明DRDD与主流扩散模型广泛兼容，在有限配对数据下仍能实现鲁棒、统一的图像到图像翻译，数据效率显著提升。

Conclusion: DRDD通过解耦扩散过程有效保留了域协调和流形提升效应，大幅简化了跨不同任务和域的统一映射学习，同时显著提高了数据效率。

Original Abstract: We propose Decoupled Residual Denoising Diffusion models (DRDD) for unified and data-efficient image-to-image (I2I) translation. While diffusion models have advanced I2I translation in terms of quality and diversity, we uncover a previously under-explored property in diffusion models. Crucially, beyond its conventional role of manifold lifting (i.e., moving data off low-dimensional manifolds), injecting Gaussian noise facilitates domain harmonization by implicitly aligning feature distributions across domains, a property particularly advantageous for unified I2I translation. However, existing diffusion models prematurely erode this harmonization effect, as noise and residuals are simultaneously removed in a single coupled diffusion process. To address this, DRDD decouples the diffusion process into two sequential and independent diffusion stages: (1) a stochastic noise diffusion for domain harmonization and manifold lifting, and (2) a deterministic residual diffusion that learns the core semantic mapping entirely within the fixed-noise domain. This decoupling preserves harmonization and manifold lifting effects throughout the transformation, substantially simplifying the learning of unified mappings across diverse tasks and domains. Notably, the noise diffusion stage is trained exclusively on abundant, unpaired target-domain images, greatly improving data efficiency. Comprehensive theoretical and empirical analysis demonstrates that DRDD is broadly compatible with mainstream diffusion models and consistently delivers robust, unified I2I translation, even under limited paired data. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKU-HealthAI/DRDD.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出解耦残差去噪扩散模型（DRDD），用于统一且数据高效的图像到图像（I2I）翻译。虽然扩散模型已在质量和多样性方面推进了I2I翻译，但我们揭示了扩散模型中一个此前未被充分探索的特性。关键在于，除其传统的流形提升作用（即将数据移出低维流形）之外，注入高斯噪声通过隐式对齐跨域的特征分布促进了域协调，这一特性对于统一的I2I翻译尤为有利。然而，现有扩散模型过早地削弱了这种协调效应，因为噪声和残差在单一的耦合扩散过程中被同时去除。为解决这一问题，DRDD将扩散过程解耦为两个顺序独立阶段：(1)随机噪声扩散，用于域协调和流形提升；(2)确定性残差扩散，在固定的噪声域内学习核心语义映射。这种解耦在整个变换过程中保留了协调和流形提升效应，极大地简化了跨不同任务和域的统一映射学习。值得注意的是，噪声扩散阶段仅在大规模、无配对的目标域图像上进行训练，显著提升了数据效率。全面的理论和实证分析表明，DRDD与主流扩散模型广泛兼容，即使在有限配对数据下也能持续提供鲁棒、统一的I2I翻译。我们的代码可在https://github.com/HKU-HealthAI/DRDD获取。

</details>


### [125] [TextFake: Benchmarking AI-Generated Image Detection on Text-Rich Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01050)
*Yuning Zhang,Changtao Miao,Mingyu Liao,Tingyu Liu,Xinghao Wang,Tao Gong,Qi Chu,Nenghai Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了TextFake基准，用于检测富含文本的AI生成图像，发现现有检测器在此任务上表现不佳，识别了三种失败模式：文本密度诅咒、渲染保真度伪装和阈值崩溃。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有AIGI检测器在自然图像上表现良好，但对富含文本的伪造内容（如伪造截图、文档、新闻页面）的检测能力尚未得到检验，存在系统性研究空白。

Method: 构建了包含20,000张图像的TextFake基准，覆盖28种语言、4个主题类别和2种场景模态；采用四阶段流水线合成伪造图像，通过分布对齐的结构化提示生成对抗样本，消除协变量捷径。

Result: 零样本评估14个专用检测器和3个前沿VLM API，发现无方法超过80%准确率，部分检测器相比自然图像基准下降超60%；诊断发现了三种失败模式。

Conclusion: 富含文本的AI生成图像检测存在系统性性能缺口，现有方法对此类伪造内容高度脆弱，亟需针对文本密集场景设计更鲁棒的检测方法。

Original Abstract: Recent AI-generated image (AIGI) detectors perform well on natural-image benchmarks, but their behavior on text-rich forgeries, such as fabricated screenshots, documents, and news pages prevalent in misinformation, remains untested. We introduce TextFake, a 20,000-image benchmark for text-rich AIGI detection spanning 28 languages, 4 topic categories, and 2 scene modalities. Fake images are synthesized via a four-stage pipeline that annotates real images along three controlled dimensions and generates counterparts through distribution-aligned structured prompting, ruling out covariate shortcuts. Zero-shot evaluation of 14 specialized detectors and 3 frontier VLM APIs reveals a large systematic gap: no method exceeds 80% accuracy, with some dropping over 60% from natural-image benchmarks. Diagnostic evaluations identify three failure modes: the Text Density Curse, where dense glyphs overwhelm low-level detectors; Cloaking via Rendering Fidelity, where stronger text rendering suppresses enerative artifacts; and Threshold Collapse, where routine perturbations drive detectors toward chance-level performance.

中文摘要翻译: 现有的AI生成图像(AIGI)检测器在自然图像基准上表现良好，但它们在富含文本的伪造内容上的行为——例如伪造截图、文档和新闻页面等虚假信息中常见的载体——尚未得到检验。我们提出了TextFake，一个包含20,000张图像的、面向富含文本的AIGI检测基准，覆盖28种语言、4个主题类别和2种场景模态。伪造图像通过一个四阶段流水线合成，该流水线对真实图像沿三个受控维度进行标注，并通过分布对齐的结构化提示生成对应图像，从而排除协变量捷径。对14个专用检测器和3个前沿VLM API的零样本评估揭示了一个系统性的大幅性能缺口：没有方法能够超过80%的准确率，部分检测器相比自然图像基准下降了超过60%。诊断评估识别出三种失败模式：文本密度诅咒，即密集的字形压倒了低级检测器；渲染保真度伪装，即更强的文本渲染抑制了生成伪影；以及阈值崩溃，即常规扰动将检测器推向接近随机水平的性能。

</details>


### [126] [3DCodeBench: Benchmarking Agentic Procedural 3D Modeling Via Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01057)
*Yipeng Gao,Lei Shu,Genzhi Ye,Xi Xiong,Ameesh Makadia,Meiqi Guo,Laurent Itti,Jindong Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出3DCodeBench基准测试和3DCodeArena排名平台，系统评估VLM代理通过代码进行程序化3D建模的能力。实验发现API不匹配是主要失败原因，测试时扩展可提升性能，并指出了高质量程序编码数据的关键需求。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 程序化3D建模需要深厚的3D软件API、参数化设计和代码级几何推理专业知识，现有神经3D生成器缺乏确定性和可编辑性，而VLM代理在这方面的能力缺乏系统评估基准。

Method: 提出3DCodeBench基准，评估12种先进VLM将文本和图像参考翻译为3D建模软件程序化代码的能力；并构建3DCodeArena排名平台，基于成对人类偏好对生成的3D输出进行排序。

Result: (1) 失败主要源于API不匹配，成功渲染仍存在组件断开或漂浮问题；(2) 测试时扩展（如更高思考预算、多轮细化）可整体提升性能；高质量程序编码数据对提升商业VLM至关重要。

Conclusion: 有效的程序化3D建模需要高质量编码数据和提供高保真反馈的稳健执行环境用于迭代优化。3DCodeBench和3DCodeArena为探索基于VLM的程序化3D建模提供了基础工具包。

Original Abstract: Procedural 3D modeling through code is emerging as a versatile paradigm, offering deterministic, engine-ready, and precisely editable assets that neural 3D generators inherently lack. Authoring such procedural content, however, demands deep expertise in 3D software APIs, parametric design, and code-level geometric reasoning. In this paper, we propose 3DCodeBench, a systematic benchmark for evaluating vision-language model (VLM) agents for procedural 3D generation in 3D modeling software. Specifically, 3DCodeBench evaluates how effectively 12 advanced VLMs can serve as procedural 3D modelers by translating text and image references into procedural code for 3D modeling software. Recognizing that automated metrics may not fully capture the perceptual quality of 3D shapes, we build 3DCodeArena, a ranking platform based on pairwise human preferences over generated 3D outputs. From extensive evaluations and results, we observe that: (1) Failures mostly arise from API mismatches, while successful renders still suffer from disconnected or floating 3D geometric components. (2) Test-time scaling, such as higher thinking budgets and multi-turn refinement, improves performance overall. Our findings highlight a critical need for high-quality procedural coding data to advance commercial VLMs. Furthermore, effective procedural 3D modeling requires a robust execution environment that provides high-fidelity feedback for iterative refinement. We release 3DCodeBench, including the curated large-scale dataset of multimodal (text/image) prompts, procedural code, 3D object triplets, evaluation protocol, and the public 3DCodeArena platform as a foundational toolkit for exploring VLM-based procedural 3D modelers.

中文摘要翻译: 通过代码进行程序化三维建模正成为一种多功能的范式，提供了神经三维生成器本质所缺乏的确定性、引擎就绪且可精确编辑的资产。然而，创作这类程序化内容需要深厚的3D软件API、参数化设计以及代码级几何推理专业知识。本文提出3DCodeBench，一个用于评估视觉-语言模型（VLM）代理在3D建模软件中进行程序化三维生成能力的系统性基准。具体而言，3DCodeBench通过将文本和图像参考转换为3D建模软件的程序化代码，评估12种先进VLM作为程序化3D建模器的有效性。鉴于自动化指标可能无法完全捕捉3D形状的感知质量，我们构建了3DCodeArena，一个基于成对人类偏好对生成3D输出进行排名的平台。广泛的评估和实验结果表明：(1) 失败主要源于API不匹配，而成功渲染的模型仍存在三维几何组件断开或漂浮的问题；(2) 测试时扩展，如更高的思考预算和多轮细化，整体上提升了性能。我们的发现强调了高质量程序化编码数据对推动商业VLM进步的关键需求。此外，有效的程序化3D建模需要稳健的执行环境，提供高保真反馈以进行迭代优化。我们发布了3DCodeBench，包括精心策划的大规模多模态（文本/图像）提示、程序化代码、3D对象三元组、评估协议，以及公共3DCodeArena平台，作为探索基于VLM的程序化3D建模器的基础工具包。

</details>


### [127] [A Multiscale Network with Supervised Contrastive Learning for Real-Time Facial Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01069)
*Rejoy Chakraborty,Archisman Adhikary,Chayan Halder,Payel Rakshit,Sanchita Ghosh,Kaushik Roy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于深度学习的系统，通过建模面部表情变化，在实时视频中检测个体的情绪变化，在标准数据集上取得了令人满意的结果。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 实时视频中面部表情的情绪识别具有挑战性，因为情绪状态随时间连续变化且个体间表情差异大，传统计算方法难以表示这种连续性。该系统可辅助心理咨询师洞察来访者的情绪状态。

Method: 采用深度学习系统，对人物实时视频中的面部表情变化进行建模，以检测情绪变化。系统在标准数据集上进行训练。

Result: 在标准数据集上训练后，该系统在检测情绪变化方面取得了非常满意的结果。

Conclusion: 提出的深度学习系统能够有效建模面部表情的连续变化，在实时视频情绪变化检测任务上表现良好，对心理学咨询等领域具有应用潜力。

Original Abstract: Real-time emotion recognition from facial expressions is a challenging task, particularly in video-based scenarios where multiple emotional states may occur over time. The difficulty increases further due to the fact that each emotional state is associated with facial expressions that vary significantly across individuals. The change of facial expressions portraying emotional state is not discrete, but rather continuous, which is very challenging to represent through computational aids. A system with the ability to detect variations in facial expressions can have a significant impact on determining the emotional state of an individual. Such a system can be very beneficial for psychologists during counseling by providing additional insights into the emotional state of a subject. In this paper, a deep learning-based system is presented to detect emotional changes in real-time video of a person by modeling the change in facial expressions. The current study is conducted on a standard dataset for training of the deep learning system and the system has provided very satisfactory outcomes in this respect.

中文摘要翻译: 基于面部表情的实时情绪识别是一项具有挑战性的任务，尤其是在视频场景中，多种情绪状态可能随时间推移而出现。由于每种情绪状态所关联的面部表情在不同个体之间存在显著差异，这一任务的难度进一步增加。表达情绪状态的面部表情变化并非离散的，而是连续的，这使其极难通过计算手段来表示。具备检测面部表情变化能力的系统，对于判断个体的情绪状态具有重要价值。这样的系统可以为心理咨询师在咨询过程中提供有关来访者情绪状态的额外洞察，从而带来很大帮助。本文提出了一种基于深度学习的系统，通过对人物实时视频中面部表情的变化进行建模，来检测情绪变化。本研究使用标准数据集对深度学习系统进行训练，该系统在这方面取得了非常令人满意的结果。

</details>


### [128] [Chameleon: Style-Content Disentangled Framework for Cross-Domain Object Compositing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01079)
*Sukhun Ko,Soo Ye Kim,Jihyong Oh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向跨域图像合成的大规模训练数据集ChameleonDataset和两阶段训练框架Chameleon。该方法通过联合硬对比学习（JHCL）实现风格与内容解耦，并利用时空注意力门控（STAG）自适应调控风格注入，在构图合理性和风格保真度上超越现有方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有跨域图像合成方法主要依赖无训练混合与精炼策略，原因是缺乏大规模配对数据集，导致只能进行色调级别的对齐，容易出现风格不一致或过度风格化的问题。为此，需要构建大规模训练数据集并开发基于训练的有效方法。

Method: 提出两阶段训练框架Chameleon：第一阶段通过联合硬对比学习（JHCL）训练ChameleonEncoder，有效解耦风格和内容表征；第二阶段在扩散Transformer中引入时空注意力门控（STAG），自适应地调控来自第一阶段的风格标记在空间和时间维度上的注入方式。

Result: 所提方法在构图合理性和风格保真度上超越了最先进的域内和跨域合成模型、序列化流程以及商业模型。

Conclusion: 通过构建大规模数据集和两阶段训练框架，有效解决了跨域图像合成中风格不一致和过度风格化的挑战，推动了基于训练方法的跨域合成发展。

Original Abstract: Image compositing aims to seamlessly insert a foreground object into a background image, and recent advances in diffusion models have significantly enhanced the quality, especially when the foreground and background images come from the same domain (e.g., natural images). However, cross-domain compositing, where the foreground and background come from different domains, is relatively underexplored and remains challenging because the model must preserve the foreground object's identity while stylizing it to match the background domain. Existing cross-domain compositing approaches largely rely on training-free blending and refinement strategies. This is partly due to the lack of large-scale paired datasets for cross-domain compositing, limiting the development of training-based solutions. As a result, they are limited to tone-level alignment and often produce style-inconsistent or overstylized results. To overcome such limitations, we construct ChameleonDataset, the first large-scale training dataset for cross-domain compositing, with a comprehensive evaluation benchmark, built through a scalable data construction pipeline. Building on this, we propose Chameleon, a novel two-stage training-based cross-domain compositing framework. In the first stage, we propose Joint Hard Contrastive Learning (JHCL) to train ChameleonEncoder, which effectively disentangles style and content representations. In the second stage, we introduce Spatio-Temporal Attention Gating (STAG) into a diffusion transformer for effective stylization, adaptively regulating how style tokens from the first-stage encoder are injected across spatial and temporal dimensions. Our method outperforms state-of-the-art in-domain and cross-domain compositing models, sequential pipelines and commercial models, achieving improvements in both compositional plausibility and stylistic fidelity.

中文摘要翻译: 图像合成旨在将前景对象无缝插入到背景图像中，扩散模型的最新进展显著提升了合成质量，特别是当前景和背景图像来自同一领域（如自然图像）时。然而，跨域合成——前景与背景来自不同领域——相对未被充分探索且仍具挑战性，因为模型必须保留前景对象的身份特征，同时对其进行风格化以匹配背景领域。现有跨域合成方法主要依赖无训练混合与精炼策略。这在一定程度上是由于缺乏大规模跨域合成配对数据集，限制了基于训练的方法的发展。因此，它们局限于色调级别的对齐，且往往产生风格不一致或过度风格化的结果。为了克服这些限制，我们构建了ChameleonDataset——首个用于跨域合成的大规模训练数据集，并配有综合评估基准，通过可扩展的数据构建流程实现。在此基础上，我们提出Chameleon，一种新颖的两阶段基于训练的跨域合成框架。在第一阶段，我们提出联合硬对比学习（JHCL）来训练ChameleonEncoder，有效解耦风格和内容表征。在第二阶段，我们将时空注意力门控（STAG）引入扩散Transformer以实现有效的风格化，自适应地调控来自第一阶段编码器的风格标记在空间和时间维度上的注入方式。我们的方法在构图合理性和风格保真度上均超越了最先进的域内和跨域合成模型、序列化流程以及商业模型。

</details>


### [129] [Dual-Route Top-K Retrieval with 1v1 VLM Reranking for the CoVR-R](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01097)
*Yuyang Sun,Yongliang Wu,Xingyu Zhu,Yuxia Chen,Zhenxiang Jiang,Yangguang Ji,Wenbo Zhu,Yanxi Shi,Jay Wu,Shuo Wang,Xu Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对组合视频检索（CoVR-R）任务，提出了一种双路径Top-K检索结合1v1 VLM重排序的方法。该方法将问题解耦为候选集检索和谨慎替换决策两个子问题，融合文本推理路径（VLM槽选择器）和视觉路径（DFN嵌入），再通过保守的1v1 VLM比较器进行最终重排序。在隐藏测试集上达到95.28 R@1等优异成绩，核心发现是召回-选择解耦比全局文本重排序或多候选VLM分类更有效。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有组合视频检索方法在构建候选集时往往不够充分，且缺乏一种机制来安全、谨慎地决定是否用新候选替换已有强top-1结果，因此需要一种将候选检索与替换决策解耦的双路径方法。

Method: 方法包含两条路径：1）文本路径：使用VLM槽选择器（slot selector）对现有候选进行推理/文本种子改进，而不引入DFN视觉检索；2）视觉路径：使用DFN-H/DFN-L从接触式画面嵌入（contact-sheet embeddings）进行视觉检索。两条路径合并为top-10候选集后，使用VLM进行保守的1v1比较（当前top-1 vs 每个挑战候选），决定是否替换。

Result: 在隐藏测试集上，系统达到R@1: 95.28, R@5: 97.47, R@10: 98.48, R@50: 99.66。实验表明，召回-选择解耦（recall-selection decoupling）比广泛的文本重排序或直接多候选VLM分类更有效。

Conclusion: 组合视频检索（CoVR-R）任务中，将召回（retrieval）和选择（selection）解耦为两个独立问题，并采用保守的1v1重排序策略，比全局文本重排序或直接对多个候选进行VLM分类的方法更优。

Original Abstract: We describe \emph{Dual-Route Top-K Retrieval with 1v1 VLM Reranking} for the CoVR-R challenge. The method treats composed video retrieval as two coupled problems: finding a sufficiently complete top-k candidate set, and then safely deciding whether any candidate should replace a strong current top-1. We first improve the reasoning/text seed with a VLM slot selector over existing candidates, without introducing DFN visual retrieval. We then add a visual route from contact-sheet embeddings using DFN-H/DFN-L. The routes are merged into a top-10 candidate set, after which a VLM final reranker performs conservative 1v1 comparisons between the current top-1 and each challenger. On the hidden test split, the final system reaches 95.28 R@1, 97.47 R@5, 98.48 R@10, and 99.66 R@50. The main lesson is that CoVR-R benefits more from recall-selection decoupling than from broad text reranking or direct multi-candidate VLM classification.

中文摘要翻译: 我们针对CoVR-R挑战赛提出了一种\textbf{双路径Top-K检索结合1v1 VLM重排序}方法。该方法将组合视频检索视为两个耦合问题：首先找到一个足够完整的top-k候选集，然后安全地决定是否有任何候选应该替换当前较强的top-1结果。我们首先通过一个VLM槽选择器对现有候选进行推理/文本种子的改进，无需引入DFN视觉检索。然后，我们添加一条视觉路径，通过使用DFN-H/DFN-L从接触式画面嵌入中进行检索。两条路径合并为一个top-10候选集，之后一个VLM最终重排序器在当前top-1与每个挑战候选之间进行保守的1v1比较。在隐藏测试集上，最终系统达到R@1: 95.28, R@5: 97.47, R@10: 98.48, R@50: 99.66。主要经验是：CoVR-R任务从召回-选择解耦中获益，而非从广泛的文本重排序或直接的多候选VLM分类中获益。

</details>


### [130] [Adaptive Dense Evidence Refinement for Video Relational Reasoning for VRR-QA Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01104)
*Yuyang Sun,Yongliang Wu,Xingyu Zhu,Yuxia Chen,Zhenxiang Jiang,Yangguang Ji,Wenbo Zhu,Yanxi Shi,Jay Wu,Shuo Wang,Xu Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于自适应测试时计算的视频问答系统VRR-QA，通过轻量级视图筛选不稳定问题，仅将困难问题路由到高预算密集证据模块，在测试集上达到90.07平均准确率。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 视频语言系统在推断空间、时间、视角、深度和可见性关系时存在困难，这些关系往往无法通过单帧解决，且现有方法常混淆"寻找可能的替代答案"和"决定何时应更改当前答案"这两个问题。

Method: 构建一个仅推理系统：先用直接视频语言模型推理回答每个问题，再用多个轻量级视图找出不稳定问题，仅将这些困难问题路由到高预算密集证据模块（包含带时间戳的帧观测、关系特定探针、候选验证和保守时序聚合）。

Result: 在测试集上获得90.07平均准确率和87.81宏平均准确率。

Conclusion: 通过分离"寻找替代答案"和"决定何时更改答案"两个子问题，并采用自适应路由机制将计算资源集中到困难问题上，可以有效提升视频问答系统的性能。

Original Abstract: VRR-QA evaluates whether video-language systems can infer spatial, temporal, viewpoint, depth, and visibility relations that are not always resolved by a single frame. We present an inference-only system built around adaptive test-time computation. The system first answers each question with a direct video-language model pass, then uses multiple lightweight views to find unstable questions. Only these difficult questions are routed to a high-budget dense evidence module that constructs timestamped frame observations, relation-specific probes, candidate verification, and conservative temporal aggregation. This design separates two problems that are often confused in video question answering: finding plausible alternative answers and deciding when a current answer should actually be changed. On the test split, the final system obtains 90.07 average accuracy and 87.81 macro average accuracy. The report focuses on the final test system and the implementation settings required to reproduce the adaptive dense verifier.

中文摘要翻译: VRR-QA评估视频语言系统能否推断空间、时间、视角、深度和可见性关系——这些关系往往无法通过单帧图像来解析。我们提出一个基于自适应测试时计算的纯推理系统。该系统首先通过直接视频语言模型推理来回答每个问题，然后利用多个轻量级视图找出不稳定问题。仅将这些困难问题路由到一个高预算的密集证据模块，该模块构建带有时间戳的帧观测、关系特定探针、候选验证以及保守的时序聚合。这种设计分离了视频问答中常被混淆的两个问题：寻找可能的替代答案，以及决定何时应真正更改当前答案。在测试集上，最终系统获得了90.07的平均准确率和87.81的宏平均准确率。本报告重点介绍最终的测试系统以及复现自适应密集验证器所需的实现设置。

</details>


### [131] [Temporal Evidence Routing with Structured Visual Evidence for TimeLogicQA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01106)
*Yuyang Sun,Yongliang Wu,Xingyu Zhu,Yuxia Chen,Zhenxiang Jiang,Yangguang Ji,Wenbo Zhu,Yanxi Shi,Jay Wu,Shuo Wang,Xu Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出了TimeLogicQA任务，用于评估视频问答系统在时间关系推理（如事件存在性、顺序、持续性、边界条件和重叠）上的能力，并设计了一个视觉证据路由流水线，将感知与符号时间推理分离，在官方测试集上达到81.8的AvgAcc。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有视频问答系统在时间关系推理方面能力不足，缺乏专门评估事件存在性、顺序、持续性、边界条件和重叠等时序推理能力的基准和有效方法。

Method: 提出视觉证据路由流水线，将感知与符号时间推理分离。首先将问题解析为事件目标、回答模式、候选选项和时间算子；然后根据视频时长和算子难度路由视频，对短片段使用有序全帧证据，对长视频使用事件聚焦候选窗口；多模态大语言模型生成结构化视觉证据，程序化验证器恢复密集动作区间，确定性缩减器应用算子特定时间规则产生最终答案；保守融合机制仅在视觉证据、时间程序和置信度检查一致时接受答案。

Result: 在官方测试评估中，最终系统实现了81.8的AvgAcc。

Conclusion: 通过将视觉感知与符号时间推理分离，并采用保守融合策略，该流水线能有效减少噪声干扰和答案翻转，在时间关系推理任务上取得了良好性能。

Original Abstract: TimeLogicQA evaluates whether video question answering systems can reason over temporal relations such as event existence, ordering, persistence, boundary conditions, and overlap. We address this task with a visual evidence routing pipeline that separates perception from symbolic temporal reasoning. The system first parses each question into event targets, answer mode, candidate options, and temporal operators. It then routes videos according to duration and operator difficulty, using ordered full-frame evidence for short clips and event-focused candidate windows for long videos. A multimodal large language model produces structured visual evidence for the relevant events, while programmatic verifiers recover dense action intervals and a deterministic reducer applies operator-specific temporal rules to produce the final answer. Conservative fusion accepts an answer only when the visual evidence, temporal program, and confidence checks agree, reducing noisy answer flips. On the official test evaluation, our final system achieves an AvgAcc of 81.8.

中文摘要翻译: TimeLogicQA评估视频问答系统能否对事件存在性、顺序、持续性、边界条件和重叠等时间关系进行推理。我们采用一种视觉证据路由流水线来解决该任务，该流水线将感知与符号时间推理相分离。系统首先将每个问题解析为事件目标、回答模式、候选选项和时间算子。然后根据视频时长和算子难度对视频进行路由，对短片段使用有序全帧证据，对长视频使用事件聚焦的候选窗口。多模态大语言模型为相关事件生成结构化的视觉证据，同时程序化验证器恢复密集动作区间，确定性缩减器应用算子特定的时间规则来产生最终答案。保守融合机制仅在视觉证据、时间程序和置信度检查一致时才接受答案，从而减少噪声引起的答案翻转。在官方测试评估中，我们的最终系统达到了81.8的平均准确率（AvgAcc）。

</details>


### [132] [R^3: Composed Video Retrieval via Reasoning-Guided Recalling and Re-ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01113)
*Zixu Li,Yupeng Hu,Zhiheng Fu,Zhiwei Chen,Weili Guan,Liqiang Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出R³，一种零样本组合视频检索流水线，通过推理引导的召回与重排序，将源视频与文本编辑指令转化为推理增强查询，显著提升检索准确性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有组合视频检索方法面临两难：强嵌入模型可扩展但难以表达目标视频中的细粒度变化（如状态改变、动作替换等），而逐对多模态重排序器虽能精确验证但计算成本过高。本文旨在设计一种兼顾效率与准确性的零样本检索方案。

Method: R³流水线包含三步：（1）推理引导生成：模型根据源视频和编辑指令生成描述预期目标视频的推理轨迹；（2）推理增强召回：将推理轨迹与源视频联合编码作为增强查询，与基础组合查询通过一致性门控残差融合进行评分；（3）重排序验证：对召回候选集使用源-候选直接比较的重排序器进行精确验证。

Result: 实验证明了该方法在组合视频检索挑战中的有效性。（具体数值结果原文未提供，但整体效果显著。）

Conclusion: 将源-编辑查询转化为基于推理的检索程序，而非将编辑文本视为简短描述，是解决组合视频检索任务的有效范式。

Original Abstract: The CoVR-R challenge evaluates composed video retrieval, where a system must retrieve a target video from a large gallery given a reference video and a textual edit instruction. This setting is not a standard video-text retrieval problem: the query is defined by both the visual evidence in the source video and the transformation implied by the edit. A strong embedding model can provide scalable candidate recall, but it may under-express target-side consequences such as state changes, action replacement, object preservation, or temporal consistency. A pairwise multimodal reranker can verify such details more directly, but exhaustive reranking over the full gallery is computationally infeasible. We present $\mathbb{R}^3$, a zero-shot composed video retrieval pipeline built around Reasoning-guided Recalling and Reranking. The core idea is to turn the source-edit query into a reasoning-grounded retrieval program rather than treating the edit text as a short caption. First, the model generates a reasoning trace that describes the expected target video after applying the edit. Then the trace is encoded together with the source video as a reasoning-augmented query, and its retrieval score is fused with the base composed query through an agreement-gated residual rule. At last, a re-ranker verifies the recalled candidates with direct source-candidate comparison. Experiments have demonstrated the effectiveness of our method in addressing this challenge. Codes are available on https://github.com/Lee-zixu/R-3.

中文摘要翻译: CoVR-R挑战评估组合视频检索，即系统需在给定参考视频和文本编辑指令的条件下，从大规模图库中检索目标视频。该场景并非标准视频-文本检索问题：查询由源视频中的视觉证据和编辑所暗示的变换共同定义。强嵌入模型可提供可扩展的候选召回，但可能无法充分表达目标侧的后果，如状态变化、动作替换、对象保持或时间一致性。逐对多模态重排序器能更直接地验证这些细节，但全图库的穷举重排序在计算上不可行。我们提出R³，一种零样本组合视频检索流水线，其核心是推理引导的召回与重排序（Reasoning-guided Recalling and Reranking）。核心思路是将源-编辑查询转化为基于推理的检索程序，而非将编辑文本视为简短描述。首先，模型生成描述应用编辑后期望目标视频的推理轨迹。然后，该轨迹与源视频联合编码为推理增强查询，其检索分数通过一致性门控残差规则与基础组合查询融合。最后，重排序器通过直接的源-候选比较验证召回候选。实验证明了我们方法在应对这一挑战时的有效性。代码已开源在https://github.com/Lee-zixu/R-3。

</details>


### [133] [Rank-Aware Quantile Activation for Motion-Robust Crop Segmentation in UAV Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01118)
*Abinav Kiran,Sravan Danda,Aditya Challa,Sougata Sen,Daya Sagar B S*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Dual Quantile Activation (QAct)，一种基于秩归一化的激活函数，替代标准CNN中的ReLU，以应对高速无人机采集运动模糊导致的语义分割性能下降问题，尤其针对纹理依赖的稀有农业类别。实验表明QAct在零样本和模糊监督设置下均优于ReLU，且与模糊域训练互补。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 高速无人机采集的运动模糊会破坏高频率幅值特征，导致依赖纹理的稀有农业类别（高农学价值）在语义分割中被统计性擦除，标准CNN（如ReLU）对此鲁棒性不足。

Method: 提出Dual Quantile Activation (QAct)，一种秩感知（rank-aware）模块，用实例级秩归一化（instance-level rank normalization）替代传统的幅值门控（magnitude gating）机制。

Result: 在Agriculture-Vision 2021数据集上，QAct在零样本和模糊监督两种设置、多种模糊严重程度下均取得一致mIoU提升，在稀有结构和纹理依赖类上增益最显著；零样本QAct在中等模糊下优于蒸馏训练的ReLU；Distill-QAct在所有严重程度上取得最佳性能。

Conclusion: 秩感知激活（QAct）与模糊域训练是两种互补的鲁棒性来源，结合二者可获得最优性能。

Original Abstract: Motion blur from high-speed UAV acquisition de-grades semantic segmentation on rare texture-dependent classes with high agronomic value. Standard CNNs rely on high-frequency magnitude features that blur destroys, causing statistical erasure of minority signals. We propose Dual Quantile Activation (QAct), a rank-aware block replacing magnitude gating with instance-level rank normalization. Evaluated onAgriculture-Vision 2021 across zero-shot and blur-supervised regimes at multiple severities, QAct is the dominant architectural factor: it delivers consistent mIoU gains over ReLU across both regimes and all severities, with strongest gains on rare structural and texture-dependent classes. Some dominant classes (water,planter skip) show mixed per-class performance under distillation. At moderate blur, zero-shot QAct outperforms distillation-trained ReLU; across all severities, Distill-QAct achieves best performance, confirming rank aware activation and blur-domain training are complementary robustness sources.

中文摘要翻译: 高速无人机采集的运动模糊会降低语义分割在具有高农学价值的稀有纹理依赖类别上的性能。标准CNN依赖高频率幅值特征，而模糊会破坏这类特征，导致少数类信号的统计性擦除。本文提出Dual Quantile Activation (QAct)，一种秩感知模块，用实例级秩归一化替代幅值门控。在Agriculture-Vision 2021数据集上，我们评估了零样本和模糊监督两种设置下的多种模糊严重程度，结果表明QAct是主导性的架构因素：它在两种设置和所有严重程度上均比ReLU取得一致的mIoU提升，其中在稀有结构和纹理依赖类别上的增益最为显著。一些主导类别（水、播种机跳过）在蒸馏下出现混合的每类性能表现。在中等模糊下，零样本QAct优于蒸馏训练的ReLU；在所有严重程度上，Distill-QAct取得最佳性能，证实了秩感知激活与模糊域训练是两种互补的鲁棒性来源。

</details>


### [134] [HakushoBench: A Japanese Chart and Table VQA Benchmark from Governmental White Papers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01132)
*Issa Sugiura,Shuhei Kurita,Yusuke Oda,Naoaki Okazaki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对非英语图表VQA基准稀缺的问题，利用政府白皮书构建了日语的HakushoBench基准，包含2,053张图像和人工标注QA对，实验表明开源模型在该基准上表现不佳（最佳仅58.6%），与闭源模型差距达34.9个百分点。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有图表与表格理解的视觉语言模型基准主要集中在英语领域，非英语基准严重匮乏，难以评估模型在不同语言上的泛化能力；同时，大规模收集真实且多样化的非英语图表与表格图像存在困难。

Method: 利用多个国家政府白皮书作为可扩展的基准构建来源，从中提取自然出现的多样化图表与表格图像；作为首次实例，从33份日本政府白皮书构建了HakushoBench基准，包含2,053张图像、覆盖10余种图像类型，并配有手工标注的QA对，旨在评估对图表和表格的深层整体理解而非局部视觉线索。

Result: 在多种VLM上的实验表明：最佳开源模型仅达58.6%准确率；开源模型与闭源模型之间差距达34.9个百分点，说明复杂图表与表格理解任务仍有很大改进空间。

Conclusion: HakushoBench对开源视觉语言模型具有较大挑战性，揭示了当前模型在非英语环境下复杂图表与表格理解能力的不足，并希望通过发布数据集与代码推动该领域研究。

Original Abstract: Understanding chart and table images is essential for applying vision-language models (VLMs) to real-world document understanding. While English benchmarks have advanced rapidly, non-English counterparts remain scarce, leaving it unclear whether this progress generalizes across languages. A key obstacle is the difficulty of collecting realistic and diverse non-English chart and table images at scale. To address this, we leverage governmental white papers as a scalable source for benchmark construction beyond English, as they contain naturally occurring charts and tables across diverse formats and domains and are freely accessible in many countries. As a first instantiation, we introduce HakushoBench, a challenging Japanese chart and table VQA benchmark built from 33 governmental white papers. HakushoBench contains 2,053 images spanning over 10 image types, with manually annotated QA pairs, designed to assess deep and holistic understanding of charts and tables, rather than local visual cues alone. Experiments across a broad range of VLMs demonstrate that HakushoBench remains challenging for open-weight models: the best open-weight model achieves only 58.6% accuracy, and a 34.9-point gap between open-weight and proprietary models highlights substantial room for improvement in complex chart and table understanding. We release our dataset and code.

中文摘要翻译: 理解图表和表格图像对于将视觉语言模型（VLM）应用于真实世界的文档理解至关重要。尽管英语基准已取得快速发展，但非英语基准仍然稀缺，这使得这些进展能否跨语言泛化尚不明确。一个关键障碍在于难以大规模收集真实且多样化的非英语图表和表格图像。为解决此问题，我们利用政府白皮书作为超越英语的基准构建的可扩展来源，因为其中包含自然出现的、覆盖多种格式和领域的图表和表格，且在许多国家可免费获取。作为首次实例，我们推出了HakushoBench——一个基于33份政府白皮书构建的具有挑战性的日语图表与表格VQA基准。HakushoBench包含2,053张图像，覆盖10余种图像类型，并配有手工标注的问答对，旨在评估对图表和表格的深层整体理解，而非仅依赖局部视觉线索。在多种VLM上的实验表明，HakushoBench对开源模型仍具挑战性：最佳开源模型仅达到58.6%的准确率，而开源模型与闭源模型之间34.9个百分点的差距表明，在复杂的图表与表格理解任务上仍有很大的改进空间。我们已发布数据集和代码。

</details>


### [135] [CoSTL: Comprehensive Spatial-Temporal Representation Learning for Moment Retrieval and Highlight Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01149)
*Xin Dong,Wenjia Geng,Wenfeng Deng,Yansong Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CoSTL框架，通过文本驱动的渐进式细粒度图像编码器和多尺度时间感知模块，联合建模细粒度空间信息和时序动态，在视频时刻检索和高亮检测任务上达到SOTA性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有方法主要利用帧级特征进行时序建模，忽略了帧内与文本查询相关的丰富视觉信息，导致定位不准确。因此需要一种能同时捕获细粒度图像级信息和时序动态的框架。

Method: 提出CoSTL框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) 文本驱动的渐进式细粒度图像编码器，通过两步文本驱动知识提取过程学习细粒度空间表示；(2) 多尺度时间感知模块，捕获全面的时空表示，增强对时序动态的处理能力。

Result: 在QVHighlights、Charades-STA、TACoS和TVSum四个公开基准上取得了SOTA性能。

Conclusion: 同时建模细粒度图像级信息和时序动态能有效提升视频时刻检索和高亮检测的定位精度，CoSTL框架验证了该思路的有效性。

Original Abstract: Video Moment Retrieval (MR) and Highlight Detection (HD) are crucial tasks in video analysis that aim to localize specific moments and estimate clip-wise relevance based on a given text query. Recent approaches treat them as similar video grounding tasks and use the same architecture to solve them. These tasks require both fine-grained comprehension at the image level and high-level temporal understanding across the entire video. Existing approaches have primarily focused on temporal modeling using frame-level features, often neglecting the rich visual information related to the text query within individual frames. This oversight leads to inaccurate grounding results. To address this limitation, we propose a Comprehensive Spatial-Temporal Representation Learning Framework (CoSTL), which captures both fine-grained image-level information and temporal dynamics. Specifically, CoSTL incorporates a text-driven progressive fine-grained image encoder, performing a two-step text-driven knowledge extraction process to learn fine-grained spatial representations. Furthermore, a multi-scale temporal perception module captures comprehensive spatial-temporal representations, enhancing the model's ability to process temporal dynamics. We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on four public benchmarks: QVHighlights, Charades-STA, TACoS, and TVSum.

中文摘要翻译: 视频时刻检索（MR）和高亮检测（HD）是视频分析中的关键任务，旨在基于给定文本查询定位特定时刻并估计片段级别的相关性。近期方法将这些任务视为类似的视频定位任务，并使用相同的架构进行解决。这些任务既需要图像级别的细粒度理解，也需要跨整个视频的高层时序理解。现有方法主要利用帧级特征进行时序建模，往往忽略了帧内与文本查询相关的丰富视觉信息，这一疏忽导致了不准确的定位结果。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种全面的时空表示学习框架（CoSTL），该框架同时捕获细粒度图像级信息和时序动态。具体而言，CoSTL包含一个文本驱动的渐进式细粒度图像编码器，通过两步文本驱动知识提取过程来学习细粒度空间表示。此外，一个多尺度时间感知模块捕获全面的时空表示，增强模型处理时序动态的能力。我们在四个公开基准：QVHighlights、Charades-STA、TACoS和TVSum上展示了最先进的性能。

</details>


### [136] [HiTokSR: A Coarse-to-Fine Tokenizer with Hierarchical Codebooks for High-Fidelity Real-World Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01157)
*Mingxi Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HiTokSR提出了一种分层令牌预测框架，通过沿通道维度将潜在空间划分为频率感知组，并用独立子码本进行量化，从而解耦低频结构和高频纹理，在真实图像超分辨率任务中取得了最先进的感知质量和重建保真度。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有向量量化生成模型在真实图像超分中使用单一码本，导致低频结构与高频纹理纠缠在一起，迫使单个码本捕获组合复杂结构-纹理配对，限制了表示能力和码本利用率。

Method: HiTokSR将潜在空间沿通道维度划分为频率感知组，每个组用独立子码本量化，实现从粗到细的解耦设计；生成器通过自适应特征调制、多尺度类别令牌和表示对齐损失引入视觉基础模型先验；在解码器微调阶段引入索引级扰动策略以弥合离散令牌预测的训练-测试差异。

Result: 在真实世界基准数据集上的大量实验表明，HiTokSR在感知质量和重建保真度方面均达到了最先进水平。

Conclusion: 通过分层解耦设计和语义先验注入，HiTokSR有效提升了码本利用率与组合表达能力，为真实图像超分提供了新的解决方案。

Original Abstract: Vector-quantized (VQ) generative models have shown promising results in real-world image super-resolution (Real-ISR). However, existing methods typically rely on a monolithic latent space that entangles low-frequency structures with high-frequency textures. This entanglement forces a single codebook to capture a combinatorially complex set of structure-texture pairings, which constrains representational capacity and limits codebook utilization. To address this issue, we present HiTokSR, a hierarchical token prediction framework. Instead of using a single codebook, HiTokSR partitions the latent space along the channel dimension into frequency-aware groups, quantizing each with an independent sub-codebook. This coarse-to-fine design disentangles global structures from fine details, enhancing combinatorial expressiveness while circumventing the optimization instability of high-dimensional nearest-neighbor lookups. To further improve semantic consistency, our generator integrates priors from a vision foundation model via adaptive feature modulation, multi-scale class tokens, and a representation alignment loss. Additionally, we introduce an index-level perturbation strategy during decoder fine-tuning to bridge the train-test discrepancy in discrete token prediction. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that HiTokSR achieves state-of-the-art performance in both perceptual quality and reconstruction fidelity.

中文摘要翻译: 向量量化生成模型在真实图像超分辨率（Real-ISR）中已展现出有前景的结果。然而，现有方法通常依赖一个将低频结构与高频纹理纠缠在一起的单一潜在空间。这种纠缠迫使单个码本捕获组合上复杂的结构-纹理配对，从而限制了表示能力和码本利用率。为解决这一问题，我们提出了HiTokSR，一种分层令牌预测框架。HiTokSR不使用单一码本，而是沿通道维度将潜在空间划分为频率感知组，并用独立的子码本对每组进行量化。这种从粗到细的设计将全局结构与细节解耦，增强了组合表达能力，同时避免了高维最近邻查找的优化不稳定性。为进一步提升语义一致性，我们的生成器通过自适应特征调制、多尺度类别令牌和表示对齐损失整合了视觉基础模型的先验知识。此外，我们在解码器微调阶段引入了一种索引级扰动策略，以弥合离散令牌预测中的训练-测试差异。在真实世界基准上的大量实验表明，HiTokSR在感知质量和重建保真度方面均达到了最先进的性能。

</details>


### [137] [Towards Interactive Video World Modeling: Frontiers, Challenges, Benchmarks, and Future Trends](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01164)
*Jiuming Liu,Chaojun Ni,Mengmeng Liu,Chensheng Peng,Fangjinhua Wang,Sitian Shen,Marc Pollefeys,Masayoshi Tomizuka,Ayush Tewari,Per Ola Kristensson*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了交互式世界建模的研究现状，涵盖应用场景、技术挑战、评估基准与未来方向，并公开了相关资源仓库。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 随着大语言模型和扩散生成技术的发展，世界建模受到广泛关注，但现有综述缺乏对交互式世界建模（即用户动作条件化的视频/3D生成范式）的系统梳理，亟需总结技术进展与未来方向。

Method: 首先按应用场景、状态演化、场景模态总结研究趋势；接着深入分析动作条件可控性、长程交互与记忆、实时响应三大技术挑战；再比较开放世界探索、游戏引擎、自动驾驶、机器人四个领域的基准和指标；最后展望下一代交互式世界建模的方向。

Result: 系统梳理了交互式世界建模在技术挑战（动作可控性、长程交互、实时响应）与四个应用领域（开放世界、游戏、自动驾驶、机器人）的基准和指标对比，并指出了未来研究方向。

Conclusion: 交互式世界建模在多个下游领域具有巨大潜力，但仍需在可控性、长程记忆、实时交互等方面进一步突破，本文为后续研究提供了系统性参考。

Original Abstract: With rapid development of large language models and diffusion-based content generation, world modeling has attracted increasing research attention, benefiting various downstream domains such as game engines, embodied AI, autonomous driving, etc. Through explicitly incorporating user actions into world state transition, recent literature empowers world modeling with interactivity in an action-conditioned video or 3D generation paradigm, further enhancing controllability over world evolutions and facilitating users to freely traverse, manipulate, navigate, and personalize the state evolution. In this paper, we aim to systematically review recent research trends, technical developments, evaluation benchmarks, and also propose future potential directions in interactive world modeling. Specifically, we first summarize recent efforts and trends in terms of application scenarios, world state evolution, and scene modality. Afterwards, we delve into three crucial technical challenges, including action-conditioned controllability, long-horizon interactions and memory, and action-following responsiveness for real-time interactivity. Furthermore, we also thoroughly compare existing benchmarks and metrics in four specific application fields: open-world exploration, game engine, autonomous driving, and robotics. Finally, we discuss several promising future directions in achieving next-generation interactive world modeling. The corresponding repository is publicly available at: https://github.com/liujiuming123/Awesome-Interactive-World-Model.

中文摘要翻译: 随着大语言模型和基于扩散的内容生成技术的快速发展，世界建模引起了越来越多的研究关注，惠及游戏引擎、具身智能、自动驾驶等多个下游领域。通过将用户动作显式地纳入世界状态转移，近期文献以动作条件化的视频或3D生成范式赋予世界建模交互性，进一步增强了世界演化的可控性，并促进用户自由地遍历、操纵、导航和个性化定制状态演化过程。本文旨在系统性地回顾交互式世界建模的最新研究趋势、技术进展、评估基准，并展望未来的潜在方向。具体而言，我们首先从应用场景、世界状态演化和场景模态三个方面总结了近期的工作与趋势。随后，我们深入探讨了三个关键技术挑战，包括动作条件化的可控性、长程交互与记忆，以及面向实时交互的动作跟随响应能力。此外，我们还对四个具体应用领域——开放世界探索、游戏引擎、自动驾驶和机器人——中现有的基准和指标进行了全面比较。最后，我们讨论了在实现下一代交互式世界建模方面的几个有前景的未来方向。对应的代码仓库已在 https://github.com/liujiuming123/Awesome-Interactive-World-Model 公开。

</details>


### [138] [Reusing Fusion-Time Spectral Reliability for Adaptive Fusion and Expert Routing in RGB-Infrared Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01173)
*Yefeng Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一个无参数的7维光谱可靠性描述符，在融合阶段之后复用，分别驱动光谱可靠性融合（SRF）和可靠性条件专家路由（RCER），显著提升RGB-红外检测器在跨模态融合中的鲁棒性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有RGB-红外检测器在跨模态融合过程中产生的统计信息通常被丢弃，导致下游模块无法判断当前交互是否可靠，因此需要一种显式的可靠性信号来指导融合和后融合条件计算。

Method: 提取一个无参数的7维光谱可靠性描述符，包含波段能量、幅度比、相位一致性和跨模态相关性；该描述符用于驱动：(1) 光谱可靠性融合（SRF），通过对光谱残差进行门控与保守空间基融合；(2) 可靠性条件专家路由（RCER），将描述符与池化内容结合引导稀疏后融合专家。

Result: 在DroneVehicle数据集的六种合成退化下，平均保持率提升至95.0%（对比内容仅MoE的92.0%和直接拼接的87.9%），在模态缺失下增益最大；在自然昼夜划分下mAP50提升+5.2/+5.3；消融实验表明描述符感知门控优于仅内容自适应门控，因子分析显示描述符条件路由的边际增益大于专家架构本身。

Conclusion: 保留融合时的可靠性作为显式信号，有助于自适应融合和后融合条件计算，显著提升跨模态检测的鲁棒性。

Original Abstract: RGB-infrared detectors typically discard the statistics generated during cross-modal fusion, leaving downstream modules unaware of whether the current interaction is reliable. We propose to extract a parameter-free, 7-dimensional spectral reliability descriptor -- summarizing band energy, amplitude ratio, phase consistency, and cross-modal correlation -- and to reuse it beyond the fusion stage. The descriptor drives both Spectral Reliability Fusion (SRF), which gates a spectral residual against a conservative spatial base, and Reliability-Conditioned Expert Routing (RCER), which combines the descriptor with pooled content to steer sparse post-fusion experts. Under matched ablations, descriptor-aware gating improves mAP50 over content-only adaptive gating; a $2{\times}2$ factorial analysis further shows that descriptor-conditioned routing provides the larger marginal gain over expert architecture alone at near-equal parameter count. Under six synthetic degradations on DroneVehicle, average retention rises to 95.0%, versus 92.0% for content-only MoE and 87.9% for concatenation, with the largest gain under modality drop; the same model also improves mAP50 by +5.2/+5.3 on the natural day/night split. These results suggest that preserving fusion-time reliability as an explicit signal benefits both adaptive fusion and post-fusion conditional computation.

中文摘要翻译: RGB-红外检测器通常会丢弃跨模态融合过程中产生的统计信息，使得下游模块无法判断当前交互是否可靠。本文提出提取一个无参数的7维光谱可靠性描述符——汇总波段能量、幅度比、相位一致性和跨模态相关性——并在融合阶段之后复用。该描述符同时驱动光谱可靠性融合（SRF），通过对光谱残差进行门控与保守空间基融合，以及可靠性条件专家路由（RCER），将描述符与池化内容结合以引导稀疏后融合专家。在匹配消融实验下，描述符感知门控相比仅内容自适应门控提升了mAP50；2×2因子分析进一步表明，在参数数量几乎相等的情况下，描述符条件路由相比仅专家架构提供了更大的边际增益。在DroneVehicle上的六种合成退化条件下，平均保持率提升至95.0%，而仅内容MoE为92.0%、直接拼接为87.9%，其中在模态缺失条件下增益最大；同一模型在自然昼夜划分下还使mAP50提升了+5.2/+5.3。这些结果表明，将融合时的可靠性作为显式信号保留下来，同时有利于自适应融合和后融合条件计算。

</details>


### [139] [PairedGTA: Generating Driving Datasets for Controlled Photometric Shift Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01192)
*Andrea Chianese,Giulio Rossolini,Alessandro Biondi,Marco Cococcioni,Giorgio Buttazzo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于高保真游戏引擎的数据生成框架，通过API控制GTA引擎中的光照和天气条件，在保持场景几何、相机位姿和动态物体不变的情况下生成完美配对的图像，从而独立评估光度变化对视觉感知系统的影响。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 真实世界数据集难以提供同一场景在不同环境条件下的完美配对图像，因为相机位姿、交通状况和动态物体位置会随时间变化，导致只能获取粗略配对的数据，无法独立评估光度变化（光照、天气）对感知性能的影响。

Method: 基于高保真游戏引擎（GTA）的数据生成框架，通过软件API与游戏引擎通信，在保持场景几何、相机位姿、动态物体身份和位置不变的前提下，修改光照和天气条件，程序化生成像素级对齐的配对图像。

Result: 通过语义分割模型的系统分析证明，该框架生成的完美配对数据能够更直接地将模型输出退化归因于光度变化，而非不可控的语义或几何因素。

Conclusion: 所提出的生成框架能够在驾驶场景中提供完美配对的图像数据，使得对视觉感知模型的分析更加公平和精确，有效分离光度变化与其他混杂因素的影响。

Original Abstract: Evaluating the performance of visual perception systems for autonomous driving is essential to ensure reliable operation across diverse environmental scenarios. Ideally, a balanced and fair analysis across different adverse conditions would require perfectly paired images of the same scene under different weather or illumination changes. This would allow evaluating the effect of photometric shifts independently of geometry and semantic changes. Unfortunately, real-world datasets rarely provide images of the same scene under different environmental conditions, because, normally, camera pose, traffic, and locations of dynamic objects (vehicles, pedestrians, etc.) vary over time, thus yielding only coarsely paired data. To address this challenge, this work introduces a data generation framework based on a high-fidelity game engine for extracting perfectly paired images. By leveraging software APIs that communicate with the GTA game engine, the framework modifies illumination and weather conditions while preserving scene geometry, camera pose, and the identity and placement of dynamic objects. For each sampled location, it procedurally instantiates dynamic entities and renders pixel-aligned images under diverse adverse conditions. The benefit of the proposed generation framework in driving scenarios is demonstrated through a systematic analysis of semantic segmentation models, whose output degradation can be attributed more directly to photometric shifts rather than to uncontrolled semantic or geometric factors.

中文摘要翻译: 评估自动驾驶视觉感知系统在不同环境场景下的性能对于确保其可靠运行至关重要。理想情况下，要在不同恶劣条件下进行平衡且公平的分析，需要同一场景在不同天气或光照变化下的完美配对图像。这样才能独立于几何和语义变化来评估光度变化的影响。然而，真实世界数据集很少提供同一场景在不同环境条件下的图像，因为通常相机位姿、交通状况和动态物体（车辆、行人等）的位置会随时间变化，从而只能获得粗略配对的数据。为应对这一挑战，本文提出了一种基于高保真游戏引擎的数据生成框架，用于提取完美配对的图像。通过利用与GTA游戏引擎通信的软件API，该框架在保持场景几何、相机位姿以及动态物体的身份和位置不变的情况下，修改光照和天气条件。对于每个采样位置，它程序化地实例化动态实体，并在各种恶劣条件下渲染像素级对齐的图像。通过对语义分割模型的系统分析，展示了所提出生成框架在驾驶场景中的优势，这些模型输出的退化可以更直接地归因于光度变化，而非不可控的语义或几何因素。

</details>


### [140] [Feature Alignment Determines Fusion Strategy: A Comparative Study of Cross-Attention and Concatenation in Multimodal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01207)
*Zhiqiang Zhou,Xuezhen Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现多模态融合中特征对齐质量而非数据规模是决定交叉注意力与拼接策略优劣的关键因素，基于样本复杂度分析证明拼接在特征预对齐时更具样本效率，并通过实验验证了这一理论。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 当前多模态融合中交叉注意力与拼接的选择依赖直觉而非原理性理解，缺乏理论指导，作者希望建立系统化的决策框架。

Method: 在Flickr8k数据集上，使用ResNet18和CLIP ViT-B/32两种特征提取骨干，控制样本规模（2048-16384）进行对比实验；从样本复杂度角度进行理论分析，推导拼接和交叉注意力的样本复杂度分别为O(d_v+d_t)和O(d_v*d_t)；并通过对齐退化实验验证单调趋势。

Result: 当特征通过视觉-语言预训练目标预对齐时，拼接在所有测试规模下比交叉注意力高4.1-5.1个百分点；对于512维CLIP特征，交叉注意力需超过256倍的样本量才能学习双线性注意力权重；对齐退化实验中，随着对齐程度下降，拼接的优势从1.3%增长到2.8%。

Conclusion: 特征对齐质量是决定融合策略选择的首要因素，拼接在特征已对齐时具有显著的样本效率优势，为多模态系统融合方法选择提供了原理性决策框架，对多模态大语言模型的设计有直接启示。

Original Abstract: The choice between cross-attention and concatenation for multimodal fusion remains governed by practitioner intuition rather than principled understanding. In this paper, we demonstrate that feature alignment quality, not data scale alone, is the primary determinant of which fusion strategy excels. Through controlled experiments on Flickr8k using two feature extraction backbones (ResNet18 and CLIP ViT-B/32), we show that concatenation outperforms cross-attention by 4.1-5.1 percentage points across all tested scales (2048-16384 samples) when features are pre-aligned by a vision-language pretraining objective. We provide a theoretical explanation grounded in sample complexity analysis: concatenation requires O(d_v + d_t) samples to learn its fusion projection, while cross-attention requires O(d_v * d_t) samples to learn bilinear attention weights, over 256 times as many for 512-dimensional CLIP features. When features are already aligned, the approximation error gap between the two methods vanishes, and concatenation's sample efficiency dominates at all practical dataset sizes. An alignment degradation study confirms a monotonic trend: as feature alignment degrades, concatenation's advantage grows from 1.3% to 2.8%. These findings provide a principled decision framework for fusion method selection in multimodal systems, with direct implications for the design of Multimodal Large Language Models.

中文摘要翻译: 在跨模态注意力与拼接之间进行多模态融合的选择，目前仍然由从业者的直觉主导，而非基于原理性的理解。在本文中，我们证明了特征对齐质量（而非仅数据规模）是决定哪种融合策略更优的主要因素。通过在Flickr8k数据集上使用两种特征提取骨干网络（ResNet18和CLIP ViT-B/32）进行的受控实验，我们表明：当特征通过视觉-语言预训练目标实现预对齐时，在所有测试规模（2048-16384样本）下，拼接方法均以4.1-5.1个百分点的优势优于交叉注意力。我们提供了基于样本复杂度分析的理论解释：拼接学习其融合投影需要O(d_v + d_t)个样本，而交叉注意力学习双线性注意力权重需要O(d_v * d_t)个样本——对于512维的CLIP特征而言，后者所需的样本量超过前者的256倍。当特征已经对齐时，两种方法之间的近似误差差距消失，拼接的样本效率在所有实际数据集规模下均占主导地位。对齐退化研究证实了一个单调趋势：随着特征对齐程度下降，拼接的优势从1.3%增长到2.8%。这些发现为多模态系统中融合方法的选择提供了原理性决策框架，并对多模态大语言模型的设计具有直接启示意义。

</details>


### [141] [TECCI: Tricky Edits of Collected and Curated Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01213)
*Aishwarya Agrawal,Roy Hirsch,Yasumasa Onoe,Sherry Ben,Jason Baldridge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个名为TECCI的新型图像编辑基准，包含7550对图像和编辑指令，用于系统测试文本引导图像编辑方法。人类评估和自动评估表明，现有最先进模型在TECCI上的总体成功率均低于22%，揭示了该基准的挑战性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 当前文本引导图像编辑方法在指令遵循、最小化编辑源图像和确保高视觉质量等方面仍存在诸多困难，特别是在涉及位置、运动、视角、尺度和创意编辑等复杂任务时表现不佳。现有基准缺乏针对这些挑战性编辑场景的系统性测试，因此需要构建一个专门针对现有方法弱点的基准。

Method: 构建TECCI基准：1) 收集并筛选全新的图像数据集，涵盖7个图像类别，专门针对现有方法弱点设计；2) 使用Gemini自动生成编辑指令，每张源图像覆盖5种编辑类型；3) 额外收集530张图像并配以人工编写的挑战性编辑指令；4) 整体包含7550对图像和编辑指令。采用人工评估（指令遵循、编辑最小性和视觉质量三个维度）以及基于Gemini的自动评估器。

Result: 1) 所有模型的总体成功率均不超过22%；2) Nano Banana Pro是表现最好的模型；3) 模型在指令遵循方面明显优于编辑最小性和视觉质量；4) 模型在编辑建筑和自然图像方面表现困难，这些任务需要强大的空间布局理解和复杂的视觉细节处理；5) 推理和创意编辑最难，颜色和外貌编辑最容易。

Conclusion: TECCI基准揭示了当前文本引导图像编辑方法的显著局限性，特别是在编辑最小性、视觉质量以及处理复杂编辑（如推理、创意编辑）方面。该基准为未来图像编辑研究提供了具有挑战性的评估标准。

Original Abstract: Despite tremendous recent progress, current text-guided image editing methods still struggle with many aspects of editing involving instruction following, minimally editing the source image, and ensuring high visual quality. These problems are especially apparent when the requested edit is challenging, such as those that involve position, motion, viewpoint, scale and creative edits. To systematically test generative image editors, we propose a novel image editing benchmark -- TECCI: Tricky Edits of Collected and Curated Images. TECCI consists of a completely new set of images we are releasing. The images in TECCI span 7 image categories. The images and these categories were curated intentionally to target weaknesses of existing methods. The edit instructions in TECCI are automatically generated by Gemini, covering 5 edit types per source image. We also curated a set of 530 images for which we created challenging manually written edit instructions. Overall, TECCI contains 7550 pairs of images and edit instructions. We conduct human evaluations of five leading image editing models on TECCI. Humans judge outputs along three dimensions: 1) instruction following, 2) minimality of the edits, and 3) visual quality. To scale-up the evaluation, we also build an auto-rater using Gemini that achieves 74.7% accuracy in matching human evaluations. Our evaluations reveal that: 1) none of the models exceed a 22% overall success rate, demonstrating the challenging nature of TECCI, 2) Nano Banana Pro is the best performing model overall, 3) models perform significantly better at instruction following compared to minimal edits and visual quality, 4) models struggle with editing architecture and nature images which require strong understanding of spatial layout and intricate visual details. 5) reasoning and creative edits are the most difficult, whereas color and appearance edits are the easiest.

中文摘要翻译: 尽管近期取得了巨大进展，但当前的文本引导图像编辑方法在指令遵循、最小化编辑源图像以及确保高视觉质量等诸多方面仍然面临困难。当请求的编辑具有挑战性时，这些问题尤为明显，例如涉及位置、运动、视角、尺度和创意编辑等任务。为了系统性地测试生成式图像编辑器，我们提出了一个新的图像编辑基准——TECCI：经过整理和策划的棘手编辑图像集。TECCI包含一套我们发布的全新图像集。TECCI中的图像涵盖7个图像类别。这些图像及其类别的策划旨在针对现有方法的弱点。TECCI中的编辑指令由Gemini自动生成，每张源图像覆盖5种编辑类型。我们还整理了530张图像，并为这些图像创建了具有挑战性的人工编写的编辑指令。总体而言，TECCI包含7550对图像和编辑指令。我们对五种领先的图像编辑模型在TECCI上进行了人类评估。评估者从三个维度判断输出：1) 指令遵循，2) 编辑最小性，以及3) 视觉质量。为了扩展评估规模，我们还使用Gemini构建了一个自动评估器，其在匹配人类评估方面达到了74.7%的准确率。我们的评估揭示：1) 没有一个模型的总体成功率超过22%，这证明了TECCI的挑战性；2) Nano Banana Pro是总体表现最好的模型；3) 模型在指令遵循方面表现显著优于编辑最小性和视觉质量；4) 模型在编辑建筑和自然图像方面存在困难，这些任务需要强大的空间布局理解和复杂的视觉细节处理；5) 推理和创意编辑最为困难，而颜色和外貌编辑最为容易。

</details>


### [142] [Distilling Neuro-Symbolic Programs into 3D Multi-modal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01215)
*Wentao Mo,Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: APEIRIA是一种神经符号3D多模态大模型，通过三阶段课程学习将符号推理模式蒸馏到MLLM中，结合了符号方法的可解释推理与MLLM的灵活性，在3D空间推理任务上超越NS3D方法并匹配SOTA 3D MLLM性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有3D空间推理方法存在根本性权衡：神经符号3D方法虽能实现可解释推理，但受限于封闭概念集和简单程序；端到端3D多模态大模型虽能处理复杂自然语言和开放词汇概念，但缺乏显式空间验证的黑箱推理。APEIRIA旨在弥合这两种范式的差距。

Method: 提出三阶段课程学习：(a) 3D感知对齐，将目标视觉几何特征与LLM对齐；(b) CoT-SFT，通过符号程序轨迹教授查询分解和逐步验证；(c) CoT-RL，将推理模式扩展到开放集概念和深度嵌套指令。通过转移推理模式而非概念特定知识，保持了透明推理和模块化可互换性。

Result: 在接地、问答和描述生成任务上的评估表明，APEIRIA超越了先前的NS3D方法，并在3D空间推理数据集上匹配了最先进的3D MLLM，统一了符号方法的系统推理与MLLM的灵活性。

Conclusion: APEIRIA成功地将神经符号3D方法的系统推理能力与多模态大模型的灵活性相结合，通过推理模式转移而非概念知识蒸馏，实现了透明推理与模块化组件可互换性，为3D空间推理提供了一种新范式。

Original Abstract: Current 3D spatial reasoning methods face a fundamental trade-off: neuro-symbolic 3D (NS3D) concept learners achieve interpretable reasoning through compositional programs but are constrained to closed-set concept vocabularies and simple programs; end-to-end 3D multi-modal LLMs (3D MLLMs) could handle complex natural language and open-vocabulary concepts but suffer from black-box reasoning without explicit spatial verification. We introduce APEIRIA, a neuro-symbolic 3D MLLM to bridge two paradigms by distilling symbolic reasoning patterns into MLLMs with natural language chain-of-thought. Our three-stage curriculum progressively builds reasoning capabilities: a) 3D perception alignment grounds object visual-geometric features to the LLM, b) CoT-SFT teaches query decomposition and stepwise verification from symbolic program traces, and c) CoT-RL extends reasoning patterns to open-set concepts and deeply nested instructions. By transferring reasoning patterns rather than concept-specific knowledge, APEIRIA preserves key NS3D virtues: transparent reasoning and modular interchangeability of planning and perception components. Evaluations on grounding, question answering, and captioning show that APEIRIA surpasses prior NS3D methods and matches state-of-the-art 3D MLLMs on 3D spatial reasoning datasets, unifying symbolic methods' systematic reasoning with MLLMs' flexibility. Code is available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/APEIRIA.

中文摘要翻译: 当前的3D空间推理方法面临一个根本性的权衡：神经符号3D（NS3D）概念学习器通过组合式程序实现可解释推理，但受限于封闭集概念词汇表和简单程序；端到端3D多模态大语言模型（3D MLLM）能够处理复杂的自然语言和开放词汇概念，但存在缺乏显式空间验证的黑箱推理问题。我们提出了APEIRIA，一种神经符号3D多模态大语言模型，通过将符号推理模式以自然语言思维链的方式蒸馏到MLLM中，从而弥合两种范式之间的差距。我们的三阶段课程学习逐步构建推理能力：(a) 3D感知对齐将目标视觉几何特征与LLM对齐；(b) CoT-SFT通过符号程序轨迹教授查询分解和逐步验证；(c) CoT-RL将推理模式扩展到开放集概念和深度嵌套指令。通过转移推理模式而非概念特定知识，APEIRIA保留了神经符号3D方法的关键优点：透明推理以及规划与感知组件的模块化可互换性。在接地、问答和描述生成任务上的评估表明，APEIRIA超越了先前的NS3D方法，并在3D空间推理数据集上匹配了最先进的3D MLLM，统一了符号方法的系统推理与MLLM的灵活性。代码可在https://github.com/oceanflowlab/APEIRIA获取。

</details>


### [143] [Analysis of Ethnic Disparities in Autism Spectrum Disorder among Toddlers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01217)
*Aadithya Prabha Ramaharsha,Deevna Reddy,Uma Ranjan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究通过逻辑回归分析了种族、性别、新生儿黄疸与自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）之间的关系。结果显示：白人欧洲人患ASD的风险比亚洲人高81%，中东人比亚洲人低79%；新生儿黄疸和男性性别也是显著的风险因素。研究强调了在ASD诊断和评估中考虑种族差异的必要性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 探究种族（白人欧洲人、亚洲人、中东人）与ASD患病率之间的关系，以及行为评分、性别和新生儿黄疸等变量在不同种族群体中的影响，以揭示现有诊断框架可能存在的种族偏差。

Method: 采用逻辑回归（Logistic Regression）模型，分析种族、性别、新生儿黄疸以及行为评分对ASD患病率的影响，比较白人欧洲人、亚洲人和中东人三个种族群体之间的差异。

Result: 种族对ASD患病率有显著影响：与亚洲人相比，白人欧洲人患ASD的风险增加81%，中东人风险降低79%。此外，新生儿黄疸是ASD的显著预测因子，男性儿童患ASD的风险远高于女性儿童。

Conclusion: ASD的诊断框架和干预措施需要考虑种族差异，以适应不同种族群体在ASD特征表现和评估上的差异性。

Original Abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by challenges in communication and behavior. This study examines the relationship between ethnicity and ASD traits, along with behavioural scores, sex and neonatal jaundice across three ethnic groups: White Europeans, Asians, and Middle Eastern individuals. We perform a logistic regression and show that ethnicity has a significant effect on incidence of ASD. White Europeans are 81% increased risk of ASD and Middle Easterners are at 79\% reduced risk of ASD compared to Asians. We also confirm earlier studied which show that neonatal jaundice is a significant predictor of ASD, while male children are at much higher risk of ASD compared to female children. These results suggest the need for diagnostic frameworks and interventions that account for ethnic in the presentation and assessment of ASD traits

中文摘要翻译: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）是一种以沟通和行为障碍为特征的神经发育障碍。本研究探讨了种族与ASD特征之间的关系，以及行为评分、性别和新生儿黄疸在三个种族群体（白人欧洲人、亚洲人和中东人）中的差异。我们采用逻辑回归分析，结果显示种族对ASD患病率有显著影响。与亚洲人相比，白人欧洲人患ASD的风险增加81%，而中东人风险降低79%。我们还证实了先前研究的结果，即新生儿黄疸是ASD的显著预测因子，且男性儿童患ASD的风险远高于女性儿童。这些结果表明，ASD特征的呈现和评估需要制定考虑种族差异的诊断框架和干预措施。

</details>


### [144] [Where to Look: Can Foundation Models Reach a Target Viewpoint Through Active Exploration?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01247)
*Liyang Li,Muzhi Zhu,Zhiyue Zhao,Hengyu Zhao,Ke Liu,Linhao Zhong,Hao Chen,Chunhua Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出目标视点复现（TVR）任务及TVRBench基准，发现现有模型在该任务上表现极差，并通过统一的后训练框架（SFT+GRPO）将9B开源模型成功率从7.8%提升至51.4%，揭示了视觉动作监督与多轮强化学习的关键作用。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有基础模型的空间智能主要关注被动理解预采集的观测数据，而人类通过主动调整头部和身体来复现目标视点的能力尚未被系统研究。本文旨在填补这一空白，提出主动视点复现任务及其评估基准。

Method: 构建TVRBench室内仿真基准，提出统一的后训练框架，包括：专家轨迹SFT、推理监督CoT-SFT、离线单轮GRPO、基于仿真器在线交互的多轮GRPO。

Result: 开源和闭源最强模型在TVR上成功率分别仅7.8%和12.0%；模型难以利用多轮视觉历史，且身体平移场景性能骤降。后训练中，视觉动作SFT带来主要提升（9B模型达50.8%），多轮GRPO进一步提升至51.4%，而CoT监督和单轮GRPO反而降低闭环性能。

Conclusion: TVRBench可作为衡量和训练主动感知与行动于3D环境的基础模型的测试平台；视觉动作监督和多轮强化学习是提升主动视点复现能力的关键路径。

Original Abstract: Humans can reproduce the viewpoint specified by a target image through active head and body motion, yet spatial intelligence in foundation models has largely been studied as passive understanding of pre-collected observations. We introduce Target Viewpoint Reproduction (TVR) -- an active task where an agent adjusts its viewpoint in a 3D environment until its observation matches a given target image -- and TVRBench, an indoor-simulation benchmark spanning scene scale and target-view visual richness. TVR is far from solved: on the evaluation split, the strongest open-source and closed-source models reach only 7.8% and 12.0% success. Fine-grained analysis identifies two consistent bottlenecks: off-the-shelf models struggle with multi-turn visual history, and performance drops sharply when viewpoint reproduction requires body translation rather than in-place rotation, exposing a gap in mapping spatial discrepancies to embodied movement. To study reducing this gap, we build a unified TVR post-training framework covering expert-trajectory SFT, rationale-supervised CoT-SFT, offline Single-turn GRPO, and on-policy Multi-turn GRPO from live simulator rollouts. Visual-action SFT supplies the main gain, raising a 9B open-source model to 50.8% success; Multi-turn GRPO provides targeted multi-room refinement and reaches 51.4% overall, while CoT supervision and Single-turn GRPO degrade closed-loop performance. These results establish TVRBench as a testbed for measuring and training foundation models that actively perceive and act in 3D environments. Our code, data, and models are available at https://github.com/aim-uofa/TVRBench.

中文摘要翻译: 人类能够通过主动的头部和身体运动来复现目标图像所指定的视点，然而基础模型中的空间智能长期以来主要被研究为对预采集观测数据的被动理解。本文提出目标视点复现（TVR）——一个智能体在3D环境中调整其视点直至其观测与给定目标图像匹配的主动任务——以及TVRBench，一个涵盖场景尺度和目标视点视觉丰富度的室内仿真基准。TVR远未解决：在评估集上，最强的开源和闭源模型分别仅达到7.8%和12.0%的成功率。细粒度分析识别出两个一致的瓶颈：现成模型难以处理多轮视觉历史，并且当视点复现需要身体平移而非原地旋转时，性能急剧下降，暴露出空间差异到具身运动映射的缺口。为研究缩小这一缺口，我们构建了一个统一的TVR后训练框架，涵盖专家轨迹SFT、推理监督CoT-SFT、离线单轮GRPO以及基于实时仿真器交互的在策略多轮GRPO。视觉动作SFT提供了主要增益，将9B开源模型提升至50.8%的成功率；多轮GRPO提供了针对性的多房间精细化调整并达到51.4%的整体成功率，而CoT监督和单轮GRPO降低了闭环性能。这些结果确立了TVRBench作为衡量和训练主动感知与行动于3D环境的基础模型的测试平台。我们的代码、数据和模型已开源至https://github.com/aim-uofa/TVRBench。

</details>


### [145] [Exploiting In-Sensor Computing for Energy-Efficient Earth Observation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01271)
*Luigi Capogrosso,Pietro Bonazzi,Loris Hoxhaj,Michele Magno*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于索尼IMX500智能视觉传感器的星载传感器端计算框架，通过TinyML技术将地球观测数据处理从主嵌入式设备下放到传感器层，在8MB约束下达到96.68%精度和42.26 GMAC/J的能效。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 卫星产业快速增长导致地理空间数据采集量激增，但下行链路带宽严重不足，现有星载计算虽能缓解该问题，仍需进一步将计算前移至传感器端以减少噪声/无关数据的传输。

Method: 提出一种面向严格计算约束的端到端地球观测流水线，集成TinyML技术与索尼IMX500智能视觉传感器，将处理直接迁移至传感器层级，卸载主嵌入式设备的计算负担；在EuroSAT数据集上部署并评估了SqueezeNet、ShuffleNetV2和MCUNetV1等高效卷积神经网络。

Result: 在IMX500的8MB约束下，模型保持96.68%的竞争性精度；平均处理吞吐量17.40 FPS，延迟27.43 ms；每次推理能耗仅14.19 mJ，能效达42.26 GMAC/J。

Conclusion: 所提出的传感器内计算框架在严格资源约束下实现了高精度、高吞吐量和极低能耗，验证了其在星载传感器端部署的可行性。

Original Abstract: The rapid growth of the satellite industry has driven a significant increase in geospatial data acquisition, highlighting a critical bottleneck: the severe disparity between the volume of collected sensor data and the limited downlink bandwidth available to ground stations. While On-Board Computing (OBC) has helped address this by pre-processing data in orbit, this article further advances the paradigm by introducing an in-sensor computing framework. We present an optimized end-to-end Earth Observation (EO) pipeline tailored for strict computational constraints by integrating TinyML techniques with the Sony IMX500 Intelligent Vision Sensor. Specifically, our approach shifts processing directly to the sensor level, offloading the computation from the primary embedded device, and effectively mitigating the downlink transmission of noisy or irrelevant data. We evaluated several efficient Convolutional Neural Networks (ConvNets), i.e., SqueezeNet, ShuffleNetV2, and MCUNetV1, on the EuroSAT dataset. Experimental results show that, despite the optimizations required for deployment on the IMX500 platform, our models maintain a competitive 96.68% accuracy while operating within its 8 MB constraints. Specifically, the models reach an average processing throughput of 17.40 FPS with a latency of 27.43 ms. Furthermore, our system profile exhibits high energy efficiency, with a low energy footprint of 14.19 mJ per inference and an efficiency rating of 42.26 GMAC/J, demonstrating its viability for in-sensor deployment.

中文摘要翻译: 卫星产业的快速增长推动了地理空间数据采集的显著增加，同时凸显了一个关键瓶颈：收集到的传感器数据量与地面站可用下行链路带宽之间的严重不匹配。尽管星载计算通过在轨预处理数据已在一定程度上缓解了该问题，但本文进一步推进了这一范式，引入了一种传感器内计算框架。我们提出了一种面向严格计算约束优化的端到端地球观测流水线，该流水线将TinyML技术与索尼IMX500智能视觉传感器相结合。具体而言，我们的方法将处理直接迁移至传感器层级，卸载主嵌入式设备的计算负担，有效减少了噪声或无关数据的下行传输。我们在EuroSAT数据集上评估了多种高效卷积神经网络，即SqueezeNet、ShuffleNetV2和MCUNetV1。实验结果表明，尽管针对IMX500平台的部署进行了优化，我们的模型在其8MB约束下仍能保持96.68%的竞争性精度。具体而言，模型达到平均17.40 FPS的处理吞吐量和27.43 ms的延迟。此外，我们的系统配置展现出高能效特性，每次推理仅需14.19 mJ的低能耗，能效评级达42.26 GMAC/J，验证了其在传感器内部署的可行性。

</details>


### [146] [Event-Based Vision in Space: Applications, Trends, and Future Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01280)
*Luigi Capogrosso,Pietro Bonazzi,Michele Magno*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了事件视觉（神经形态相机）在太空领域的最新进展，提出了基于四个核心应用领域的分类法，并论证了神经形态工程范式对现代遥感和可持续空间探索的革命性意义。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 尽管事件传感器正从地面系统快速扩展至轨道平台，但围绕其太空应用的科学文献高度碎片化，缺乏系统性梳理。本文旨在弥合这一空白。

Method: 对事件视觉在太空领域的现有文献进行全面综述，并提出一个基于四个核心领域的分类法：大气与高速观测、环境监测与变化检测、运行支持与星上处理、地理空间建模与预测分析。

Result: 综述表明神经形态工程远非补充性成像技术，而是一种能够直接解决现代遥感和可持续空间探索中关键瓶颈的范式转变。

Conclusion: 神经形态工程是解决现代遥感与可持续空间探索关键瓶颈的范式变革性技术。

Original Abstract: Earth Observation (EO) is undergoing a significant transformation driven by the deployment of novel sensing technologies. Traditional frame-based optical sensors often struggle with motion blur, high power consumption, and extreme data redundancy in challenging orbital environments. In contrast, event-based sensors, also known as neuromorphic cameras, offer a bio-inspired asynchronous approach. By capturing only local illumination changes, they provide microsecond temporal resolution, an extremely high dynamic range, and exceptional energy efficiency. Although the use of these sensors is rapidly expanding from terrestrial systems to orbital platforms, the scientific literature surrounding their space-based applications remains heavily fragmented. To bridge this gap, this article presents a comprehensive review of the state-of-the-art in event-based vision in the space domain. Based on the retrieved literature, we introduce a taxonomy structured around four primary domains: 1) atmospheric and high-speed observation; 2) environmental monitoring and change detection; 3) operational support and onboard processing; and 4) geospatial modeling and predictive analysis. As a result, this survey highlights that neuromorphic engineering is far more than a supplementary imaging technique; it is a paradigm shift that can be used to directly address critical bottlenecks in modern remote sensing and sustainable space exploration.

中文摘要翻译: 地球观测（EO）正经历由新型传感技术部署驱动的重大变革。传统的基于帧的光学传感器在多变的轨道环境中常面临运动模糊、高功耗和极端数据冗余等问题。相比之下，事件传感器（亦称神经形态相机）提供了一种受生物启发的异步方法。通过仅捕获局部光照变化，它们实现了微秒级时间分辨率、极高动态范围和卓越的能效。尽管这些传感器的应用正从地面系统快速扩展至轨道平台，但围绕其太空应用的科学文献仍高度碎片化。为弥合这一空白，本文对太空领域事件视觉的最新技术进行了全面综述。基于所检索到的文献，我们提出了一个围绕四个核心领域的分类法：1）大气与高速观测；2）环境监测与变化检测；3）运行支持与星上处理；4）地理空间建模与预测分析。最终，本综述突显了神经形态工程远非一种补充性成像技术，而是一种可直接用于解决现代遥感和可持续空间探索中关键瓶颈的范式转变。

</details>


### [147] [KG-FairDiff: Knowledge Graph-Guided Prompt Refinement for Demographically Fair Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01282)
*Farbod Davoodi,Seyed Reza Tavakoli Shiyadeh,Pooria Safaei,Sana Harighi,Parsa Gholami,Amirali Amini,Kimia Vanaei,Emad Firoozi,Parham Abed Azad,Babak Khalaj,Siavash Ahmadi,Amir Hossein Payberah,Mohammad Hossein Rohban,Soheil Kolouri,Ali Diba*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出KG-FairDiff，一个模型无关的推理时公平性框架，通过知识图谱引导的提示词精炼循环，在保持语义的同时减少文生图系统的性别、种族、年龄等偏见。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有TTI系统存在从训练数据继承的人口和文化刻板印象（性别、种族、年龄、非西方文化等），造成大规模部署时的群体性伤害。现有缓解方法要么需要昂贵的重新训练（对闭源商业模型不可行），要么依赖忽略文化背景的固定人口统计模板。

Method: 将公平感知提示词精炼形式化为约束优化问题，并实现为闭环管道：(1) 包含约1200个文化与偏见三元组的知识图谱检索结构化上下文；(2) LLM重写器提出精炼方案；(3) 验证器仅接受能降低基于散度的公平性损失且保留语义保真度的提示词。精炼循环具有有限终止保证。

Result: 在8个广泛部署的骨干生成器上审计，KG-FairDiff显著降低了性别、种族、年龄及交叉性差异，同时保留了提示词语义。

Conclusion: 提供了一个实用的、可部署的路径，以实现更公平的生成式AI。

Original Abstract: Text-to-Image (TTI) systems are now everyday infrastructure for journalism, education, advertising, and public communication, and the demographic and cultural stereotypes they inherit from training data (rendering women, people of colour, older adults, and non-Western cultures as under-represented or caricatured) become a population-level harm at deployment scale. Existing mitigations either require costly retraining, infeasible for the closed-source backbones that dominate consumer products, or rely on fixed demographic templates that ignore cultural context. We present KG-FairDiff, a model-agnostic, inference-time framework that formalises fairness-aware prompt refinement as a constrained optimisation problem and operationalises it as a closed-loop pipeline: a knowledge graph of ~1,200 culture- and bias-related triples retrieves structured context, an LLM rewriter proposes refinements, and a validator accepts only prompts that reduce a divergence-based fairness loss while preserving semantic fidelity to the user's original intent. We prove a finite-termination bound for the refinement loop, contribute a mathematically consistent evaluation suite linking Bias-P/Bias-W to divergence from target distributions and ENS to KL divergence, and audit eight widely-deployed backbone generators. KG-FairDiff substantially reduces gender, race, age, and intersectional disparities while preserving prompt semantics, offering a practical, deployment-ready route to more equitable generative AI.

中文摘要翻译: 文本到图像(TTI)系统现已成为新闻、教育、广告和公共传播的日常基础设施，它们从训练数据中继承的人口和文化刻板印象（将女性、有色人种、老年人和非西方文化呈现为代表性不足或被刻板化）在大规模部署时会造成群体层面的伤害。现有的缓解方法要么需要昂贵的重新训练（对主导消费产品的闭源骨干模型不可行），要么依赖忽略文化背景的固定人口统计模板。我们提出KG-FairDiff，一个模型无关的推理时框架，将公平感知提示词精炼形式化为一个约束优化问题，并将其实现为闭环管道：一个包含约1200个文化与偏见相关三元组的知识图谱检索结构化上下文，一个LLM重写器提出精炼方案，以及一个验证器仅接受能降低基于散度的公平性损失同时保留用户原始意图语义保真度的提示词。我们证明了精炼循环的有限终止界，贡献了一个数学一致的评估套件（将Bias-P/Bias-W与目标分布的散度联系起来，将ENS与KL散度联系起来），并审计了8个广泛部署的骨干生成器。KG-FairDiff在保留提示词语义的同时显著减少了性别、种族、年龄和交叉性差异，为更公平的生成式AI提供了一条实用的、可部署的路径。

</details>


### [148] [Knowledge-Intensive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01285)
*Chenxu Wang,Mingda Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出知识密集型视频生成（KIVI）任务及对应基准KIVI-Bench，评估当前视频生成模型在事实性和实用性方面的不足，实验表明现有模型远未达到人类水平。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有文生视频模型在视觉质量上进步迅速，但对生成视频的事实准确性和实际有用性的评估严重不足，缺乏专门针对知识密集型、信息寻求类提示的视频生成评测基准。

Method: 1) 定义知识密集型视频生成（KIVI）任务，要求模型根据简短的信息寻求提示（如解释、步骤、演示）生成视频；2) 构建KIVI-Bench基准（含1,080条提示）；3) 提出面向事实性和有用性的自动评估指标。

Result: 人类评估表明所提指标比现有替代方案与人类标注的一致性更高；在七个最先进模型上的实验显示，当前系统在视觉属性、操作步骤和清晰信息呈现方面仍远落后于人类表现。

Conclusion: KIVI是一个具有挑战性的方向，现有视频生成模型在事实性和指导性有用视频生成方面仍有较大提升空间。

Original Abstract: Text-to-video generation has advanced rapidly in visual quality, but remains under-evaluated for factuality and practical usefulness. We introduce knowledge-intensive video generation (KIVI), where models generate videos from short information-seeking prompts that ask for explanations, procedures, or demonstrations. To evaluate this setting, we construct KIVI-Bench, a benchmark of 1,080 prompts, and propose automatic metrics for factuality and helpfulness. Human evaluation shows that our metrics significantly better align with human annotations than existing alternatives. Experiments on seven state-of-the-art video generation models show that current systems still lag behind human performance, especially on visual properties, procedural operations, and clear information presentation. These results highlight KIVI as a challenging direction for factual and instructionally useful video generation.

中文摘要翻译: 文本到视频生成在视觉质量方面取得了快速进展，但在事实性和实际有用性方面的评估仍显不足。我们提出了知识密集型视频生成（KIVI）任务，其中模型需根据简短的信息寻求提示（如要求解释、步骤或演示）生成视频。为评估该设置，我们构建了包含1,080条提示的KIVI-Bench基准，并提出了面向事实性和有用性的自动评估指标。人工评估表明，我们的指标与人类标注的一致性显著优于现有替代方案。在七个最先进的视频生成模型上的实验显示，当前系统仍远落后于人类表现，尤其在视觉属性、操作步骤和清晰的信息呈现方面。这些结果凸显了KIVI作为事实性和指导性有用的视频生成领域中的一项具有挑战性的研究方向。

</details>


### [149] [Beyond Visual Memory: Mechanistic Diagnostics of Latent Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01287)
*Garvin Guo,Yu Chen,Xiang Wang,Shuai Li,Xinpei Zhao,Huaxing Liu,Shuai Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过将潜在视觉推理中的潜在标记分解为三个可测试组件（潜在槽、边界标记和格式），揭示了性能提升的真实来源并非潜在槽（视觉记忆），而是来自边界标记、格式以及注意力模式。研究表明，仅保留边界标记即可保留78-100%的性能增益，而潜在槽在所有测试中均未支持视觉记忆假设。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有潜在视觉推理方法通过插入连续潜在标记取得了显著性能提升，但这些增益常被归因于编码视觉证据的潜在标记。然而近期分析发现了一个悖论：潜在标记与图像关联松散且对答案贡献有限。但这些分析将潜在标记视为单一整体，掩盖了增益的真实来源。因此需要分解潜在标记，探究其各组成部分的实际作用。

Method: 将潜在标记分解为三个可测试组件：潜在槽（latent slots）、边界标记（boundary markers）和格式（format）。并在有利条件下开发了一种最先进的方法作为探针，在六种方法-阶段设置和四个感知密集型基准上系统测试每个组件的贡献。

Result: 1）潜在槽在所有测试中均未支持视觉记忆假说的预测；2）仅保留边界标记即可在多种设置中保留78-100%的性能增益；3）模型在潜在位置的图像注意力比在答案位置更窄。增益来源于边界标记、格式以及注意力模式，而非潜在槽。此外，不同方法利用该机制的方式取决于其训练监督方式。

Conclusion: 潜在视觉推理不仅需要基于准确性进行评估，还需要考察模型实际依赖的机制。不同方法即使在准确率匹配的情况下，其依赖的推理机制也可能存在显著差异。

Original Abstract: Recent latent visual reasoning methods achieve substantial gains by inserting continuous latent tokens into multimodal language models. These gains are commonly attributed to the tokens encoding visual evidence; recent analyses, however, reveal a paradox: the tokens are loosely tied to the image and contribute little to the answer. Critically, these analyses treat latent tokens as a single unit, obscuring the true source of the gains. We therefore decompose latent tokens into three testable components: latent slots, boundary markers, and format, and develop a state-of-the-art method as a probe under favorable conditions. Across six method-stage settings and four perception-heavy benchmarks, latent slots fail every prediction of the visual-memory account. Strikingly, retaining only the boundary markers preserves 78 to 100% of the gain in several settings, while the model attends to the image more narrowly at latent positions than at answer positions. The gain therefore comes from boundary markers, format, and this attention pattern, not from latent slots. How each method engages this mechanism depends on its training supervision: at matched accuracy, mechanisms can still differ markedly. Latent visual reasoning thus needs evaluation not only by accuracy but by what the model actually relies on.

中文摘要翻译: 最近的潜在视觉推理方法通过在多模态语言模型中插入连续的潜在标记取得了显著的性能提升。这些增益通常被归因于标记编码了视觉证据；然而，最近的分析揭示了一个悖论：这些标记与图像的关联松散，且对答案贡献甚微。关键在于，这些分析将潜在标记视为一个单一整体，掩盖了增益的真正来源。因此，我们将潜在标记分解为三个可测试的组件：潜在槽、边界标记和格式，并在有利条件下开发了一种最先进的方法作为探针。在六种方法-阶段设置和四个感知密集型基准测试中，潜在槽在视觉记忆假说的所有预测中均告失败。引人注目的是，在若干设置中，仅保留边界标记即可保留78%到100%的增益，同时模型在潜在位置对图像的关注比在答案位置更为聚焦。因此，增益来源于边界标记、格式以及这种注意力模式，而非潜在槽。每种方法如何利用这一机制取决于其训练监督方式：在准确率匹配的情况下，其机制仍可能存在显著差异。因此，潜在视觉推理不仅需要通过准确性进行评估，还需要考察模型实际依赖的机制。
