</details>


### [150] [DeblurNVS: Geometric Latent Diffusion for Novel View Synthesis from Sparse Motion-Blurred Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01315)
*Changyue Shi,Wangbo Yu,Chaoran Feng,Li Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DeBlurNVS框架，直接从稀疏运动模糊图像中合成高质量新视图，无需逐场景优化，通过恢复中间几何表示实现模糊输入下的可靠多视图推理。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有新视图合成方法依赖清晰无模糊的观测，而实际拍摄中运动模糊普遍存在（由相机抖动、场景运动或有限曝光引起），破坏了局部细节和多视图几何对应。现有的模糊感知NVS方法虽能建模模糊成像过程，但依赖于昂贵的逐场景优化，限制了高效且可泛化的稀疏视图合成能力。

Method: 提出DeBlurNVS框架：从稀疏运动模糊图像中恢复中间几何表示（如可靠的结构和对应关系线索），再结合目标相机信息合成目标视图表示，最终重建出清晰的RGB新视图。同时，利用插值法有限曝光模糊合成从DL3DV-10K构建大规模运动模糊NVS数据集以支持训练。

Result: 在合成运动模糊基准上优于现有基线方法，能泛化到真实运动模糊场景，生成感知上更清晰、结构上更稳定的新视图，且无需逐场景优化。

Conclusion: DeBlurNVS实现了从稀疏运动模糊图像直接进行高质量、可泛化的新视图合成，有效解决了运动模糊带来的退化问题，避免了传统方法中昂贵的逐场景优化开销。

Original Abstract: Novel view synthesis (NVS) is a fundamental problem in computer vision and graphics. Recent advances in neural radiance fields (NeRF), 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), and generative view synthesis have substantially improved its quality. Yet most methods still rely on clean observations, where image structures and cross-view geometric cues are well preserved. Motion blur breaks this assumption by corrupting local details and weakening multi-view correspondences. Such blur commonly arises from camera shake, scene motion, or finite exposure in practical capture. Blur-aware NVS methods address this degradation by modeling image formation, but their reliance on costly per-scene optimization limits efficient and generalizable sparse-view synthesis. To address this, we propose DeblurNVS, a novel framework for synthesizing high-fidelity novel views directly from sparse motion-blurred images, without requiring per-scene optimization. DeblurNVS restores the intermediate geometric representations needed for multi-view reasoning, enabling blurred inputs to recover reliable structure and correspondence cues. The restored representations are then combined with target camera information to synthesize the target-view representation and reconstruct a sharp RGB novel view. To enable the large-scale training, we construct a motion-blurred NVS dataset from DL3DV-10K using interpolation-based finite-exposure blur synthesis. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeblurNVS outperforms existing baselines on synthetic motion-blur benchmarks and generalizes to real motion-blurred scenes, producing perceptually sharper and structurally more stable novel views while avoiding costly per-scene optimization. Project page: https://github.com/PKU-YuanGroup/DeblurNVS.

中文摘要翻译: 新视图合成（NVS）是计算机视觉和图形学中的一个基本问题。神经辐射场（NeRF）、3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）和生成式视图合成的最新进展显著提升了其质量。然而，大多数方法仍然依赖于清晰无模糊的观测，在这些观测中图像结构和跨视角几何线索得以良好保存。运动模糊破坏了这一假设，它会损坏局部细节并削弱多视图对应关系。这种模糊通常在实际拍摄中由相机抖动、场景运动或有限曝光引起。现有的模糊感知NVS方法通过建模成像过程来解决这一退化问题，但它们依赖于昂贵的逐场景优化，限制了高效且可泛化的稀疏视图合成。为解决这一问题，我们提出了DeBlurNVS，一种新颖的框架，能够直接从稀疏运动模糊图像中合成高保真新视图，无需逐场景优化。DeBlurNVS恢复了多视图推理所需的中间几何表示，使模糊输入能够恢复可靠的结构和对应关系线索。然后，将恢复的表示与目标相机信息相结合，合成目标视图表示并重建出清晰的RGB新视图。为支持大规模训练，我们利用基于插值的有限曝光模糊合成方法，从DL3DV-10K数据集构建了一个运动模糊NVS数据集。大量实验表明，DeBlurNVS在合成运动模糊基准上优于现有基线方法，并能泛化到真实运动模糊场景，生成感知上更清晰、结构上更稳定的新视图，同时避免了昂贵的逐场景优化。项目页面：https://github.com/PKU-YuanGroup/DeblurNVS。

</details>


### [151] [HOLA: Holistic Multi-Modal Alignment for Open-Set 3D Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01334)
*Koby Aharonov,Oren Shrout,Ayellet Tal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出解耦多正面对比损失，将点云与多视角图像和多文本描述对齐，实现在长尾基准上的开放词汇3D识别SOTA。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有方法依赖单图像或单标题与点云对齐，锚定于部分视角，缺乏对3D对象的整体理解。

Method: 提出解耦多正面对比损失（Decoupled Multi-Positive Contrastive Loss），联合对齐一个3D实例与多个图像和文本信号，分离正样本聚合与负样本竞争；同时设计轻量文本适配器缩小网络标题与人工标注之间的领域差距。

Result: 在长尾基准上实现开放词汇SOTA，零样本性能显著提升，同时保持高帧率。

Conclusion: 多模态、多实例对齐是提升3D开放集识别的有效途径，解耦设计避免了“聚光灯拥挤”问题。

Original Abstract: Open-set 3D recognition requires models that generalize to rare or unseen categories. Recent approaches address this by distilling language-vision knowledge into 3D encoders, typically relying on heavy 2D ViTs and aligning each point cloud with a single image or caption, thus anchoring representations to partial views. We propose aligning each point cloud with multiple images and textual descriptions to capture a more holistic understanding of 3D objects. To realize this idea, it is essential to design a loss function capable of jointly aligning a 3D instance with multiple matched signals, multi-view images and multiple texts, while separating positive aggregation from negative competition. We introduce such a function, termed the decoupled multi-positive contrastive loss. Our formulation enhances the loss's hardness-aware focus on challenging negatives, avoiding the "spotlight crowding" that occurs when many positives share the same softmax with all the negatives. Complementing this, we present a lightweight text adapter applied only to web captions, reducing the domain gap to curated annotations and enabling effective use of large-scale unsupervised text. Our model demonstrates state-of-the-art open-vocabulary performance on long-tail benchmarks, yielding substantial zero-shot improvements while sustaining high frame rates.

中文摘要翻译: 开放集3D识别要求模型能够泛化到稀有或未见类别。现有方法通过将语言-视觉知识蒸馏到3D编码器中来解决这一问题，但通常依赖庞大的2D ViT，并将每个点云与单张图像或标题对齐，从而将表示锚定在部分视角上。本文提出将每个点云与多张图像和多个文本描述对齐，以捕捉对3D对象更全面的理解。为实现这一想法，关键在于设计一个能够将3D实例与多个匹配信号（多视角图像和多文本）联合对齐，同时分离正样本聚合与负样本竞争的损失函数。我们引入了这样一种函数，称为解耦多正面对比损失。该公式增强了损失对困难负样本的聚焦能力，避免了当多个正样本与所有负样本共享同一个softmax时出现的“聚光灯拥挤”问题。作为补充，我们提出了一种轻量文本适配器，仅应用于网络爬取的标题，缩小其与人工标注之间的领域差距，从而实现大规模无监督文本的有效利用。我们的模型在长尾基准上展现了最先进的开放词汇性能，在保持高帧率的同时实现了显著的零样本提升。

</details>


### [152] [ChartArena: Benchmarking Chart Parsing across Languages, Scenarios, and Formats](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01348)
*Shangpin Peng,Gengluo Li,Xingyu Wan,Chengquan Zhang,Hao Feng,Binghong Wu,Huawen Shen,Weinong Wang,Ziyi Cai,Zhuotao Tian,Han Hu,Can Ma,Yu Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ChartArena是一个覆盖8类图表族、3种视觉场景的双语基准，通过格式无关的评估协议和结构感知指标系统评估26个多模态大模型，揭示了前沿模型在图表解析上的能力差距，尤其是雷达图和手绘场景仍是挑战。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有图表解析基准覆盖的图表类型狭窄，忽略流程图、思维导图等图解结构；模型输出格式不兼容；数据集缺乏打印或手绘图像。需要统一的、格式无关的评估框架来系统衡量模型能力。

Method: 构建包含8类图表族（数值图表和图解结构）、3种视觉场景（数字渲染、打印照片、手绘照片）的双语基准ChartArena；采用人机协作标注流水线及多阶段人工验证；设计格式无关的评估协议，将异构输出映射到归一化三元组视图和有向图视图两个标准语义空间，并用结构感知指标评分。

Result: 评估26个前沿多模态大模型发现：(i) Gemini 3.1 Pro等专有模型领先，但最强开源模型迅速缩小差距；(ii) 文档解析模型处理数值图表尚可，但在图解结构上大幅落后；(iii) 专业图表解析器局限于窄图表族。所有模型在雷达图和手绘场景上尤为困难。

Conclusion: ChartArena暴露了现有模型在图表解析上的明确能力差距，为未来进展提供了统一基础。

Original Abstract: Charts are a primary medium for conveying quantitative and relational information, yet systematically evaluating chart parsing models remains difficult. Existing benchmarks focus on narrow chart types and leave diagrammatic structures such as flowcharts and mind maps largely unaddressed, while models produce outputs in incompatible formats, and datasets rarely include the printed or hand-drawn images encountered in practice. To address these issues, we introduce ChartArena, a comprehensive bilingual benchmark covering eight chart families spanning both numeric charts and diagrammatic structures, each evaluated across three visual scenarios: digital renderings, printed photos, and hand-drawn photos. The dataset is built via a human-agent collaborative annotation pipeline with multi-stage human verification to ensure annotation reliability. To enable fair cross-model comparison, we further design a format-agnostic evaluation protocol that maps heterogeneous outputs into two canonical semantic spaces, a normalized triple view and a directed graph view, and scores them with structure-aware metrics. Through extensive evaluation of 26 leading MLLMs, we observe three consistent findings: (i) frontier proprietary models such as Gemini 3.1 Pro lead overall, yet the strongest open-source systems are rapidly closing the gap; (ii) document parsing models handle numeric charts reasonably but fall sharply behind on diagrammatic structures; and (iii) expert chart parsers remain limited to narrow chart families. Across all models, radar charts and hand-drawn scenarios stay especially challenging. These findings show that ChartArena exposes clear capability gaps and provides a unified foundation for future progress. ChartArena is publicly available at https://github.com/pspdada/ChartArena.

中文摘要翻译: 图表是传达定量和关系信息的主要媒介，但系统评估图表解析模型仍然困难。现有基准聚焦于狭窄的图表类型，未能涵盖流程图和思维导图等图解结构；模型输出格式不兼容；数据集也很少包含实践中遇到的打印或手绘图像。为解决这些问题，我们提出ChartArena，一个全面的双语基准，覆盖8类图表族，包括数值图表和图解结构，每类均在三种视觉场景（数字渲染、打印照片、手绘照片）中评估。该数据集通过人机协作的标注流水线构建，并经过多阶段人工验证以确保标注可靠性。为实现公平的跨模型比较，我们进一步设计了格式无关的评估协议，将异构输出映射到两个规范语义空间——归一化三元组视图和有向图视图，并使用结构感知指标进行评分。通过对26个前沿多模态大模型的广泛评估，我们观察到三个一致的发现：(i) Gemini 3.1 Pro等前沿专有模型整体领先，但最强开源系统正在迅速缩小差距；(ii) 文档解析模型处理数值图表尚可，但在图解结构上大幅落后；(iii) 专业图表解析器仍局限于狭窄的图表族。在所有模型中，雷达图和手绘场景始终最具挑战性。这些发现表明，ChartArena暴露了明确的能力差距，并为未来进展提供了统一基础。ChartArena已在https://github.com/pspdada/ChartArena公开。

</details>


### [153] [Diamonds in the Sky: Pareidolic Animals in Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01361)
*Miriam Horovicz,Yacov Hel-Or,Yael Moses*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种AI方法，利用扩散模型预测和增强云朵中的空想性动物感知（空想性错视），即使传统识别方法无法检测到这些动物。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 人们常在云朵中看到动物形状（空想性错视），但现有最先进的识别方法无法检测到这类动物，因此需要一种方法预测人们可能感知到的动物，并辅助那些最初未能识别的人看到特定动物。

Method: 使用扩散模型将云朵片段转换为视觉上类似原始云朵的动物形状；扩散过程仅在目标动物与云朵形状相似时成功；成功生成的图像用于预测空想性动物；此外，制作从生成图像过渡回原始云朵的短时变形视频，增强人类对空想性动物的感知。

Result: 扩散模型仅在目标动物形状与原始云朵相似时才能成功生成，且微妙的视觉提示足以帮助人们识别空想性动物。

Conclusion: 所提方法能有效预测人们可能在云朵中感知到的动物，并通过变形视频进一步增强人类对空想性动物的识别能力。

Original Abstract: People often see animal shapes in clouds, a phenomenon known as pareidolia. We propose an AI-based method that aims to predict which animals people are likely to perceive in clouds, even though state-of-the-art recognition methods typically fail to detect such animals. Additionally, we introduce a method to assist individuals in perceiving specific pareidolic animals, even if they did not recognize them initially. Our approach uses a diffusion model to transform cloud segments into an animal shape that visually resemble the original cloud. This diffusion technique is inspired by the observation that the diffusion process succeeds only when the target animal resembles the shape of the cloud, and that subtle visual hints often suffice to help individuals recognize specific pareidolic animals. A generated image, successfully derived from the diffusion model, is then used to predict the pareidolic animal. Additionally, a short morphing video transitioning from the generated image back to the original cloud segment is employed to further enhance the human's perception of the pareidolic animals.

中文摘要翻译: 人们经常在云朵中看到动物的形状，这种现象被称为空想性错视。我们提出了一种基于AI的方法，旨在预测人们可能在云朵中感知到哪些动物，尽管最先进的识别方法通常无法检测到这类动物。此外，我们引入了一种方法，帮助个体感知特定的空想性动物，即使他们最初未能识别出它们。我们的方法使用扩散模型将云朵片段转换为视觉上类似原始云朵的动物形状。该扩散技术受到以下观察的启发：扩散过程仅在目标动物与云朵形状相似时才能成功，并且微妙的视觉提示往往足以帮助个体识别特定的空想性动物。成功通过扩散模型生成的图像随后被用于预测空想性动物。此外，我们还采用了一段从生成图像逐渐过渡回原始云朵片段的短时变形视频，以进一步增强人类对空想性动物的感知。

</details>


### [154] [Training-free image inversion for one-step diffusion models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01380)
*Tao Wu,Senmao Li,Yaxing Wang,Shiqi Yang,Kai Wang,Joost van de Weijer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为TFinv的无训练逆框架，用于一步扩散模型的真实图像反演与编辑。该方法通过迭代噪声对齐（iterNA）和后缀学习（suffL）两种技术，分别解决初始潜码可编辑性不足和文本描述与图像表示对齐不佳的问题，并引入基于掩膜的局部编辑技术。在PIE-Bench数据集上，TFinv在一步扩散编辑中达到了最先进性能，且效率显著优于现有多步方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有一步扩散模型在真实图像反演和编辑中面临两个关键障碍：(1) 初始潜码可编辑性差，即初始噪声与理想高斯分布之间存在距离；(2) 描述差距，即文本描述与图像表示之间的对齐不足。这两个因素严重影响了反演效率和编辑能力。

Method: (1) 迭代噪声对齐（iterNA）：通过迭代优化最小化初始噪声与标准高斯分布之间的分布差距；(2) 后缀学习（suffL）：引入可学习的后缀提示词元，增强文本到图像的描述对齐；(3) 基于掩膜的编辑技术：实现局部编辑的同时保持背景完整性。

Result: 在PIE-Bench数据集上的综合实验表明，TFinv在一步扩散编辑任务中达到了最先进的性能，并且在效率上显著优于现有的多步方法。

Conclusion: 本文提出的TFinv框架通过iterNA和suffL两种技术，有效解决了一步扩散模型在真实图像反演和编辑中的关键挑战，实现了高效率和高质量的图像编辑。

Original Abstract: In this work, we introduce a novel training-free inversion (TFinv) framework for one-step diffusion models,addressing key challenges in real image inversion and editing. We first identify two critical factors hamperingreal-image inversion and editing: (1) Initial Latent Editability, which is related to the distance between theinitial noise and the ideal Gaussian distribution, and (2) Caption Gap, which means the alignment betweentext captions and image representations. Both factors influence inversion efficiency and the editability ofone-step diffusion models. Then, we propose two novel techniques: iterative noise alignment (iterNA), whichminimizes the distribution gap to align with the normal Gaussian distribution, and suffix learning (suffL),which enhances text-to-image caption alignment by introducing learned suffix prompt tokens. These techniquesenable precise inversion of input images into their initial noise representations and facilitate image editing.Furthermore, we propose a mask-based editing technique for localized edits while preserving backgroundintegrity. Comprehensive experiments on the PIE-Bench dataset validate that our method TFinv not onlyachieves state-of-the-art performance in one-step diffusion editing, but also significantly outperforms existingmultistep approaches in efficiency. The code is available at https://github.com/tttao-uwu/TFinv.git.

中文摘要翻译: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的无训练反演（TFinv）框架，用于一步扩散模型，解决了真实图像反演和编辑中的关键挑战。我们首先识别出阻碍真实图像反演和编辑的两个关键因素：(1) 初始潜码可编辑性，这与初始噪声与理想高斯分布之间的距离有关；(2) 描述差距，即文本描述与图像表示之间的对齐程度。这两个因素都会影响一步扩散模型的反演效率和可编辑性。然后，我们提出了两项新技术：迭代噪声对齐（iterNA），通过最小化分布差距来使噪声与标准高斯分布对齐；以及后缀学习（suffL），通过引入学习到的后缀提示词元来增强文本到图像的描述对齐。这些技术能够将输入图像精确反演为其初始噪声表示，并促进图像编辑。此外，我们提出了一种基于掩膜的编辑技术，用于在保持背景完整性的同时进行局部编辑。在PIE-Bench数据集上的综合实验验证了我们的方法TFinv不仅在一步扩散编辑中达到了最先进的性能，而且在效率上显著优于现有的多步方法。代码可在 https://github.com/tttao-uwu/TFinv.git 获取。

</details>


### [155] [PAI-Studio: Cinematic Video Background Replacement with Camera-Aware Motion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01399)
*Heyuan Gao,Bangxun Tang,Yiren Song,Guian Fang,Zijian He,Jie Yang,Mike Zheng Shou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PAI-Studio提出了一种新的参考条件视频合成任务，通过扩散Transformer视频骨干和双向注意力机制，在统一架构中联合建模前景动态与背景参考信息，实现运动一致的动态背景生成、高保真前景重光照和前景身份保持，显著优于现有开源和商业API方案。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有开源系统和商业API无法同时保证运动一致的背景生成、高保真前景重光照和前景身份保持，常导致静态背景、不一致边界和合成伪影，缺乏一个能够同时解决这些问题的统一框架。

Method: 基于扩散Transformer（Diffusion Transformer）视频骨干，将问题重新表述为上下文条件生成任务，通过双向注意力机制在统一架构中联合捕获前景动态信息和背景参考信息，并构建了30K规模的高质量电影和在线视频数据集。

Result: 大量评估表明，该方法在背景生成、前景重光照和身份保持方面显著优于现有的开源和商业API解决方案。

Conclusion: PAI-Studio通过统一的双向注意力架构有效解决了动态背景合成、前景重光照和身份保持的联合挑战，为电影级背景替换提供了可行的解决方案。

Original Abstract: We present PAI-Studio, a new reference-conditioned video synthesis task that addresses a long-standing challenge in cinematic background replacement: generating dynamic backgrounds aligned with foreground motion while preserving foreground identity, matching reference scene appearance, and achieving globally consistent illumination with realistic foreground relighting. Existing open-source systems and commercial APIs cannot simultaneously ensure motion-consistent background generation, high-fidelity foreground relighting and foreground identity preservation, often resulting in static backgrounds, inconsistent boundaries, and noticeable compositing artifacts. To bridge this gap, we build upon a Diffusion Transformer video backbone and reformulate the problem as an in-context conditional generation task. Through bidirectional attention, our model jointly captures foreground dynamics and background reference information within a unified architecture. We further construct a 30K-scale dataset sourced from high-quality films and online videos to support this task. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing open-source and commercial API solutions.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出了PAI-Studio，一种新的参考条件视频合成任务，旨在解决电影级背景替换中长期存在的挑战：生成与前景运动对齐的动态背景，同时保持前景身份、匹配参考场景外观，并实现全局一致的照明与真实感的前景重光照。现有的开源系统和商业API无法同时保证运动一致的背景生成、高保真前景重光照和前景身份保持，常常导致静态背景、不一致边界和明显的合成伪影。为弥合这一差距，我们基于扩散Transformer视频骨干构建模型，并将该问题重新表述为上下文条件生成任务。通过双向注意力机制，我们的模型在统一架构中联合捕获前景动态信息和背景参考信息。我们进一步构建了一个30K规模的数据集，数据来源于高质量电影和在线视频以支持该任务。大量评估表明，我们的方法显著优于现有的开源和商业API解决方案。

</details>


### [156] [Agent Skills Should Go Beyond Text: The Case for Visual Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01414)
*Binxiao Xu,Ruichuan An,Bocheng Zou,Hang Hua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出多模态技能范式，将文本逻辑与视觉支持相结合，通过静态先验、动态先验和交错视觉技能三种形式，以及自动构建系统SYSTEM，在GUI等视觉密集任务中优于纯文本技能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有技能学习方法仅存储文本形式（如指令、推理轨迹）的可复用经验，但视觉密集任务中的可复用知识往往依赖于空间布局、视觉定位、细粒度外观和局部状态变化，纯文本范式成为瓶颈。

Method: 提出多模态技能范式NAME，包含三种可复用形式：静态先验（稳定空间约定）、动态先验（原位视觉工作记忆）和交错视觉技能（将有序文本步骤与源帧、截图或页面区域绑定）。同时提出SYSTEM系统，自动从任务轨迹中提取文本推理、空间引用、视觉边界和交互模式，构建可复用多模态技能。

Result: 在GUI及其他视觉密集任务上的实验表明，多模态技能一致优于纯文本技能，尤其在需要空间对应、视觉证据和状态感知交互的任务中提升显著。

Conclusion: 可复用的智能体技能应超越纯文本，成为面向未来多模态智能体的多模态资产。

Original Abstract: Reusable skills are a key mechanism for extending agent capabilities, allowing agents to accumulate experience and solve increasingly complex tasks. Yet most existing skill-learning methods store reusable experience as text-only assets, such as instructions, reasoning traces, or summarized trajectories. We argue that this text-only paradigm creates a fundamental bottleneck for visual-centric tasks, where reusable knowledge often depends on spatial layout, visual grounding, fine-grained appearance, and localized state changes. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{\NAME}, a multimodal skill paradigm that combines declarative textual logic with explicit visual support. We distinguish three reusable forms: static priors for stable spatial conventions, dynamic priors for in-situ visual working memory, and interleaved visual skills that bind ordered text steps to the source frames, screenshots, or page regions that justify them. Rather than only describing what to do, visual skills also encode where to look, how to inspect, and how to verify visual outcomes. To scale visual-skill construction, we introduce \textbf{\SYSTEM}, an automatic system that converts agent experience into reusable multimodal skills by preserving textual reasoning, spatial references, visual boundaries, and interaction patterns from task trajectories. Experiments on GUI and other visual-centric tasks show that visual skills consistently outperform text-only skills, particularly when success requires spatial correspondence, visual evidence, and state-aware interaction. These results support our central position: reusable agent skills should go beyond text and become multimodal assets for future multimodal agents.

中文摘要翻译: 可复用技能是扩展智能体能力的关键机制，使智能体能够积累经验并解决日益复杂的任务。然而，现有大多数技能学习方法仅将可复用经验存储为纯文本资产，例如指令、推理轨迹或总结的轨迹。我们认为，这种纯文本范式为视觉密集任务带来了根本性瓶颈，因为可复用知识往往依赖于空间布局、视觉定位、细粒度外观和局部状态变化。为解决这一局限性，我们提出\NAME，一种将声明式文本逻辑与显式视觉支持相结合的多模态技能范式。我们区分了三种可复用形式：用于稳定空间约定的静态先验、用于原位视觉工作记忆的动态先验，以及将有序文本步骤与为其提供依据的源帧、截图或页面区域绑定在一起的交错视觉技能。视觉技能不仅描述要做什么，还编码了看向哪里、如何检查以及如何验证视觉结果。为规模化构建视觉技能，我们引入\SYSTEM，一个自动系统，通过保留任务轨迹中的文本推理、空间引用、视觉边界和交互模式，将智能体经验转化为可复用的多模态技能。在GUI及其他视觉密集任务上的实验表明，多模态技能一致优于纯文本技能，尤其在成功需要空间对应、视觉证据和状态感知交互的任务中。这些结果支持我们的核心观点：可复用的智能体技能应超越纯文本，成为面向未来多模态智能体的多模态资产。

</details>


### [157] [DENSER: Depth-Guided Ensemble with Staged EFA-GS Reconstruction for Soccer Novel View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01419)
*Parthsarthi Rawat*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DENSER提出了一种基于深度指导的集成方法，通过相机高度加权的损失函数、单目深度监督和三模型像素平均集成，用于足球比赛新视角合成，在五个场景中取得了29.89 dB PSNR的良好效果。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有基于EFA-GS的方法在足球场景新视角合成中，对地面广播视角的保真度不足，且在无纹理区域（如草地）的几何重建存在退化问题，单一模型也难以达到最优性能。

Method: (1) 基于相机高度的损失加权，优先优化地面广播视角；(2) 引入Depth-Anything-V2的单目深度监督，约束无纹理区域的几何形状；(3) 构建三模型像素平均集成，各模型从同一基检查点出发，通过不同训练轮数和高斯尺度钳制实现多样化。

Result: 在五个挑战场景上，平均PSNR达29.89 dB，SSIM达0.791，LPIPS达0.366。

Conclusion: DENSER通过深度指导、视角加权和集成策略有效提升了足球场景新视角合成的质量，验证了各模块的有效性。

Original Abstract: We propose DENSER, a Depth-guided ENSemble with Staged EFA-GS Reconstruction for soccer novel view synthesis. DENSER extends EFA-GS with three key contributions: (1) camera-height-based loss weighting that prioritises ground-level broadcast views, (2) monocular depth supervision from Depth-Anything-V2 to regularise geometry in textureless regions, and (3) a three-model pixel-average ensemble whose members diverge from a shared base checkpoint by varying training length and Gaussian scale clamping. On five held-out challenge scenes we achieve a mean PSNR of 29.89 dB, SSIM of 0.791, and LPIPS of 0.366.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出DENSER，一种用于足球比赛新视角合成的深度指导集成与分阶段EFA-GS重建方法。DENSER在EFA-GS基础上做出三项关键贡献：(1) 基于相机高度的损失加权，优先优化地面广播视角；(2) 利用Depth-Anything-V2的单目深度监督来约束无纹理区域的几何结构；(3) 三模型像素平均集成，各模型从共享基检查点出发，通过改变训练轮数和高斯尺度钳制实现差异化。在五个保留挑战场景上，我们实现了平均PSNR为29.89 dB、SSIM为0.791、LPIPS为0.366的结果。

</details>


### [158] [SafeGen-Bench: Benchmarking Safety in Image-Conditioned Text-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01481)
*Yingzi Ma,Xiaogeng Liu,Yawen Zheng,Chaowei Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了SafeGen-Bench，一个专门评估条件文本到视频（T2V）模型安全性的基准测试。该基准涵盖10个恶意类别，聚焦时序和行为风险，并包含精心挑选的起始帧与文本提示对。评估结果表明，现有T2V模型在避免生成恶意内容方面表现不佳（不安全分数高达44.5），且单一模态的防护措施（文本或图像）效果有限，在7个恶意类别中失败率达80%。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有基准主要关注恶意文本提示引发的视频安全问题，忽略了即使文本和图像本身安全，二者组合仍可能生成有害视频内容的常见且具有挑战性的场景。因此，需要专门针对条件T2V模型的安全性评估基准。

Method: 构建SafeGen-Bench基准，定义10个恶意类别（聚焦时序序列和描绘行为风险），从多种图像和视频源中精心挑选起始帧，并配对相应文本提示以模拟真实输入。在该基准上评估多种条件T2V模型，并测试基于文本和基于图像的防护措施的有效性。

Result: 现有条件T2V模型在SafeGen-Bench上难以一致地避免生成恶意内容，不安全分数高达44.5，尤其是在要求高质量的条件下。基于文本和图像的单一模态防护措施均不足以提供稳健防御，在7个恶意类别上失败率达80%。

Conclusion: SafeGen-Bench能够有效揭示现有条件T2V模型的安全漏洞，有望推动更安全、更可控的条件T2V模型的发展。

Original Abstract: With the rapid advancements in text-to-image diffusion models, generative video models (T2V models) like Sora can now produce short synthetic videos from a text prompt or an initial image. However, synthetic video generation -- especially when guided by an initial image -- often poses risks, including the potential creation of illegal, politically sensitive, or unethical content. Existing benchmarks have started to consider the safety of generated videos, but they primarily focus on testing models with malicious text prompts, ignoring the scenario where text prompt and image combination may still lead to harmful video content. In practice, this is a common and challenging issue: videos generated from safe text and image inputs can nonetheless convey harmful information. To bridge this gap, we introduce SafeGen-Bench, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate the safety of conditional T2V models. Our benchmark defines 10 malicious categories, concentrating on risks related to both temporal sequences and depicted behaviors. SafeGen-Bench consists of carefully selected start frames from diverse image and video sources, paired with corresponding text prompts to simulate realistic inputs. We evaluate a variety of conditional T2V models on SafeGen-Bench, and the results indicate that current models struggle to consistently avoid generating malicious content with unsafety scores reaching up to 44.5, especially under conditions requiring high quality. Furthermore, we assess the effectiveness of both text-based and image-based guardrails on our benchmark, finding that unimodal guardrails alone were insufficient to provide a robust defense, with an 80\% failure rate across seven malicious categories. We hope that SafeGen-Bench will foster the development of safer and more controllable conditional T2V models.

中文摘要翻译: 随着文本到图像扩散模型的快速发展，生成式视频模型（如Sora）现在能够根据文本提示或初始图像生成短视频。然而，合成视频生成——尤其在初始图像引导下——往往带来风险，包括可能产生非法、政治敏感或不道德的内容。现有基准已开始关注生成视频的安全性，但主要集中于用恶意文本提示测试模型，忽视了文本提示与图像组合仍可能导致有害视频内容的场景。在实践中，这是一个常见且具有挑战性的问题：由安全的文本和图像输入生成的视频仍可能传达有害信息。为弥补这一空白，我们提出SafeGen-Bench，一个专门用于评估条件T2V模型安全性的基准。我们的基准定义了10个恶意类别，重点关注与时间序列和所描绘行为相关的风险。SafeGen-Bench包含从多种图像和视频源中精心挑选的起始帧，并配以相应的文本提示以模拟真实输入。我们在SafeGen-Bench上评估了多种条件T2V模型，结果表明现有模型难以一致地避免生成恶意内容，不安全分数高达44.5，尤其是在需要高质量输出的条件下。此外，我们评估了基于文本和基于图像的防护措施在该基准上的有效性，发现单一模态防护措施不足以提供稳健防御，在7个恶意类别上失败率达到80%。我们希望SafeGen-Bench能够推动开发更安全、更可控的条件T2V模型。

</details>


### [159] [Perception First: A Frontier Native-Video Model with Self-Consistency for Implicit Video Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01485)
*Ali Alavi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文针对VRR Challenge @ CVPR 2026中的隐式视频问答基准（ImplicitQA/VRR-QA）进行了系统研究。核心发现是，该基准是“感知受限”而非“推理受限”的：推理增强策略（如思维链、问题分解等）效果中性甚至有害，而基础模型的感知能力和轻量级测试时去噪才是唯一可靠的提升手段。按类别错误分析表明，困难集中在低层感知（相对深度、视角、计数），而因果和社会推理几乎已被解决。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 探究VRR-QA基准中视频问答任务的性能瓶颈究竟在于感知能力还是推理能力，并系统评估多种开源视频大语言模型及推理时策略的效果。

Method: 对多个开源Video-LMM（Qwen2.5-VL、Qwen3-VL、InternVL3、Gemma-3、Video-R1、VideoChat-R1.5）进行无训练的系统研究，对比多种推理时策略（思维链、问题分解、描述-推理级联、音频转录、空间状态提示、自一致性、多模型集成、类别路由），并进行按类别错误分析和深度提示扰动实验。

Result: 1) 推理增强策略效果中性甚至有害；2) 基础模型感知能力和轻量级测试时去噪是唯一可靠提升手段；3) 最困难类别是相对深度、视角和计数；4) 因果和社会推理几乎已被解决；5) 向最弱类别注入单目深度提示反而使准确率下降5.8个百分点。

Conclusion: VRR-QA基准是感知受限而非推理受限，模型需要更好的感知器（percept）而非更好的推理流程（procedure）。

Original Abstract: We describe our submission to the VRR Challenge @ CVPR 2026, built on the \emph{ImplicitQA} / \emph{VRR-QA} benchmark~\cite{implicitqa}: multiple-choice video question answering in which answers are deliberately \emph{not} observable in any single frame and must be inferred from spatial layout, motion, depth, viewpoint, causality, and social context across discontinuous frames of creative video. We conduct a systematic, training-free study spanning open-source Video-LMMs (Qwen2.5-VL~\cite{qwen25vl}, Qwen3-VL~\cite{qwen3vl}, InternVL3, Gemma-3, and the RL-tuned video reasoners Video-R1~\cite{videor1} and VideoChat-R1.5~\cite{videochatr15}) and a battery of inference-time strategies (chain-of-thought, question decomposition, describe-then-reason cascades, audio transcripts, spatial state prompting, self-consistency~\cite{selfconsistency}, multi-model ensembling, and category routing). Our central finding is that this benchmark is \emph{perception-bound rather than reasoning-bound}: reasoning-side augmentations are neutral-to-harmful, whereas base-model perceptual capability and lightweight test-time denoising are the only reliable levers. A per-category error analysis localizes the difficulty to low-level perception -- relative depth, viewpoint, and counting are the hardest categories, while causal and social reasoning are nearly solved -- and a prompt that explicitly injects monocular depth cues to attack the weakest category \emph{lowers} test accuracy by $5.8$ points, confirming that the model needs a better \emph{percept}, not a better \emph{procedure}.

中文摘要翻译: 我们介绍了提交至CVPR 2026 VRR挑战赛的方案，该方案基于\emph{ImplicitQA} / \emph{VRR-QA}基准~\cite{implicitqa}：这是一个多项选择视频问答任务，其答案故意在单帧中不可观测，必须通过不连续帧的空间布局、运动、深度、视角、因果关系和社会上下文进行推断。我们对开源视频大语言模型（Qwen2.5-VL~\cite{qwen25vl}、Qwen3-VL~\cite{qwen3vl}、InternVL3、Gemma-3，以及经过强化学习调优的视频推理器Video-R1~\cite{videor1}和VideoChat-R1.5~\cite{videochatr15}）和一系列推理时策略（思维链、问题分解、描述-推理级联、音频转录、空间状态提示、自一致性~\cite{selfconsistency}、多模型集成和类别路由）进行了系统的、无需训练的研究。我们的核心发现是：该基准是\emph{感知受限而非推理受限}的——推理侧的增强策略效果中性甚至有害，而基础模型的感知能力和轻量级测试时去噪才是唯一可靠的提升手段。按类别的错误分析将困难定位到低层感知——相对深度、视角和计数是最困难的类别，而因果和社会推理几乎已被解决；针对最弱类别显式注入单目深度线索的提示反而使测试准确率下降了5.8个百分点，证实了模型需要更好的\emph{感知器}，而非更好的\emph{流程}。

</details>


### [160] [Splatshot: 3D Face Avatar Generation from a Single Unconstrained Photo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01493)
*Hao Liang,Zhixuan Ge,Soumendu Majee,Joanna Li,Ashok Veeraraghavan,Guha Balakrishnan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SplatShot提出了一种无需训练框架，通过将3D高斯泼溅显式表示与扩散模型2D先验在去噪过程中直接耦合，从单张非约束照片重建具有多视图一致性和照片真实感的3D面部头像。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 前馈3DGS模型在分布外输入上性能退化，而预训练扩散模型虽能生成高保真图像但缺乏多视图一致性。观察到两类范式本质互补：显式3D表示保证几何一致性，2D扩散先验确保照片真实感。

Method: 提出训练无关框架SplatShot，在去噪过程中直接耦合3DGS与扩散先验。给定基础3DGS人脸模型和单张参考图像，通过每步3D反馈循环联合去噪所有目标视图：从噪声潜变量预测干净图像→将3DGS重新拟合到多视图预测→将3DGS重渲染与2D预测之间的光度差异反向传播到噪声估计中，引导采样轨迹产生严格3D一致且身份保真的输出。

Result: 在多种野外图像上的实验表明，SplatShot生成的3D头像在身份保持、照片真实感和多视图一致性方面均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 通过将显式3D表示与2D扩散先验在去噪过程中直接耦合，实现了无需额外训练的、兼具几何一致性与照片真实感的单张图片3D人脸头像重建。

Original Abstract: Reconstructing a photorealistic 3D face avatar from a single unconstrained photograph is challenging: feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) models degrade on out-of-distribution inputs, while pretrained diffusion models produce high-fidelity images but lack multi-view consistency. We observe that these paradigms are fundamentally complementary: explicit 3D representations guarantee geometric consistency, whereas 2D diffusion priors ensure photorealism. Building on this, we propose SplatShot, a training-free framework that couples these representations directly within the denoising process. Given a base 3DGS face model and a single reference image, we jointly denoise all target views using a per-step 3D feedback loop. At each timestep, we predict clean images from the noisy latents, refit the 3DGS to these multi-view predictions, and back-propagate the photometric discrepancy between the 3DGS re-renderings and 2D predictions into the noise estimate. This steers the sampling trajectory toward strictly 3D-coherent, identity-faithful outputs. Experiments on diverse in-the-wild images demonstrate that SplatShot produces 3D avatars with superior identity preservation, photorealism, and multi-view consistency.

中文摘要翻译: 从单张非约束照片中重建照片级真实感的3D人脸头像具有挑战性：前馈式3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）模型在分布外输入上性能退化，而预训练扩散模型虽能生成高保真图像但缺乏多视图一致性。我们观察到这些范式本质互补：显式3D表示保证几何一致性，而2D扩散先验确保照片真实感。基于此，我们提出SplatShot，一种无需训练框架，在去噪过程中直接耦合上述表示。给定一个基础3DGS人脸模型和单张参考图像，我们通过每步3D反馈循环联合去噪所有目标视图。在每个时间步，我们从噪声潜变量中预测干净图像，将3DGS重新拟合到这些多视图预测，并将3DGS重渲染与2D预测之间的光度差异反向传播到噪声估计中。这引导采样轨迹朝向严格3D一致、身份保真的输出。在多种野外图像上的实验表明，SplatShot生成的3D头像在身份保持、照片真实感和多视图一致性上均表现优越。

</details>


### [161] [On the Limits of Token Reduction for Efficient Unified Vision Language Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01503)
*Siyi Chen,Weiming Zhuang,Jingtao Li,Lingjuan Lv*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于token缩减的加速方法在统一视觉-语言模型（VLM）联合训练中的可行性与局限性，发现视觉理解与视觉生成在深层注意力分配上存在根本性不对称，并指出任务特定的token丢弃会破坏联合训练中的协同增益，强调需要协同感知的加速策略。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 统一VLM的联合训练计算成本高昂，而现有研究较少从效率角度进行优化，因此本文探索基于token缩减的加速方法在统一VLM训练中的可行性与边界。

Method: 通过逐层注意力分配的系统分析，揭示视觉理解在深层存在大量视觉冗余，而视觉生成对图像token保持持久依赖；基于此观察设计任务特定的加速器，选择性减少各目标的图像token计算；并在统一训练场景下评估其协同效应。

Result: 任务特定的token缩减在独立设置下能实现显著的效率提升，但在统一训练中导致协同损失——任务特定的token丢弃迫使参数路径分化，消除了联合优化中通常存在的相互性能增益。

Conclusion: 高效的统一建模需要保留共享的跨任务结构，凸显了设计协同感知加速策略的必要性。

Original Abstract: Unified vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual understanding and visual generation within a single autoregressive backbone, but their joint training is computationally expensive and largely overlooked from an efficiency perspective. In this work, we study the feasibility and limits of token-reduction-based acceleration for unified VLM training. Through a systematic analysis of layerwise attention allocation, we uncover a fundamental asymmetry: visual understanding exhibits substantial late-layer visual redundancy, whereas visual generation maintains persistent dependence on image tokens across depth. Guided by this observation, we design task-specific accelerators that selectively reduce image-token computation for each objective. While these methods achieve significant efficiency gains in isolated settings, we observe a consistent synergy loss under unified training -- task-specific token dropping necessitates divergent parameter pathways and eliminates the mutual performance gains typically observed in joint optimization. Our findings suggest that efficient unified modeling requires preserving shared cross-task structures, highlighting the need for synergy-aware acceleration strategies. Project page: https://chicychen.github.io/TokenReductionUnifiedVLM/.

中文摘要翻译: 统一视觉-语言模型（VLM）将视觉理解与视觉生成集成在单个自回归骨干网络中，但其联合训练计算成本高昂，且从效率角度的探索很大程度上被忽视。本文研究了基于token缩减的加速方法在统一VLM训练中的可行性与边界。通过系统分析逐层注意力分配，我们揭示了一个根本的不对称性：视觉理解在深层表现出显著的视觉冗余，而视觉生成在跨深度层中保持对图像token的持久依赖。基于这一观察，我们设计了任务特定的加速器，分别针对每个目标选择性减少图像token计算。尽管这些方法在孤立设置下能实现显著的效率提升，但我们在统一训练中观察到一致的协同损失——任务特定的token丢弃迫使参数路径分化，并消除了联合优化中通常存在的相互性能增益。我们的研究结果表明，高效的统一建模需要保留共享的跨任务结构，凸显了对协同感知加速策略的需求。

</details>


### [162] [MotionDreamer: Universal Skeletal Motion Generation for 3D Rigged Shapes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01518)
*Ye Tao,Yuxin Yao,Kendong Liu,Dapeng Wu,Junhui Hou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MotionDreamer是一个基于扩散的框架，能够从2D视频引导中生成与类别无关的骨骼动画，通过大规模动态数据集和结构-语义注入机制，实现了跨多种形态的高保真4D资产生成。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有模板方法受限于特定拓扑结构，无法泛化到不同形态；逐案例优化计算昂贵且易陷入局部最优，且对视角歧义敏感。需要一种无需类别特定模板、高效且鲁棒的骨骼动画生成方法。

Method: 提出了MotionDreamer框架：1) 构建了包含约20,000个多样化3D模型的大规模动态数据集；2) 设计了结构-语义注入机制，将纹理和语义属性直接集成到骨骼关节表示中，弥合2D视觉运动线索与异构3D骨架结构之间的运动学鸿沟。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在各类未见过的类别（从现存生物到幻想生物）上显著优于现有方法，树立了鲁棒且高效的4D资产生成新的基准。

Conclusion: MotionDreamer通过结合大规模数据、扩散模型和结构-语义注入，成功实现了类别无关的骨骼动画生成，具有良好的泛化能力和动画保真度。

Original Abstract: Motion generation for rigged shapes is vital for scalable 4D asset production. However, template-based methods are limited by specific topologies and fail to generalize across diverse morphologies. Conversely, per-case optimization is computationally expensive, susceptible to local optima, and highly sensitive to viewpoint-induced ambiguities. In this paper, we present MotionDreamer, a diffusion-based framework designed for category-agnostic skeletal animation generation from 2D video guidance. To overcome the scarcity of high-quality training data, we have curated a large-scale dynamic dataset comprising approximately 20,000 diverse 3D models, each featuring complete textures, skeletal rigging, and a wide array of comprehensive animation sequences. To bridge the kinematic gap between 2D visual motion cues and heterogeneous 3D skeletal structures, we propose a structural-semantic injection mechanism. Our model integrates texture and semantic attributes directly into skeletal joint representations. This allows it to map perceived visual dynamics to specific joint hierarchies and their functional roles. This enables MotionDreamer to synthesize high-fidelity animations that maintain anatomical consistency across a vast range of unseen categories, from existing biological species to fantastical beings. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing methods, setting a new state-of-the-art benchmark for robust and efficient 4D asset generation. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

中文摘要翻译: 为绑定了骨骼的模型生成运动对于可扩展的4D资产制作至关重要。然而，基于模板的方法受限于特定的拓扑结构，无法泛化到多种形态。相反，逐案例优化的方法计算成本高昂，容易陷入局部最优，并且对视点引起的歧义高度敏感。在本文中，我们提出了MotionDreamer，一个基于扩散的框架，旨在从2D视频引导中生成与类别无关的骨骼动画。为了克服高质量训练数据稀缺的问题，我们构建了一个大规模动态数据集，包含约20,000个多样化的3D模型，每个模型都具有完整的纹理、骨骼绑定以及丰富全面的动画序列。为了弥合2D视觉运动线索与异构3D骨骼结构之间的运动学鸿沟，我们提出了一种结构-语义注入机制。该模型将纹理和语义属性直接集成到骨骼关节表示中，使其能够将感知到的视觉动态映射到特定的关节层级结构及其功能角色。这使得MotionDreamer能够合成高保真动画，在一系列广泛的未见类别（从现存生物到幻想生物）中保持解剖学一致性。大量实验表明，我们的方法显著优于现有方法，为鲁棒且高效的4D资产生成树立了新的最先进基准。代码将在论文被接收后公开。

</details>


### [163] [PaCX-MAE: Physiology-Augmented Chest X-Ray Masked Autoencoder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01537)
*Yancheng Liu,Kenichi Maeda,Manan Pancholy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PaCX-MAE 是一个跨模态蒸馏框架，通过在训练时引入心电图和实验室检查等生理信号先验，增强胸片编码器的表示能力，同时在推理时保持纯单模态输入，在多个基准上显著提升了生理相关任务的性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 临床诊断通常需要结合影像与生理测量数据，但现有模型大多仅处理单模态数据，缺乏对生理信息的感知能力。作者希望在不改变推理时单模态输入的前提下，将生理先验注入到胸片编码器中。

Method: PaCX-MAE 在域内掩码自编码（masked autoencoding）的基础上，引入双对比-预测目标（dual contrastive-predictive objective），将胸片表示与配对的心电图（ECG）和实验室检查嵌入进行对齐，实现跨模态蒸馏。

Result: 在九个基准上的一致改进：生理依赖任务上 MedMod AUROC +2.7，VinDr F1 +6.5；1%标签率下高效；分割任务解剖保真度与MAE持平；零样本和注意力分析表明模型学会了关注心脏轮廓等生理指标。

Conclusion: PaCX-MAE 成功将生理先验注入胸片编码器，在不增加推理负担的前提下提升了生理相关任务的性能，且保持了解剖结构的保真度，验证了跨模态蒸馏在医学影像预训练中的有效性。

Original Abstract: Clinical diagnosis often requires combining imaging with physiological measurements, yet deployed models typically operate on unimodal data. We present PaCX-MAE, a cross-modal distillation framework that injects physiological priors into chest X-ray (CXR) encoders while remaining strictly unimodal at inference. PaCX-MAE augments in-domain masked autoencoding with a dual contrastive-predictive objective, aligning CXR representations with paired ECG and laboratory embeddings. Extensive evaluation across nine benchmarks demonstrates consistent improvements over domain-specific MAE, particularly on physiology-dependent tasks (e.g., +2.7 AUROC on MedMod; +6.5 F1 on VinDr). The method proves highly label-efficient in the 1% regime and preserves anatomical fidelity, achieving parity with MAE on segmentation tasks. Zero-shot and attention analyses confirm that PaCX-MAE successfully learns to attend to physiological indicators, such as the cardiac silhouette, absent in standard visual pretraining.

中文摘要翻译: 临床诊断通常需要将影像学与生理测量相结合，然而已部署的模型通常仅处理单模态数据。本文提出 PaCX-MAE，一种跨模态蒸馏框架，该框架在胸片（CXR）编码器中注入生理先验，同时在推理时严格保持单模态输入。PaCX-MAE 通过双重对比-预测目标增强域内掩码自编码，将胸片表示与配对的心电图和实验室检查嵌入进行对齐。在九个基准上的广泛评估表明，该方法在领域特定 MAE 基础上取得了一致改进，尤其在依赖生理信息的任务上表现突出（例如 MedMod 上 AUROC 提升 2.7；VinDr 上 F1 提升 6.5）。该方法在 1% 标签率场景下表现出极高的标签效率，并保持了解剖保真度，在分割任务上与 MAE 持平。零样本和注意力分析证实，PaCX-MAE 成功学习关注标准视觉预训练中不存在的生理指标，如心脏轮廓。

</details>


### [164] [PathAR: Structure-First Autoregressive Synthesis of Multimodal Pathology Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01543)
*Yuan Zhang,Jiahao Xia,Junzhang Huang,Meng Wang,Feng Chen,Guanyu Yang,Huazhu Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PathAR提出了一种结构优先的自回归生成框架，通过显式分解结构（structure）与外观（appearance）令牌，实现模态标签条件下的病理图像生成，在保持形态一致性的同时提升模态保真度。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有多模态病理生成方法将结构与外观耦合在统一的令牌流中建模，导致模态变化时结构可控性弱化，难以在异构模态外观下保持形态学结构的稳定性。

Method: PathAR包含两个核心组件：1) Dual-VQ分词器，将样本分解为基于掩码引导的结构令牌和外观令牌；2) 交错自回归（IAR）Transformer，采用非对称注意力可见性机制强制结构到外观的依赖关系，实现模态标签条件化的病理图像生成。

Result: 实验表明，PathAR在结构一致性和模态保真度上优于基线方法，保持样本多样性，支持数据稀缺场景下的下游分割任务，并能扩展到更细粒度的器官标签变化。

Conclusion: PathAR通过显式分解结构与外观并强制执行结构到外观的依赖关系，有效解决了多模态病理生成中结构控制与模态保真之间的权衡问题。

Original Abstract: Data scarcity in multimodal pathology motivates unified generative models that synthesize modality-specific appearance while preserving anatomically coherent structure. Although modalities differ in appearance statistics, morphological structures such as cellular topology and tissue boundaries are largely preserved across acquisition protocols. However, existing methods often model these factors within a homogeneous token stream, implicitly coupling structure with appearance and weakening structural controllability under modality shifts. To address this, we propose pathology Autorgressive modeling (PathAR), a structure-first autoregressive synthesis framework that explicitly factorizes structure and appearance for modality-label-conditioned pathology generation.PathAR employs a dual vector quantization (Dual-VQ) tokenizer to decompose samples into mask-grounded structure and appearance tokens, and an interleaved autoregressive (IAR) transformer with asymmetric attention visibility to enforce structure-to-appearance dependence. PathAR stabilizes morphology under heterogeneous modality-specific appearances and enables spatially aligned image--mask pair generation. Extensive experiments show that PathAR improves structural consistency and modality fidelity over baselines, maintains sample diversity, supports downstream segmentation in data-scarce regimes, and demonstrates extensibility to finer-grained intra-modality organ-label variation.

中文摘要翻译: 多模态病理学中的数据稀缺问题推动了统一生成模型的发展，这类模型在保持解剖结构一致性的同时合成模态特定的外观。尽管不同模态在外观统计特性上存在差异，但细胞拓扑结构、组织边界等形态学结构在不同采集协议下基本得以保留。然而，现有方法往往在同质化的令牌流中建模这些因子，隐式地将结构与外观耦合在一起，削弱了模态变化下的结构可控性。为解决这一问题，本文提出了病理自回归建模（PathAR），一种结构优先的自回归合成框架，该框架显式分解结构与外观，用于模态标签条件化的病理生成。PathAR采用双向量量化（Dual-VQ）分词器将样本分解为基于掩码引导的结构令牌和外观令牌，并设计了一种具有非对称注意力可见性的交错自回归（IAR）Transformer，强制执行结构到外观的依赖关系。PathAR在异构模态特定外观下稳定了形态学结构，并实现了空间对齐的图像-掩码对生成。大量实验表明，PathAR在结构一致性和模态保真度上优于基线方法，保持了样本多样性，支持数据稀缺场景下的下游分割任务，并能扩展到更细粒度的模态内器官标签变化。

</details>


### [165] [ForestMamba: Sparse Mamba with Geometry-guided Queries for 3D Forest Point Cloud Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01549)
*Trung Thanh Nguyen,Tuan-Anh Vu,Duc Viet Le,Yasutomo Kawanishi,Takahiro Komamizu,Ichiro Ide,Teja Kattenborn*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ForestMamba提出了一种基于状态空间模型的森林LiDAR点云分割方法，通过垂直优先序列化、几何引导的查询初始化和Mamba解码器，在保持线性计算复杂度的同时，在七个森林区域上实现了优于现有方法的语义和实例分割性能，推理速度提升3倍，GPU内存降低2.3倍。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有基于稀疏卷积或Transformer的森林LiDAR分割方法存在两个关键局限：注意力机制的二次复杂度难以扩展到大规模森林场景，且通用上下文建模未能利用森林结构先验知识，导致复杂区域中的树木分离效果不佳。

Method: (1) 垂直优先的条带序列化稀疏编码器：将稀疏体素组织为垂直连贯的序列，实现高效的长程上下文建模；(2) 几何引导的查询初始化：基于多尺度冠层高度模型（CHM）的冠层极大值提供生态上有意义的查询种子，结合最远点采样（FPS）覆盖林下树木；(3) Mamba查询解码器：结合局部kNN体素聚合与空间双路径Mamba，以线性计算复杂度实现查询精化。

Result: 在七个森林区域的实验中，ForestMamba在语义分割和实例分割任务上均一致优于现有基线方法，同时推理速度比基于Transformer的方法快3倍，GPU内存消耗降低2.3倍。

Conclusion: 将森林结构先验融入特征编码、查询生成和查询精化过程，并用线性时间状态空间建模替代二次注意力机制，能够有效提升森林LiDAR点云分割的精度和效率。

Original Abstract: AI-based semantic and instance segmentation of terrestrial and drone LiDAR point clouds is emerging as a transformative approach for converting the complex 3D structure of forests into actionable information for forest monitoring and biodiversity assessment. However, forest LiDAR scenes remain highly challenging due to their large data volumes, irregular sampling density, overlapping and complex canopy structure, and geographic variability. Existing methods based on sparse convolutions or Transformers achieve promising results, but suffer from two key limitations: Quadratic complexity of attention scales poorly to large forest scenes, and Generic context modeling does not exploit forest structural priors, limiting tree separation in complex regions. To address these challenges, we propose ForestMamba, a structure-aware method that incorporates forest-specific priors into feature encoding, query generation, and query refinement, while replacing quadratic attention with linear-time state-space modeling. First, we introduce a sparse encoder with vertical-priority slab serialization that organizes sparse voxels into vertically coherent sequences for efficient long-range context modeling. Second, we propose a geometry-guided query initialization strategy based on an on-the-fly multi-scale Canopy Height Model (CHM), where canopy maxima provide ecologically meaningful query seeds, supplemented by Farthest Point Sampling (FPS) to cover understory trees. Third, we design a Mamba-based query decoder that combines local kNN voxel aggregation with a spatial dual-path Mamba for query refinement with linear computational complexity. Extensive experiments across seven forest regions demonstrate that ForestMamba consistently outperforms existing baselines in both segmentation tasks, while achieving 3 times faster inference and 2.3 times lower GPU memory than Transformer-based methods.

中文摘要翻译: 基于AI的地面和无人机LiDAR点云语义分割与实例分割正成为一种变革性方法，将森林的复杂三维结构转化为可用于森林监测和生物多样性评估的可操作信息。然而，由于森林LiDAR场景数据量大、采样密度不规则、冠层结构重叠复杂以及地理变异性大，其仍面临巨大挑战。现有的基于稀疏卷积或Transformer的方法取得了有前景的结果，但存在两个关键局限：注意力的二次复杂度难以扩展到大型森林场景，以及通用上下文建模未能利用森林结构先验知识，限制了复杂区域中的树木分离。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了ForestMamba——一种结构感知方法，它将森林特定先验融入特征编码、查询生成和查询精化，并用线性时间状态空间建模替代二次注意力机制。首先，我们引入了一个具有垂直优先条带序列化的稀疏编码器，将稀疏体素组织为垂直连贯的序列，以实现高效的长程上下文建模。其次，我们提出了一种基于实时多尺度冠层高度模型（CHM）的几何引导查询初始化策略，其中冠层极大值提供了生态上有意义的查询种子，并辅以最远点采样（FPS）覆盖林下树木。第三，我们设计了一个基于Mamba的查询解码器，将局部kNN体素聚合与空间双路径Mamba相结合，以线性计算复杂度实现查询精化。在七个森林区域上的大量实验表明，ForestMamba在两个分割任务上均一致优于现有基线方法，同时推理速度比基于Transformer的方法快3倍，GPU内存消耗降低2.3倍。

</details>


### [166] [Attention-guided Fine-tuning of Multimodal Large Language Models Improves Chain-of-Thought Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01558)
*Sanchit Sinha,Guangzhi Xiong,Bohan Liu,Zhenghao He,Aidong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 系统分析了多模态大模型中CoT提示的失效模式（过早承诺答案和视觉token访问不足），并提出Attentive-CoT（注意力引导的微调目标）来改善CoT推理轨迹，在多个视觉推理基准上提升了性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: CoT提示在多模态大模型中的有效性不确定，在多个视觉推理基准上反而会降低性能，需要系统分析其失败原因并提出改进方法。

Method: 提出Attentive-CoT（Att-CoT），一种注意力引导的微调目标函数，通过鼓励CoT轨迹延迟答案承诺并保持持续的视觉token访问来改善推理过程，可即插即用于任何CoT-SFT训练流程，无需架构修改。

Result: 识别出两个反复出现的失败模式：过早承诺答案和推理过程中有限的直接视觉token访问。标准CoT-SFT只能部分缓解这些问题，且会增加对文本先验的依赖。Att-CoT在三个视觉推理基准、六个MLLM上均优于标准微调。

Conclusion: Attentive-CoT能有效增强CoT在多模态大模型中的表现，通过注意力引导机制克服了标准CoT方法的固有缺陷。

Original Abstract: The effectiveness of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) remains uncertain: across several visual reasoning benchmarks, CoT prompting often degrades performance compared to direct prompting. In this paper, we provide a systematic analysis of CoT behavior in three modern MLLM families across model scales on datasets requiring step-wise visual evidence. Our analysis identifies two recurring failure modes: premature answer commitment and limited direct visual-token access during rationale generation. We further find that standard CoT-style Supervised Fine-Tuning (CoT-SFT) can mitigate these issues only partially, while often increasing reliance on textual priors and reducing counterfactual visual dependence. Motivated by these findings, we propose Attentive-CoT (Att-CoT), an attention-guided fine-tuning objective that encourages CoT trajectories to delay answer commitment while maintaining sustained visual-token access. Att-CoT can be plugged into any CoT-SFT training run without architectural changes. Experiments on three visual reasoning benchmarks across six MLLMs show that Att-CoT enhances CoT performance over standard fine-tuning.

中文摘要翻译: 链式思维提示在多模态大模型中的有效性仍不确定：在多个视觉推理基准上，链式思维提示往往比直接提示表现更差。本文系统分析了三种现代多模态大模型家族在不同模型规模下、在需要逐步视觉证据的数据集上的链式思维行为。我们的分析识别出两种反复出现的失败模式：过早承诺答案以及在推理生成过程中有限的直接视觉token访问。我们进一步发现，标准的链式思维监督微调只能部分缓解这些问题，同时往往增加对文本先验的依赖并减少反事实的视觉依赖。基于这些发现，我们提出了Attentive-CoT，一种注意力引导的微调目标，它鼓励链式思维轨迹延迟答案承诺，同时保持持续的视觉token访问。Attentive-CoT可以在无需架构修改的情况下嵌入任何链式思维监督微调训练流程中。在六个多模态大模型上、三个视觉推理基准上的实验表明，Attentive-CoT相较于标准微调增强了链式思维的性能。

</details>


### [167] [$\text{VG}^2$GT: Voxel-Gaussian Splatting Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01573)
*Yibin Zhao,Yihan Pan,Jun Nan,Wenli Yang,Liwei Chen,Jianjun Yi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VG²GT，一种基于体素-高斯泼溅的视觉几何基础Transformer，利用冻结的预训练视觉基础模型和多尺度可微体素模块实现几何精确的3D重建和新视角合成，无需逐场景优化，在多个基准数据集上达到最优性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有高斯泼溅方法大多需要精确的相机参数和逐场景优化，前馈方法中像素对齐的高斯基元存在伪影和不均匀问题，缺乏几何理解能力。

Method: VG²GT采用冻结的预训练视觉基础模型（VFM）提取特征，引入多尺度可微体素模块增强几何理解，直接从体素特征分割和回归高斯基元参数；训练时通过随机立体体渲染监督深度图，保持VFM完全冻结。

Result: 在DTU、Replica、TAT和ScanNet数据集上，VG²GT性能超越当前最先进方法。

Conclusion: VG²GT可无缝嵌入任何基于补丁特征的VFM，显著降低训练成本，同时实现几何精确的高斯场景重建。

Original Abstract: Gaussian splatting has shown strong potential for 3D reconstruction and novel view synthesis. However, most existing methods require accurate camera parameters and per-scene optimization, while feed-forward methods with pixel-aligned Gaussian primitives often suffer from artifacts and non-uniform primitives. In this paper, we propose $\text{VG}^2$GT, a Voxel-Gaussian Splatting Visual Geometry-Grounded Transformer. $\text{VG}^2$GT leverages a frozen pretrained visual foundation model (VFM), incorporates a multi-scale differentiable voxel module to enhance geometric understanding, and directly splits and regresses Gaussian primitive parameters from voxel features. During training, depth maps are supervised through stochastic solid volume rendering, enabling geometrically accurate Gaussian scene reconstruction while keeping the visual foundation model fully frozen. This design enables $\text{VG}^2$GT to be seamlessly plugged into any patch-feature-based VFM, while substantially reducing the required training cost. $\text{VG}^2$GT outperforms current state-of-the-art methods on widely used DTU, Replica, TAT, and ScanNet datasets.

中文摘要翻译: 高斯泼溅在三维重建和新视角合成方面展现出了巨大的潜力。然而，现有大多数方法需要精确的相机参数和逐场景优化，而基于像素对齐的高斯基元的前馈方法则常受伪影和非均匀基元问题的困扰。本文提出了VG²GT，一种基于体素-高斯泼溅的视觉几何基础Transformer。VG²GT利用冻结的预训练视觉基础模型（VFM），引入多尺度可微体素模块以增强几何理解，并直接从体素特征分割和回归高斯基元参数。训练过程中，通过随机立体体渲染对深度图进行监督，在保持视觉基础模型完全冻结的同时实现几何精确的高斯场景重建。这一设计使VG²GT能够无缝嵌入任何基于补丁特征的VFM，同时大幅降低所需的训练成本。VG²GT在广泛使用的DTU、Replica、TAT和ScanNet数据集上均优于当前最先进的方法。

</details>


### [168] [Deformable Wiener Filter for Future Video Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01576)
*Xuewei Meng,Chuanmin Jia,Xinfeng Zhang,Shanshe Wang,Siwei Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种可变形维纳滤波器(DWF)，通过有监督学习融合局部与非局部特征，在VVC中实现显著的码率节省。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有VVC环路滤波器主要利用图像局部相似性，非局部滤波器虽能弥补这一不足，但其广泛采用的无监督参数估计方法限制了性能。

Method: 基于维纳滤波理论，有监督地训练滤波器系数。先为每个待滤波样本推导局部相邻样本和非局部相似样本，再基于块级噪声和样本级特征分类，同类样本共享系数，最后进行自适应融合并带离群值约束的滤波操作。

Result: 相比VTM-11.0，在All Intra、Random Access、Low-Delay B配置下平均分别节省1.16%、1.92%和2.67%的码率。

Conclusion: 所提出的DWF通过有监督学习融合局部与非局部信息，显著提升了环路滤波性能。

Original Abstract: In-loop filters have attracted increasing attention due to the remarkable noise-reduction capability in the hybrid video coding framework. However, the existing in-loop filters in Versatile Video Coding (VVC) mainly take advantage of the image local similarity. Although some non-local based in-loop filters can make up for this shortcoming, the widely-used unsupervised parameter estimation method by non-local filters limits the performance. In view of this, we propose a deformable Wiener Filter (DWF). It combines the local and non-local characteristics and supervisedly trains the filter coefficients based on the Wiener Filter theory. In the filtering process, local adjacent samples and non-local similar samples are first derived for each sample of interest. Then the to-be-filtered samples are classified into specific groups based on the patch level noise and sample-level characteristics. Samples in each group share the same filter coefficients. After that, the local and non-local reference samples are adaptively fused based on the classification results. Finally, the filtering operation with outlier data constraints is conducted for each to-be-filtered sample. Moreover, the performance of the proposed DWF is analyzed with different reference sample derivation schemes in detail. Simulation results show that the proposed approach achieves 1.16%, 1.92%, and 2.67% bit-rate savings on average compared to the VTM-11.0 for All Intra, Random Access, and Low-Delay B configurations, respectively.

中文摘要翻译: 在混合视频编码框架中，环路滤波器因其显著的降噪能力而受到越来越多的关注。然而，现有通用视频编码(VVC)中的环路滤波器主要利用了图像的局部相似性。虽然一些基于非局部的环路滤波器可以弥补这一不足，但非局部滤波器广泛采用的无监督参数估计方法限制了其性能。鉴于此，本文提出了一种可变形维纳滤波器(DWF)。它结合了局部和非局部特性，并基于维纳滤波理论有监督地训练滤波器系数。在滤波过程中，首先为每个待滤波样本推导局部相邻样本和非局部相似样本。然后，基于块级噪声和样本级特征将待滤波样本分类为特定组别，每组样本共享相同的滤波器系数。随后，根据分类结果自适应地融合局部和非局部参考样本。最后，对每个待滤波样本进行带离群值约束的滤波操作。此外，本文还详细分析了不同参考样本推导方案下所提DWF的性能。仿真结果表明，与VTM-11.0相比，所提方法在All Intra、Random Access和Low-Delay B配置下平均分别节省了1.16%、1.92%和2.67%的码率。

</details>


### [169] [FLAME: Physics-Guided Neural Operators for Onboard Satellite Methane Detection in Hyperspectral Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01577)
*Junhyuk Heo,Junhwan Park,Sancheol Sim,Beomkyu Choi,Woojin Cho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FLAME是一种物理引导的神经算子，通过将甲烷吸收的物理机制直接嵌入网络架构，在星载硬件延迟预算内实现了最高检测精度，并将像素级假阳性率降低至最强神经基线的近1/3。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 甲烷是近期气候变化的主要驱动因素，快速识别其排放源是关键的气候干预手段。星载高光谱影像是主要工具，但数据量过大使地面检测不切实际，需要星载检测。经典方法在星载硬件上计算成本过高，而深度学习方法速度快但检测质量不足。

Method: 提出FLAME，一种物理引导的神经算子（physics-guided neural operator），将甲烷吸收的物理机制直接构建到网络架构中。

Result: 在甲烷检测基准上，FLAME在所有评估方法中取得最高检测精度；像素级假阳性率相比最强神经基线降低近3倍；在学习的基线方法中使用参数量最少；运行延迟在星载卫星硬件的预算范围内。

Conclusion: FLAME通过将物理知识嵌入网络架构，在保持高效推理的同时显著提升了检测质量，非常适合星载部署。

Original Abstract: Methane is a major driver of near-term climate change, and rapidly identifying its emission sources is a critical climate intervention. Spaceborne hyperspectral imagery is the primary tool for this task, but the volume of data produced by each sensor makes ground-based detection impractical and necessitates onboard detection. Classical methods incur prohibitive computational cost on onboard hardware, while deep learning models are fast but fall short on detection quality. We propose FLAME, a physics-guided neural operator that builds the physics of methane absorption directly into its architecture. On the methane detection benchmark, FLAME achieves the highest detection accuracy among all evaluated methods, reduces the pixel-level false positive rate by nearly $3\times$ over the strongest neural baseline, uses the fewest parameters among learned baselines, and runs within the latency budget of onboard satellite hardware.

中文摘要翻译: 甲烷是近期气候变化的主要驱动因素，快速识别其排放源是一项关键的气候干预手段。星载高光谱影像是完成此任务的主要工具，但每个传感器产生的数据量使得地面检测不切实际，因此需要星载检测。经典方法在星载硬件上计算成本过高，而深度学习模型虽然速度快，但检测质量不足。我们提出FLAME，一种物理引导的神经算子（physics-guided neural operator），将甲烷吸收的物理机制直接构建到其网络架构中。在甲烷检测基准上，FLAME在所有评估方法中取得了最高的检测精度，将像素级假阳性率相比最强的神经基线降低了近3倍，在学习的基线方法中使用了最少的参数量，并且在星载卫星硬件的延迟预算内运行。

</details>


### [170] [Effective Multi-sensor Conditioning for Street-view Novel-view Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01590)
*Zhengfei Kuang,Adam Sun,Liyuan Zhu,Tong Wu,Shengqu Cai,Jonathan Tremblay,Iro Armeni,Ehsan Adeli,Lior Yariv,Gordon Wetzstein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: StreetNVS提出一种多传感器融合的视频扩散框架，通过联合利用稀疏LiDAR、环视参考图像和相机位姿实现高质量驾驶场景新视角合成，尤其在极端偏离轨迹路径上表现优异。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有驾驶场景新视角合成方法仅利用了传感器信号的部分信息，当目标轨迹偏离原始行驶路径时合成质量严重下降，本质上是多传感器融合不足的问题。

Method: 提出StreetNVS框架，包含一个基于相对射线级位置编码的参考增强相机注意力模块，联合条件化稀疏LiDAR重投影、环视参考图像和相机位姿三种信号；设计两阶段课程训练策略，逐步让模型适应越来越稀疏的LiDAR输入。

Result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上，StreetNVS在稀疏LiDAR条件下显著优于SOTA基线，性能媲美使用密集10-100倍点云的方法；并能合成沿极端偏离轨迹（如抬升、变道、拉远、旋转）的连贯视频。

Conclusion: 通过多传感器信号的有效融合，即使在极其稀疏的LiDAR条件下也能实现高质量的新视角合成，并在极端偏离轨迹路径上保持连贯性。

Original Abstract: Modern vehicle platforms are equipped with a rich sensor suite, including LiDAR, calibrated multi-camera rigs, and accurate ego-motion, that in principle offers strong signal for re-rendering a driving scene from novel viewpoints. A growing line of recent work leverages video diffusion models for this task, using their generative priors to synthesize plausible novel views from sparse vehicle observations. In practice, however, existing methods exploit only a fragment of this signal, and their quality tends to degrade as the target trajectory departs from the recorded driving path. We argue that this is fundamentally a multi-sensor fusion problem: sparse LiDAR reprojections supply accurate but incomplete metric geometry, surround-view reference imagery supplies dense appearance but no metric depth, and camera poses tie the two together across views. We introduce StreetNVS, a video diffusion framework that jointly conditions on all three signals through a Reference-Enhanced Camera Attention module based on a relative ray-level positional encoding. We develop a two-stage curriculum training strategy that gradually exposes the model to increasingly sparse LiDAR. On the Waymo Open Dataset, StreetNVS substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines under sparse LiDAR conditioning, matches methods that rely on 10-100 times denser point clouds. We further show capabilities of synthesizing coherent videos along extreme out-of-trajectory paths such as elevation, lane-shift, pullback, and rotation.
  Our website: https://streetnvs.github.io

中文摘要翻译: 现代车辆平台配备了丰富的传感器套件，包括LiDAR、标定好的多相机系统以及精确的自我运动信息，这原则上为从新视角重新渲染驾驶场景提供了强信号。最近一系列研究利用视频扩散模型来完成此任务，借助其生成先验从稀疏的车辆观测中合成合理的新视角。然而在实践中，现有方法仅利用了这些信号的一小部分，当目标轨迹偏离原始行驶路径时，其质量往往会下降。我们认为这本质上是一个多传感器融合问题：稀疏的LiDAR重投影提供了精确但不完整的度量几何，环视参考图像提供了密集的外观信息但没有度量深度，而相机位姿则将两者在视角间联系起来。本文提出StreetNVS，一个视频扩散框架，通过基于相对射线级位置编码的参考增强相机注意力模块，同时以这三种信号为条件。我们开发了一种两阶段课程训练策略，逐步让模型暴露于越来越稀疏的LiDAR数据。在Waymo Open Dataset上，StreetNVS在稀疏LiDAR条件下显著优于最先进的基线方法，性能可媲美那些使用密集10-100倍点云的方法。我们进一步展示了沿极端偏离轨迹路径（如抬升、变道、拉远、旋转）合成连贯视频的能力。我们的网站：https://streetnvs.github.io

</details>


### [171] [TLG: Temporal-Logic Grounding for Video Question Answering via Source-Annotation Reconstruction and Category-Targeted Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01591)
*Ali Alavi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TLG系统，通过将视频动作时间线重建与时序逻辑程序执行相结合，显著提升了视频时序逻辑推理能力，从46.9%提升至71.37%，证明了时序定位是核心瓶颈而非模型规模。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有端到端视频语言模型在TimeLogic Challenge上表现接近随机，因为它们将视频视为帧集合，无法定位动作发生的时间点，缺乏时序逻辑推理能力。

Method: TLG是一个三层次系统：(i) 从公开标注重建视频动作时间线，将问题解析为时序逻辑程序并确定性执行；(ii) 在无标注区域回退到强开源VLM；(iii) 将VLM最弱的题型路由到前沿推理模型。

Result: TLG将测试准确率从VLM基线46.9%提升至71.37%（绝对提升+24.5），仅落后排行榜第一名3个百分点。消融实验表明三种基于模型的时间线重建变体均不如整体VLM，证明时序定位是不可约的瓶颈，真实标注而非更大模型驱动准确率提升。

Conclusion: 时序定位（temporal grounding）是视频时序逻辑推理任务的核心瓶颈，利用真实标注进行时间线重建比扩大模型规模更为有效。

Original Abstract: The TimeLogic Challenge evaluates formal temporal-logic reasoning over video - 16 operators (before, after, until, since, always, co-occur, ordering, ...) in boolean and 4-way multiple-choice form. End-to-end video-language models (VLMs) hover near chance on this task because they treat video as a bag of frames and cannot localize when actions occur. We present TLG (Temporal-Logic Grounding), a three-tier system that (i) reconstructs each video's action timeline from the public source-dataset annotations the benchmark was generated from, parses every question into a temporal-logic program, and executes it deterministically; (ii) falls back to a strong open VLM where no annotation exists; and (iii) routes only the question categories where the VLM is empirically weakest to a frontier reasoning model. TLG raises test accuracy from a 46.9% VLM baseline to 71.37%, a +24.5 absolute gain, reaching within 3 points of the leaderboard top. We report extensive ablations, including three model-based timeline-reconstruction variants that all underperform a holistic VLM, isolating temporal grounding as the irreducible bottleneck and showing that real annotations - not larger models - drive accuracy.

中文摘要翻译: TimeLogic Challenge旨在评估视频上的形式化时序逻辑推理能力——涵盖16个算子（之前、之后、直到、自从、总是、共现、排序等），采用布尔型和四选一选择题形式。端到端视频语言模型在此任务上表现接近随机，因为它们将视频视为帧集合，无法定位动作发生的时间点。本文提出TLG（时序逻辑接地）系统，这是一个三层次系统：(i) 从基准测试所依赖的公开源数据集标注中重建每个视频的动作时间线，将每个问题解析为时序逻辑程序，并确定性执行；(ii) 在不存在标注的情况下回退到强开源VLM；(iii) 仅将VLM经验证最弱的题目类别路由到前沿推理模型。TLG将测试准确率从VLM基线46.9%提升至71.37%，绝对提升达24.5个百分点，仅落后排行榜第一名3个百分点。我们进行了广泛的消融实验，包括三种基于模型的时间线重建变体——它们均不如整体VLM表现，从而将时序定位隔离为不可约的瓶颈，并证明真实标注（而非更大的模型）驱动了准确率的提升。

</details>


### [172] [RoboTrustBench: Benchmarking the Trustworthiness of Video World Models for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01600)
*Huiqiong Li,Jiayu Wang,Zhiting Mei,Anirudha Majumdar,Jingjing Chen,Bin Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RoboTrustBench基准，评估视频世界模型在正常、约束敏感、反事实和对抗四种场景下的可信度，发现现有模型虽能生成视觉连贯视频，但在约束推理、反事实接地、物理交互和抑制不安全指令方面存在不足。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有视频世界模型基准主要评估模型在有效、可行且安全的指令下的表现，缺乏对模型在非理想场景（如约束敏感、反事实和对抗性指令）下可信度的系统评估。

Method: 基于真实世界DROID数据集构建RoboTrustBench基准，包含1,207个专家验证的指令-图像对，设计六维评估协议（含13个细粒度标准），在正常、约束敏感、反事实和对抗四种场景下评估七个代表性视频世界模型，结合人类和MLLM评估。

Result: 现有模型能生成视觉连贯的视频，但在约束推理、反事实接地、物理交互和抑制不安全指令等方面表现不佳，说明视觉质量和表面指令跟随不足以衡量视频世界模型的可信度。

Conclusion: 当前视频世界模型在视觉质量和指令跟随方面表现良好，但在可信赖的机器人视频世界建模所需的关键能力（约束推理、反事实接地、物理交互、不安全指令抑制）上仍有显著不足。

Original Abstract: Video world models are increasingly used in robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks mostly evaluate them under valid, feasible, and safe instructions. We introduce RoboTrustBench, a benchmark for evaluating the trustworthiness of video world models under four scenarios: Normal, Constraint-Sensitive, Counterfactual, and Adversarial. Built from real-world DROID episodes, RoboTrustBench contains 1,207 expert-validated instruction-image pairs and a six-dimensional evaluation protocol with 13 fine-grained criteria. Evaluating seven representative video world models with human and MLLM assessment, we find that current models often generate visually coherent videos, but struggle with constraint reasoning, counterfactual grounding, physical interaction, and unsafe-instruction suppression. These results show that visual quality and surface-level instruction following are insufficient for trustworthy robotic video world modeling.

中文摘要翻译: 视频世界模型在机器人操作中应用日益广泛，然而现有基准主要评估模型在有效、可行且安全的指令下的表现。我们提出RoboTrustBench，一个用于评估视频世界模型在正常、约束敏感、反事实和对抗四种场景下可信度的基准。RoboTrustBench基于真实世界的DROID片段构建，包含1,207个专家验证的指令-图像对，并设计了一个六维评估协议，涵盖13个细粒度标准。通过对七个代表性视频世界模型进行人类和MLLM评估，我们发现当前模型通常能生成视觉连贯的视频，但在约束推理、反事实接地、物理交互以及不安全指令抑制方面存在困难。这些结果表明，视觉质量和表面层面的指令跟随不足以实现可信赖的机器人视频世界建模。

</details>


### [173] [EIVE: End-to-End Instance-Specific Visual Explanations for Detection Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01601)
*Jianlin Xiang,Yanshan Li,Linhui Dai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种端到端的实例级视觉可解释性框架EIVE，针对DETR类检测器，通过重构解码器中的交叉注意力机制为实例级特征归因路径，无需梯度计算或输入扰动，高效生成实例级显著性图，并在多个数据集上达到或超越现有最优后处理方法的效果。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有目标检测的可解释性方法主要采用后处理范式（如基于梯度或基于扰动的解释方法），需要额外的梯度计算或重复模型推理，导致效率低下。为此，本文旨在设计一种高效且无需额外计算开销的端到端实例级视觉解释框架。

Method: (1) 将DETR类模型解码器中的交叉注意力机制重构为实例级特征归因路径，使每个目标查询的交叉注意力对应其预测实例的视觉归因；(2) 设计跨层混合共识融合（CLHCF）模块，聚合解码器各层的交叉注意力信号，生成稳定且紧凑的解释；(3) 提出注意力感知联合训练策略（AAJTS），对交叉注意力施加空间约束，鼓励稳定且集中的归因表示，同时提升可解释性和检测性能。

Result: 在MS COCO 2017、ExDark和Cityscapes数据集上的实验表明，EIVE能够生成高质量的实例级显著性图，在标准评估指标上达到或优于最先进的后处理方法，同时显著提升了解释效率。

Conclusion: EIVE框架无需梯度计算和输入扰动，即可高效生成实例级视觉解释，适用于单尺度和多尺度的DETR类目标检测器，并且通过AAJTS训练策略能同时提升可解释性和检测性能。

Original Abstract: Visual explainability for object detection remains challenging due to the multi-instance nature of detection. Existing approaches predominantly adopt post-hoc paradigms, such as gradient-based or perturbation-based explanation methods, to interpret pretrained detectors. However, these methods require additional gradient computation or repeated model inference, resulting in limited efficiency. To address this issue, we propose an End-to-end Instance-specific Visual Explanation framework (EIVE) that directly generates instance-level saliency maps following the forward pass of Detection Transformer (DETR)-like models. Specifically, we reformulate the cross-attention mechanism in the decoder as an instance-level feature attribution pathway, so that the cross-attention of each object query corresponds to the visual attribution of its predicted instance. Based on this formulation, we design a cross-layer hybrid consensus fusion (CLHCF) module to aggregate cross-attention signals across decoder layers, producing stable and compact explanations. The explanation process of EIVE requires neither gradient computation nor input perturbation, yielding high computational efficiency, and applies to single- and multi-scale DETR-like object detectors. Finally, we present an attention-aware joint training strategy (AAJTS) as a training-oriented application, which imposes spatial constraints on cross-attention patterns to encourage stable and concentrated attribution representations, thereby improving both interpretability and detection performance. Experiments on MS COCO 2017, ExDark, and Cityscapes demonstrate that EIVE produces high-quality instance-level saliency maps and achieves performance comparable to, or better than, state-of-the-art post-hoc methods across standard metrics, while substantially improving explanation efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/xjlDestiny/EIVE.git.

中文摘要翻译: 目标检测的视觉可解释性因其多实例特性而仍然具有挑战性。现有方法主要采用后处理范式（如基于梯度或基于扰动的解释方法）来解释预训练的检测器。然而，这些方法需要额外的梯度计算或重复的模型推理，导致效率有限。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种端到端的实例级视觉解释框架（EIVE），该框架在Detection Transformer（DETR）类模型的前向传播后直接生成实例级显著性图。具体而言，我们将解码器中的交叉注意力机制重构为实例级特征归因路径，使每个目标查询的交叉注意力对应其预测实例的视觉归因。基于这一公式，我们设计了跨层混合共识融合（CLHCF）模块，用于聚合解码器各层的交叉注意力信号，生成稳定且紧凑的解释。EIVE的解释过程既不需要梯度计算，也不需要输入扰动，具有较高的计算效率，并且适用于单尺度和多尺度的DETR类目标检测器。最后，我们提出了一种注意力感知联合训练策略（AAJTS）作为面向训练的应用，该策略对交叉注意力模式施加空间约束，以鼓励稳定且集中的归因表示，从而提升可解释性和检测性能。在MS COCO 2017、ExDark和Cityscapes上的实验表明，EIVE能够生成高质量的实例级显著性图，在标准指标上达到或优于最先进的后处理方法，同时显著提高了解释效率。代码地址：https://github.com/xjlDestiny/EIVE.git。

</details>


### [174] [Paving the Way for Point Cloud Video Representation Learning Using A PDE Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01604)
*Zhuoxu Huang,Zhenkun Fan,Jungong Han,Josef Kittler*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MotionPDE，将点云视频中的时空相关性学习形式化为可求解的偏微分方程（PDE），并通过对比学习结构优化PDE求解过程，作为一种即插即用的增强模块，以较低计算开销提升现有骨干模型在点云视频理解上的性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统基于流的方法难以处理点云序列数据的无序空间排列特性导致的时空相关性建模困难，而PDE在物理领域虽已成熟但尚未被有效应用于点云视频这类新型序列数据。

Method: 受流体分析启发，构造一个简化的PDE来正则化时空相关性学习；通过时间嵌入与空间嵌入之间的对比学习结构来引导和优化PDE的求解过程，从而实现对现有骨干模型的即插即用增强。

Result: MotionPDE作为增强模块仅增加极小的计算开销和参数量，并在自监督学习设置下展现出良好的效果，验证了其在点云视频数据解释中的实用性和适应性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的基于PDE正则化与对比学习的方法能够有效建模点云视频的时空相关性，是一种轻量、通用的增强方案，有望为后续点云视频研究提供基础工具。

Original Abstract: Investigating spatial-temporal correlations, specifically how spatial points vary over time, is crucial for understanding point cloud videos. Traditional methods, particularly flow-based techniques, struggle with these correlations due to the unordered spatial arrangement of sequential point cloud data. To address this challenge, we propose a novel approach that regularizes spatial-temporal correlation learning by formulating the problem as a solvable Partial Differential Equation (PDE). While PDEs have long been effective in the physical domain, their application to novel sequential data like point cloud video remains underexplored. Inspired by fluid analysis, we construct a simplified PDE, and the process of solving PDE is guided and refined by a contrastive learning structure between the temporal embeddings and the spatial embeddings. With this extra supervision, our method, named MotionPDE, serves as an effective, plug-and-play enhancement module for existing backbone models, adding minimal computational overhead and parameters. Capitalizing on the contrastive learning process, we delve deeper into the self-supervised capabilities of MotionPDE, yielding promising results that underscore its utility and adaptability in point cloud video data interpretation. The code repo with trained checkpoints will be available at https://github.com/zhh6425/motionpde.git for facilitating future research.

中文摘要翻译: 理解时空相关性，即空间点如何随时间变化，对于理解点云视频至关重要。传统方法，特别是基于流的方法，由于序列点云数据的无序空间排列，难以处理这些相关性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖方法，通过将问题形式化为可求解的偏微分方程（PDE）来正则化时空相关性学习。尽管PDE在物理领域早已得到有效应用，但其在点云视频等新型序列数据上的应用仍有待探索。受流体分析启发，我们构建了一个简化的PDE，并通过时间嵌入与空间嵌入之间的对比学习结构来引导和优化PDE的求解过程。借助这一额外监督，我们的方法——命名为MotionPDE——作为一种有效的即插即用增强模块，可应用于现有骨干模型，且仅增加极小的计算开销和参数量。利用对比学习过程，我们进一步挖掘了MotionPDE的自监督学习能力，取得了令人鼓舞的结果，突显了其在点云视频数据解释中的实用性和适应性。包含训练好检查点的代码仓库将在https://github.com/zhh6425/motionpde.git公开，以促进未来研究。

</details>


### [175] [Exploiting Semantic and Pixel Representations for Ultra-Low Bitrate Image Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01608)
*Hao Wei,Yanhui Zhou,Chenyang Ge,Saeed Anwar,Ajmal Mian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SPRDiff是一种基于扩散模型的超低比特率图像压缩方法，通过三重编码器架构和失真感知重建模块，在低于0.03 bpp的极低码率下实现了率-失真-感知三者之间的最优平衡。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有极端压缩方法往往优先保证感知真实性和视觉逼真度而牺牲像素级精度，导致重建图像与原始图像存在明显偏差。超低比特率图像压缩不仅需要生成极度紧凑的表示，还需要确保重建图像在语义和像素层面上都忠实于源图像。

Method: 提出三重编码器架构，利用预训练的面向失真和面向语义的编码器提取的高保真特征来补偿冻结VAE编码器提取的有限表示，从而改进潜在压缩和熵建模。同时引入带双特征提取的失真感知重建模块，该模块不仅生成保留主要结构的粗略重建，还提供实用的语义级和像素级条件信号来引导扩散模型。

Result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，在极低码率（低于0.03 bpp）下，该方法在率-失真-感知权衡上优于现有最先进方法，有效保持了重建图像的感知质量和像素级保真度。

Conclusion: SPRDiff通过融合语义和像素双重表示，在超低比特率条件下显著提升了重建保真度，为极端压缩场景下的率-失真-感知权衡提供了有效解决方案。

Original Abstract: Most existing extreme compression methods fail to achieve an optimal rate-distortion-perception trade-off, as they typically prioritize perceptual fidelity and visual realism over pixel-level accuracy. Consequently, the resulting reconstructions often deviate noticeably from the originals. Ultra-low bitrate image compression is therefore crucial-not only for producing extremely compact representations but also for ensuring that reconstructed images remain semantically coherent and faithful to the source at the pixel level. To this end, we propose SPRDiff, a diffusion-based compression method that fully leverages both semantic and pixel representations, thereby enhancing reconstruction fidelity under ultra-low bitrate constraints. Specifically, we develop a triple-encoder architecture that utilizes high-fidelity features from the pretrained distortion-oriented and semantic-oriented encoders to compensate for the limited representations extracted by the frozen VAE encoder, thereby improving latent compression and entropy modeling. To further enhance the reconstruction fidelity of diffusion models, we introduce a distortion-aware reconstruction module with dual feature extraction. This module not only generates a coarse reconstruction that preserves the main structures, but also provides practical and accurate semantic- and pixel-level conditional signals to guide the diffusion model. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in the rate-distortion-perception tradeoff at extremely low bitrates (below 0.03 bpp), effectively preserving both perceptual quality and pixel-wise fidelity in the reconstructed images. We will release the source code and trained models at https://github.com/cshw2021/SPRDiff.

中文摘要翻译: 大多数现有的极端压缩方法未能实现最优的率-失真-感知权衡，因为它们通常优先考虑感知保真度和视觉真实感，而牺牲了像素级精度。因此，得到的重建结果往往与原始图像存在明显偏差。超低比特率图像压缩至关重要——不仅要生成极度紧凑的表示，还要确保重建图像在语义上保持一致并在像素级忠实于源图像。为此，我们提出SPRDiff，一种基于扩散的压缩方法，充分利用语义和像素双重表示，从而在超低比特率约束下增强重建保真度。具体而言，我们开发了一个三重编码器架构，利用预训练的面向失真和面向语义的编码器的高保真特征，来补偿冻结VAE编码器提取的有限表示，从而改进潜在压缩和熵建模。为了进一步增强扩散模型的重建保真度，我们引入了一个带有双特征提取的失真感知重建模块。该模块不仅生成保留主要结构的粗略重建，还提供实用且准确的语义级和像素级条件信号来引导扩散模型。在基准数据集上进行的大量实验表明，在极低码率（低于0.03 bpp）下，我们的方法在率-失真-感知权衡上优于现有最先进方法，有效保持了重建图像的感知质量和像素级保真度。我们将于https://github.com/cshw2021/SPRDiff 发布源代码和训练好的模型。

</details>


### [176] [Self-Improving Small Object Grounding in LVLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01612)
*Tianze Yang,Yucheng Shi,Ruitong Sun,Ninghao Liu,Jin Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文证明大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的内部注意力模式无需微调即可识别可靠的小目标边界框，并提出了基于注意力的候选选择框架（ACS），包括有学习组件的ACS-Learned和无训练的ACS-Free，在COCO和Objects365上实现了小目标定位最高19%的自我提升。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 探究LVLM内部注意力模式是否能够在不经微调的情况下，可靠地识别小目标边界框，从而提升目标定位的可靠性和可解释性。

Method: 提出基于注意力的候选选择框架（ACS），包含两种变体：(1) ACS-Learned：利用轻量级IoU回归器（仅基于注意力图训练，Pearson r > 0.67）从多个采样候选中选择最佳框；(2) ACS-Free：通过分析回归器学到的知识，识别最关键Transformer层和头，在这些判别性头上基于注意力熵对候选进行排序，推理阶段无任何学习组件。

Result: 在COCO和Objects365数据集上，小目标定位最多提升19%；ACS-Free在所有无训练方法中排名最佳；注意力图训练的IoU回归器达到强预测性能（Pearson r > 0.67）。

Conclusion: LVLM中有用的注意力结构能够提升目标定位的可靠性和可解释性，无需微调即可实现有效的小目标检测。

Original Abstract: Can internal attention patterns in Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) identify reliable small-object boxes without fine-tuning? In this work, we provide an affirmative answer. Attention structure in LVLMs encodes grounding quality-a lightweight IoU regressor trained solely on attention maps achieves strong IoU prediction (Pearson r > 0.67). This regressor powers the regressor-based variant of our Attention-based Candidate Selection (ACS) framework, called ACS-Learned, which selects the best box from multiple sampled candidates to improve object grounding. By analyzing what the regressor learns, we reveal which transformer layers and heads are most critical and derive ACS-Free: a training-free selector that ranks candidates by attention entropy on these discriminative heads, with no learned component at inference. Experiments on COCO and Objects365 demonstrate up to 19% self-improvement on small object localization, with ACS-Free ranking best among all training-free methods, demonstrating that useful attention structure improves both localization reliability and interpretability in LVLMs.

中文摘要翻译: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）中的内部注意力模式能否在不经微调的情况下识别可靠的小目标边界框？在这项工作中，我们给出了肯定的答案。LVLM中的注意力结构编码了定位质量——仅基于注意力图训练的轻量级IoU回归器即可实现强IoU预测（皮尔逊r > 0.67）。该回归器驱动了我们基于注意力的候选选择框架（ACS）的回归器变体，称为ACS-Learned，它从多个采样候选中选择最佳框以改进目标定位。通过分析回归器学到的知识，我们揭示了哪些Transformer层和头最为关键，并推导出ACS-Free：一种无训练的选择器，它在这些判别性头上基于注意力熵对候选进行排序，推理时无需任何学习组件。在COCO和Objects365上的实验表明，小目标定位最多提升19%，其中ACS-Free在所有无训练方法中排名最佳，这表明有用的注意力结构既提升了LVLM中定位的可靠性，也增强了其可解释性。

</details>


### [177] [Turing Patterns for Multimedia: Reaction-Diffusion Multi-Modal Fusion for Language-Guided Video Moment Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01615)
*Xiang Fang,Wanlong Fang,Wei Ji,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出反应-扩散多模态融合框架(RDMF)，将视频-语言对齐建模为图灵反应-扩散过程，通过Gray-Scott模型实现时间扩散与文本-视频非线性反应，用于时刻检索与高亮检测。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有视频-语言模型依赖静态交叉注意力或提示调优机制，无法自适应建模模态间动态演化的关系，导致对齐次优且泛化有限。

Method: 受系统生物学中图灵模式形成原理启发，将视频特征沿时间维度扩散以捕获时序上下文，文本-视频交互建模为非线性反应以放大相关特征并抑制噪声，基于Gray-Scott反应-扩散模型设计高效融合模块，并通过图灵不稳定性判据进行稳定性与收敛性数学分析。

Result: 初步实验表明RDMF在识别视频显著时刻方面具有超越现有方法的潜力。

Conclusion: RDMF是首个跨学科融合系统生物学与多媒体研究的工作，为视频-语言任务提供了新范式，理论上通过图灵不稳定性分析保证稳定模式形成，实践中可集成预训练编码器和DETR风格头部。

Original Abstract: Video-language models are pivotal for tasks such as moment retrieval and highlight detection, yet they often struggle to capture the dynamic, non-linear interactions between temporal video sequences and textual semantics. Existing approaches, relying on static cross-attention or prompt-tuning mechanisms, fail to adaptively model the evolving relationships between modalities, leading to suboptimal alignment and limited generalization. Inspired by systems biology, we propose \textbf{Reaction-Diffusion Multimodal Fusion (RDMF)}, a novel framework that reimagines video-language alignment as a reaction-diffusion (RD) process, drawing on the principles of pattern formation introduced by Alan Turing. In RDMF, video features diffuse across time to capture temporal context, while text-video interactions are modeled as non-linear reactions that amplify relevant features and suppress noise, forming emergent patterns akin to biological systems. Leveraging the Gray-Scott RD model, we design a computationally efficient fusion module that integrates video and text representations, supported by rigorous mathematical analysis of stability and convergence using Turing instability criteria. Our framework is theoretically grounded, employing advanced mathematical tools to ensure stable pattern formation, and is practically viable, incorporating standard components like pretrained encoders and DETR-style heads for moment retrieval and saliency prediction. RDMF represents a pioneering interdisciplinary approach, bridging systems biology and multimedia research to address the limitations of conventional multimodal fusion. Preliminary experiments demonstrate its potential to outperform existing methods in identifying salient video moments, offering a new paradigm for video-language tasks.

中文摘要翻译: 视频-语言模型对于时刻检索和高亮检测等任务至关重要，但它们往往难以捕捉时序视频序列与文本语义之间动态、非线性的交互。现有方法依赖静态交叉注意力或提示调优机制，无法自适应地建模模态间演化的关系，导致对齐次优且泛化能力有限。受系统生物学启发，我们提出\textbf{反应-扩散多模态融合（RDMF）}，这是一个新颖的框架，将视频-语言对齐重新构想为反应-扩散（RD）过程，借鉴了艾伦·图灵提出的模式形成原理。在RDMF中，视频特征沿时间维度扩散以捕获时序上下文，而文本-视频交互被建模为非线性反应，放大相关特征并抑制噪声，形成类似于生物系统的涌现模式。利用Gray-Scott RD模型，我们设计了一个计算高效的融合模块，集成视频和文本表示，并辅以基于图灵不稳定性判据的稳定性与收敛性的严格数学分析。我们的框架具有理论根基，使用先进数学工具确保稳定的模式形成，同时具备实践可行性，集成了预训练编码器和用于时刻检索与显著性预测的DETR风格头部等标准组件。RDMF代表了一种开创性的跨学科方法，桥接了系统生物学与多媒体研究，以解决传统多模态融合的局限性。初步实验表明，它在识别视频显著时刻方面具有超越现有方法的潜力，为视频-语言任务提供了新范式。

</details>


### [178] [Real-Time Generation of Streamable Talking Portrait Video with Reference-Guided Deep Compression VAEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01620)
*Sicheng Xu,Yu Deng,Shoukang Hu,Yichuan Wang,Yizhong Zhang,Zhan Chen,Jiaolong Yang,Baining Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种流式说话人脸视频生成框架，通过因果视频VAE和自回归潜在去噪模型实现实时高质量生成，速度显著快于基线模型。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型计算开销大，难以用于交互式应用（如实时说话人脸生成）。

Method: 1) 因果视频VAE（集成可变数量参考图像引导，增强压缩效率与重建质量；扩展残差自编码范式改善时空因果性处理）；2) 基于Rectified Flow Transformer的自回归逐块潜在去噪生成器。

Result: 实现实时高质量说话人脸视频生成，速度显著快于基线模型，在真实性、生动性和视频质量上与大型模型持平或更优。

Conclusion: 该框架有效降低了视频扩散模型的计算开销，实现了流式场景下的实时交互式说话人脸生成，且质量不逊于甚至超越大模型。

Original Abstract: Video diffusion models have significantly advanced portrait video generation, yet their high computational demands limit their use in interactive applications. This work presents a framework for streamable talking portrait video generation conditioned on speech audio and reference images. Designed meticulously for streaming scenarios, it features a causal video VAE for deep latent compression and an autoregressive latent denoising model. Our causal VAE integrates a variable number of reference images as guidance, allowing the network to focus on dynamic information rather than static appearance, thereby enhancing compression efficacy and reconstruction quality. Additionally, we extend the residual auto-encoding paradigm to improve spatial-temporal causality handling in our VAE. The generator is based on a Rectified Flow Transformer architecture and produces video latents in a blockwise auto-regressive manner. Our method enables the real-time generation of high-quality talking portrait videos, achieving speeds significantly faster than baseline models. Furthermore, comprehensive experiments demonstrate that it is on par with or even outperforms these large models in realism, vividness, and video quality.

中文摘要翻译: 视频扩散模型在肖像视频生成方面取得了显著进展，但其高昂的计算成本限制了在交互式应用中的使用。本文提出了一种面向流式场景的说话肖像视频生成框架，该框架以语音音频和参考图像为条件。我们专为流式场景精心设计了因果视频VAE用于深度潜在压缩，以及一个自回归潜在去噪模型。因果VAE集成了可变数量的参考图像作为引导，使网络能够聚焦于动态信息而非静态外观，从而提升压缩效率与重建质量。此外，我们扩展了残差自编码范式以改善VAE中时空因果性的处理。生成器基于Rectified Flow Transformer架构，以逐块自回归的方式生成视频潜在表示。该方法能够实时生成高质量的说话肖像视频，速度显著快于基线模型。全面的实验表明，在真实性、生动性和视频质量方面，该方法与大型模型持平甚至更优。

</details>


### [179] [Goal2Pixel: Grounding Goals to Pixels for Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01621)
*Muyi Bao,Yuxin Cai,Hang Xu,Zongtai Li,Jinxi He,Jingfan Tang,Chen Lv,Ji Zhang,Yaqi Xie,Wenshan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Goal2Pixel将视觉语言导航（VLN-CE）重新定义为可导航像素定位任务，通过图像平面作为统一空间接口，预测导航像素并反投影为3D航点，减少VLM调用次数，在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上实现竞争性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有基于VLM的VLN-CE方法将导航建模为低级动作预测，存在接口模糊、受限于短视运动基元、因重复查询VLM而导致效率低下等问题。

Method: Goal2Pixel提出纯像素范式：1) 将导航重构为可导航像素定位，在图像平面上预测像素点并反投影为3D航点进行前向导航；2) 在图像平面附加辅助指令区域（左/右/底部）对应左转、右转和停止；3) 提出可见性感知的关键帧记忆实现长程导航；4) 引入语义嵌入和坐标感知辅助损失微调预训练VLM。

Result: 在R2R-CE Val-Unseen上达到54.1% SR和52.5% SPL，每次仅需7.75次VLM调用，比直接动作预测（46.62次调用，32.9% SR）减少6倍；在RxR-CE上同样保持优势。

Conclusion: Goal2Pixel证明了以像素作为统一空间接口进行导航的有效性，大幅减少VLM调用次数同时保持竞争性能，为VLN-CE提供了高效的新范式。

Original Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a common foundation for vision-and-language navigation in continuous environments (VLN-CE). Yet most VLM-based methods cast navigation as low-level action prediction, an interface that is ambiguous, tied to short-horizon motion primitives, and inefficient due to repeated VLM querying. We propose Goal2Pixel, a pure pixel-based paradigm that reformulates VLN-CE as navigable pixel grounding. Rather than predicting actions, Goal2Pixel uses the image plane as a unified spatial interface between VLM reasoning and robot motion: the model predicts a visible navigable pixel to the agent, which is back-projected into a 3D waypoint for forward navigation. For non-forward actions, we append auxiliary directive regions to the image plane, where the left/right/bottom regions are interpreted as turning left, turning right, and stopping, respectively. To enable long-horizon navigation, we propose a visibility-aware keyframe memory for compact and informative history representation. To adapt pretrained VLMs to navigable pixel grounding, we introduce semantic embeddings and coordinate-aware auxiliary losses. Goal2Pixel achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance while requiring fewer VLM inference calls than prior methods. On R2R-CE Val-Unseen it achieves 54.1% SR and 52.5% SPL with just 7.75 VLM calls per episode, 6x fewer than the 46.62 required by direct action prediction at 32.9% SR. The same trend holds on RxR-CE.Project Page: https://baobao0926.github.io/Goal2Pixel/.

中文摘要翻译: 视觉语言模型（VLM）已成为连续环境下的视觉与语言导航（VLN-CE）的通用基础。然而，大多数基于VLM的方法将导航建模为低级动作预测，这种接口存在歧义性、受限于短视运动基元，并且由于重复的VLM查询而导致效率低下。我们提出Goal2Pixel，一种纯像素范式，将VLN-CE重新定义为可导航像素定位。Goal2Pixel不预测动作，而是将图像平面作为VLM推理与机器人运动之间的统一空间接口：模型预测一个对智能体可见的可导航像素，该像素被反投影为用于前向导航的3D航点。对于非前向动作，我们在图像平面上附加辅助指令区域，其中左/右/底部区域分别被解释为左转、右转和停止。为了实现长程导航，我们提出了一种可见性感知的关键帧记忆，用于紧凑且信息丰富的历史表示。为了将预训练的VLM适配到可导航像素定位，我们引入了语义嵌入和坐标感知辅助损失。Goal2Pixel在达到具有竞争力的最先进性能的同时，所需的VLM推理调用次数比先前方法更少。在R2R-CE Val-Unseen上，它实现了54.1%的成功率（SR）和52.5%的路径长度加权成功率（SPL），每次仅需7.75次VLM调用，比直接动作预测（46.62次调用，32.9% SR）减少了6倍。同样的趋势在RxR-CE上也有所体现。项目页面：https://baobao0926.github.io/Goal2Pixel/。

</details>


### [180] [What to Test Next: Interpretable Coverage Gap Discovery in Driving VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01624)
*Abhishek Aich,Sparsh Garg,Vijay Kumar BG,Turgun Yusuf Kashgari,Manmohan Chandraker*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SliceScorer，一种用于驾驶视觉语言模型（VLM）在操作设计域（ODD）中缺失切片推荐的确定性评分规则，并将其嵌入 SliceNav 流水线中，以 LLM 编排的方式实现高覆盖、可审计的验证工作流。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有驾驶 VLM 验证中，许多 ODD 条件切片缺失，导致经验故障率不可靠，亟需一种可解释、保守且能推荐高风险缺失切片的方法。

Method: 提出 SliceScorer 确定性评分规则，包含曝光度覆盖先验和邻居失败先验；再将其嵌入 SliceNav 流水线，由 LLM 根据开发者查询编排验证操作（分诊、评分、获取、评估），所有评分保持确定性和可审计性。

Result: 在 WiseAD、DriveMM、Cosmos-Reason2-2B 三个驾驶 VLM 上，SliceNav 比现有切片发现方法更有效地发现高风险覆盖缺口，并保持推荐多样性。消融实验验证了两个评分组件的贡献，定性分析展示了从查询到评估的端到端工作流。

Conclusion: SliceScorer 和 SliceNav 为驾驶 VLM 的安全关键验证提供了可解释、保守且高效的缺失切片推荐方案，有助于提升验证覆盖率与可靠性。
