### [209] [ChWDTA: Channel-wise Wavelet-Domain Transformer Attention and Entropy Modeling for Learned Image Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00111)
*Haisheng Fu,Runyu Yang,Feng Ding,Siyu Zhu,Jie Liang,Xiaoxiao Li,Zhenman Fang,Jingning Han*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出将通道级小波变换引入CNN-Transformer混合图像压缩架构，在Transformer注意力模块和熵编码阶段分别设计通道级小波域变换注意力（ChWDTA）和通道级小波包分解（ChWP），显著提升了率失真性能，在多个测试集上取得超过17%的BD-rate降低。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有最先进的学习图像压缩（LIC）方案多采用CNN-Transformer混合架构，为进一步提升率失真性能，探索将通道级小波变换引入Transformer和熵编码组件，旨在通过小波变换对通道协方差进行稀疏化，同时保持高效的空域窗口自注意力机制。

Method: 1) 提出通道级小波域Transformer注意力（ChWDTA）：在窗口化空间自注意力基础上，对Q/K/V投影在通道级小波变换后的特征上进行计算，再用逆变换映射回注意力输出，形成通道级小波域Transformer块（ChWDTB）。2) 提出通道级小波包分解（ChWP）：将每个通道子带分解为四个等大小子带，适配通道级切片自回归熵建模，每个通道子带分为两个切片时共使用8个切片进行熵编码。

Result: 在Kodak、CLIC Professional Validation和Tecnick测试集上分别取得-17.82%、-19.15%和-22.56%的BD-rate降低。即使将每个通道子带编码为单一切片（较低复杂度配置），仍能保留大部分编码增益。

Conclusion: 在CNN-Transformer混合LIC方案中引入小波变换能够有效提升率失真性能，通道级小波变换在注意力模块和熵编码两个阶段的结合使用均展现出显著优势。

Original Abstract: State-of-the-art learned image compression (LIC) schemes are increasingly based on hybrid CNN-transformer architectures. To further improve rate-distortion performance, we introduce channel-wise wavelet transforms into both the transformer and entropy-coding components. First, we propose a channel-wise wavelet-domain transformer attention (ChWDTA) mechanism. ChWDTA keeps the efficient windowed spatial self-attention used in modern LIC backbones, but computes the Q/K/V projections on channel-wise wavelet-transformed features before mapping the attention output back with the inverse transform. The resulting Channel-wise Wavelet-Domain Transformer Block (ChWDTB) therefore preserves the spatial tokenization pattern of windowed attention while sparsifying the channel covariance seen by the attention projections. Second, in the entropy-coding stage, we introduce a channel-wise wavelet packet (ChWP) decomposition that produces four equal-sized subbands, which better fit channel-wise slice-based autoregressive entropy modeling. When each channel-wise subband is divided into two slices, we use eight slices for entropy coding. With this configuration, the proposed scheme obtains BD-rate reductions of -17.82%, -19.15%, and -22.56% on the Kodak, CLIC Professional Validation, and Tecnick test sets, respectively. Even when each channel-wise subband is coded as a single slice, the scheme still retains most of the coding gains with lower complexity. The results confirm the advantage of introducing wavelet transform in CNN-transformer-based LIC schemes.

中文摘要翻译: 最先进的学习图像压缩（LIC）方案日益基于混合CNN-Transformer架构。为进一步提升率失真性能，我们将通道级小波变换引入Transformer和熵编码两个组件。首先，我们提出一种通道级小波域Transformer注意力（ChWDTA）机制。ChWDTA保留了现代LIC骨干网络中高效的空域窗口自注意力，但在通道级小波变换后的特征上计算Q/K/V投影，再通过逆变换将注意力输出映射回来。由此得到的通道级小波域Transformer块（ChWDTB）在保持窗口注意力的空间标记化模式的同时，对注意力投影所见的通道协方差进行了稀疏化。其次，在熵编码阶段，我们引入一种通道级小波包（ChWP）分解，产生四个等大小的子带，更好地适配基于通道级切片的自回归熵建模。当每个通道子带被划分为两个切片时，我们共使用八个切片进行熵编码。采用该配置，所提方案在Kodak、CLIC Professional Validation和Tecnick测试集上分别取得了-17.82%、-19.15%和-22.56%的BD-rate降低。即使将每个通道子带编码为单个切片，该方案仍能以较低复杂度保留大部分编码增益。实验结果证实了在基于CNN-Transformer的LIC方案中引入小波变换的优势。

</details>


### [210] [Mathematical framework for perception-driven parameter choice in image denoising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00122)
*Saara Isoranta,Emilia L. K. Blåsten,Lílian Ferreira de Freitas,Jukka Häkkinen,Markus Juvonen,Samuli Siltanen*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文从感知驱动角度研究图像去噪，通过结合数学与心理学方法构建感知相似度度量框架，利用心理物理学缩放获得HaarPSI阈值来离散化参数网格，最终生成可用于感知驱动成像实验的心理测量标定图像集。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有图像去噪方法通常基于客观指标优化，但未必符合人类视觉感知。本文旨在从感知驱动视角出发，探索如何选择最适合人类视觉感知的去噪参数。

Method: 以同一基图为输入，通过调整全变分去噪算法的参数值构造不同去噪程度的样本图像集；招募人类参与者进行对比测试以调查图像间的感知差异；利用心理物理学缩放方法分析结果，得到HaarPSI值作为离散化参数网格的阈值。

Result: 获得了经过心理测量标定的、公开可用的图像集，以及一套可用于后续涉及对比测试的感知驱动成像实验框架。

Conclusion: 本文提出的感知驱动框架能够有效地将人类视觉感知纳入图像去噪参数选择过程，所得到的标定图像集和实验框架为后续感知驱动成像研究提供了基础工具。

Original Abstract: We approach image denoising from a perception-driven perspective: how can we select the parameters that are best suited for human visual perception? We combine research methods in mathematics and psychology to develop a mathematical framework for measuring perceived similarity. We construct a sample set of differently denoised photographs by using the same base image as input data and by tuning the parameter value in a total variation denoising algorithm. A comparison test is conducted with human participants to survey perceived differences between the images. Analyzing the results with psychometric scaling provides us with a HaarPSI value to use as a threshold in discretizing parameter grids. As a result, we obtain psychometrically scaled, openly available image sets that are ready to use in further experiments in perception-driven imaging, as well as a framework for ensuing experiments involving comparison tests.

中文摘要翻译: 我们从感知驱动的角度处理图像去噪问题：如何选择最适合人类视觉感知的参数？我们结合数学和心理学的研究方法，构建了一个用于测量感知相似度的数学框架。我们以同一基图为输入数据，通过调整全变分去噪算法中的参数值，构造了一组不同去噪程度的照片样本集。我们招募人类参与者进行对比测试，以调查图像之间的感知差异。通过心理物理学缩放方法分析结果，我们得到HaarPSI值，用作离散化参数网格的阈值。最终，我们获得了经过心理测量标定的、公开可用的图像集，可直接用于后续的感知驱动成像实验，同时还建立了一套可用于涉及对比测试的实验框架。

</details>


### [211] [Bounding Global and Local Compression Error of Signal Parameterizations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00126)
*Quang Luong Nhat Nguyen,Sara Fridovich-Keil*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出一种无需真实信号即可对可微分信号参数化（如隐式神经表示）的压缩重建误差进行非渐近、信号特异性界定的理论框架，并在多种模型和任务中验证了其有效性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 在计算成像中，隐式神经表示等可微分信号参数化方法日益重要，但在真实信号未知时，缺乏既理论可靠又高效可计算的工具来评估有限模型尺寸下的重建保真度。

Method: 证明当参数化压缩满足某些自然属性时，任意压缩级别的压缩误差可由不同压缩级别下模型预测之间简单的缩放差值来界定。该理论框架为非渐近、信号特异性、无需真实信号的误差上界提供保证，并适用于插值网格、傅里叶特征网络、多分辨率哈希编码和张量分解等模型族。

Result: 在合成/自然信号直接拟合、辐射场重建和MRI重建等逆问题中，该方法能紧密跟踪全局误差曲线，并生成信息丰富的局部误差热图，且无需访问真实信号。

Conclusion: 提出了一种无需真实信号即可预测压缩信号参数化重建误差的理论框架，实验证明其理论界紧致且可泛化，为计算成像中的保真度评估提供了实用工具。

Original Abstract: Differentiable signal parameterizations such as implicit neural representations (INRs) and hybrid models are increasingly central to computational imaging, yet principled tools for evaluating reconstruction fidelity at finite model size remain limited when ground truth is unavailable. We introduce a framework for predicting the reconstruction error of compressive signal parameterizations, yielding non-asymptotic, signal-specific bounds that are both theoretically sound and efficiently computable without access to the ground truth signal. Specifically, we prove that when parameterization-based compression satisfies certain natural properties, the compression error at any compression level is bounded by a simple scaled difference between model predictions at different compression levels. We verify these properties for representative model families including interpolated grids, Fourier feature networks, multi-resolution hash encodings, and tensor factorizations, and show empirically that the resulting worst-case guarantees can be efficiently adapted into signal-specific error predictors that are tight and generalizable. Across direct fitting of synthetic and natural signals, and inverse problems including radiance field and MRI reconstruction, our method closely tracks global error curves and yields informative local error heatmaps without ground-truth access. Code is available at https://github.com/voilalab/global_error_bound.

中文摘要翻译: 可微分信号参数化（如隐式神经表示和混合模型）在计算成像中日益核心，但在真实信号未知时，评估有限模型尺寸下重建保真度的原则性工具仍然有限。我们提出一个预测压缩信号参数化重建误差的框架，生成非渐近的、信号特定的界，该界既在理论上合理，又无需访问真实信号即可高效计算。具体而言，我们证明当基于参数化的压缩满足某些自然属性时，任意压缩级别的压缩误差可由不同压缩级别下模型预测之间简单的缩放差值所界定。我们验证了这些属性在代表性模型族（包括插值网格、傅里叶特征网络、多分辨率哈希编码和张量分解）中的成立性，并实验表明，由此产生的最坏情况保证可高效地适配为紧致且可泛化的信号特定误差预测器。在合成与自然信号的直接拟合，以及辐射场重建与MRI重建等逆问题中，我们的方法无需真实信号即可紧密跟踪全局误差曲线，并生成信息丰富的局部误差热图。代码已开源：https://github.com/voilalab/global_error_bound。

</details>


### [212] [Multi-Contrast MRI Motion Correction via Parameter-Informed Disentanglement and Adaptive Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00146)
*Honglin Xiong,Yuxian Tang,Feng Li,Yulin Wang,Lei Xiang,Dinggang Shen,Qian Wang*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出一种结合参数引导的对比度解混与严重度感知自适应校正的统一框架（ScanCLIP），用于去除MRI运动伪影，在多种对比度和伪影严重度下均优于现有方法，并具备零样本泛化能力。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有基于深度学习的MRI运动伪影去除方法通常针对特定对比度设计，无法泛化到不同成像模态和伪影严重度，缺乏统一有效的解决方案。

Method: (1) 基于ScanCLIP（在3万+ MRI文本-图像对上预训练）从采集参数中提取对比度嵌入，将对比度风格与解剖内容解耦，得到对比度无关特征；(2) 使用Vision Transformer估计运动严重度，并通过Mixture-of-Experts网络进行自适应伪影校正；(3) 双路径解码器同时重建干净图像和残差伪影图，施加图像空间一致性约束。

Result: 在IXI和HCP基准上，PSNR提升0.75 dB，SSIM最高提升0.0279；在高伪影严重度下增益更大。在真实临床数据上展现出鲁棒的零样本泛化能力，而现有方法要么无法去除伪影，要么引入额外失真。

Conclusion: 所提统一框架有效解决了MRI运动伪影校正中跨对比度和跨严重度的泛化难题，在基准和真实临床数据上均表现优越，具有较强的实用价值。

Original Abstract: Motion artifacts in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) degrade diagnostic reliability. Existing deep learning methods are typically contrast-specific and fail to generalize across diverse modalities and artifact severities. We propose a unified framework combining parameter-informed contrast disentanglement with severity-aware adaptive correction. ScanCLIP, pretrained on over 30,000 MRI text-image pairs, derives contrast embeddings from acquisition parameters to disentangle contrast style from anatomical content, yielding contrast-free features. A Vision Transformer then estimates motion severity and routes features through a Mixture-of-Experts network, enabling targeted artifact correction. A dual-pathway decoder reconstructs both the clean image and residual artifact map, enforcing image-space consistency. On IXI and HCP benchmarks, our method improves PSNR by 0.75 dB and SSIM by up to 0.0279 over state-of-the-art approaches, with larger gains at higher artifact severities. It further demonstrates robust zero-shot generalization on real-world clinical data acquired with unseen scanning parameters, where existing methods either fail to remove artifacts or introduce additional distortions.

中文摘要翻译: 磁共振成像（MRI）中的运动伪影会降低诊断可靠性。现有的深度学习方法通常针对特定对比度设计，无法泛化到不同成像模态和伪影严重度。我们提出一个统一框架，将参数引导的对比度解混与严重度感知的自适应校正相结合。ScanCLIP在超过30,000对MRI文本-图像对上预训练，从采集参数中提取对比度嵌入，将对比度风格与解剖内容解耦，得到对比度无关的特征。随后，Vision Transformer估计运动严重度，并将特征路由至Mixture-of-Experts网络，实现针对性的伪影校正。双路径解码器同时重建清晰图像和残差伪影图，强制图像空间一致性。在IXI和HCP基准上，我们的方法相比现有最先进方法PSNR提升0.75 dB，SSIM最高提升0.0279，在高伪影严重度下增益更大。该方法在使用未见扫描参数采集的真实临床数据上展现出鲁棒的零样本泛化能力，而现有方法要么无法去除伪影，要么引入额外的失真。

</details>


### [213] [A physics-informed foundation model for quantitative diffusion MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00156)
*Zihan Li,Jialan Zheng,Ziyu Li,Xun Yuan,Kasidit Anmahapong,Ziang Wang,Mingxuan Liu,Hongjia Yang,Yifei Chen,Zhuhao Wang,Yuhang He,Fang Chen,Rui Li,Huaiqiang Sun,Yi Liao,Congyu Liao,Yang Yang,Haibo Qu,Xue Zhang,Hongen Liao,Qiyuan Tian*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出了PIGMENT，一个物理信息引导的生成式微结构网络，通过零样本自适应实现跨平台、跨场强的定量弥散MRI微结构映射，在超稀疏采样、低成本低场系统和超快速临床协议下均能生成可靠且具有生物学有效性的定量图谱。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 弥散MRI是唯一能在体无创获取全脑微结构的成像技术，但可靠的定量映射目前仍局限于需要密集采样和优化采集协议的专业研究环境，难以在临床常规或异质性数据上推广。

Method: PIGMENT是一种物理信息引导的生成式微结构网络，先在多站点、多厂商、多场强的11375次扫描数据上学习人脑微结构的通用生成先验，再通过零样本方式自适应到每个被试的实测数据，恢复出个体特异性的定量图谱。

Result: 在五个独立中心的外部数据集上，PIGMENT实现了张量、峰度和NODDI模型的可靠定量映射；在极稀疏采集下仍能恢复有意义的图谱并支持下游纤维追踪和结构连接映射；保留亚毫米级皮层微观结构模式和10倍加速扫描下的儿童早期白质发育轨迹；在低成本低场系统和超快速临床协议下分别实现了可靠定量张量映射和肿瘤相关生物标志物提取。

Conclusion: PIGMENT作为一个物理信息引导的基础模型，将定量弥散MRI的应用扩展到传统上因过于稀疏、异质或临床受限而无法进行可靠分析的场景中。

Original Abstract: Understanding the human brain requires access to its microscopic tissue architecture. Diffusion magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) provides the only noninvasive window into whole-brain microstructure in vivo, yet reliable quantitative mapping remains confined to specialized research settings requiring dense sampling and optimized acquisition protocols. To address this gap, we present a physics-informed generative microstructure network (PIGMENT) that learns a universal generative prior of human brain microstructure and adapts it zero-shot to each participant's measured data to recover subject-specific maps. Trained on 11375 scans spanning multiple sites, vendors, and field strengths, PIGMENT enabled reliable quantitative mapping for tensor, kurtosis, and NODDI models across external datasets from five independent centers. It remains effective where conventional fitting becomes unreliable, recovering meaningful maps from extremely sparse acquisitions while supporting downstream tractography and structural connectivity mapping. PIGMENT estimates demonstrated strong biological validity, preserving submillimeter cortical microarchitectural patterns and early-childhood white matter developmental trajectories from 10-fold accelerated scans. Furthermore, PIGMENT enables reliable quantitative tensor mapping on cost-efficient low-field systems and the extraction of tumor-related biomarkers using ultra-fast clinical protocols. Together, these results establish PIGMENT as a physics-informed foundation model that extends quantitative diffusion MRI into regimes traditionally too sparse, heterogeneous, or clinically constrained for reliable analysis.

中文摘要翻译: 理解人脑需要获取其微观组织结构。弥散磁共振成像（MRI）是唯一能在体无创观察全脑微结构的手段，然而可靠的定量映射目前仍局限于需要密集采样和优化采集协议的专业研究环境。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一种物理信息引导的生成式微结构网络（PIGMENT），它学习人脑微结构的通用生成先验，并通过零样本方式自适应到每个被试的实测数据，从而恢复个体特异性图谱。该网络在涵盖多站点、多厂商和多场强的11375次扫描数据上训练后，能够在来自五个独立中心的外部数据集上实现张量、峰度以及NODDI模型的可靠定量映射。在传统拟合方法不可靠的场景下，PIGMENT依然有效，能从极稀疏的采集中恢复有意义的图谱，同时支持下游的纤维追踪和结构连接映射。PIGMENT估计结果展现出强大的生物学有效性，在10倍加速扫描下仍能保留亚毫米级皮层微结构模式以及儿童早期白质发育轨迹。此外，PIGMENT能够在成本高效的低场强系统上实现可靠的定量张量映射，并利用超快速临床协议提取肿瘤相关生物标志物。这些结果共同确立了PIGMENT作为一个物理信息引导的基础模型的地位，将定量弥散MRI扩展到了传统上因过于稀疏、异质或临床受限而无法进行可靠分析的领域。

</details>


### [214] [Training-Free Continuous Bitrate Control for Scalable Image Coding for Humans and Machines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00158)
*Yui Tatsumi,Hiroshi Watanabe*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需训练的可变码率可扩展图像编码框架，通过调整量化步长实现连续码率控制，同时保持机器层和增强层中的高层语义信息。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 实际应用中对连续可变码率压缩有强烈需求，但在面向人类和机器的可扩展图像编码领域，该方向尚未被充分探索。

Method: 基于预测的尺度值调整量化步长，在无需额外训练的情况下实现连续码率控制，并在机器层和增强层中保留高层语义信息。

Result: 实验结果表明该方法有效，并揭示了两层之间码率分配的重要性。

Conclusion: 所提出的训练无关的可变码率框架能够有效实现可扩展图像编码，且码率分配策略对性能有重要影响。

Original Abstract: Continuous variable-rate compression is highly demanded in real-world applications, but remains underexplored in scalable image coding for humans and machines. In this paper, we propose a training-free variable-rate scalable image coding framework. By adjusting quantization steps based on predicted scale values, the proposed method achieves continuous bitrate control while preserving high-scale information in the machine and enhancement layers. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method and highlight the importance of bitrate allocation between the two layers.

中文摘要翻译: 连续可变码率压缩在实际应用中需求巨大，但在面向人类和机器的可扩展图像编码领域中仍未被充分探索。本文提出了一种无需训练的可变码率可扩展图像编码框架。通过基于预测的尺度值调整量化步长，所提方法在机器层和增强层中保持高层信息的同时，实现了连续的码率控制。实验结果证明了该方法的有效性，并突显了两层之间码率分配的重要性。

</details>


### [215] [AutoIQ: An Ensemble Framework for Automatic Assessment of Geometric Distortion in Prostate Diffusion-Weighted Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00393)
*Haoran Sun,Lixia Wang,Yin-Chen Hsu,Hsu-Lei Lee,Chang Gao,Fei Han,Robert Grimm,Vibhas Deshpande,Ziyang Long,Hsin-Jung Yang,Rola Saouaf,Alessandro D'Agnolo,Timothy Daskivich,Hyung Kim,Debiao Li,Yibin Xie*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出AutoIQ，一种集成机器学习框架，用于自动量化和分类前列腺DWI的几何失真严重程度，在测试集上达到0.95准确率和0.98 AUC，可帮助识别需要重扫的病例。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 前列腺弥散加权成像中的几何失真会损害病灶定位并降低MRI临床评估的可靠性，现有方法缺乏自动化的定量质量评估手段。

Method: AutoIQ结合两种互补的失真量化策略：基于分割的方法测量T2WI与DWI之间前列腺边界不匹配度，以及基于配准的方法估计DWI到T2WI对齐后的形变幅度。将生成的失真分数用于训练个体分类器和逻辑回归集成模型。

Result: 两种计算方法均能显著区分严重失真与可接受失真（p < 0.001）。在独立测试集上，集成模型达到0.95准确率、0.93 F1分数和0.98 AUC，优于单一模型。

Conclusion: AutoIQ能够为前列腺DWI提供自动化的定量质量评估，有助于识别需要重扫的扫描图像。

Original Abstract: Geometric distortion in prostate diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) can impair lesion localization and reduce the reliability of MRI-based clinical assessment. We propose AutoIQ, an ensemble machine learning framework for automatic quantification and classification of DWI geometric distortion severity. A total of 140 retrospective prostate biparametric MRI examinations were analyzed, including 33 scans with severe distortion requiring repeat acquisition and 107 scans with acceptable distortion based on expert radiologist assessment. AutoIQ combines two complementary distortion quantification strategies: a segmentation-based method measuring prostate boundary mismatch between T2-weighted imaging (T2WI) and DWI, and a registration-based method estimating deformation magnitude after DWI-to-T2WI alignment. The resulting distortion scores were used to train individual classifiers and a logistic-regression ensemble model. Both computational methods significantly differentiated severe from acceptable distortion cases (p < 0.001). On an independent test set, the ensemble model achieved an accuracy of 0.95, F1-score of 0.93, and AUC of 0.98, outperforming individual models. These results suggest that AutoIQ can provide automated, quantitative quality assessment for prostate DWI and may help identify scans that require repeat acquisition.

中文摘要翻译: 前列腺弥散加权成像中的几何失真会损害病灶定位并降低基于MRI的临床评估的可靠性。我们提出AutoIQ，一种集成机器学习框架，用于自动量化和分类DWI几何失真严重程度。共分析了140例回顾性前列腺双参数MRI检查，其中33例存在严重失真需要重扫，107例根据放射科专家评估具有可接受的失真。AutoIQ结合两种互补的失真量化策略：基于分割的方法测量T2加权成像与DWI之间前列腺边界不匹配度，以及基于配准的方法估计DWI到T2WI对齐后的形变幅度。生成的失真分数用于训练个体分类器和逻辑回归集成模型。两种计算方法均能显著区分严重失真与可接受失真病例（p < 0.001）。在独立测试集上，集成模型达到0.95的准确率、0.93的F1分数和0.98的AUC，优于个体模型。这些结果表明，AutoIQ能够为前列腺DWI提供自动化的定量质量评估，并可能有助于识别需要重扫的扫描图像。

</details>


### [216] [RFDT-Channel: RGB-LiDAR-Based RF Digital Twin Scene Construction for 28 GHz Indoor Ray-Tracing Channel Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01261)
*Chengyang Yao,Cunhua Pan,Jiaming Zeng,Yuquan Sun,Haoyang Weng,Haojian Wang,Hong Ren,Jiangzhou Wang*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出RFDT-Channel，一种基于RGB图像和LiDAR点云的射频数字孪生场景构建工作流，用于28 GHz室内毫米波射线追踪仿真，通过语义材料绑定显著减少有效路径数量并保持主路径幅度不变。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 解决室内毫米波仿真中手动场景建模效率低、视觉重建网格射频适应性差、以及28 GHz射线追踪仿真缺乏材料绑定的问题。

Method: 使用Jetson Orin平台采集室内视频和LiDAR点云；通过COLMAP、3D Gaussian Splatting和SuGaR生成初始三角网格；在Blender中利用LiDAR点云进行面向射频的几何正则化（对齐、墙面固化、门窗开口构建、拓扑修复）；使用OpenScene进行语义分割将室内结构映射为混凝土、玻璃、木材和金属材料；最后用Sionna RT执行28 GHz射线追踪仿真。

Result: 在固定收发部署下，生成的CIR、CFR和Radio Map结果表明：材料绑定主要改变弱反射、透射和散射路径，有效路径数从约742条减少至约52条，而主路径幅度几乎不变。

Conclusion: 材料绑定对室内毫米波信道仿真至关重要，能够大幅过滤无效传播路径而不影响主路径，从而提升仿真的物理真实性和计算效率。

Original Abstract: Real-scene indoor millimeter-wave simulation requires efficient modeling of radio frequency (RF)-computable geometry and electromagnetic material properties. To address the low efficiency of manual scene modeling, the limited RF adaptability of visually reconstructed meshes, and the lack of material binding in 28 GHz ray-tracing simulation, RFDT-Channel is developed as an RF digital twin scene construction workflow based on red-green-blue (RGB) images and light detection and ranging (LiDAR) point clouds. Indoor videos and point clouds are collected by a Jetson Orin platform with LiDAR and GMSL cameras. An initial triangular mesh is generated through COLMAP, 3D Gaussian Splatting, and SuGaR. The LiDAR point cloud then provides geometric and scale references for RF-oriented regularization in Blender, including alignment, wall solidification, door/window opening construction, and topology repair. OpenScene semantic segmentation maps major indoor structures to concrete, glass, wood, and metal materials, and Sionna RT performs 28 GHz ray tracing. Under a fixed transmitter-receiver deployment, the generated channel impulse response (CIR), channel frequency response (CFR), and Radio Map results show that material binding mainly changes weak reflection, transmission, and scattering paths, reducing the number of effective paths from about 742 to about 52 while keeping the dominant path amplitude nearly unchanged.

中文摘要翻译: 真实场景室内毫米波仿真需要高效建模射频可计算的几何与电磁材料属性。为解决手动场景建模效率低、视觉重建网格的射频适应性差以及28 GHz射线追踪仿真缺乏材料绑定等问题，RFDT-Channel被提出作为一种基于RGB图像和LiDAR点云的射频数字孪生场景构建工作流。室内视频和点云由搭载LiDAR和GMSL摄像头的Jetson Orin平台采集。通过COLMAP、3D Gaussian Splatting和SuGaR生成初始三角网格。LiDAR点云随后为Blender中的射频导向正则化提供几何与尺度参考，包括对齐、墙面固化、门窗开口构建和拓扑修复。OpenScene语义分割将主要室内结构映射为混凝土、玻璃、木材和金属材料，Sionna RT执行28 GHz射线追踪。在固定收发部署下，生成的信道冲激响应（CIR）、信道频率响应（CFR）和Radio Map结果表明：材料绑定主要改变弱反射、透射和散射路径，有效路径数从约742条减少至约52条，而主路径幅度几乎不变。

</details>


### [217] [ResNet-34 with Lightweight Decoder for Accurate and Efficient Segmentation of Fetal Brain MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01293)
*Ashiqur Rahman,Muhammad E. H. Chowdhury,Md. Abu Sayed,Md. Sharjis Ibne Wadud,Abu Naser Md. Arafat,Mehedi Hasan Prince*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出了一种结合ResNet-34编码器和轻量级MLP解码器的深度学习模型，用于胎儿脑组织MRI分割，在FeTA 2021数据集上达到97.37%准确率和90.33% DSC，并具有实时临床部署潜力。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 胎儿脑MRI分割因胎儿运动、低组织对比度和妊娠期解剖变异性而极具挑战性，现有方法在分割白质、灰质、侧脑室、深部灰质、脑外脑脊液、小脑和脑干等复杂结构时效果不佳。

Method: 提出一种结合ResNet-34编码器与基于多层感知机（MLP）模块的轻量级解码器的深度学习模型。解码器采用MLP模块进行自适应特征精炼以保留解剖边界，使用双线性上采样替代转置卷积以减少参数量，整体设计兼顾计算效率与分割精度。

Result: 在FeTA 2021数据集上经过5折交叉验证，模型平均准确率97.37%，平均DSC 90.33%，平均IoU 86.93%，精确率90.83%，优于UNet、UNet++、DeepLabV3和DeepLabV3+等基线模型，且推理速度快、计算负载低。

Conclusion: 所提出的模型在胎儿脑组织分割任务中实现了性能与效率的平衡，其快速推理和低计算开销使其适合集成到实时临床工作流中。

Original Abstract: Accurate segmentation of fetal brain tissues in Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is critical for early diagnosis of congenital abnormalities and improving prenatal care. However, the task remains difficult because of fetal motion, low tissue contrast, and major anatomical variability throughout gestational ages, particularly in segmenting complex structures such as white matter, gray matter, lateral ventricles, deep gray matter, extra-cerebrospinal fluid, cerebellum, and brainstem. As a solution to these difficulties, this research introduces a novel deep learning model that combines a ResNet-34 encoder with a lightweight decoder leveraging multi-layer perceptron (MLP) modules for adaptive feature refinement. This design specifically enhances the model's ability to preserve anatomical boundaries and mitigate segmentation errors caused by motion artifacts and intensity inhomogeneities. Computational efficiency is achieved by reducing parameter count, employing bilinear upsampling instead of transposed convolutions, and optimizing the decoder for speed without sacrificing accuracy. Trained and validated on the FeTA 2021 dataset using 5-fold cross-validation, the proposed model outperforms baseline architectures such as UNet, UNet++, DeepLabV3, and DeepLabV3+, achieving an average Accuracy of 97.37% with a mean Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 90.33%, mean Intersection over Union (IoU) of 86.93%, and Precision of 90.83%. Additionally, its fast inference time and reduced computational load make it well-suited for integration into real-time clinical workflows.

中文摘要翻译: 胎儿脑组织的磁共振成像（MRI）精确分割对于先天性异常的早期诊断和改善产前护理至关重要。然而，由于胎儿运动、低组织对比度以及妊娠期显著的解剖变异性，该任务仍然困难重重，尤其是在分割白质、灰质、侧脑室、深部灰质、脑外脑脊液、小脑和脑干等复杂结构时。针对这些难题，本研究提出了一种新颖的深度学习模型，该模型将ResNet-34编码器与结合多层感知机（MLP）模块的轻量级解码器相结合，以实现自适应特征精炼。该设计特别增强了模型保留解剖边界的能力，并减少了由运动伪影和强度不均匀性引起的分割误差。通过减少参数量、采用双线性上采样替代转置卷积以及优化解码器速度而不牺牲精度，实现了计算效率的提升。该模型在FeTA 2021数据集上经过5折交叉验证训练和验证，其性能优于UNet、UNet++、DeepLabV3和DeepLabV3+等基线架构，平均准确率达97.37%，平均Dice相似系数（DSC）为90.33%，平均交并比（IoU）为86.93%，精确率为90.83%。此外，其快速的推理时间和降低的计算负载使其非常适合集成到实时临床工作流程中。

</details>


### [218] [PINNOCHIO: Physics-Informed Neural Network for Coupled Hyperelastic Interface-Volume Simulation in Orthognathic Surgery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01572)
*Jungwook Lee,Daeseung Kim,Kevin Gu,Zhangfeng Hu,Tianshu Kuang,Finn Hopeman,Michael A. K. Liebschner,Jaime Gateno,Pingkun Yan*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: PINNOCHIO 是一个基于物理信息的神经网络框架，通过混合序列分解解耦骨骼-软组织界面运动与体积超弹性变形，实现了快速、准确且物理一致的面部软组织变形预测，适用于交互式正颌手术规划。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有面部软组织变形预测方法面临精度与效率的严格权衡：高保真有限元方法计算成本过高，纯深度学习模型结果缺乏生物力学一致性，而物理信息神经网络在仅有部分临床监督（外表面）下学习骨骼-软组织复杂异质力学不稳定。因此需要一种兼具精度、效率与物理一致性的方法。

Method: 提出混合序列分解方法，显式解耦不连续的骨骼-软组织界面运动与连续的体积超弹性变形；采用物理启发的仿真到现实（sim-to-real）自适应策略，无需体积真值即可保证内部生物力学一致性。

Result: 在40名患者的临床数据集上，PINNOCHIO 在表面精度和物理有效性方面均优于现有基线方法，同时相比有限元方法实现了显著加速，成功解决了精度-效率权衡问题。

Conclusion: PINNOCHIO 为交互式手术规划提供了一个高度可靠且实用的工具，兼顾了高精度、物理一致性和计算效率。

Original Abstract: Predicting patient-specific facial soft-tissue deformation is critical for iterative orthognathic surgery planning. However, current computational methods face a strict accuracy-efficiency trade-off: high-fidelity Finite Element Methods (FEM) are computationally prohibitive, whereas pure deep learning models often produce biomechanically inconsistent results. While Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) offer a promising avenue, learning the complex heterogeneous mechanics of bone--soft-tissue interactions with only partial clinical supervision (i.e., outer facial surfaces) remains highly unstable. To overcome these challenges, we present PINNOCHIO, a novel physics-informed framework for facial soft-tissue simulation. PINNOCHIO introduces a hybrid sequential decomposition that explicitly decouples discontinuous bone--soft-tissue interface movements from continuous volumetric hyperelastic deformation. This structural separation enables stable training and facilitates a physics-enabled sim-to-real adaptation strategy, ensuring internal biomechanical consistency without requiring volumetric ground truth. Evaluated on a 40-patient clinical cohort, PINNOCHIO outperforms existing baselines in both surface accuracy and physical validity. Furthermore, it achieves a substantial speedup over FEM, successfully resolving the accuracy-efficiency trade-off to provide a highly reliable and practical tool for interactive surgical planning.

中文摘要翻译: 预测患者特定的面部软组织变形对于迭代式正颌手术规划至关重要。然而，当前计算方法面临着严格的精度-效率权衡：高保真有限元方法计算成本过高，而纯深度学习模型往往产生生物力学不一致的结果。尽管物理信息神经网络（PINNs）提供了一种有前景的途径，但在仅依赖部分临床监督（即外表面）的情况下学习骨骼-软组织相互作用的复杂异质力学仍然极不稳定。为克服这些挑战，我们提出了 PINNOCHIO，一种用于面部软组织仿真的新型物理信息框架。PINNOCHIO 引入了一种混合序列分解方法，将不连续的骨骼-软组织界面运动与连续的体积超弹性变形显式解耦。这种结构分离使得训练稳定，并促进了基于物理的仿真到现实（sim-to-real）自适应策略，确保在没有体积真值的情况下实现内部生物力学一致性。在包含40名患者的临床队列评估中，PINNOCHIO 在表面精度和物理有效性方面均优于现有基线方法。此外，相比于有限元方法，它实现了显著的加速，成功解决了精度-效率权衡问题，为交互式手术规划提供了一个高度可靠且实用的工具。

</details>


### [219] [Regularized joint reconstruction and slab combination for accelerated three-dimensional multi-slab diffusion-weighted imaging using multi-scale energy models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01606)
*Reza Ghorbani,Jyothi Rikhab Chand,Chu-Yu Lee,Mathews Jacob,Merry Mani*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出EPEN，一种基于能量编码的联合重建框架，用于从欠采样3D多板k空间数据中重建高分辨率弥散加权MRI，有效抑制板边界伪影并保留精细解剖细节。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 高分辨率弥散加权MRI中，多板采集方式会产生板边界伪影，传统校正方法效果有限，亟需一种既能抑制伪影又能保留精细解剖结构的联合重建方法。

Method: EPEN采用双线性前向模型将弥散加权图像体积和板激发轮廓均视为未知变量，构建最大后验优化目标，包含高斯数据保真项、基于CNN的深度能量先验（表示干净图像的负对数分布）和二次正则化项。通过交替最小化求解，图像体积更新采用主化-最小化方案和共轭梯度优化，板轮廓更新采用正则化最小二乘。

Result: 在多种加速因子和板配置下，EPEN相比传统板边界校正方法显著减少了板边界伪影，同时提高了结构一致性并保持了弥散加权对比度。

Conclusion: EPEN在统一的基于深度能量图像先验的优化框架内，实现了鲁棒的联合3D多板弥散MRI重建和板轮廓校正。

Original Abstract: This work presents Energy-based Profile Encoding, EPEN, a joint reconstruction framework for high-resolution diffusion-weighted MRI from undersampled 3D multi-slab k-space acquisitions, designed to suppress slab-boundary artifacts while preserving fine anatomical detail. EPEN formulates the multi-slab acquisition process using a bilinear forward model in which both the diffusion-weighted image volume and slab excitation profiles are treated as unknown variables. Reconstruction is posed as a maximum a posteriori optimization problem with three components: a Gaussian data-fidelity term enforcing consistency with the acquired k-space measurements, a CNN-based deep energy prior that represents the negative log distribution of clean diffusion-weighted images, and a quadratic regularization term that constrains the estimated slab profiles toward an initial profile estimate. The gradient of the learned energy prior guides accelerated reconstruction toward an artifact-free image distribution. The resulting nonconvex objective is solved using alternating minimization, with image-volume updates performed through a majorize-minimize scheme using conjugate-gradient optimization and slab-profile updates estimated by regularized least squares. Across multiple acceleration factors and slab configurations, EPEN substantially reduced slab-boundary artifacts compared with conventional slab-boundary correction methods, while improving structural consistency and preserving diffusion-weighted contrast. These results demonstrate that EPEN enables robust joint 3D multi-slab diffusion MRI reconstruction and slab-profile correction within a unified optimization framework supported by deep energy-based image priors.

中文摘要翻译: 本文提出基于能量编码的轮廓编码（EPEN），一种从欠采样3D多板k空间采集中重建高分辨率弥散加权MRI的联合重建框架，旨在抑制板边界伪影同时保留精细解剖细节。EPEN使用双线性前向模型对多板采集过程进行建模，其中弥散加权图像体积和板激发轮廓均被视为未知变量。重建被构建为一个最大后验优化问题，包含三个组成部分：与采集的k空间测量值保持一致性约束的高斯数据保真项、表示干净弥散加权图像负对数分布的基于CNN的深度能量先验，以及将估计的板轮廓约束向初始轮廓估计的二次正则化项。学习到的能量先验的梯度引导加速重建朝向无伪影的图像分布。最终的凸目标函数通过交替最小化求解，其中图像体积更新通过主化-最小化方案使用共轭梯度优化进行，板轮廓更新通过正则化最小二乘估计。在多种加速因子和板配置下，与传统板边界校正方法相比，EPEN显著减少了板边界伪影，同时提高了结构一致性并保持了弥散加权对比度。这些结果表明，EPEN能够在由深度能量图像先验支持的统一优化框架内实现鲁棒的联合3D多板弥散MRI重建和板轮廓校正。

</details>


### [220] [MoRE: A Mixture-of-Experts-Based Task-Adaptive End-to-End Network for Multimodal MRI Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01784)
*Yuyang Li,Yipin Deng,Wenlei Shang,Juncen Wu,Xin Bai,Zijian Zhou,Peng Hu*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出MoRE，一种将稀疏门控混合专家（MoE）模块集成到端到端变分网络中的方法，在有限计算资源下实现跨解剖结构、跨对比度的通用MRI重建，在fastMRI多线圈脑部和膝关节数据集上取得了高稳定性的SSIM和PSNR性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有端到端学习的加速MRI重建方法虽然进展迅速，但部署一个能泛化到不同解剖结构和对比度、同时受限于有限计算资源的统一网络仍然具有挑战性。

Method: 提出MoRE，通过将稀疏激活的混合专家（MoE）模块集成到端到端变分网络中，耦合共享编码器与样本级无监督路由机制，激活最小子集的专家解码器，并严格保持基于物理的数据一致性。

Result: 在fastMRI多线圈脑部和膝关节数据集上、8倍欠采样下，MoRE在多对比度数据集上实现了高度稳定的SSIM和PSNR性能；t-SNE可视化显示路由嵌入具有可解释的、模态感知的专家特化；稀疏条件计算机制确保了架构开销保持在适度水平。

Conclusion: MoE风格的能力扩展可以显著增强通用MRI重建，而无需按比例增加计算能力。

Original Abstract: Although accelerated MRI reconstruction has advanced rapidly through end-to-end learning, deploying a single unified network that generalizes across diverse anatomies and contrasts under constrained computational resources remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce MoRE, a sparsely activated mixture-of-experts (MoE) module integrated into an end-to-end variational network. MoRE couples a shared encoder with sample-wise, unsupervised routing to activate a minimal subset of expert decoders while strictly preserving physics-based data consistency. Evaluated on the fastMRI multi-coil brain and knee datasets under 8x undersampling, MoRE achieves highly stable SSIM and PSNR performance across multi-contrast datasets. Furthermore, t-SNE visualization of the routing embeddings reveals interpretable, modality-aware expert specialization. The sparse conditional computation mechanism ensures that the architectural overhead remains modest. These results demonstrate that MoE-style capacity scaling can significantly enhance general-purpose MRI reconstruction without requiring proportional increases in computational power.

中文摘要翻译: 尽管通过端到端学习，加速MRI重建已取得快速进展，但在有限计算资源下部署一个能够泛化到不同解剖结构和对比度的统一网络仍然具有挑战性。本文提出MoRE，一种将稀疏激活的混合专家（MoE）模块集成到端到端变分网络中的方法。MoRE将共享编码器与样本级无监督路由相结合，激活最小子集的专家解码器，同时严格保持基于物理的数据一致性。在8倍欠采样下的fastMRI多线圈脑部和膝关节数据集上评估，MoRE在多对比度数据集上实现了高度稳定的SSIM和PSNR性能。此外，路由嵌入的t-SNE可视化揭示了可解释的、模态感知的专家特化。稀疏条件计算机制确保了架构开销保持在适度水平。这些结果表明，MoE风格的能力扩展可以显著增强通用MRI重建，而无需按比例增加计算能力。

</details>


### [221] [Face Liveness Detection Using RGB and Thermal Image Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01836)
*Merve Erşan,Melike Girgin,Tayfun Akgül*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种融合RGB边缘信息与热成像的多模态方法，利用自定义ARISTOF数据集训练YOLOv8-Face模型，有效提升人脸活体检测的准确性与鲁棒性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统可见光人脸检测难以区分活体与照片、面具等欺骗攻击，基于纹理、运动或生理信号的方法对光照变化敏感且鲁棒性有限。热成像虽能天然排除非活体，但检测精度不足，需融合多模态信息来提升性能。

Method: 提出一种混合方法，将RGB图像的边缘信息与对应的热成像图像进行融合，构建自定义ARISTOF数据集（包含活体与欺骗人脸）。使用YOLOv8-Face模型分别在RGB、热成像及融合三种模态下进行人脸检测对比，并基于融合图像训练YOLOv8-Face模型进行活体/欺骗分类。

Result: 所提融合方法提升了热成像图像的人脸检测精度；基于融合图像训练的YOLOv8-Face模型在活体与欺骗分类任务中表现出色，验证了多模态融合对人脸活体检测的有效性。

Conclusion: 多模态融合（RGB边缘信息+热成像）能有效支持鲁棒的人脸活体检测，克服了单一模态在欺骗攻击下的局限性。

Original Abstract: Face detection with visible-spectrum cameras can capture facial features, but it often fails to distinguish live subjects from spoof sources such as photographs, masks, or statues. Previous approaches based on texture, motion, or physiological cues are sensitive to illumination changes and show limited robustness against spoofing attacks. Thermal imaging helps overcome these limitations by detecting heat emissions, naturally excluding spoof faces. This study proposes a hybrid approach that fuses the edge information of RGB images with corresponding thermal images using a custom ARISTOF dataset containing live and spoof faces. The fused images are first evaluated using the YOLOv8-Face model to compare face detection performance across RGB, thermal, and fused modalities. The results show that the proposed method enhances the face detection accuracy of thermal images. The fused images are subsequently used to train a YOLOv8-Face model for live and spoof classification, demonstrating that the proposed multimodal fusion effectively supports robust face liveness detection.

中文摘要翻译: 可见光相机的人脸检测能够捕获面部特征，但通常难以区分活体与照片、面具或雕像等欺骗来源。以往基于纹理、运动或生理信号的方法对光照变化敏感，且针对欺骗攻击的鲁棒性有限。热成像通过检测热辐射来帮助克服这些局限，天然地排除了欺骗人脸。本研究提出一种混合方法，利用包含活体和欺骗人脸的定制ARISTOF数据集，将RGB图像的边缘信息与对应的热成像图像进行融合。首先使用YOLOv8-Face模型对融合图像进行评估，比较RGB、热成像和融合三种模态下的人脸检测性能。结果表明，所提方法提升了热成像图像的人脸检测精度。随后使用融合图像训练YOLOv8-Face模型进行活体与欺骗分类，证明所提出的多模态融合能有效支持鲁棒的人脸活体检测。

</details>


### [222] [LALE: Lightweight-Transformer Architecture for Land-Cover Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02092)
*Ümit Mert Çağlar,Alptekin Temizel*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出LALE，一种轻量级Transformer架构，通过分辨率分叉编码器（高分辨率ConvMixer处理局部细节+低分辨率Transformer处理全局上下文）和全MLP多尺度解码器，在遥感图像语义分割中实现极致的效率-性能平衡。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有遥感图像分割方法难以同时在全局上下文捕获、局部细节保留和计算效率三个维度上取得平衡：注意力机制擅长全局但计算成本高，卷积擅长局部但感受野有限，轻量模型往往牺牲性能。混合方法需要架构改动和繁重编码器，限制了效率。

Method: LALE将编码器按分辨率分叉：轻量ConvMixer阶段处理高分辨率局部特征，Transformer阶段处理低分辨率全局上下文，将自注意力的二次复杂度限制在深层下采样特征图上。采用全MLP多尺度解码器，并在整个网络中引入RMSNorm和StarReLU以减少计算量和参数量。

Result: 在ARAS400k基准上，最小变体（仅1.6M参数）F1分数仅比最佳基线（UPerNet）低2.6，但参数量减少4.5倍，存储减少7倍，GMACs减少17倍，吞吐量提升1.8倍。

Conclusion: LALE通过分辨率分叉策略和轻量设计，在遥感图像语义分割中建立了优于CNN、Transformer和混合基线的效率-性能权衡，证明了精心设计的轻量架构可以以极低的计算代价接近甚至媲美重型模型的性能。

Original Abstract: Semantic segmentation of remote sensing imagery requires models that capture both global context and local detail under tight computational budgets. Prior work typically optimizes for one of these axes: attention for global context, convolution for local detail, or compactness for efficiency. While hybrid approaches aim to capture both, they require architectural changes and encoder backbones with computational overhead, limiting efficiency and performance. We present LALE (Lightweight-transformer Architecture for Land-cover Estimation), an end-to-end remote sensing image segmentation architecture, that bifurcates its encoder by resolution: lightweight ConvMixer stages handle high-resolution local features, while transformer stages handle low-resolution global context, confining the quadratic cost of self-attention to deep, downsampled feature maps. An all-MLP multi-scale decoder, together with RMSNorm and StarReLU throughout, further reduces compute and parameter count. On the large-scale ARAS400k remote-sensing segmentation benchmark, LALE establishes a strong efficiency-performance trade-off against CNN, transformer, and hybrid baselines. Our smallest variant, (just 1.6M parameters), reaches within 2.6 F1 points of the best baseline (UPerNet) while using 4.5x fewer parameters, 7x less storage, 17x fewer GMACs, and delivering 1.8x higher throughput.

中文摘要翻译: 遥感图像的语义分割要求模型在严格的计算预算下同时捕捉全局上下文和局部细节。先前的工作通常只优化其中一个维度：注意力机制用于全局上下文，卷积用于局部细节，或紧凑性用于效率。虽然混合方法旨在同时捕获两者，但它们需要架构改动和编码器主干带来计算开销，限制了效率和性能。我们提出LALE（轻量Transformer架构用于土地覆盖估计），一种端到端的遥感图像分割架构，其编码器按分辨率分叉：轻量ConvMixer阶段处理高分辨率局部特征，而Transformer阶段处理低分辨率全局上下文，将自注意力的二次成本限制在深层的下采样特征图上。全MLP多尺度解码器，结合贯穿网络的RMSNorm和StarReLU，进一步减少了计算量和参数量。在大型遥感分割基准ARAS400k上，LALE建立了优于CNN、Transformer和混合基线的强效率-性能权衡。我们的最小变体（仅1.6M参数）的F1分数仅比最佳基线（UPerNet）低2.6，同时参数量减少4.5倍，存储减少7倍，GMACs减少17倍，吞吐量提升1.8倍。

</details>


### [223] [Predicting the risk of colorectal anastomotic leak based on preoperative mapping of the blood supply of the bowel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02156)
*Zahra Tabatabaei,Jon Sporring,Mark Bremholm Ellebæk,Alaa El-Hussuna*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出并描述了一个基于AI的术前CT影像分析系统框架，用于预测结直肠癌术后吻合口漏风险，包含风险评估模块和基于内容的医学图像检索模块，旨在推动可解释、数据驱动的精准手术决策。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 吻合口漏是结直肠癌术后最严重的并发症之一，当前术前评估仅依赖临床主观判断，缺乏基于CT影像的客观、可验证的预测方法。因此，亟需开发一种AI驱动的术前风险预测系统来填补这一空白。

Method: 遵循GDPR规范进行数据收集与预处理；对术前和增强后CT图像进行图像预处理；探索多种深度学习架构以生成临床可解释的输出。最终构建两个核心工具：1）风险评估模块，通过分析CT影像中的血管和组织特征量化漏风险；2）基于内容的医学图像检索（CBMIR）模块，检索并展示相似历史病例以辅助循证决策。

Result: 本文为方案协议论文，未给出定量实验结果。但论证了该系统在技术上的可行性以及在现有医疗基础设施中的临床可实施性，并指出其他机构可复现该工作流以开发类似决策支持工具。

Conclusion: 该跨学科框架有望增强手术规划、降低吻合口漏发生率，并推动向可解释、数据驱动的精准手术范式转变。

Original Abstract: Anastomotic leak remains one of the most serious complications following colorectal cancer surgery, substantially affecting patient outcomes, recovery trajectories, and healthcare costs. Despite advances in imaging technology, current preoperative assessment relies only on clinical assessment, a process that is subjective, error-prone, and highly dependent on individual expertise. To date, no validated CT-based method exists to predict anastomotic leak risk prior to surgery. This protocol paper outlines a comprehensive framework for developing and validating an AI-driven system for preoperative risk assessment using pre- and post-contrast CT imaging. The study describes the stages of data collection, ethical handling, and preprocessing of patient data in accordance with GDPR, image preprocessing, and the exploration of deep learning architectures designed to generate clinically interpretable outputs. Two integrated tools constitute the main deliverables of this workflow: 1) a risk assessment module, which quantifies the likelihood of leakage by analyzing vascular and tissue features in CT scans, and 2) a Content-Based Medical Image Retrieval (CBMIR) module, which identifies and displays similar historical cases to support evidence-based surgical decision making. The protocol paper requires close collaboration between hospitals and universities; this protocol demonstrates that such a system is technically feasible and clinically implementable within existing healthcare infrastructures. By following the proposed methodological stages and regulatory principles, other institutions can reproduce this workflow to develop analogous decision-support tools. Ultimately, this interdisciplinary framework aims to enhance surgical planning, reduce leak incidence, and contribute to a broader paradigm shift toward explainable, data-driven precision surgery.

中文摘要翻译: 吻合口漏仍然是结直肠癌手术后最严重的并发症之一，严重影响患者预后、恢复轨迹和医疗成本。尽管影像技术不断进步，当前的术前评估仍仅依赖临床评估，这一过程主观性强、易出错且高度依赖个人经验。迄今为止，尚无经过验证的基于CT的方法可在术前预测吻合口漏风险。本方案论文概述了一个全面的框架，用于开发和验证一个AI驱动的术前风险评估系统，该系统利用增强前后的CT影像。研究描述了根据GDPR进行数据收集、伦理处理和患者数据预处理、图像预处理以及探索旨在生成临床可解释输出的深度学习架构等阶段。两个集成工具构成了该工作流的主要成果：1）风险评估模块，通过分析CT扫描中的血管和组织特征来量化漏的可能性；2）基于内容的医学图像检索（CBMIR）模块，用于识别和展示相似的历史病例以支持基于证据的外科决策。该方案论文要求医院和大学之间的紧密合作；本方案证明了此类系统在技术上是可行的，并且可在现有医疗基础设施中临床实施。通过遵循所提出的方法论阶段和监管原则，其他机构可以复现此工作流以开发类似的决策支持工具。最终，这一跨学科框架旨在增强手术规划、降低漏发生率，并推动向可解释、数据驱动的精准手术的更广泛范式转变。

</details>

### [224] [BitsMoE: Efficient Spectral Energy-Guided Bit Allocation for MoE LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00079)
*Jiayu Zhao,Zihan Teng,Minhao Fan,Tianrui Ma,Wentao Ren,Song Chen,Weichen Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BitsMoE提出了一种基于谱能量引导的位分配框架，通过SVD分解将MoE层拆分为共享基座和专家特定谱因子，并利用整数线性规划求解混合精度量化方案，在超低比特场景下显著降低性能损失。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有的MoE压缩方法在超低比特场景下存在不足：剪枝不可逆地移除模型容量，而粗粒度量化未能根据异构的专家和权重方向重要性分配比特位宽。

Method: (1) 通过SVD将每个MoE层分解为共享基座和专家特定谱因子，共享基座不量化以保留跨专家的共同结构；(2) 将谱域混合精度量化建模为激活感知的重建损失代理，并求解整数线性规划，在固定比特预算下最小化估计重建损失。

Result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base上，2-bit量化相比GPTQ：量化加速12.3倍，平均准确率提升27.83个百分点，解码速度提升1.76倍。

Conclusion: BitsMoE在超低比特量化场景下显著减少了下游任务精度退化，是一种有效的MoE LLM量化方法。

Original Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models reduce per-token computation through sparse expert activation, but their deployment remains memory-intensive because all expert weights must be kept resident in memory. Existing MoE compression methods struggle in the ultra-low-bit regime: pruning irreversibly removes model capacity, while coarse-grained quantization fails to allocate bits according to heterogeneous expert and weight-direction importance. We propose BitsMoE, a spectral-energy-guided bit-allocation framework for MoE LLM quantization. BitsMoE decomposes each MoE layer by SVD into a shared basis and expert-specific spectral factors, retaining the shared basis without quantization to preserve common cross-expert structure and using the expert-specific factors as fine-grained quantization units. To determine the bit-width of each unit, BitsMoE formulates spectrum-wise mixed-precision quantization as an activation-aware reconstruction surrogate and solves an integer linear program that minimizes estimated reconstruction loss under a fixed bit budget. Experiments across multiple MoE LLMs show that BitsMoE substantially reduces downstream task accuracy degradation in ultra-low-bit regimes. Under 2-bit quantization on Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base, BitsMoE accelerates quantization by 12.3$\times$, improves average accuracy by 27.83 percentage points, and increases decoding speed by 1.76$\times$ over GPTQ. Our model and code are publicly available at https://github.com/zjiayu064/BitsMoE.

中文摘要翻译: 混合专家（MoE）大语言模型通过稀疏专家激活减少了每个token的计算量，但其部署仍然存在内存密集的问题，因为所有专家权重必须常驻内存。现有的MoE压缩方法在超低比特场景下表现不佳：剪枝不可逆地移除模型容量，而粗粒度量化未能根据异构的专家和权重方向重要性分配比特位宽。我们提出BitsMoE，一种面向MoE大语言模型量化的谱能量引导位分配框架。BitsMoE通过奇异值分解（SVD）将每个MoE层分解为共享基座和专家特定谱因子，保留共享基座不量化以保持跨专家的共同结构，并将专家特定谱因子作为细粒度量化单元。为了确定每个单元的位宽，BitsMoE将谱域混合精度量化建模为激活感知的重建损失代理，并求解一个在固定比特预算下最小化估计重建损失的整数线性规划。在多个MoE大语言模型上的实验表明，BitsMoE在超低比特场景下显著减少了下游任务的精度退化。在Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base的2-bit量化下，BitsMoE相比GPTQ实现了12.3倍的量化加速、27.83个百分点的平均准确率提升以及1.76倍的解码速度提升。我们的模型和代码已在https://github.com/zjiayu064/BitsMoE公开。

</details>


### [225] [DAStatFormer: A Hybrid Multibranch Transformer with Statistical Feature Integration for DAS-Based Pattern Recognitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00081)
*Michel Dione,Jerry Lonlac,Hélène Louis,Anthony Fleury,Stephane Lecoeuche*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DAStatFormer，一种混合多分支Transformer，通过提取多域统计特征替代原始DAS信号，显著降低计算成本并实现高精度事件分类。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: DAS数据高维且时空模式复杂，现有深度学习方法（CNN、RNN、Transformer变体）要么无法捕获长程依赖，要么处理原始DAS矩阵计算成本过高，亟需高效且可扩展的解决方案。

Method: 从每个通道的时域、波形和频域提取24个ANOVA筛选的统计特征，大幅降维；通过专用的逐步注意力分支和逐通道注意力分支分别处理各域特征，并由自适应门控机制融合，形成混合多分支Transformer架构。

Result: 在公开Φ-OTDR基准和真实DAS数据集上达到99.4%的准确率和近乎完美的真实场景性能，参数量和推理成本显著低于DASFormer和DeepViT等模型。

Conclusion: DAStatFormer兼具高精度与低计算开销，适用于大规模、实时的DAS监测任务。

Original Abstract: Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) enables large-scale monitoring through optical fibers, but its high dimensionality and complex spatio-temporal patterns make event classification demanding. Existing deep learning approaches-CNNs, recurrent models, and Transformer variants-either fail to capture long-range dependencies or require processing raw DAS matrices at prohibitive cost. We propose DAStatFormer, a hybrid multibranch Transformer that combines compact multidomain statistical features with Gated Transformer Networks. Instead of raw signals, we extract 24 ANOVA-selected attributes per channel from the temporal, waveform, and spectral domains, reducing data size by orders of magnitude while preserving discriminative information. Each domain is processed via dedicated step-wise and channel-wise attention branches, fused by an adaptive gating mechanism. Experiments on the open $Φ$-OTDR benchmark and a real-scenario DAS dataset show that DAS-tatFormer achieves up to 99.4% accuracy and near-perfect real-world performance, while using significantly fewer parameters and lower inference cost than models such as DASFormer and DeepViT. These results demonstrate its suitability for scalable, real-time DAS-based monitoring. We release our code at https://github.com/MichelD-git/DAStatFormer

中文摘要翻译: 分布式声学传感（DAS）通过光纤实现大规模监测，但其高维度和复杂的时空模式使事件分类极具挑战。现有的深度学习方法——CNN、循环模型和Transformer变体——要么无法捕获长程依赖，要么需要以高昂成本处理原始DAS矩阵。我们提出DAStatFormer，一种混合多分支Transformer，将紧凑的多域统计特征与门控Transformer网络相结合。我们不再使用原始信号，而是从每个通道的时域、波形和频域提取24个经ANOVA筛选的属性，将数据规模降低数个数量级，同时保留判别性信息。每个域通过专用的逐步骤注意力和逐通道注意力分支处理，并由自适应门控机制融合。在公开的Φ-OTDR基准和一个真实场景DAS数据集上的实验表明，DAStatFormer达到了高达99.4%的准确率和近乎完美的真实世界性能，同时使用的参数数量和推理成本显著低于DASFormer和DeepViT等模型。这些结果证明了其适用于可扩展、实时的DAS监测。我们在https://github.com/MichelD-git/DAStatFormer 上发布代码。

</details>


### [226] [Hoeffding Concept Bottleneck Models with Applications to Overhead Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00082)
*Clément Bénard,Manon Arfib,Christophe Labreuche,Victor Quétu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Hoeffding概念瓶颈模型（HCBM），利用梯度提升树的Hoeffding函数分解实现概念分数的非线性稀疏聚合，并通过质蕴含项生成紧凑预测，在提升可解释性的同时优于传统线性CBM方法，并扩展至目标检测任务。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型（CBM）依赖线性聚合概念分数来预测，但大量概念的使用削弱了可解释性并导致信息泄露，且概念与输出logits之间的关系本质上并非线性。

Method: 基于梯度提升树的Hoeffding函数分解，构建非线性、稀疏的概念分数聚合方式，利用质蕴含项（prime implicants）生成紧凑预测。

Result: HCBM被证明对概念间信息泄露具有鲁棒性，在大量实验中性能优于标准线性CBM；在目标检测（尤其是航拍图像）任务中也展现了高性能。

Conclusion: HCBM通过非线性和稀疏聚合提升了概念瓶颈模型的可解释性与预测性能，并能有效扩展至目标检测等更复杂的任务场景。

Original Abstract: Explainability of deep learning algorithms is critical for computer-vision applications with high-stake decisions. Concept bottleneck models (CBM) have recently shown promising performance to provide explainable and accurate predictions for classification problems, based on a bottleneck of high-level concepts. Existing CBM methods rely on a linear aggregation of the concept scores to compute predictions. However, a large number of concepts is often used in this linear approach, which undermines explainability and favors information leakage. In general, the underlying relation between concepts and output logits is not linear. Therefore, we introduce Hoeffding Concept Bottleneck Models (HCBM), which build on the Hoeffding functional decomposition of gradient-boosted trees to provide non-linear and sparse aggregations of concept scores, and generate compact predictions using prime implicants. HCBM are proved to be robust to interconcept leakage, and outperform standard linear CBM in practice, as shown in extensive experiments. Beyond classification, HCBM can be adapted to object detection, and we focus on a challenging case with overhead images to show the high performance of HCBM in these settings.

中文摘要翻译: 深度学习算法的可解释性对于高风险决策的计算机视觉应用至关重要。概念瓶颈模型（CBM）近期在分类问题中展现出良好的性能，能够基于高层概念的瓶颈层提供可解释且准确的预测。现有CBM方法依赖线性聚合概念分数来计算预测结果。然而，这种线性方法通常使用大量概念，这不仅削弱了可解释性，还容易导致信息泄露。一般而言，概念与输出logits之间的潜在关系并非线性。为此，我们提出Hoeffding概念瓶颈模型（HCBM），该方法基于梯度提升树的Hoeffding函数分解，实现概念分数的非线性和稀疏聚合，并利用质蕴含项生成紧凑预测。实验证明，HCBM对概念间信息泄露具有鲁棒性，且在大量实验中优于标准线性CBM。除分类任务外，HCBM还可扩展到目标检测领域，我们重点研究了航拍图像这一具有挑战性的场景，展示了HCBM在此类设置中的高性能。

</details>


### [227] [From Demonstrations to Rewards: Test-Time Prompt Optimization for VLM Reward Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00083)
*Christian Gumbsch,Leonardo Barcellona,Lennard Schünemann,Platon Karageorgis,Andrii Zadaianchuk,Zehao Wang,Sergey Zakharov,Fabien Despinoy,Rahaf Aljundi,Efstratios Gavves*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Demo2Reward提出了一种测试时自适应技术，利用少量专家演示（3-10条轨迹）优化VLM奖励模型的语言指令，在不增加策略学习计算开销的前提下减少假阳性奖励，提升下游策略学习性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 强化学习依赖准确的奖励函数，但现实中往往难以获得。现有基于VLM的零样本奖励模型在缺乏精心提示工程时会产生次优奖励，假阳性预测会严重破坏下游策略学习。

Method: 提出Demo2Reward，一种测试时自适应方法，通过少量专家演示轨迹（3-10条）优化VLM奖励模型的语言指令，在保持真阳性率的同时减少假阳性率。该方法无需额外的模型训练或计算资源。

Result: 在多个模拟机器人任务和策略主干上，Demo2Reward持续优于现有的零样本和少样本VLM奖励模型；并在真实机器人场景中有效迁移，实现了无需手工设计奖励函数的策略学习。

Conclusion: 仅需少量演示即可优化VLM奖励模型，显著提升奖励质量，且不增加策略学习阶段的计算负担，在模拟和真实机器人任务中均表现优异。

Original Abstract: Reinforcement learning relies on accurate reward functions, which are often hand-crafted or even unavailable in real-world applications, such as robotics. Recent work has explored the zero-shot reasoning capabilities of pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as reward models. However, without careful prompt engineering, these approaches tend to produce suboptimal rewards, where false positive predictions can severely degrade downstream policy learning. In robotics, limited datasets comprising expert demonstrations are often collected to bootstrap policy learning. This scenario provides an opportunity to optimize a reward model prior policy training. We propose Demo2Reward a test-time adaptation technique to optimize the language instruction of a reward model based on a few demonstrations (3-10 trajectories) to reduce false positives while preserving true positives. Crucially, this requires no additional model training or computation resources during policy learning. We show that Demo2Reward consistently outperforms existing zero- and few-shot VLM reward models across a range of simulated robotic tasks and policy backbones. Finally, we demonstrate that Demo2Reward effectively transfers to a real-world robotic learning scenario, enabling policy learning without manually engineering a reward function.

中文摘要翻译: 强化学习依赖于准确的奖励函数，而在机器人等实际应用中，奖励函数通常需要手工设计甚至难以获得。近期研究探索了利用预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）的零样本推理能力作为奖励模型。然而，缺乏精心设计的提示工程时，这些方法往往产生次优奖励，其中假阳性预测会严重破坏下游策略学习。在机器人学中，通常收集包含专家演示的有限数据集来引导策略学习。这一场景提供了在策略训练之前优化奖励模型的机会。我们提出Demo2Reward，一种测试时自适应技术，基于少量演示（3-10条轨迹）优化奖励模型的语言指令，在减少假阳性同时保持真阳性。关键的是，这在策略学习过程中不需要额外的模型训练或计算资源。我们展示了Demo2Reward在多种模拟机器人任务和策略主干上持续优于现有的零样本和少样本VLM奖励模型。最后，我们证明了Demo2Reward能够有效迁移到真实机器人学习场景，无需手工设计奖励函数即可实现策略学习。

</details>


### [228] [A Shared Valence Axis Across Modern LLMs and Human EEG: The Saturation Regularity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00129)
*Yousef A. Radwan,Xuhui Liu,Kilichbek Haydarov,Yuqian Fu,Mohamed Elhoseiny*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现LLM内部产生的情绪效价方向（V-axis）与人类EEG神经表征高度一致，但额外对齐策略无法提升解码性能，并提出了“饱和正则性”（saturation regularity）理论：当任务标签已驱动脑解码网络达到目标方向时，额外监督只会扭曲已饱和的盆地，而有用的类内残差几乎得不到梯度。基于这一发现，作者通过集成残差多样性而非监督盆地，在FACED和SEED-V数据集上显著提升了平衡准确率。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 探索现代LLM能否作为理解人脑神经表征（特别是EEG中情绪效价）的透镜，并研究语言模型与人类神经活动之间的表征对齐是否能为脑解码提供有效训练信号。

Method: 1) 仅用9句情感句子从LLM构建一维权价方向（V-axis），通过零样本迁移和跨模型一致性验证；2) 将LLM导出的方向映射到EEG神经活动（123名被试观看情感视频）；3) 测试25种对齐策略（知识蒸馏、表征相似性、对比学习、拓扑损失等）；4) 提出“饱和正则性”理论解释对齐失败原因；5) 基于该理论提出残差多样性集成方法提升性能。

Result: 1) LLM导出的V-axis可通过EEG特征的线性投影追踪；2) 36个未暴露于V-axis的EEG情绪分类器在其内部表征中自发发现了相同方向；3) 25种对齐策略均未提升解码性能，其中16种显著降低准确率；4) 提出的残差多样性集成方法在FACED上提升平衡准确率10.5%，在SEED-V上验证了相同效果。

Conclusion: LLM与人脑在情绪效价表征上存在趋同，但这种趋同不能为脑解码提供有效训练信号。改进应来自监督不可达的残差子空间，而非对齐已饱和的盆地。

Original Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful representation learners whose internal features increasingly align with human cognition. We study whether modern LLMs can serve as a lens for understanding neural representations in the human brain, focusing on emotional valence in EEG.
  We first build a one-dimensional valence direction, the V-axis, from modern LLMs using only nine emotion-evocative sentences. We validate it through zero-shot transfer to sentiment benchmarks and cross-model consistency across fourteen LLMs. We then show that this LLM-derived direction maps onto human neural activity. On a public EEG cohort of 123 subjects watching affective videos, a single linear projection on EEG features tracks the V-axis position of each stimulus. Moreover, 36 EEG emotion classifiers trained without exposure to the V-axis spontaneously rediscover the same direction in their internal representations, suggesting that the same valence structure emerges in both language models and human electrophysiology.
  Yet this convergence does not provide an effective training signal. We test twenty-five alignment strategies, including knowledge distillation, representational similarity, contrastive, and topographic losses; none improve decoding, and sixteen significantly reduce accuracy. We formalize this result as the saturation regularity: once task labels alone drive a brain-decoding network onto the target direction, additional supervision mainly distorts an already-saturated basin, while the load-bearing within-class residual receives little useful gradient.
  This regularity also indicates where improvement should come from: the residual subspace unreachable by supervision. Motivated by this insight, we ensemble across residual diversity rather than supervising the basin, improving balanced accuracy by 10.5% over the prior best on FACED, with the same effect replicated on SEED-V.

中文摘要翻译: 大型语言模型（LLM）已成为强大的表征学习器，其内部特征越来越与人类认知对齐。我们研究现代LLM能否作为理解人脑神经表征（尤其是脑电图中的情绪效价）的透镜。我们首先仅用九个情感唤起句子从现代LLM中构建了一个一维权价方向（V-axis），通过零样本迁移到情感基准测试以及跨14个LLM的一致性验证其有效性。然后我们展示这个LLM导出的方向映射到了人类神经活动上。在一个包含123名被试观看情感视频的公开EEG队列中，EEG特征的单一线性投影就能追踪每个刺激的V-axis位置。此外，36个未暴露于V-axis的EEG情绪分类器在其内部表征中自发发现了相同方向，表明相同的效价结构在语言模型和人类电生理学中同时出现。然而这种趋同并不能提供有效的训练信号。我们测试了25种对齐策略，包括知识蒸馏、表征相似性、对比学习和拓扑损失；没有任何一种能提升解码性能，其中16种显著降低了准确率。我们将这一结果形式化为饱和正则性：一旦任务标签本身将脑解码网络驱动到目标方向，额外的监督主要会扭曲一个已饱和的盆地，而承载负荷的类内残差几乎得不到有用的梯度。这一正则性也指明了改进应来自何处：监督不可达的残差子空间。受此启发，我们通过对残差多样性进行集成而非监督盆地，在FACED上将平衡准确率提升了10.5%，并在SEED-V上复现了相同效果。

</details>


### [229] [Automatically Differentiable Nonlinear Tensor Networks (ADNTNs) for Exponential Compression of Deep Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00130)
*Andrzej Cichocki,Michal Wietczak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出可自动微分非线性张量网络（ADNTNs），一种通过反向模式自动微分端到端训练的结构化权重生成器，可在AlexNet和VGG-16上实现2000×至77000×的逐层压缩比，且精度接近甚至优于密集基线。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有低秩自适应和张量分解方法使用单一低秩矩阵更新，表达能力有限；本文旨在通过层次化小核、非线性激活和横向混合张量构建大规模权重张量，在保持结构化的同时提升模型压缩效率与表达能力。

Method: 提出ADNTNs框架，包含三种架构：树张量网络（TTN）、带边界解纠缠的增强TTN（aTTN）和多尺度纠缠重整化拟设（MERA）。核心思想是用层次化小核通过非线性激活和横向混合构建大权重张量，并通过反向模式自动微分进行端到端训练，支持非线性激活、任务感知目标、批处理和硬件感知执行调度。

Result: 在AlexNet和VGG-16各层上的实验显示，逐层压缩比约为2000×至77000×，精度通常匹配密集基线，且在多个VGG-16场景中精度有所提升。

Conclusion: ADNTNs是一条有前景、数学结构清晰且硬件感知的通往更小神经网络的路线，但需将优化、收缩调度和部署内核协同设计才能发挥全部潜力。

Original Abstract: We study Automatically Differentiable Nonlinear Tensor Networks (ADNTNs), a family of structured weight generators whose compact core tensors are trained end-to-end by reverse-mode automatic differentiation (AD). The approach can be viewed as a natural extension of low-rank adaptation and tensor factorisation: instead of using one low-rank matrix update, an ADNTN builds a large weight tensor through a hierarchy of small cores, nonlinear activations, and optional lateral mixing tensors. The paper focuses on three architectures: Tree Tensor Networks (TTNs), augmented TTNs (aTTNs) with boundary disentanglers, and Multi-scale Entanglement Renormalisation Ansatze (MERA).
  The formulation supports nonlinear activations, task-aware objectives, batching, and hardware-aware execution schedules. At the same time, the paper keeps a clear distinction between \emph{differentiating} a contraction program and making contraction free: AD does not remove the cost of large intermediates, poor contraction orders, or exact contraction of general loopy tensor networks.
  Extensive simulations on AlexNet and VGG-16 layers show per-layer compression ratios from roughly $2000\times$ to $77000\times$ in the studied settings, with accuracy often matching the dense baseline and, in several VGG-16 cases, improving it. These results are encouraging rather than final: they suggest that ADNTNs are a promising, mathematically structured, and hardware-aware route toward much smaller neural networks, provided that optimisation, contraction schedules, and deployment kernels are designed together.

中文摘要翻译: 本文研究可自动微分非线性张量网络（ADNTNs），这是一类结构化的权重生成器，其紧凑核心张量通过反向模式自动微分（AD）进行端到端训练。该方法可视为低秩自适应和张量分解的自然扩展：ADNTN并非使用一个低秩矩阵更新，而是通过层次化的小核、非线性激活以及可选的横向混合张量来构建大规模权重张量。本文聚焦于三种架构：树张量网络（TTN）、带边界解纠缠的增强TTN（aTTN）以及多尺度纠缠重整化拟设（MERA）。该公式支持非线性激活、任务感知目标、批处理以及硬件感知的执行调度。同时，本文明确区分了“对收缩程序求微分”与“使收缩变得免费”：自动微分并未消除大中间张量、不良收缩顺序或一般环状张量网络精确收缩的开销。在AlexNet和VGG-16各层上的大量仿真表明，在所研究的设定下，逐层压缩比约为2000×至77000×，精度通常与密集基线匹配，且在多个VGG-16场景中有所提升。这些结果是鼓舞人心而非最终的：它们表明，若能将优化、收缩调度和部署内核进行协同设计，ADNTNs是一条有前景、数学结构清晰且硬件感知的通往更小神经网络的路线。

</details>


### [230] [Foundation-Preserving Adaptation via Generalized Rayleigh-Quotient Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00132)
*Dongjun Kim,Adrian de Wynter,Huancheng Chen,Heasung Kim,Haris Vikalo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FoLoRA框架，通过广义瑞利商评分更新方向并采用方向级门控Adam，在微调中平衡下游任务适应与非目标能力保持，优于现有基线。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有遗忘感知方法依赖特殊初始化或固定约束来寻求更安全的更新，但未能动态调节训练过程中适配与保持之间的权衡。

Method: 基于一阶保持条件定义预训练代理激活上的遗忘惩罚和下游任务激活上的任务效用，通过广义瑞利商计算单位遗忘惩罚的任务效用来评分更新方向，构建谱坐标系实现方向级门控Adam更新，抑制低效用-惩罚比的方向；通过从预训练模型采样而非依赖单一代理数据集来构建预训练代理校准数据。

Result: 在数学、代码和指令跟随适应任务上，FoLoRA在保持-适配平衡上优于所有基线，提升了目标任务性能并实现了非目标能力的最佳聚合保持。

Conclusion: FoLoRA作为一种遗忘感知优化框架，通过方向级梯度调控有效实现了适配与保持的最优平衡。

Original Abstract: While finetuning effectively adapts foundation models to specialized downstream tasks, it can degrade nontarget capabilities acquired during pretraining. Existing forgetting aware methods typically seek safer updates through specialized initialization or fixed constraints, but do not regulate the adaptation preservation trade-off during training. We propose Foundation Preserving LoRA (FoLoRA), a forgetting aware optimization framework. Guided by a first order preservation condition, FoLoRA defines a forgetting penalty over pretraining-proxy activations and a task utility over downstream task activations. It then scores update directions by task utility per unit forgetting penalty via a generalized Rayleigh quotient. The resulting spectral coordinate system enables direction wise gated Adam updates, attenuating low utility to penalty directions during training. To estimate the forgetting penalty, FoLoRA constructs pretraining proxy calibration data by sampling from the pretrained model rather than relying on a single proxy dataset. Experiments on math, code, and instruction following adaptation show that FoLoRA achieves the strongest preservation adaptation balance over baselines, improving target task performance with best aggregate preservation of non target capabilities.

中文摘要翻译: 虽然微调能有效将基础模型适应到特定的下游任务，但可能会损害预训练阶段获得的非目标能力。现有的遗忘感知方法通常通过专门的初始化或固定约束来寻求更安全的更新，但未能调节训练过程中适配与保持之间的权衡。我们提出FoLoRA（Foundation Preserving LoRA），一种遗忘感知优化框架。在一阶保持条件的指导下，FoLoRA定义了基于预训练代理激活的遗忘惩罚和基于下游任务激活的任务效用。然后，通过广义瑞利商计算单位遗忘惩罚下的任务效用，对更新方向进行评分。由此产生的谱坐标系使得方向级门控Adam更新成为可能，在训练过程中衰减低效用-惩罚比的方向。为了估计遗忘惩罚，FoLoRA通过从预训练模型中采样来构建预训练代理校准数据，而非依赖于单一的代理数据集。在数学、代码和指令跟随适应任务上的实验表明，FoLoRA在保持-适配平衡上优于所有基线，既提升了目标任务性能，又实现了非目标能力的最佳聚合保持。

</details>


### [231] [World Models: A Comprehensive Survey of Architectures, Methodologies, Reasoning Paradigms, and Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00133)
*Arif Hassan Zidan,Yi Pan,Hanqi Jiang,Ruiyu Yan,Wei Ruan,Zihao Wu,Lifeng Chen,Weihang You,Xinliang Li,Bowen Chen,Huawen Hu,Peilong Wang,Sizhuang Liu,Jing Zhang,Siyuan Li,Zhengliang Liu,Yu Bao,Lin Zhao,Lichao Sun,Dajiang Zhu,Xiang Li,Jinglei Lv,Quanzheng Li,Wei Liu,Tianming Liu,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对世界模型领域进行了系统性综述，构建了一个涵盖架构、方法论、推理策略和应用领域的四维分类法，梳理了从早期认知科学基础到PlaNet、Dreamer、MuZero、Sora等里程碑系统的演进脉络，并指出了当前挑战与未来方向。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 世界模型领域虽在强化学习、机器人、自动驾驶和视频生成等领域取得了快速进展，但缺乏一个统一的框架来整合其多样化的架构选择、训练方法、推理机制和应用场景。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 采用多轴分类法，沿四个维度组织分析：(i)架构维度（表征格式、动态公式、输入模态、学习范式、下游应用）；(ii)方法论家族（状态空间与循环方法、Transformer模型、扩散生成器、物理信息网络、语言增强多模态系统）；(iii)推理策略（基于想象的规划、潜在策略学习、反事实推理、不确定性下的规划）；(iv)应用领域（机器人、自动驾驶、视频预测、多模态智能体、强化学习、科学建模、医学影像、教育测量、商业与金融）。

Result: 梳理了从认知科学基础到PlaNet、Dreamer系列、MuZero、Sora、Cosmos、Genie等里程碑系统的发展历程，揭示了思维链推理与世界模型想象的最新融合趋势，总结了评估协议与基准，识别了复合预测误差、仿真到现实迁移、碎片化评估等持续性挑战。

Conclusion: 指出了未来方向：统一多模态世界模型、基础规模交互式模拟器、以及安全关键领域的安全部署。

Original Abstract: World models, internal simulators that learn the structure and dynamics of an environment, have emerged as a central paradigm in the pursuit of artificial general intelligence, enabling agents to predict, plan, and reason within learned representations. Despite rapid progress across reinforcement learning, robotics, autonomous driving, and video generation, the field lacks a unified framework integrating its diverse architectural choices, training methods, reasoning mechanisms, and application settings. This survey addresses that gap with a multi-axis taxonomy organized along four dimensions: (i) architecture, encompassing representation format, dynamics formulation, input modality, learning paradigm, and downstream application; (ii) methodological family, including state-space and recurrent approaches, transformer-based models, diffusion-based generators, physics-informed networks, and language-augmented multimodal systems; (iii) reasoning strategy, covering imagination-based planning, latent policy learning, counterfactual reasoning, and planning under uncertainty; and (iv) application domain, spanning robotics, autonomous driving, video prediction, multimodal agents, reinforcement learning, scientific modeling, medical imaging, educational measurement, and business and finance. Tracing the field from early cognitive-science foundations to milestone systems such as PlaNet, the Dreamer family, MuZero, Sora, Cosmos, and Genie, we examine how these dimensions interact and highlight the recent convergence of chain-of-thought reasoning with world-model imagination. We review evaluation protocols and benchmarks, identify persistent challenges such as compounding prediction errors, sim-to-real transfer, and fragmented evaluation, and outline future directions toward unified multimodal world models, foundation-scale interactive simulators, and safe deployment in safety-critical domains.

中文摘要翻译: 世界模型是一种学习环境结构与动态的内部模拟器，已成为追求人工通用智能的核心范式，使智能体能够在学到的表征中进行预测、规划和推理。尽管在强化学习、机器人、自动驾驶和视频生成等领域取得了快速进展，但该领域缺乏一个统一框架来整合其多样化的架构选择、训练方法、推理机制和应用设置。本文综述填补了这一空白，提出了一个多轴分类法，沿四个维度进行组织：(i)架构，涵盖表征格式、动态公式、输入模态、学习范式和下游应用；(ii)方法论家族，包括状态空间和循环方法、基于Transformer的模型、扩散生成器、物理信息网络以及语言增强的多模态系统；(iii)推理策略，涵盖基于想象的规划、潜在策略学习、反事实推理和不确定性下的规划；(iv)应用领域，涵盖机器人、自动驾驶、视频预测、多模态智能体、强化学习、科学建模、医学影像、教育测量以及商业与金融。本文追溯了该领域从早期认知科学基础到PlaNet、Dreamer系列、MuZero、Sora、Cosmos和Genie等里程碑系统的发展历程，考察了这些维度如何相互交互，并强调了思维链推理与世界模型想象的最新融合趋势。我们回顾了评估协议与基准，识别了诸如复合预测误差、仿真到现实迁移和碎片化评估等持续性挑战，并勾勒了朝向统一多模态世界模型、基础规模交互式模拟器以及安全关键领域安全部署的未来方向。

</details>


### [232] [On Effectiveness and Efficiency of Agentic Tool-calling and RL Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00135)
*Tong Liu,Cheng Qian,Matej Cief,Yuan He,Daniele Dan,Nikolaos Aletras,Gabriella Kazai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了LLM智能体工具调用的有效性与效率两大维度：有效性方面揭示了评估流程对微小实现细节的高度敏感性；效率方面分析了强化学习训练中的计算浪费，并提出了两种加速技术。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有研究对工具调用的评估缺乏标准化，导致结果不可靠；同时RL训练存在大量计算浪费，需提升训练效率。

Method: 1) 系统分析工具调用评估流程中随机种子、系统提示、多轮模板构建等实现选择对结果的影响；2) 识别RL训练中回滚阶段无效样本和策略更新阶段高计算开销两大浪费来源；3) 提出两种加速RL工具调用训练的技术。

Result: 评估结果对实现细节高度敏感，尤其在多轮场景中排名不可靠；提出的加速技术在不降性能的前提下实现显著的墙上时钟加速。

Conclusion: 工具调用评估亟需标准化；RL训练可通过减少计算浪费有效加速，而性能不受影响。

Original Abstract: Tool-calling is a central component of modern large language model (LLM) agents, equipping them with skills beyond their parametric knowledge. This paper studies tool-calling along two complementary axes: effectiveness, i.e., how this capability is measured, and efficiency, i.e., how it is learned. On effectiveness, we systematically analyze tool-calling evaluation pipelines and show that results can be highly sensitive to seemingly minor, often undocumented implementation choices including the random seed, system prompt, multi-turn template construction, and how prior interaction/reasoning history is carried forward. These choices can lead to substantial differences in reported performance, especially in multi-turn settings where without rigorous standardization, leaderboard rankings are unreliable. On efficiency, we examine standard reinforcement learning (RL) for tool-calling and identify two sources of computational waste: (i) during rollouts, many prompts produce no learning signal, and (ii) during policy updates, optimization incurs high computational cost. Guided by these findings, we introduce two techniques that accelerate RL-based tool-calling training, achieving substantial wall-clock speedup without degrading performance.

中文摘要翻译: 工具调用是现代大语言模型（LLM）智能体的核心组件，为其赋予超越参数化知识的技能。本文沿两个互补维度研究工具调用：有效性，即如何衡量这一能力；效率，即如何习得这一能力。在有效性方面，我们系统分析了工具调用评估流程，发现结果对看似微小、通常未文档化的实现选择高度敏感，包括随机种子、系统提示、多轮模板构建以及先前交互/推理历史的传递方式。这些选择可能导致报告性能出现显著差异，尤其是在多轮场景中——若缺乏严格标准化，排行榜排名将不可靠。在效率方面，我们审视了用于工具调用的标准强化学习（RL），并识别出两个计算浪费来源：（i）在回滚阶段，许多提示不产生学习信号；（ii）在策略更新阶段，优化带来了高昂的计算成本。基于这些发现，我们引入了两种加速基于RL的工具调用训练的技术，在不降低性能的前提下实现了显著的墙上时钟加速。

</details>


### [233] [Generative AI and Digital Ecosystem Resilience: A Proactive Lifecycle-Based Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00136)
*Jonghyun Chung,Rishabh Chaddha,Sanket Badhe,Debanshu Das,Nathan Huang,Amanpreet Kaur*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于生命周期（C5交互模型）的统一分类法，用于综述对抗性合成内容（尤其由GenAI驱动）的主动检测方法，涵盖从叙事创建、播种、放大到后果检测的全阶段技术，并展望了未来研究方向。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统被动式检测方法无法有效应对由生成式AI加速产生的对抗性合成内容，亟需转向主动检测新兴虚假叙事的范式。

Method: 采用统一的、基于生命周期的C5交互模型（Context, Causes, Content, Cycle of Amplification, Consequences）作为分析框架，整合机器学习与社会科学方法，系统综述了包括协调不真实行为（CIB）分析、流行病学建模、Hawkes过程、高维嵌入空间异常检测、多层图上的无监督协调检测以及智能体AI系统在内的多种主动检测技术。

Result: 提出了一个系统性的、基于生命周期的综述，展示了从被动检测向主动检测的范式转变，并识别了GenAI带来的关键挑战（如快速变化的威胁追踪和多层级分布漂移）。

Conclusion: 需要构建面向新兴合成威胁的主动、可预期且具有韧性的检测系统，未来研究应聚焦于异常簇的检测与韧性信息生态系统的建设。

Original Abstract: The proliferation of adversarial synthetic content, accelerated by Generative AI (GenAI) is rendering traditional reactive detection methods ineffective. This survey synthesizes emerging research to demonstrate a paradigm shift toward the proactive detection of emerging inauthentic narratives. In this survey, we adopt a unified, lifecycle-based taxonomy to combine socio-technical lifecycle models of adversarial campaigns with advanced computational methodologies for emerging inauthentic narrative detection. By structuring the analysis around the C5 Interaction Model (Context, Causes, Content, Cycle of Amplification, Consequences), we integrate different research streams from machine learning and social science. To differentiate spread patterns of synthetic amplification from authentic baseline traffic, this paper surveys state-of-the-art techniques for modeling the creation, seeding, and propagation of fresh narratives, including the analysis of Coordinated Inauthentic Behavior (CIB), epidemiological modeling, and Hawkes process. This survey also provides a systematic review of proactive detection methods for adversarial threats at different stages in the C5 interaction model, specifically, anomaly detection in high-dimensional embedding spaces, unsupervised coordination detection on multi-layer graphs, and agentic AI systems. Finally, this survey addresses challenges posed by GenAI, including the difficulty of tracking rapidly changing threats and multi-level distributional drift, and it outlines a future research agenda focused on detecting anomalous clusters and building anticipatory and resilient systems. This survey provides a comprehensive, lifecycle-based review of methods for the proactive detection of emerging synthetic threats for more resilient information ecosystems.

中文摘要翻译: 由生成式AI加速的对抗性合成内容的泛滥，使得传统的被动式检测方法失效。本综述整合新兴研究，论证了向主动检测新兴虚假叙事的范式转变。我们采用统一的、基于生命周期的分类法，将对抗性活动的社会技术生命周期模型与用于新兴虚假叙事检测的先进计算方法相结合。通过围绕C5交互模型（上下文、原因、内容、放大循环、后果）构建分析，我们整合了机器学习和社会科学的不同研究流。为区分合成放大模式与真实基线流量，本文综述了建模新叙事创建、播种和传播的最先进技术，包括协调不真实行为分析、流行病学建模和霍克斯过程。本综述还系统回顾了C5交互模型不同阶段中针对对抗性威胁的主动检测方法，具体包括高维嵌入空间中的异常检测、多层图上的无监督协调检测以及智能体AI系统。最后，本综述探讨了GenAI带来的挑战，包括追踪快速变化威胁和多层级分布漂移的困难，并勾勒了专注于检测异常簇以及构建可预期和韧性系统的未来研究议程。本综述提供了关于新兴合成威胁主动检测方法的全面、基于生命周期的回顾，以构建更具韧性的信息生态系统。

</details>


### [234] [Geometric Erasure by Contrastive Velocity Matching in Rectified Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00140)
*Jonas Henry Grebe,Tobias Braun,Anna Rohrbach,Marcus Rohrbach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GEM提出了一种面向Rectified Flow Transformer的高效概念擦除框架，通过将轨迹级遗忘与教师引导统一，实现了对不良概念的精准抑制而不损害良性生成。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 随着多模态生成模型的广泛应用，有害内容合成、深度伪造和版权侵权等风险日益增加。概念擦除作为一种防护手段已得到关注，但现有研究主要基于U-Net扩散模型，未能跟上向Rectified Flow Transformers过渡的趋势，亟需针对新型架构的有效擦除方法。

Method: 建立了一个基于轨迹的遗忘（Generative Flow Networks）与经典教师引导擦除之间的原则性桥梁。具体而言，教师模型提供互补的吸引和排斥信号，并将这些信号组合成单一的几何引导目标，实现对目标概念的定向抑制，同时保持良性内容的生成质量。

Result: GEM框架在Rectified Flow模型上实现了简单而高效的概念擦除，在抑制不受欢迎概念的同时保持了良性生成能力，统一了两类范式的优势。

Conclusion: GEM为Rectified Flow模型提供了一种简洁有效的概念擦除方案，通过统一轨迹级遗忘与教师引导范式，为该领域向新型生成模型架构的过渡提供了可行的技术路径。

Original Abstract: While the rapid adoption of multimodal generative models offers immense potential, it has also increased the risks of harmful content synthesis, deepfakes, and copyright infringements. To address these challenges, concept erasure has emerged as a prospective safeguard. However, as the field gradually transitions from U-Net-based diffusion models to Rectified Flow Transformers, erasure research has struggled to keep pace. In this work, we introduce GEM, a simple but highly effective erasure framework for Rectified Flow models. As part of our contribution, we establish a principled bridge between trajectory-based unlearning grounded in Generative Flow Networks and classic teacher-guided erasure: we translate trajectory-based signals into a teacher-guided flow-matching setup that unifies the strengths of both paradigms. Concretely, a teacher provides complementary attraction and repulsion signals that we combine into a single geometric guidance objective, yielding targeted suppression of unwanted concepts while preserving benign generation.

中文摘要翻译: 尽管多模态生成模型的快速应用带来了巨大潜力，但也增加了有害内容合成、深度伪造和版权侵权的风险。为应对这些挑战，概念擦除作为一种前瞻性防护手段应运而生。然而，随着该领域逐渐从基于U-Net的扩散模型向Rectified Flow Transformer过渡，擦除研究未能同步跟进。本文提出了GEM，一个面向Rectified Flow模型的简单而高效的概念擦除框架。作为本文的贡献之一，我们在基于生成流网络（Generative Flow Networks）的轨迹级遗忘与经典教师引导擦除之间建立了原则性桥梁：将轨迹级信号转化为教师引导的流匹配设置，统一了两类范式的优势。具体而言，教师模型提供互补的吸引和排斥信号，我们将这些信号组合成一个单一的几何引导目标，在保持良性生成能力的同时实现对目标概念的选择性抑制。

</details>


### [235] [DAGGER: Gradient-Free Construction of Transiently Amplifying Networks under Hard Connectivity Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01227)
*James C. Ferguson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DAGGER算法，一种无梯度、单次前向传播的方法，能在保持符号、稀疏性和对角约束的前提下，为稳定稀疏矩阵赋予瞬态非正态放大能力，峰值放大倍数可达10^10，且比梯度方法减少30-100倍特征分解计算量。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有构建具有瞬态非正态放大能力的网络（如生物连接组和结构化RNN初始化）的方法，要么需要基于梯度的局部搜索（需大量内循环特征分解），要么使用破坏约束的Schur形式直接构造。亟需一种在硬约束（符号/稀疏性/对角）下高效构造放大网络的方法。

Method: 提出DAGGER（有向无环图引导边重新加权）算法。这是一个无梯度的单次前向传播算法，输入稳定有符号稀疏矩阵，输出保持相同符号、稀疏性和对角结构的矩阵。通过一个标量β控制Wasserstein-2预算，在精确多重集保留（β=0）与放大之间平滑权衡。

Result: DAGGER在单次前向传播中匹配或超越基于梯度方法的多重集保留性能，特征分解次数减少30-100倍；峰值放大倍数随β增长理论上无界，经验上可达10^10；在中等β值下，在连接性精确保留的条件下，放大性能优于梯度方法数个数量级。

Conclusion: DAGGER是一种高效且结构独特的瞬态放大网络构造方法，在严格约束下实现了前所未有的放大性能与计算效率，在下游信号检测任务中也优于现有方法。

Original Abstract: Many networks not only support but also rely on transient non-normal amplification, an orders-of-magnitude increase in the activity of an otherwise stable system. Constructing such networks under hard sign/sparsity/diagonal constraints -- the regime relevant for biological connectomes and structured RNN initializations -- has so far required either gradient-based local search with thousands of inner-loop eigendecompositions or Schur-form direct construction in an abstract basis that breaks the constraints under projection.
  Here we introduce DAGGER (Directed Acyclic Graph Guided Edge Reweighting), a gradient-free single-pass algorithm. Given a stable signed sparse matrix, DAGGER produces an output with the same sign, sparsity, and diagonal. A single scalar $β$ controls a Wasserstein-2 budget that smoothly trades exact multiset preservation ($β= 0$) for amplification; peak amplification grows essentially without bound with $β$, empirically reaching $10^{10}$ before numerical overflow.
  DAGGER matches or exceeds gradient-based methods at multiset preservation in a single forward pass -- 30-100$\times$ fewer eigendecompositions than a typical gradient inner loop -- and at moderate $β$ beats them by orders of magnitude with connectivity exactly preserved. We develop the algorithm, compare it to the existing methods and on a downstream signal-detection task, and examine the diagnostics that show why DAGGER is structurally different from other amplifying networks.

中文摘要翻译: 许多网络不仅支持、而且依赖于瞬态非正态放大——即一个原本稳定的系统活性出现数量级级别的增长。在硬性符号/稀疏性/对角约束下（这是生物连接组和结构化RNN初始化的相关设定），构建此类网络此前要么需要基于梯度的局部搜索（需数千次内循环特征分解），要么在抽象基中使用Schur形式直接构造（该方法在投影下会破坏约束）。本文提出DAGGER（有向无环图引导边重新加权），一种无梯度的单次前向传播算法。给定一个稳定的有符号稀疏矩阵，DAGGER输出具有相同符号、稀疏性和对角结构的矩阵。单个标量β控制一个Wasserstein-2预算，该预算在精确多重集保留（β=0）与放大之间平滑权衡；峰值放大倍数随β增长理论上无界，经验上在数值溢出前可达10^10。DAGGER在单次前向传播中匹配或超越基于梯度方法的多重集保留性能——特征分解次数比典型梯度内循环少30-100倍——并且在中等β值下，在连接性精确保留的条件下，放大性能优于梯度方法数个数量级。我们开发了该算法，将其与现有方法及下游信号检测任务进行对比，并考察了证明DAGGER在结构上与其他放大网络存在差异的诊断指标。

</details>


### [236] [Adaptive data selection improves wearable prediction under low baseline performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00141)
*Ali Kargarandehkordi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究可穿戴健康系统中自适应感知策略在固定数据预算下的个体差异收益，发现自适应策略对基线表现差的参与者提升显著（AUROC最高提升0.7），而对基线好的参与者提升有限甚至为负，表明自适应感知并非普遍有益，应根据基线表现选择性部署。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 自适应感知策略虽被广泛用于可穿戴健康系统以在有限数据预算下提升预测性能，但其收益在不同个体间的差异尚不清楚，本文旨在系统评估这种个体差异性。

Method: 在纵向可穿戴数据集中，针对心率、活动和生态瞬时评估（EMA）多种传感模态，在固定测量预算下评估自适应选择时间窗口进行模型训练的效果，以随机采样为基线，使用AUROC和F1分数量化性能提升。

Result: 自适应策略对基线表现低的参与者AUROC提升显著（最高达0.7），对基线好的参与者提升有限或为负；自适应增益与基线性能呈强负相关（Pearson r=-0.67, Spearman ρ=-0.62）；60-80%的参与者在AUROC上受益，但F1提升较小且一致性较差。

Conclusion: 自适应感知并非对所有个体均有益，其最大价值体现在低基线性能场景中；应基于基线表现进行选择性部署，以提高可穿戴健康监测的效率。

Original Abstract: Adaptive sensing strategies that selectively sample data are increasingly used in wearable health systems to improve prediction performance under limited data budgets, yet their benefits across individuals remain poorly understood. Here, we evaluate adaptive selection of time windows for model training under fixed measurement budgets across multiple sensing modalities, including heart rate, activity, and ecological momentary assessment (EMA), in a longitudinal wearable dataset. We quantify performance gains relative to random sampling using both area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and F1 score. Adaptive strategies yield substantial improvements in AUROC for participants with low baseline performance (with gains up to 0.7), while offering limited or negative gains for participants with strong baselines. Across modalities, adaptive gain is strongly inversely correlated with baseline performance (Pearson r = -0.67; Spearman p = -0.62). At the participant level, most individuals benefit in AUROC (60-80% across modalities), although improvements in F1 are smaller and less consistent. These findings show that adaptive sensing is not uniformly beneficial, but instead provides the greatest value in underperforming settings. Our results support selective deployment strategies that tailor adaptive sensing based on baseline performance to improve efficiency in wearable health monitoring.

中文摘要翻译: 在可穿戴健康系统中，自适应感知策略（adaptive sensing strategies）通过选择性采样数据，在有限数据预算下提升预测性能，但其在不同个体间的收益尚不明确。本文在一项纵向可穿戴数据集中，针对心率、活动和生态瞬时评估（EMA）等多种传感模态，评估在固定测量预算下自适应选择时间窗口进行模型训练的效果。我们以随机采样为基线，使用受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）和F1分数量化性能提升。结果表明，对于基线表现较低的参与者，自适应策略带来了显著的AUROC提升（增益最高达0.7），而对于基线表现较好的参与者，增益有限甚至为负。跨模态分析显示，自适应增益与基线性能呈强烈负相关（Pearson r = -0.67；Spearman ρ = -0.62）。在个体层面，大多数参与者在AUROC上受益（各模态为60-80%），但F1分数的提升较小且一致性较差。这些发现表明，自适应感知并非普遍有益，而是在低表现场景中提供最大价值。我们的结果支持根据基线表现定制自适应感知的选择性部署策略，以提高可穿戴健康监测的效率。

</details>


### [237] [BudgetDraft: Acceptance-Aware Multi-View Training for Sparse-KV Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00144)
*Liang He,Jingbo Wen,Qishi Zhan,Yixiong Chen,Kangning Cui,Qizhen Lan,Xilu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BudgetDraft，一种针对中长文本推理中稀疏推测解码的多视图稀疏训练方法，通过让起草器在训练中接触多种KV缓存预算并与共享的全缓存教师对齐，解决稀疏/全缓存不匹配导致的接受率下降问题，在4K-16K上下文长度下实现2.10x-6.55x的端到端加速。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 在资源受限的中长文本推理（4K-16K上下文长度）中，现有的稀疏/全缓存推测解码方法随着上下文增长会出现稀疏与全缓存之间的不匹配问题，导致token接受率迅速下降，从而降低加速效果。

Method: BudgetDraft采用多视图稀疏训练方法：(1) 在训练中将起草器暴露于多种采样的KV缓存预算下；(2) 让每个稀疏视图与一个共享的全缓存教师目标对齐；(3) 结合全缓存分支上的接受率感知损失和稀疏缓存分支上的多视图损失，训练出单一的对预算鲁棒的起草器，无需额外推理组件。

Result: 在PG-19、LongBench和LWM数据集上，与自回归解码相比，BudgetDraft在4K、8K和16K上下文长度下分别实现最高6.55倍、4.46倍和2.10倍的端到端加速，同时保持推理管线内存友好。

Conclusion: BudgetDraft通过多视图稀疏训练有效解决了中长文本推理中稀疏推测解码的稀疏/全缓存不匹配问题，在显著加速推理的同时保持了较低的内存占用。

Original Abstract: Speculative decoding speeds up autoregressive decoding by using a drafter to propose multiple tokens that a verifier validates in parallel. In resource-constrained deployments, the drafter uses a sparse KV cache to limit peak GPU memory and end-to-end latency under a fixed KV budget, while the verifier keeps a full KV cache. Mid-to-long context inference (4K--16K context length) is common in real applications. However, naive sparse/full speculative decoding suffers from the sparse/full mismatch as context length grows, causing the acceptance rate to drop quickly. We propose BudgetDraft, a multi-view sparse training method for sparse drafting in mid-to-long inference. The drafter is exposed to multiple sampled KV budgets during training and learns to align each sparse view with one shared full-cache teacher target. BudgetDraft combines an acceptance-aware loss on a full-cache branch with a multi-view loss on a sparse-cache branch, producing a single budget-robust drafter that recovers acceptance across sparsity levels without extra inference-time components. Experimental results on PG-19, LongBench, and LWM show that BudgetDraft achieves up to 6.55x, 4.46x, and 2.10x end-to-end speedup vs AR at 4K, 8K, and 16K context lengths, while keeping the inference pipeline memory-friendly.

中文摘要翻译: 推测解码通过让起草器提出多个token并由验证器并行验证来加速自回归解码。在资源受限的部署场景中，起草器使用稀疏KV缓存来限制峰值GPU内存和端到端延迟（在固定KV预算下），而验证器则保持完整的KV缓存。中长上下文推理（4K--16K上下文长度）在实际应用中很常见。然而，随着上下文长度增长，朴素的稀疏/全缓存推测解码会遭受稀疏/全缓存不匹配问题，导致接受率快速下降。我们提出BudgetDraft，一种用于中长推理中稀疏起草的多视图稀疏训练方法。起草器在训练中暴露于多种采样的KV缓存预算，并学习将每个稀疏视图与一个共享的全缓存教师目标对齐。BudgetDraft将全缓存分支上的接受率感知损失与稀疏缓存分支上的多视图损失相结合，产生一个单一的对预算鲁棒的起草器，无需额外推理组件即可恢复不同稀疏度下的接受率。在PG-19、LongBench和LWM上的实验结果表明，与自回归解码相比，BudgetDraft在4K、8K和16K上下文长度下分别实现了最高6.55倍、4.46倍和2.10倍的端到端加速，同时保持推理管线内存友好。

</details>


### [238] [RAFT: Data Refinement and Adaptive Distillation for Domain Fine-Tuning with Alleviated Forgetting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00147)
*Yuduo Li,Xiaofeng Shi,Qian Kou,Longbin Yu,Hua Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对领域微调导致通用能力退化的问题，提出RAFT框架，通过数据精炼（自条件重写、语义过滤、答案融合）和自适应蒸馏（基于答案条件的学生轨迹蒸馏），显著提升领域性能并缓解遗忘。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 领域SFT在提升领域性能的同时会损害模型通用能力，其根源有两个实践差距：监督兼容性差距（领域目标与模型自然响应在风格和推理格式上不匹配）和轨迹保持差距（教师强制SFT优化固定目标token，未约束模型在自身生成前缀上的行为）。现有方法未能同时解决这两个问题。

Method: RAFT是一个两阶段框架。第一阶段为数据精炼：通过自条件重写使领域数据与模型风格兼容，结合语义过滤和答案融合构建模型兼容的监督。第二阶段为答案条件在线策略蒸馏：以融合答案为条件，让原始指令微调模型在学生模型自身生成的轨迹上提供软目标，并引入Top-K温度蒸馏和EMA自适应损失平衡来稳定领域-通用权衡。

Result: 在3个指令微调基座模型和5个领域上，RAFT相比标准SFT平均领域准确率提升23.2%；在MS-Bench和IFEval上分别相对改善18.2%和10.2%，有效恢复了SFT导致的通用能力退化。

Conclusion: 将数据精炼与轨迹级保持相结合，为领域微调时缓解遗忘提供了有效方案。RAFT证明了耦合数据预处理和训练策略能更好地平衡领域性能与通用能力。

Original Abstract: Domain-specific supervised fine-tuning (SFT) often improves in-domain performance at the cost of degrading a model's general capabilities. We view this degradation through two practical gaps in domain SFT: a supervision-compatibility gap, where domain targets differ in style and reasoning format from the original model's natural responses, and a trajectory-preservation gap, where teacher-forced SFT optimizes fixed target tokens without constraining the model's behavior on its own generated prefixes. This process fails to preserve the model's original behavior. We propose RAFT (Data Refinement and Adaptive Distillation for Domain Fine-Tuning with Alleviated Forgetting), a two-stage framework that addresses both factors. First, RAFT constructs model-compatible supervision through self-conditioned rewriting, semantic filtering, and answer fusion. Second, RAFT performs Answer-Conditioned On-Policy Distillation, where the original instruction-tuned model provides soft targets on student-generated trajectories while being conditioned on the fused answer as helpful context. We further introduce top-K temperature distillation and EMA-based adaptive loss balancing to stabilize the domain-general trade-off.
