TL;DR: CrysLDNet 是一种基于潜在扩散的预训练框架，通过结合变分自编码器与扩散模型，从大规模无标签晶体数据中学习结构-化学语义，显著提升了数据稀缺场景下的晶体性质预测性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有图神经网络和Transformer模型在晶体性质预测中表现优异，但严重依赖大量标注数据。实际中晶体性质标注数据稀缺，而预训练-微调策略（尤其是基于扩散模型的方法）有望缓解这一问题。

Method: 提出CrysLDNet框架：在预训练阶段，使用变分自编码器（VAE）将3D晶体结构映射到平滑的潜在空间，然后在该潜在空间中应用扩散过程进行预训练，使图编码器从大规模无标签数据中捕获结构语义和化学语义；预训练后对特定性质预测任务进行微调。

Result: 在JARVIS和MP数据集上，CrysLDNet相比从头训练和预训练基线分别提升4.26%和4.90%；在稀疏数据条件下保持鲁棒性，且利用有限实验数据微调后能够修正DFT误差。

Conclusion: CrysLDNet有效缓解了晶体性质预测中的数据稀缺问题，性能显著优于现有方法，且在数据稀疏和实验数据有限场景下表现稳健。

Original Abstract: Fast and accurate prediction of crystal properties is a central challenge in new materials design. Graph neural networks and Transformer-based models have emerged as powerful tools for this task due to their ability to encode the local structural environment of atoms within a crystal. However, these models are data-hungry, and in practice, labeled data for crystal properties are scarce. Pretraining-finetuning strategies, particularly those based on diffusion models, have shown promise in addressing these limitations. In this work, we introduce a novel latent diffusion based pretraining framework, CrysLDNet, designed to mitigate data scarcity. Our approach integrates a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) with a diffusion model during the pretraining stage. The VAE encoder maps 3D crystal structures into a smooth latent space within which the diffusion process is applied. This latent diffusion pretraining enables the graph encoder to effectively capture structural and chemical semantics from large-scale unlabeled data, which can then be finetuned for specific property prediction tasks. Comprehensive experiments on popular DFT datasets for property prediction reveal that CrysLDNet significantly outperforms both training-from-scratch and pretrained baselines, with improvements of 4.26% and 4.90% on the JARVIS and MP datasets, respectively. Additionally, the learned representations remain robust in sparse-data conditions and are expressive enough to correct DFT errors when finetuned with limited experimental data. Code is available at: https://github.com/shrimonmuke0202/CrysLDNet.git.

中文摘要翻译: 晶体性质的快速准确预测是新材料设计中的核心挑战。图神经网络和基于Transformer的模型因其能够编码晶体中原子的局部结构环境而成为完成该任务的强大工具。然而，这些模型对数据需求量大，而实践中晶体性质的标注数据十分稀缺。预训练-微调策略（特别是基于扩散模型的策略）在解决这些限制方面展现出了潜力。在这项工作中，我们引入了一个新颖的基于潜在扩散的预训练框架CrysLDNet，旨在缓解数据稀缺问题。我们的方法在预训练阶段将变分自编码器（VAE）与扩散模型相结合。VAE编码器将3D晶体结构映射到一个平滑的潜在空间，在该空间内施加扩散过程。这种潜在扩散预训练使图编码器能够从大规模无标签数据中有效捕获结构语义和化学语义，随后可针对特定性质预测任务进行微调。在用于性质预测的流行DFT数据集上进行的综合实验表明，CrysLDNet在JARVIS和MP数据集上分别以4.26%和4.90%的提升显著优于从头训练和预训练基线。此外，学习到的表示在稀疏数据条件下保持鲁棒性，且在利用有限实验数据微调时具有足够的表达能力来修正DFT误差。代码已开源。

</details>


### [334] [Behavior-Invariant Task Representation Learning with Transformer-based World Models for Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00780)
*Fuyuan Qian,Menglong Zhang,Song Wang,Quanying Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合信息论任务表示学习与基于Transformer的随机世界模型的离线元强化学习框架，通过不变任务表征和保守价值惩罚缓解上下文与策略分布偏移，在稀疏奖励和分布外场景下取得了优于现有方法的稳定性和泛化能力。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 离线元强化学习面临上下文分布偏移和策略分布偏移两大挑战，在稀疏奖励场景下问题加剧，导致智能体陷入固有的模式困境，无法实现鲁棒的泛化能力。

Method: 提出集成信息论任务表示学习与基于Transformer的随机世界模型的框架。通过提取对行为策略不变的任务定义潜变量来缓解上下文分布偏移；同时，对基于想象轨迹的rollout施加保守价值惩罚，防止策略利用模型不准确性，从而处理策略偏移和模型过度利用问题。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在分布外和稀疏奖励场景下优于当前最先进的方法，具有更优越的稳定性和泛化能力。

Conclusion: 所提出的框架能有效缓解离线元强化学习中的分布偏移问题，实现鲁棒的泛化性能。

Original Abstract: Offline meta-reinforcement learning leverages static datasets to enable agents to generalize to unseen environments by combining offline efficiency with meta-learning adaptability, yet it faces key challenges from context and policy distribution shifts. These issues hinder agents from adapting to online environments, and are further exacerbated under sparse-reward settings. As a result, agents often become trapped in an inherent pattern dilemma, failing to achieve robust generalization. In this work, we propose a novel framework that integrates information-theoretic task representation learning with a Transformer-based stochastic world model. Our approach extracts task-defining latent variables that are invariant to behavior policy, thereby effectively mitigating the context distribution shift. To further handle policy shift and model exploitation, we apply a conservative value penalty to imagination-based rollouts, preventing the policy from exploiting model inaccuracies while maintaining robust adaptation. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, with superior stability and generalization under out-of-distribution and sparse-reward settings.

中文摘要翻译: 离线元强化学习利用静态数据集，通过结合离线效率与元学习适应性使智能体能够泛化到未见环境，但上下文分布偏移和策略分布偏移带来的关键挑战阻碍了智能体对在线环境的适应，并且在稀疏奖励场景下这些问题进一步加剧。因此，智能体常常陷入固有的模式困境，无法实现鲁棒的泛化。本文提出了一种新颖的框架，将信息论任务表示学习与基于Transformer的随机世界模型相结合。我们的方法提取对行为策略不变的任务定义潜变量，从而有效缓解上下文分布偏移。为了进一步处理策略偏移和模型过度利用，我们对基于想象轨迹的rollout施加保守价值惩罚，防止策略利用模型的不准确性，同时保持鲁棒的适应性。大量实验表明，我们的方法在分布外和稀疏奖励场景下优于当前最先进的方法，具有更优越的稳定性和泛化能力。

</details>


### [335] [Extending Causal Metamodeling to a non-Markovian Queue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00795)
*Pracheta Amaranath,Anant Bhide,David Jensen,Peter Haas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将模块化动态贝叶斯网络（MDBN）从马尔可夫系统扩展到非马尔可夫队列系统，通过相位型分布近似非指数分布，首次实现了对非马尔可夫系统的因果元建模，在G/M/1队列上验证了其准确性和显著加速效果。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 以往的MDBN元模型只能处理马尔可夫系统，而现实中的离散事件仿真往往涉及非指数分布（非马尔可夫过程），因此需要将MDBN扩展到非马尔可夫队列，以支持更广泛的系统仿真加速。

Method: 使用相位型分布来近似非指数分布，从而将非马尔可夫系统转化为可被MDBN建模的形式；同时解决相位数量选择（平衡精度与可计算性）、元模型参数高效学习以及离散时间MDBN采样间隔选择等关键挑战。

Result: 在G/M/1队列上的实验表明，MDBN能够准确回答概率和因果查询，相比直接仿真实现了数量级的推理加速。

Conclusion: 本文初步解决了将MDBN扩展到非马尔可夫系统所面临的若干挑战，首次提出了适用于非马尔可夫系统的因果元建模技术，展示了其在实际应用中的潜力。

Original Abstract: Metamodels for discrete-event simulations approximate the behavior of simulation models without running expensive simulations. Prior work introduced modular dynamic Bayesian networks (MDBNs) -- a class of metamodels that can estimate a range of probabilistic and causal queries (PCQs) using a single, trained model -- but the method was limited to Markovian systems. In this paper, we initiate an extension of MDBNs to non-Markovian queues by approximating non-exponential distributions using phase-type distributions. This approach raises novel challenges, including balancing metamodeling accuracy and tractability when choosing the number of phases, efficiently learning metamodel parameters, and choosing the sampling interval that is used to approximate a continuous-time simulation by a discrete-time MDBN. We provide preliminary solutions to these challenges, yielding the first causal metamodeling technique for non-Markovian systems. Experiments on a G/M/1 queue demonstrate that the MDBN can produce accurate answers to PCQs with orders-of-magnitude speedup of inference times relative to direct simulation.

中文摘要翻译: 用于离散事件仿真的元模型可以在不运行昂贵仿真的情况下近似仿真模型的行为。以往的工作引入了模块化动态贝叶斯网络（MDBN）——一类能够使用单个训练模型估计多种概率和因果查询（PCQs）的元模型——但该方法仅限于马尔可夫系统。在本文中，我们通过使用相位型分布近似非指数分布，启动了对MDBN向非马尔可夫队列的扩展。这种方法带来了新的挑战，包括在相位数量选择上平衡元建模精度与可计算性、高效学习元模型参数，以及选择用于将连续时间仿真近似为离散时间MDBN的采样间隔。我们为这些挑战提供了初步解决方案，从而首次提出了针对非马尔可夫系统的因果元建模技术。在G/M/1队列上的实验证明，MDBN能够为概率和因果查询生成准确的答案，且推理时间相比直接仿真实现了数量级的加速。

</details>


### [336] [Safe-Subspace Pseudo-Label Refinement for Source-Free Graph Domain Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00808)
*Yingxu Wang,Xinwang Liu,Siyang Gao,Nan Yin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对无源图域适应（SF-GDA）中伪标签可靠性问题，提出了一种基于安全子空间的选择性伪标签精炼框架（S$^2$PLR），通过语义和结构双重证据筛选可靠样本进行硬标签监督，对不确定样本采用噪声容忍的软正则化，从而在无源场景下实现鲁棒的图域适应。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 在无源图域适应中，源图不可访问，目标图面临特征和拓扑偏移，导致源模型的伪标签可能出现高置信度错误，而图消息传递机制会放大这些系统性误差。现有方法假设全局有界的伪标签噪声，这在实践中难以满足。因此，需要一种更精细的选择性伪标签策略来应对这一挑战。

Method: 提出SafeSubspace Pseudo-Label Refinement (S$^2$PLR)框架：1) 利用源委员会置信度与分歧度估计语义可靠性；2) 通过图对比学习学习目标域内在的结构表示；3) 通过邻域一致性验证伪标签；4) 对筛选出的可靠样本施加硬伪标签监督，对不确定样本采用噪声容忍的软正则化。核心是识别一个置信度一致的安全子空间，在此子空间上伪标签噪声可控。

Result: 在图像和真实世界图基准数据集上，针对不同类型的域偏移实验表明，S$^2$PLR在多种无源迁移设置下均能取得鲁棒且有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 通过识别安全子空间并将硬标签监督仅限于语义和结构双重证据支持的样本，可以有效地控制伪标签噪声，实现可靠的源无关图域适应。

Original Abstract: Source-free graph domain adaptation (SF-GDA) aims to adapt source-trained graph models to unlabeled target graphs when source graphs are no longer accessible. A central obstacle is pseudo-label reliability: under feature and topological shifts, source-induced predictions may become confidently wrong, and indiscriminate self-training can amplify systematic errors through graph message passing. This paper studies SF-GDA from a selective pseudo-labeling perspective. Instead of assuming globally bounded pseudo-label noise over the entire target domain, we identify a confidence-consistent safe subspace on which pseudo-label noise can be controlled under restricted posterior discrepancy, and derive a target-risk decomposition that separates safe-subspace fitting error, selected-label noise, and uncertain-set risk. Guided by this analysis, we propose SafeSubspace Pseudo-Label Refinement (S$^2$PLR), a source-free graph adaptation framework that applies hard pseudo-label supervision only to target graphs supported by both semantic and structural evidence. Specifically, S$^2$PLR estimates semantic reliability using source-committee confidence and disagreement, learns a targetintrinsic structural representation via graph contrastive learning, verifies pseudo-labels through neighborhood consistency, and exploits the remaining uncertain samples with noise-tolerant soft regularization rather than unreliable hard labels. Experiments on image and real-world graph benchmarks under different domain shifts demonstrate that S$^2$PLR achieves robust and competitive performance across diverse source-free transfer settings.

中文摘要翻译: 无源图域适应（SF-GDA）旨在当源图不可访问时，将源训练的图模型适应到未标注的目标图上。一个核心障碍是伪标签的可靠性：在特征和拓扑偏移下，源模型诱导的预测可能以高置信度出错，而 indiscriminate 自训练会通过图消息传递放大系统性误差。本文从选择性伪标签的视角研究无源图域适应。我们不假设整个目标域上伪标签噪声全局有界，而是识别出一个置信度一致的安全子空间，在该子空间上伪标签噪声受限于受限的后验差异，并推导出一个将安全子空间拟合误差、所选标签噪声和不确定集风险分离的目标风险分解式。受此分析启发，我们提出了SafeSubspace 伪标签精炼（S$^2$PLR），一种无源图适应框架，该框架仅对同时受到语义和结构证据支持的目标图施加硬伪标签监督。具体来说，S$^2$PLR 使用源委员会置信度和分歧度估计语义可靠性，通过图对比学习学习目标域内在的结构表示，通过邻域一致性验证伪标签，并对剩余不确定样本采用噪声容忍的软正则化而非不可靠的硬标签。在图像和真实世界图基准数据集上针对不同类型域偏移的实验表明，S$^2$PLR 在多种无源迁移设置下均能取得鲁棒且有竞争力的性能。

</details>


### [337] [OmniEEG-Bench: A Standardized Evaluation Benchmark for EEG Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00815)
*Ziling Lu,Zongsheng Li,Xinke Shen,Kexin Lou,Yingyue Xin,Xiaoqi Chen,Shinan Wang,Xiang Chen,Jiahao Fan,Chenyu Huang,Xin Xu,Zhoujie Hou,Chen Wei,Quanying Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OmniEEG-Bench是一个统一的EEG基础模型基准测试平台，涵盖6大任务家族、54个数据集，通过标准化评估揭示了EEG基础模型的规模缩放规律：更大、更多样化的预训练数据与更大模型规模共同决定模型性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有EEG基础模型评估因数据集异构和任务协议不一致而碎片化，缺乏统一的基准测试平台，导致不同模型之间难以公平比较，阻碍了该领域的系统发展。

Method: 构建OmniEEG-Bench基准，包含6大任务家族（信号可靠性、生物特征与疾病、意识与状态、认知与情绪、自然刺激解码、运动与交互）、54个统一评估协议的EEG数据集、任务卡规范标准化部署与指标，并以此基准对10个代表性EEG基础模型进行系统评测。

Result: 预训练数据集的多样性和模型规模均与跨数据集的平均排名显著相关，揭示了EEG基础模型中的缩放律行为：扩大模型需要更丰富多样的预训练数据。

Conclusion: EEG基础模型的规模化不仅需要更大的网络架构，还需要更广泛、更多样化的预训练数据。

Original Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) supports a variety of brain-computer interface (BCI) tasks ranging from brain-state monitoring to human-LLM interactions. EEG foundation models are emerging, but evaluation remains fragmented due to heterogeneous datasets and nconsistent task protocols. Here, we introduce OmniEEG-Bench, a unified benchmark and downstream task roadmap for EEG foundation models (FMs). It organizes evaluation of EEG FMs into six task families spanning (i) signal reliability, (ii) biometrics and disease, (iii) consciousness and state, (iv) cognition and emotion, (v) naturalistic stimulus decoding, and (vi) motor and interaction, introducing a new generation of tasks not systematically benchmarked in prior EEG FM work. OmniEEG-Bench standardizes model deployment, task definitions, and metrics through a task-card specification, and unifies 54 EEG datasets with consistent evaluation protocols. We benchmark 10 representative EEG foundation models and report a leaderboard that covers diverse evaluation settings. Both pretraining dataset diversity and model size are significantly associated with better average ranks across datasets, revealing scaling-law behavior in EEG foundation models (Figure 1). These results suggest that scaling EEG foundation models requires not only larger architectures but also broader and more diverse pretraining data. The benchmark code is available at https://github.com/ncclab-sustech/omni-eegbench.git.

中文摘要翻译: 脑电图（EEG）支持从脑状态监测到人-大语言模型交互等多种脑机接口（BCI）任务。EEG基础模型正在兴起，但由于数据集异质性和不一致的任务协议，评估仍然分散。本文提出OmniEEG-Bench，一个用于EEG基础模型（FMs）的统一基准测试和下游任务路线图。它将EEG基础模型的评估组织为六大任务家族：（i）信号可靠性、（ii）生物特征与疾病、（iii）意识与状态、（iv）认知与情绪、（v）自然刺激解码以及（vi）运动与交互，引入了先前EEG基础模型工作中未系统基准测试的新一代任务。OmniEEG-Bench通过任务卡规范标准化模型部署、任务定义和评估指标，并统一了54个EEG数据集的一致评估协议。我们对10个代表性EEG基础模型进行了基准测试，并报告了涵盖多种评估设置的排行榜。预训练数据集多样性和模型规模均与跨数据集的平均排名显著相关，揭示了EEG基础模型中的缩放律行为（图1）。这些结果表明，扩展EEG基础模型不仅需要更大的架构，还需要更广泛和更多样化的预训练数据。基准测试代码已开源：https://github.com/ncclab-sustech/omni-eegbench.git。

</details>


### [338] [A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms for Multi-Task Prediction of the Parameters of the Pectin Hydrolysis--Extraction Process](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00821)
*Mullosharaf K. Arabov,Shavkat Yo. Kholov,Zainiddin K. Muhiddin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文利用机器学习方法解决果胶水解提取这一复杂多参数工艺过程的控制问题。基于1000组实验室实验数据，对比了11种回归算法，发现CatBoost表现最佳（R²约0.946），特征重要性分析表明原料类型占主导地位（63.6%），并部署了交互式Web界面，为智能果胶生产控制奠定基础。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 果胶水解提取是一个涉及多变量（温度、压力、时间、pH）的复杂工业过程，传统依赖大量物理实验进行参数优化，成本高、效率低。本文旨在利用机器学习方法替代部分物理实验，实现对该过程的智能控制与预测。

Method: 基于1000组实验室实验数据（7种原料、4个过程变量、4个输出指标），构建多任务回归问题。训练并比较11种算法：正则化线性模型、集成方法（随机森林、梯度提升、XGBoost、CatBoost、Extra Trees）、K近邻、支持向量回归、多层感知机。通过超参数优化选取最佳模型，并进行特征重要性分析与可解释性AI分析。

Result: CatBoost在超参数优化后表现最佳，平均R²约0.946；特征重要性分析显示原料类型占63.6%，温度和时间次之；整套流程已导出为生产就绪格式并部署为交互式Web界面。

Conclusion: 集成方法结合严格的统计分析与可解释AI能够显著减少物理实验需求，为智能果胶生产控制提供了有效方案。

Original Abstract: This study addresses the challenge of controlling a complex, multi-parameter technological process -- pectin hydrolysis--extraction -- using machine learning methods. The experimental foundation is a unique database comprising 1,000 laboratory experiments conducted under controlled conditions on seven types of plant raw material with four variable process factors (temperature 85--130 C, pressure 0.9--2.2 atm, holding time 3--10 min, pH 1.5--2.0). Four output characteristics were recorded: pectin yield, galacturonic acid content, molecular weight, and degree of esterification. To solve the multi-task regression problem, 11 algorithms were trained and compared: regularised linear models, ensemble methods (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, CatBoost, Extra Trees), k-nearest neighbours, support vector regression, and a multilayer perceptron. The best results were demonstrated by CatBoost (average R-squared approximately 0.946 after hyperparameter optimisation). Feature importance analysis revealed the dominant role of the raw material type (63.6% of total importance), followed by temperature and holding time. The developed pipeline was exported in a production-ready format and deployed as an interactive web interface. The findings demonstrate that ensemble methods combined with rigorous statistical analysis and interpretable AI significantly reduce the need for physical experiments and form the basis for intelligent pectin production control.

中文摘要翻译: 本研究利用机器学习方法解决复杂多参数工艺过程——果胶水解提取——的控制难题。实验基础是一个独特的数据库，包含在受控条件下对七种类型植物原料、四个过程变量（温度85–130°C、压力0.9–2.2 atm、保持时间3–10 min、pH 1.5–2.0）进行的1000次实验室实验。记录了四种输出特性：果胶产率、半乳糖醛酸含量、分子量和酯化度。为解决多任务回归问题，训练并比较了11种算法：正则化线性模型、集成方法（随机森林、梯度提升、XGBoost、CatBoost、Extra Trees）、K近邻、支持向量回归和多层感知机。最佳结果由CatBoost展示（超参数优化后平均R²约0.946）。特征重要性分析揭示了原料类型的支配性作用（占总重要性的63.6%），其次是温度和时间。所开发的流程已导出为生产就绪格式，并作为交互式Web界面部署。研究结果表明，集成方法结合严格的统计分析和可解释AI能够显著减少物理实验需求，并为智能果胶生产控制奠定基础。

</details>


### [339] [Partial Fairness Awareness: Belief-Guided Strategic Mechanism for Strategic Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00826)
*Xinpeng Lv,Chunyuan Zheng,Yunxin Mao,Renzhe Xu,Hao Zou,Shanzhi Gu,Liyang Xu,Huan Chen,Yuanlong Chen,Wenjing Yang,Haotian Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出部分公平感知（PFA）问题，通过公开公平性约束候选集并隐藏具体约束，结合信念引导的策略机制，在战略分类中缓解公平性暴露困境，实现更低的群体公平差距和更高的合格个体接受率。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有的公平感知战略分类方法面临公平性暴露困境：公开公平性约束会导致策略性操纵和公平性反转，而隐藏约束则可能降低社会福利并阻碍真实改进。为填补这一空白，作者提出部分公平感知（PFA）问题。

Method: 提出部分公平感知（PFA）框架，公开公平性约束候选集并隐藏具体采用的约束（基础约束）；设计信念引导的策略机制，智能体通过迭代交互和反馈，维护并更新对候选集的信念分布，逐步使其信念与系统采用的基础约束对齐。

Result: 在真实和合成数据集上的实验表明，与完全公开或完全隐藏的公平性机制相比，PFA实现了更低的群体公平差距、更高的真正合格个体接受率，以及更稳定的结果。

Conclusion: 部分公平感知策略通过部分透明的方式——公开候选集、隐藏具体约束——能够有效缓解公平性暴露困境，在战略分类中兼顾公平性与社会福利。

Original Abstract: Strategic machine learning investigates scenarios where agents manipulate their features to receive favorable decisions from predictive models. To address fairness concerns intrinsic to strategic classification, recent work has introduced group-specific fairness constraints. However, current fairness-aware approaches face a fundamental dilemma in the issue of fairness exposure: making these constraints public enables strategic manipulation and can lead to fairness reversal, while keeping them hidden may reduce social welfare and discourage genuine improvement. To fill this gap, we subsequently propose the problem of partial fairness awareness (PFA), as our theoretical analysis informs that such a dilemma can be mitigated by releasing the candidate set of fairness constraints and concealing the grounding constraint. To be specific, we introduce a belief-guided strategic mechanism, wherein agents iteratively interact with the decision system and maintain a belief distribution over the candidate set of fairness constraints. This belief-guided process enables agents, through iterative interaction and feedback, to update their belief distribution over the candidate set, thereby gradually aligning their belief with the grounding fairness constraint employed by the system. Extensive experiments on real-world and synthetic datasets demonstrate that PFA achieves lower group fairness gaps, higher acceptance of truly qualified individuals, and more stable outcomes compared to fully public or private fairness regimes.

中文摘要翻译: 战略机器学习研究的是智能体通过操纵自身特征以从预测模型中获得有利决策的场景。为应对战略分类中固有的公平性问题，近期工作引入了群体特定的公平性约束。然而，当前的公平感知方法在公平性暴露问题上面临根本性困境：公开这些约束会导致策略性操纵和公平性反转，而隐藏约束则可能降低社会福利并阻碍真正的改进。为填补这一空白，我们随后提出部分公平感知（PFA）问题，我们的理论分析表明，通过发布公平性约束的候选集并隐藏具体采用的基础约束，可以缓解这一困境。具体而言，我们引入了一种信念引导的策略机制，其中智能体与决策系统进行迭代交互，并维护对公平性约束候选集的信念分布。这一信念引导过程使智能体能够通过迭代交互和反馈，更新其对候选集的信念分布，从而逐步使其信念与系统采用的基础约束对齐。在真实和合成数据集上的大量实验表明，与完全公开或完全隐藏的公平性机制相比，PFA实现了更低的群体公平差距、更高的真正合格个体接受率，以及更稳定的结果。

</details>


### [340] [Beyond Independent Manipulation: Individual Fairness-aware Strategic Classification with Peer Imitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00827)
*Xinpeng Lv,Chunyuan Zheng,Yunxin Mao,Renzhe Xu,Jinxuan Yang,Yuanlong Chen,Wangrong Huang,Shaowu Yang,Wenjing Yang,Xinwang Liu,Peng Cui,Haotian Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出IFSC框架，针对个体公平性需求下智能体策略性操纵的相互依赖问题，通过模仿已被正分类的同侪进行特征操纵，并采用鲁棒学习处理同侪可观测性的不确定性，实验证明该方法能提升个体公平一致性并减少模仿导致的分布扭曲。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有公平感知的策略性分类研究主要关注群体公平，且假设智能体独立做出操纵决策。然而，当要求个体公平性（相似个体获得相似结果）时，智能体的操纵行为会相互依赖——个体的最优操纵策略取决于邻居的结果。这导致经典SC公式与公平感知决策环境之间存在错配，独立模型无法准确刻画策略性操纵。

Method: 提出个体公平感知策略性分类（IFSC）框架，将策略性操纵建模为基于相似性的模仿行为：智能体模仿附近已被正分类的同侪以获取有利结果。IFSC学习在操纵后分布下的分类器，并通过引入随机扰动的鲁棒学习过程来处理同侪可观测性的不确定性。

Result: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验表明，IFSC能够提升个体公平一致性，并有效缓解模仿诱导的分布扭曲。

Conclusion: 当个体公平性要求导致智能体之间产生相互依赖的操纵行为时，通过模仿同侪的模式进行建模并采用鲁棒学习处理不确定性，可以更好地实现公平感知的策略性分类。

Original Abstract: Strategic classification (SC) investigates scenarios where agents manipulate their features to obtain favorable decisions from predictive models. Existing fairness-aware SC approaches primarily focus on group fairness and typically assume that agents respond independently. However, when individual fairness is required, ensuring similar individuals receive similar outcomes, agents' manipulation becomes interdependent: an agent's preferred manipulation depends on the neighborhoods' outcomes. This induces a mismatch between classical SC formulations and fairness-aware decision settings, where independent models no longer accurately characterize strategic manipulations. To address this issue, we introduce individual fairness-aware strategic classification (IFSC), a framework that models peer-driven manipulation arising from individual fairness, where agents imitate nearby positively decided peers to obtain favorable outcomes. IFSC characterizes strategic manipulation as similarity-based imitation toward visible accepted peers and learns classifiers under the resulting post-manipulation distributions. To account for uncertainty in peer observability, IFSC employs a robust learning process that introduces stochastic perturbations during manipulation simulation. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that IFSC improves individual-fairness consistency and mitigates imitation-induced distortions.

中文摘要翻译: 策略性分类（SC）研究的是智能体操纵自身特征以获得预测模型有利决策的场景。现有的公平感知SC方法主要关注群体公平，且通常假设智能体独立做出响应。然而，当需要个体公平性——即确保相似个体获得相似结果时，智能体的操纵行为会变得相互依赖：个体偏好的操纵策略取决于其邻居的结果。这导致了经典SC公式与公平感知决策环境之间的错配，因为独立模型不再能准确刻画策略性操纵。为解决这一问题，我们提出了个体公平感知策略性分类（IFSC）框架，该框架对由个体公平性引发的同侪驱动操纵进行建模：智能体模仿附近已被正分类的同侪以获取有利结果。IFSC将策略性操纵刻画为向可见的已接受同侪进行的基于相似性的模仿，并在由此产生的操纵后分布下学习分类器。为处理同侪可观测性中的不确定性，IFSC采用了一种鲁棒学习过程，在操纵模拟中引入随机扰动。在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验表明，IFSC能够提升个体公平一致性，并缓解模仿诱导的分布扭曲。

</details>


### [341] [Online Packet Scheduling with Deadlines and Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00835)
*Gianmarco Genalti,Achraf Azize,Vianney Perchet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了部分反馈下的在线数据包调度问题（OPSD），将其与沉睡赌博机问题建立联系，设计了具有α-遗憾保证的算法，在多种松弛度场景下达到了 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{KT})$ 的上界，并在2-期限实例中突破了经典黄金比例竞争比壁垒。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 网络路由器需要在每个时钟周期决定传输哪个即将过期的数据包，而数据包的价值（权重）只有在处理后才知晓，这构成了一个在线决策难题。现有研究缺乏对部分反馈（bandit feedback）场景下OPSD问题的系统性分析，因此本文旨在为这一重要实际问题提供理论保证。

Method: 在随机权重假设下，将OPSD问题与沉睡赌博机（sleeping bandits）问题建立联系，以α-遗憾最小化为学习目标。针对是否允许随机化的系统，分别设计了不同松弛度下的算法，并分析了2-期限有界实例下的确定性算法。

Result: 所有场景下算法均达到 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{KT})$ 的α-遗憾上界，匹配标准赌博机设置的下界。在2-期限有界实例中，确定性算法达到了理论上最紧的竞争比；当数据包类型数 $K\ge 2$ 有限时，打破了 $\Phi = \frac{1+\sqrt{5}}{2}$ 的竞争比壁垒，获得了 $[\sqrt{2}, \Phi)$ 区间内更紧的竞争比 $\theta_K$。

Conclusion: 本文在部分反馈下为OPSD问题提供了完整的理论框架和最优遗憾保证，特别是在2-期限实例中突破了长期存在的竞争比上界，具有重要的理论和实践意义。

Original Abstract: Network routers that enforce Quality-of-Service (QoS) guarantees must decide, at every clock cycle, which expiring packet of information to transmit, even when the value of the packet is unknown until it is processed. We frame this problem as the Online Packet Scheduling with Deadlines (OPSD) problem under Partial Feedback: packets arrive at every clock cycle, with different deadlines, but the weights are only observed after execution. Under a stochastic assumption on the unknown weights, we explore different variants of the OPSD problem with bandit feedback. We establish a connection between our setting and the sleeping bandits problem, and set our learning goal to $α$-regret minimization. We provide algorithms with provable $α$-regret guarantees under different spans of slackness, distinguishing systems allowing for randomization and systems that do not. In every scenario, our algorithms achieve an $α$-regret upper bound of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\left(\sqrt{KT}\right)$, matching the lower bound for the standard bandit setting. In the practically relevant case of $2$-bounded deadline instances, where the deadline is set at most one clock cycle away from the arrival, our deterministic algorithm achieves the provably tightest possible competitive ratio. Remarkably, when the number of distinct packet types $K\ge 2$ is finite, it is possible to break the well-established $Φ= \frac{1+\sqrt{5}}{2}$ competitive ratio barrier and attain a tighter competitive ratio $θ_K$ ranging in $[\sqrt{2}, Φ)$.

中文摘要翻译: 执行服务质量（QoS）保证的网络路由器必须在每个时钟周期决定传输哪个即将过期的数据包，即使数据包的价值在处理之前是未知的。我们将此问题建模为部分反馈下的在线数据包调度（OPSD）问题：数据包在每个时钟周期到达，具有不同的截止期限，但权重仅在执行后才能观察到。在未知权重的随机假设下，我们探索了具有赌博机反馈的OPSD问题的不同变体。我们建立了我们的设置与沉睡赌博机问题之间的联系，并将学习目标设定为α-遗憾最小化。我们为不同的松弛度范围提供了具有可证明α-遗憾保证的算法，区分了允许随机化的系统和不允许随机化的系统。在每种场景下，我们的算法都实现了 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\left(\sqrt{KT}\right)$ 的α-遗憾上界，匹配了标准赌博机设置的下界。在实际相关的2-有界期限实例中（截止期限最多距离到达一个时钟周期），我们的确定性算法实现了理论上可证明的最紧竞争比。值得注意的是，当不同数据包类型的数量 $K\ge 2$ 有限时，有可能打破已被广泛认可的 $\Phi = \frac{1+\sqrt{5}}{2}$ 竞争比壁垒，并达到范围在 $[\sqrt{2}, \Phi)$ 内更紧的竞争比 $\theta_K$。

</details>


### [342] [CUPID in the Model Zoo: Online Matchmaking for Selecting Your Dream LLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00846)
*Son Nguyen,Xinyuan Liu,Ransalu Senanayake*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于决斗老虎机算法的主动学习框架，通过迭代对比LLM对并收集用户偏好反馈，高效地将用户与最匹配的LLM对齐。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 用户从快速增长且属性不透明的LLM池中选择合适的模型日益困难，且用户往往缺乏明确表达其偏好特征的术语或意识。

Method: 提出一种交互高效的主动学习框架，核心是信念感知的上置信界（UCB）策略的决斗老虎机算法，通过迭代选择LLM对、收集用户反馈、更新用户潜在偏好信念，在探索与利用之间取得平衡，并在用户指定的成本和时间预算下实现对齐。

Result: 在多种LLM实验和人类研究中验证了该方法能够以较低成本高效地将与用户需求匹配的LLM匹配给用户。

Conclusion: 所提出的信念感知UCB决斗老虎机框架能够在用户预算约束下高效实现用户需求与LLM能力之间的对齐。

Original Abstract: Users increasingly face the challenge of selecting an appropriate LLM for a given task from a rapidly growing pool of LLMs, each with distinct but often opaque latent properties. Compounding this challenge, users may lack the vocabulary or awareness to explicitly articulate the characteristics they value in an LLM's responses or deployment. We propose an interaction-efficient active learning framework in which a dueling bandit algorithm iteratively selects pairs of LLMs, collects user feedback about their responses, and updates its belief about the user's latent preferences. We introduce a novel belief-aware upper confidence bound strategy that balances exploration of the model pool with exploitation of inferred preferences, enabling efficient alignment between user needs and LLM capabilities under user-specified cost and time budgets. Through diverse experiments on LLMs and human studies, we experimentally verify that our model can efficiently match well-aligned LLMs to users at a lower cost.

中文摘要翻译: 用户日益面临从快速增长的LLM池中为给定任务选择合适的LLM的挑战，每个LLM具有不同但往往不透明的潜在属性。使这一挑战更加复杂的是，用户可能缺乏明确表达其在LLM响应或部署中所重视特征的术语或意识。我们提出了一种交互高效的主动学习框架，其中决斗老虎机算法迭代地选择LLM对，收集用户对其响应的反馈，并更新其对用户潜在偏好的信念。我们引入了一种新颖的信念感知上置信界策略，该策略在探索模型池与利用推断出的偏好之间取得平衡，从而在用户指定的成本和时间预算下实现用户需求与LLM能力之间的高效对齐。通过在多种LLM和人类研究上的实验，我们实验验证了我们的模型能够以较低成本高效地将匹配良好的LLM与用户对齐。

</details>


### [343] [Enhancing LLM Metacognition via Cognitive Pairwise Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00869)
*Weitao Li,Hao Zhou,Xuanyu Lei,Fandong Meng,Yuanhang Liu,Jingyi Ren,Ante Wang,Xiaolong Wang,Yuanchi Zhang,Fuwen Luo,Guangwen Yang,Lin Gan,Weizhi Ma,Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出认知配对训练（CPT），通过比较推理轨迹的可信度来内化推理质量判别边界，改善LLM推理与元认知之间的权衡。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有RLVR方法使模型在证据不可靠时更倾向于给出自信回答，而SFT/RL方法主要教授拒绝或表达不确定性，容易过度拟合拒绝行为而非提升推理可靠性。

Method: 提出认知配对训练（CPT），一种认知中训练对齐阶段，将推理轨迹上的成对比较转化为可复用的对齐信号，让模型区分可信与有缺陷的推理。

Result: 在5种模型规模和3个模型家族上，CPT改善了推理-元认知权衡。在14B模型上，CPT+RL相比标准SFT+RL管线在数学平均分上提升+2.2，在拒绝F1上提升+5.2。CPT还提升了轨迹质量，表现出强鲁棒性和可扩展性。

Conclusion: CPT通过内化推理质量判别边界而非记忆表面拒绝模式，有效提升了LLM的推理可靠性与元认知能力。

Original Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become central to LLM reasoning, but its outcome-level rewards can make models more willing to give confident answers when evidence or reasoning is unreliable. Existing SFT or RL methods mainly teach LLMs to refuse or express uncertainty at the response level, which can overfit abstention behavior rather than improve reasoning reliability. To address this limitation, we propose Cognitive Pairwise Training (CPT), a cognitive mid-training alignment stage that turns pairwise comparisons over reasoning traces into a reusable alignment signal. By learning to distinguish trustworthy from flawed reasoning, CPT encourages the model to internalize a reasoning-quality discrimination boundary rather than memorize surface refusal patterns. Across five model scales and three model families, CPT improves the reasoning--metacognition trade-off. At 14B, CPT+RL outperforms the standard SFT+RL pipeline by +2.2 math-average points and +5.2 abstention-F1 points. Further analyses show that CPT improves trace quality and exhibits strong robustness and scalability across evaluation and training settings. Code and models are released at https://github.com/Tsinghua-dhy/CPT.

中文摘要翻译: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为大型语言模型推理的核心方法，但其结果层面的奖励会使模型在证据或推理不可靠时更倾向于给出自信的回答。现有的监督微调或强化学习方法主要教授模型在响应层面进行拒绝或表达不确定性，这可能导致模型过度拟合拒绝行为，而非提升推理可靠性。为解决这一局限，我们提出认知配对训练（CPT），这是一种认知中训练对齐阶段，将推理轨迹上的成对比较转化为可复用的对齐信号。通过学习区分可信与有缺陷的推理，CPT鼓励模型内化一个推理质量判别边界，而非记忆表面的拒绝模式。在五种模型规模和三个模型家族上，CPT改善了推理与元认知之间的权衡。在14B规模上，CPT+RL相比标准SFT+RL管线在数学平均分上提升+2.2，在拒绝F1上提升+5.2。进一步分析表明，CPT提升了轨迹质量，并在评估和训练设置中展现出强鲁棒性和可扩展性。代码和模型已在https://github.com/Tsinghua-dhy/CPT开源。

</details>


### [344] [Task diversity produces systematic transfer but inhibits continual reinforcement learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00880)
*Purab Seth,Neil Shah,Kunal Jha,Samuel J. Gershman,Max Kleiman-Weiner,Wilka Carvalho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Banyan，一个GPU加速的持续强化学习基准域，通过三个可控轴（地图布局、交互对象、子目标层级结构）调控任务多样性，系统研究了任务多样性对智能体在分布偏移下持续学习能力的影响，发现多样性有助于局部迁移但不足以实现真正的持续学习。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有研究主要关注训练后冻结权重的零样本泛化，但任务多样性是否能够提升智能体在分布偏移下持续学习的能力尚不清楚，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 构建Banyan基准平台，将任务多样性分解为三个独立可控的轴（地图布局、交互对象、子目标依赖的层级结构），在GPU加速环境下进行持续强化学习实验，系统评估各轴多样性对迁移学习和持续学习的影响。

Result: 增加各轴多样性使智能体在新任务上的初始性能接近上一任务水平（即使最优策略结构发生改变）；但随着分布偏移次数增加，局部迁移不足以维持持续学习，长时域任务出现性能停滞，较早的任务分布被遗忘。

Conclusion: 受控的任务多样性在单次分布偏移下能促进局部迁移，但无法自动转化为持续的持续学习能力，Banyan为研究何时任务多样性产生可迁移学习、何时迁移能够持久以及何处未能实现真正持续学习提供了基准。

Original Abstract: Continual reinforcement learning aims to produce agents that learn not only to improve at their current tasks but also to adapt as task distributions change. Training an agent on many diverse tasks can induce zero-shot generalization, but previous work generally evaluates this generalization after training -- with frozen weights. Whether task diversity also improves an agent's ability to continue learning across distribution shifts remains unclear. We introduce Banyan, a GPU-accelerated continual RL domain in which task diversity factors into three independently controllable axes: the map layouts an agent must navigate, the objects it must interact with, and the hierarchical structures of sub-goal dependencies. Across individual distribution shifts, increasing diversity along each axis causes agents to begin training on the new tasks near the performance attained on the previous one, even when the shift changes the structure of the optimal policy. However, as the number of shifts increases, this local transfer does not by itself yield sustained continual learning: longer-horizon tasks plateau, and earlier task distributions are forgotten after later training. Banyan is a benchmark for studying when controlled task diversity produces transferable learning, when that transfer persists, and where it falls short of proper continual learning.

中文摘要翻译: 持续强化学习旨在构建不仅能在当前任务上提升表现，还能在任务分布变化时进行适应的智能体。在大量多样化任务上训练智能体可以诱导零样本泛化，但先前的工作通常在训练后（权重冻结状态下）评估这种泛化能力。任务多样性是否也能提升智能体在分布偏移下持续学习的能力尚不明确。我们提出了Banyan，一个GPU加速的持续强化学习领域，其中任务多样性分解为三个独立可控的轴：智能体必须导航的地图布局、必须与之交互的物体，以及子目标依赖的层级结构。在单次分布偏移中，增加各轴的多样性使得智能体在新任务上开始训练时的性能接近之前任务所达到的水平，即使偏移改变了最优策略的结构。然而，随着偏移次数的增加，这种局部迁移本身并不能产生持续的持续学习：更长时域的任务出现性能平台期，而较早的任务分布在后续训练后被遗忘。Banyan作为一个基准平台，用于研究受控的任务多样性何时产生可迁移的学习、这种迁移何时能够持久，以及它在哪些方面未能实现真正的持续学习。

</details>


### [345] [Dive into Waves: Morlet Spectral Transformer for Cross-Subject Emotion Decoding from EEG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00884)
*Jiaxin Qing,Lexin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需预训练的Morlet频谱Transformer（MST），通过小波标记化、长上下文基线去除和频段特定空间投影，在跨主体EEG情感识别任务上优于大型预训练基础模型和基于频率的方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有跨主体EEG情感识别方法存在不足：大型预训练EEG基础模型需要海量数据且难以应对跨主体变异性；频域编码器虽能反映频谱结构，但存在表征不匹配、漂移主导的标记化以及缺乏频段特定空间建模等问题。

Method: 提出Morlet频谱Transformer（MST），包括三个核心组件：1) Morlet小波标记化，提供匹配脑节律多尺度结构的时频表示；2) 长上下文基线去除，消除主体特异性漂移和窗口间冗余；3) 频段特定空间投影，为每个频段学习独立的空间混合器，捕获可解释的频段特定模式。

Result: 在无需预训练的情况下，MST在所有SEED系列数据集上持续优于大型预训练EEG基础模型和基于频率的方法。

Conclusion: 精心的表征设计可以产生准确、经济且可解释的替代方案，无需依赖大规模预训练。

Original Abstract: We study cross-subject emotion recognition from EEG, a practically important yet challenging problem in brain-computer interfaces. Unlike tasks with clear waveform signatures, emotion-related EEG signals are primarily encoded in spectral power and are weak, noisy, and highly variable across subjects. Existing approaches rely either on large pretrained EEG foundation models, which require massive data yet still struggle with cross-subject variability, or frequency-domain encoders, which better reflect spectral structure but suffer from mismatched representations, drift-dominated tokenization, and lack of band-specific spatial modeling. In this article, we propose the Morlet Spectral Transformer (MST), built around three key components and integrated with a spatiotemporal Transformer backbone. First, Morlet wavelet tokenization provides a time-frequency representation that matches the multi-scale structure of brain rhythms, and extends classical differential entropy features to a form suitable for Transformers. Second, long-context baseline removal acts as a simple temporal normalization that removes subject-specific drift and redundancy across nearby windows. Third, frequency-specific spatial projection learns a separate channel mixer for each frequency band, capturing interpretable band-specific patterns and reducing cross-channel mixing. We show that, even without pretraining, MST consistently outperforms both large pretrained EEG foundation models and frequency-based methods across all SEED-family datasets. These results suggest that careful representation design can yield an accurate, cost-effective, and interpretable alternative to large-scale pretraining.

中文摘要翻译: 我们研究了基于EEG的跨主体情感识别，这是脑机接口中一个实际重要但具有挑战性的问题。与具有清晰波形特征的任务不同，情感相关的EEG信号主要编码在频谱功率中，且具有弱、噪声大、跨主体变异性高的特点。现有方法依赖于大型预训练EEG基础模型（需要海量数据但仍难以应对跨主体变异性）或频域编码器（虽能更好地反映频谱结构，但存在表征不匹配、漂移主导的标记化和缺乏频段特定空间建模等问题）。本文提出Morlet频谱Transformer（MST），其围绕三个关键组件构建，并与时空Transformer骨干集成。首先，Morlet小波标记化提供与脑节律多尺度结构匹配的时频表示，并将经典差分熵特征扩展到适合Transformer的形式。其次，长上下文基线去除作为一种简单的时间归一化操作，消除主体特异性漂移和相邻窗口间的冗余。第三，频段特定空间投影为每个频段学习独立的通道混合器，捕获可解释的频段特定模式并减少跨通道混合。我们证明，即使无需预训练，MST在所有SEED系列数据集上持续优于大型预训练EEG基础模型和基于频率的方法。这些结果表明，精心的表征设计可以成为大规模预训练的准确、经济和可解释的替代方案。

</details>


### [346] [Memory-Efficient LLM Training with Dynamic Sparsity: From Stability to Practical Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00888)
*Qiao Xiao,Boqian Wu,Patrik Okanovic,Tomasz Sternal,Maurice van Keulen,Elena Mocanu,Mykola Pechenizkiy,Decebal Constantin Mocanu,Torsten Hoefler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SMET方法，通过优化器预热和密度感知学习率缩放解决动态稀疏训练（DST）在大语言模型训练中因拓扑更新导致的优化不稳定和损失尖峰问题，同时仅存储活跃参数的梯度和优化器状态以降低内存消耗，实现了稳定、可扩展且内存高效的稀疏预训练。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 在大语言模型训练中，动态稀疏训练（DST）在拓扑更新后会出现优化不稳定问题，表现为损失尖峰；研究发现标准Adam优化器会导致新再生参数的冷启动问题，产生过大的参数更新并扰乱训练动态。

Method: 提出稀疏内存高效训练（SMET），包含两个核心组件：(1) 优化器预热（optimizer warm-up），稳定新再生参数的更新行为；(2) 密度感知学习率缩放（density-aware learning-rate scaling），根据稀疏度动态调整学习率以改进训练进度。此外，仅存储活跃参数的梯度和优化器状态以降低内存消耗。

Result: 理论分析证明了SMET下更新行为的优化稳定性提升；大量实验表明SMET能够实现LLM的稳定、可扩展且内存高效的稀疏预训练，使稀疏训练成为密集训练的实际替代方案。

Conclusion: SMET有效解决了DST在大语言模型训练中的优化不稳定性问题，通过优化器预热和密度感知学习率缩放实现了稳定的稀疏训练，为实际应用中的高效稀疏预训练提供了可行方案。

Original Abstract: Dynamic Sparse Training (DST) offers a promising paradigm for improving the training and inference efficiency of deep neural networks; however, we find that in large language model training, DST can suffer from optimization instability, manifested as loss spikes after topology updates. In this work, we show that the naive use of standard Adam-based optimizers leads to a cold-start issue for newly regrown parameters, resulting in excessively large updates and disrupted training dynamics. To address this issue, we propose Sparse Memory-Efficient Training (SMET), which stabilizes DST with optimizer warm-up and improves training progress through density-aware learning-rate scaling. SMET further reduces memory consumption by storing gradients and optimizer states only for active parameters. We provide a theoretical analysis of the update behaviors under SMET, showing improved optimization stability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SMET enables stable, scalable, and memory-efficient sparse pre-training of LLMs, paving the way for sparse training as a practical alternative to dense training. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/QiaoXiao7282/SMET.

中文摘要翻译: 动态稀疏训练（DST）为提升深度神经网络的训练和推理效率提供了一种有前景的范式；然而，我们发现在大语言模型训练中，DST会出现优化不稳定性问题，表现为拓扑更新后的损失尖峰。在本工作中，我们证明标准Adam优化器的朴素使用会导致新再生参数出现冷启动问题，从而产生过大的参数更新并扰乱训练动态。为解决这一问题，我们提出稀疏内存高效训练（SMET），该方法通过优化器预热来稳定DST，并通过密度感知学习率缩放来改善训练进度。SMET进一步通过仅存储活跃参数的梯度和优化器状态来降低内存消耗。我们对SMET下的更新行为进行了理论分析，结果表明优化稳定性得到了改善。大量实验证明，SMET能够实现LLM的稳定、可扩展且内存高效的稀疏预训练，为稀疏训练作为密集训练的实际替代方案铺平了道路。我们的代码公开于：https://github.com/QiaoXiao7282/SMET。

</details>


### [347] [An Exploratory Study into using Machine-Learning for Fast Step-by-step Emulation of Numerical Mechanical Thrombectomy Simulations for Ischemic Stroke](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00892)
*Thijs Stessen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究探索了机器学习替代模型能否在显著加速的情况下，逐步骤准确模拟缺血性脑卒中机械取栓的数值物理仿真，结果表明两个模型在单步预测中表现良好并带来显著加速，但在复杂几何构型的长时间仿真中缺乏稳定性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 机械取栓治疗缺血性脑卒中需要在极短时间内做出艰难决策，数值物理仿真虽能为操作者提供理论指导，但计算速度太慢无法用于临床实践，因此亟需更快速的替代方案。

Method: 训练了三种机器学习替代模型，在两种涉及简化抽吸过程且几何复杂度不同的仿真上进行评估，并结合特定数据增强方法。

Result: 两个模型能够准确预测单个仿真步骤，并在结合数据增强后实现显著加速；但在复杂几何构型的长时间仿真中模型表现出不稳定性。

Conclusion: 本研究为未来开发能够扩展到真实机械取栓数值物理仿真的稳定方法奠定了基础。

Original Abstract: The treatment of ischemic stroke using mechanical thrombectomy involves difficult decisions under intense time constraints. Numerical physics simulations can in theory inform operators to make better decisions regarding treatment approaches and device selection, but are too slow to do so in practice. In this thesis, we investigate if current machine learning based surrogates can accurately emulate these simulations in a step-by-step manner while making them significantly faster. To do this we train three surrogate models on two simulations that involve a simplified aspiration procedure, with varying levels of geometric complexity. Our results show that two of our models accurately predict singular simulation steps and provide substantial speedups, especially when combined with specific data augmentations. However, the models showed a lack of stability when emulating simulations with complex geometries over longer time periods. Overall, this work provides a foundation for future studies to develop stable methods that scale to realistic numerical physics simulations of mechanical thrombectomy.

中文摘要翻译: 使用机械取栓治疗缺血性脑卒中涉及在高度时间紧迫下的艰难决策。数值物理仿真理论上可以为操作者提供关于治疗方案和器械选择的更好决策依据，但在实际中速度过慢而无法应用。在本论文中，我们研究了当前基于机器学习的替代模型能否以逐步骤的方式准确模拟这些仿真，同时使其显著加速。为此，我们在两个涉及简化抽吸过程且几何复杂度不同的仿真上训练了三个替代模型。结果表明，其中两个模型能够准确预测单个仿真步骤，并提供显著的加速效果，特别是在结合特定数据增强方法时。然而，这些模型在模拟具有复杂几何构型的长时间仿真时表现出缺乏稳定性。总体而言，本研究为未来开发能够扩展到机械取栓真实数值物理仿真的稳定方法奠定了基础。

</details>


### [348] [Accuracy, Stability, and Repeated-Run Reliability of Large Language Models on Deterministic Programming Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00920)
*Yongxi Zhou,Lai Yun Choi,Jiaxi Wen,Wenbo Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现，在 LLM 评估中，单次运行通过率会高估免重试覆盖率最多达 17.8 个百分点，且差距在中性能系统中最大。作者提出重复运行评估协议，基于 100 道 LeetCode 风格问题、16 个模型、2 种提示模板、每问题 5 次重复运行（共 16,000 个评估实例），揭示了准确度与稳定性之间的显著差距。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 标准代码生成基准强调单次运行准确率或重复采样下的最终成功，但许多部署场景还需要稳定性：同一任务描述下多次调用的一致结果。现有评估过度依赖 pass rate，忽略了 run-level 的稳定性，导致对模型实际表现的误判。

Method: 提出重复运行评估协议，包含三个指标：run-level 准确率（单次运行通过率）、retry-free 覆盖率（无需重试即可通过的题目占比）、以及每个问题的变异性。基于 100 道 LeetCode 风格问题的 recency 基准，对 16 个模型（来自 5 个提供者家族）使用 2 种提示模板，每问题 5 次重复运行，共 16,000 个评估实例。

Result: 尽管 run-level pass rate 与完美稳定性率高度相关（r=0.985），但 pass rate 始终高于 retry-free 覆盖率，差距最高达 17.8 个百分点，甚至导致紧密竞争模型之间的排名反转。提示效应是模型相关的，而非普遍有益。

Conclusion: 重复运行稳定性分析是传统准确率报告的必要补充，特别适用于确定性文本条件生成任务。

Original Abstract: Run-level pass rate overstates retry-free coverage by up to 17.8 percentage points -- and the gap is largest precisely for mid-performing systems. We investigate this accuracy--stability relationship in large language model (LLM) evaluation for deterministic text-conditioned generation, using programming tasks as a concrete testbed. Standard code-generation benchmarks emphasize single-run accuracy or eventual success under repeated sampling, but many deployment settings also require stability: consistent outcomes across repeated invocations under the same task description. We present a repeated-run evaluation protocol with metrics for run-level accuracy, retry-free coverage, and per-problem variability. On a recency-based benchmark of 100 LeetCode-style problems, we evaluate 16 models from five provider families under two prompt templates with five repeated runs per problem, yielding 16,000 evaluation instances. Although run-level pass rate and perfect stability rate are strongly correlated (r=0.985), pass rate consistently exceeds retry-free coverage -- a gap that reaches 17.8 percentage points and reverses model rankings even among closely matched systems. Prompt effects are model-dependent rather than uniformly beneficial. These results suggest that repeated-run stability analysis is a necessary complement to conventional accuracy reporting for deterministic text-conditioned generation tasks.

中文摘要翻译: 运行级通过率会高估免重试覆盖率最多达 17.8 个百分点——且这一差距恰恰在中性能系统中最大。我们针对确定性文本条件生成的大语言模型（LLM）评估研究了这种准确度-稳定性关系，并以编程任务作为具体测试平台。标准代码生成基准强调单次运行准确率或重复采样下的最终成功，但许多部署场景还需要稳定性：同一任务描述下多次调用的一致结果。我们提出了一种重复运行评估协议，包含运行级准确率、免重试覆盖率和每个问题的变异性等指标。在一个基于时效性的 100 道 LeetCode 风格问题基准上，我们评估了来自 5 个提供者家族的 16 个模型，使用 2 种提示模板，每问题 5 次重复运行，共计 16,000 个评估实例。尽管运行级通过率与完美稳定性率高度相关（r=0.985），但通过率始终超过免重试覆盖率——这一差距达到 17.8 个百分点，甚至导致紧密竞争模型之间的排名反转。提示效应是模型相关的，而非普遍有益。这些结果表明，对于确定性文本条件生成任务，重复运行稳定性分析是传统准确率报告的必要补充。

</details>


### [349] [Task Structure Reverses Layerwise State Encoding in Sequence Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00926)
*Yuhang Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了不同序列模型（Transformer、Mamba、LSTM、GRU等）中任务如何改变层间状态编码的分布模式，发现计算结构（前缀更新 vs. 栈）而非代数结构（交换性）是决定编码分布的关键因素，且线性探测可读的位置并不总是计算瓶颈所在。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有文献将层间状态编码模式视为架构固有特征（循环模型集中可读状态，注意力模型分散状态），但未充分探究任务变化对同一架构编码分布的影响。同时，文献中混淆了两种可能的解释：代数结构（交换性）与计算结构（前缀更新 vs. 栈）。本文旨在厘清这些混淆因素。

Method: 在Transformer、Mamba、Mamba-2、LSTM和GRU五种架构上，对比Parity、有界深度Dyck-k和非交换的S₃置换组合三种任务的层间线性探测性能；对形式化模型（4层）进行因果干预，对预训练模型（Mamba-130M、Pythia-160M/410M）进行微调探测、消融实验和激活修补分析。

Result: (1) 同一架构在不同任务上编码分布反转：Parity在Mamba和循环模型晚期集中、Transformer逐渐构建；Dyck-k则相反。(2) S₃任务与Parity而非Dyck分在一组，表明决定因素为计算结构而非交换性。(3) 因果干预表明线性可读方向在形式化模型中常是功能必需的。(4) 预训练尺度下，Pythia在Dyck上存在强中间层瓶颈（L6-L7消融降低81%准确率），Mamba在最终层可读但无单一探测方向能破坏任务，中层激活修补可恢复97-98%的logit差距。探测定位的是线性可用的状态位置，而非计算瓶颈位置。

Conclusion: 机械论解释特征是架构与任务共同作用的结果，而非架构本身的固有属性；线性探测反映的是状态的线性可用性，而非计算的瓶颈所在；研究机械论解释时必须考虑任务因素的影响。

Original Abstract: Mechanistic studies of sequence models often treat layerwise state encodings as architectural traits: recurrent models concentrate readable state, attention-based models distribute it. We find that the same architecture reverses this profile when the task changes. Across Transformers, Mamba, Mamba-2, LSTMs, and GRUs, Parity is concentrated late in Mamba and the recurrent baselines and built gradually by Transformer; on bounded-depth Dyck-k the pattern flips. The same flip appears in fine-tuned Mamba-130M and Pythia-160M, and the Pythia Dyck bottleneck persists at 410M. Two explanations are conflated in the literature: algebraic structure (commutativity) versus computational structure (prefix update vs. stack). To separate them we add a third task: non-commutative S_3 permutation composition. S_3 groups with Parity, not Dyck, on layerwise probing across all five architectures and on Mamba-specific Conv1D attribution, so the grouping tracks computational structure rather than commutativity.
  Causal interventions show that, in the 4-layer formal models, linearly readable directions are often functionally necessary and can remain important at out-of-distribution lengths on Parity and Dyck. At pretrained scale the picture splits. Fine-tuned Pythia Dyck has a strong middle-layer bottleneck (L6-L7 ablation drops accuracy by roughly 81% at 160M; broader L4-L18 plateau at 410M), far weaker at the best-probe layer. Pretrained Mamba shows the complementary failure mode: its final layer is highly readable, no single probe direction breaks the task on Parity, Dyck, or S_3, yet mid-position activation patching there recovers about 97-98% of the clean-corrupted logit gap. Probing localizes where state is linearly available, not always where the computation is bottlenecked. Mechanistic signatures are properties of architecture and task together.

中文摘要翻译: 序列模型的机械论研究通常将逐层状态编码视为架构特征：循环模型集中可读状态，注意力模型分散状态。我们发现同一架构在任务变化时会反转这一模式。在Transformer、Mamba、Mamba-2、LSTM和GRU上，Parity任务在Mamba和循环基线中晚期集中、在Transformer中逐步构建；在有界深度Dyck-k上模式反转。相同的反转出现在微调的Mamba-130M和Pythia-160M中，且Pythia的Dyck瓶颈在410M尺度仍持续存在。文献中混淆了两种解释：代数结构（交换性）与计算结构（前缀更新 vs. 栈）。为区分二者，我们引入第三个任务：非交换的S₃置换组合。在全部五种架构的逐层探测和Mamba特有的Conv1D归因中，S₃与Parity而非Dyck归为一组，因此分组依据是计算结构而非交换性。因果干预表明，在4层形式化模型中，线性可读方向通常是功能必需的，且在Parity和Dyck上可在分布外长度保持重要性。在预训练尺度上情况则分化：微调Pythia在Dyck上存在强中间层瓶颈（160M尺度L6-L7消融使准确率下降约81%；410M尺度L4-L18形成宽瓶颈），而最佳探测层的影响远弱于此。预训练Mamba呈现互补的失败模式：其最终层高度可读，但没有任何单一探测方向能在Parity、Dyck或S₃上破坏任务，然而中层位置激活修补可恢复干净-损坏logit差距的约97-98%。探测定位的是状态线性可用的位置，而非始终是计算瓶颈所在。机械论特征是架构与任务共同作用的属性。

</details>


### [350] [Cellular Sheaf Neural Operators for Structure-Preserving Surrogate Modeling of Constrained PDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00937)
*Lennon J. Shikhman,Shane Gilbertie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于细胞层神经算子的结构保持框架，通过在定向胞复形上表示PDE状态、利用学习到的限制映射耦合局部特征空间、并采用关联/Hodge感知的消息传递机制，实现对几何和离散化信息感知的神经PDE代理模型，在湍流MHD和聚变平衡代理任务上提升了结构敏感的诊断指标。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有神经算子架构通常将几何和离散化视为次要信息，将物理状态表示为网格-通道堆叠，忽略了不同物理量自然定义在胞复形的顶点、边、面、胞、边界或界面上这一事实，且难以满足相容性约束。

Method: 提出Cellular Sheaf Neural Operators框架：在定向胞复形上表示PDE状态，通过学习到的限制映射耦合局部特征空间，采用关联矩阵/Hodge感知的消息传递机制，利用学习到的更新头通过共边界或通量映射，使得约束从胞复形结构自然涌现而非仅通过损失惩罚施加。

Result: 在湍流MHD和聚变平衡代理任务上，该方法在展开行为的稳定性、散度控制、谱误差和平衡回归精度等结构敏感诊断指标上均优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 细胞层结构是一种有效的归纳偏置，能够为受约束的多物理场系统中的神经PDE代理模型提供几何和离散化感知的结构保持能力。

Original Abstract: Neural operators provide fast surrogate models for PDE simulations, but standard architectures often treat geometry and discretization as secondary to field data. Physical states are usually represented as grid-channel stacks, even when different quantities naturally belong on vertices, edges, faces, cells, boundaries, or interfaces and must satisfy compatibility constraints. We propose Cellular Sheaf Neural Operators, a discretization-aware framework for structure-preserving neural PDE surrogates. The method represents PDE states on oriented cell complexes, couples local feature spaces through learned restriction maps, and uses incidence/Hodge-informed message passing to follow computational geometry. Learned update heads pass through coboundary or flux maps, allowing selected constraints to arise from cell-complex structure rather than only from loss penalties. For magnetohydrodynamics, this yields face-based magnetic-flux updates driven by edge electromotive fields and finite-volume-style fluid updates driven by learned face fluxes and cell sources. On turbulent MHD and fusion-equilibrium surrogate tasks, the method improves structure-sensitive diagnostics, including rollout behavior, divergence control, spectral error, and equilibrium-regression accuracy. These results indicate that cellular-sheaf structure is a useful inductive bias for neural PDE surrogates in constrained multiphysics systems.

中文摘要翻译: 神经算子为偏微分方程模拟提供了快速的代理模型，但标准架构通常将几何和离散化视为次要于场数据的信息。物理状态通常被表示为网格-通道堆叠，即使不同物理量自然应归属于顶点、边、面、胞、边界或界面，并且必须满足相容性约束。本文提出细胞层神经算子——一种面向离散化感知的结构保持神经PDE代理模型框架。该方法在定向胞复形上表示PDE状态，通过学到的限制映射耦合局部特征空间，并采用关联矩阵/Hodge感知的消息传递机制来遵循计算几何结构。学到的更新头通过共边界或通量映射传递，使得所选约束可以从胞复形结构中自然产生，而非仅依赖损失惩罚。对于磁流体动力学，这实现了由边电动势场驱动的基于面的磁通更新，以及由学到的面通量和胞源驱动的有限体积风格的流体更新。在湍流MHD和聚变平衡代理任务上，该方法改善了结构敏感的诊断指标，包括展开行为、散度控制、谱误差和平衡回归精度。这些结果表明，细胞层结构是约束性多物理场系统中神经PDE代理模型的一种有效的归纳偏置。

</details>


### [351] [PRISM: Gauge-Invariant Tangent-Space Differentially Private LoRA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00944)
*Shihao Wang,Xueru Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRISM 是一种针对 LoRA 的固有差分隐私机制，通过规范不变性设计避免了 DP-SGD 直接应用于 LoRA 时产生的噪声放大问题，并实现了高效的低维噪声采样与稳定的隐私-效用权衡。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 将 DP-SGD 直接应用于 LoRA 的低秩因子 (A,B) 时，由于低秩分解的非可辨识性（多个因子对对应同一个更新矩阵 Z），会导致规范依赖的扰动和无限噪声放大问题，亟需一种规范不变且稳定的隐私保护机制。

Method: 提出 PRISM 机制：1) 通过构造规范不变（gauge invariant）的差分隐私扰动，避免双线性噪声放大；2) 设计高效的低维噪声采样器；3) 给出 Z 上固有噪声的闭式表征；4) 引入 DP-aware、规范不变的自适应更新规则，防止自适应优化放大注入的隐私噪声。

Result: 建立了标准的 (ε,δ)-DP 保证；通过有界、规范不变的扰动实现了稳定的隐私-效用权衡；所提自适应更新规则提升了实际训练中的数值稳定性。

Conclusion: PRISM 有效解决了 DP-LoRA 中因低秩分解非可辨识性导致的噪声放大问题，在保证差分隐私的同时实现了更稳定的训练过程和更好的隐私-效用权衡。

Original Abstract: Applying differential privacy (DP) via DP-SGD to Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a natural approach for privacy-preserving fine-tuning. However, LoRA's low-rank parameterization poses a fundamental challenge. In LoRA, each trainable update is represented as a low-rank matrix $Z = AB^\top$, but this factorization is inherently non-identifiable: many factor pairs $(A,B)$ represent the same update $Z$. As a result, applying DP-SGD directly to the factors induces gauge-dependent perturbations on $Z$, and we show that this naive DP-LoRA can lead to unbounded noise amplification. We propose PRISM, an intrinsic DP mechanism for LoRA that is gauge invariant by construction, avoids bilinear noise amplification, and admits an efficient low-dimensional noise sampler. Moreover, PRISM yields a closed-form characterization of the effective intrinsic noise induced on $Z$, enabling stable privacy-utility trade-offs through bounded, gauge-invariant perturbations. We establish standard $(ε,δ)$-DP guarantees for PRISM and introduce a DP-aware, gauge-invariant adaptive update rule that prevents adaptive optimization from amplifying injected privacy noise, improving numerical stability in practice.

中文摘要翻译: 通过 DP-SGD 将差分隐私（DP）应用于低秩适配（LoRA）是实现隐私保护微调的一种自然方法。然而，LoRA 的低秩参数化带来了一个根本性挑战。在 LoRA 中，每个可训练更新被表示为低秩矩阵 Z = AB^⊤，但这种分解本质上是非可辨识的：多个因子对 (A,B) 可以表示相同的更新 Z。因此，直接将 DP-SGD 应用于这些因子会导致 Z 上产生规范依赖的扰动，我们证明这种朴素 DP-LoRA 会导致无界的噪声放大。我们提出 PRISM，一种针对 LoRA 的固有差分隐私机制，该机制通过构造具有规范不变性，避免了双线性噪声放大，并支持高效的低维噪声采样。此外，PRISM 给出了 Z 上有效固有噪声的闭式表征，通过有界、规范不变的扰动实现了稳定的隐私-效用权衡。我们为 PRISM 建立了标准的 (ε,δ)-DP 保证，并引入了一种 DP-aware、规范不变的自适应更新规则，防止自适应优化放大注入的隐私噪声，从而在实践中提升了数值稳定性。

</details>


### [352] [Silent Failures in Federated Personalization of Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00947)
*YongKyung Oh,Alex Bui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出并定义了联邦学习与基础模型个性化结合中产生的“静默故障”概念——包括偏差放大、公平性崩溃和对齐侵蚀等难以被检测的信任失败问题，并通过分类学分析和研究议程呼吁将隐私保护下的行为评估纳入联邦可信AI标准。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 联邦学习在私有去中心化数据上个性化基础模型日益普遍，同时后市场监管要求日益严格；然而现有基准存在结构性割裂：联邦基准只评估系统性能，可信基准需要违反隐私的模型访问权限。两者结合产生的信任失败尚未被充分认识和系统研究。

Method: 通过景观分析揭示现有基准的结构性鸿沟，提出六种静默故障模式的分类学，分析基础模型个性化、数据集偏移与联邦约束三者交互导致信任失效的机制。

Result: 隐私保护训练本身不足以保障可信部署；联邦学习的隐私约束限制了模型行为可见性，导致偏差放大、公平性崩溃和对齐侵蚀等静默故障难以检测。

Conclusion: 需要建立隐私保护的行为评估研究议程，并将“静默故障”作为联邦可信人工智能的标准诊断类别。

Original Abstract: Foundation models are increasingly personalized on decentralized private data through federated learning and are now deployed at scale under growing regulatory requirements for post-market monitoring. We argue that this convergence creates a distinct and under-recognized class of trustworthiness failures, which we term "Silent Failures." These include amplified bias, fairness collapse, and alignment erosion that may remain difficult to detect because federated learning's privacy constraints limit visibility into model behavior. A landscape analysis of existing benchmarks reveals a structural divide. Federated benchmarks evaluate system performance but provide limited insight into model behavior, whereas centralized trustworthiness benchmarks assess behavior but require model access incompatible with federated privacy. We introduce a taxonomy of six silent failure modes arising from the interaction of foundation model personalization, dataset shift, and core federated constraints. Our analysis shows that privacy-preserving training alone is insufficient for trustworthy deployment. We conclude with a research agenda for privacy-preserving behavioral evaluation and propose that silent failures become a standard diagnostic category for trustworthy federated artificial intelligence.

中文摘要翻译: 基础模型正越来越多地通过联邦学习在去中心化的私有数据上进行个性化，并在日益增长的后市场监管合规要求下大规模部署。我们认为，这种趋势的汇合产生了一类独特且尚未被充分认识的信任失效问题，我们将其称为“静默故障”。这些问题包括放大的偏差、公平性崩溃以及对齐侵蚀，它们可能难以被检测，因为联邦学习的隐私约束限制了对模型行为的可见性。对现有基准的景观分析揭示了一种结构性鸿沟：联邦基准评估系统性能但对模型行为提供的洞察有限，而集中式可信基准评估行为却需要与联邦隐私不兼容的模型访问权限。我们提出了一种包含六种静默故障模式的分类学，这些模式由基础模型个性化、数据集偏移以及联邦核心约束之间的交互作用产生。我们的分析表明，仅靠隐私保护训练不足以实现可信部署。最后，我们提出了一个隐私保护行为评估的研究议程，并建议将“静默故障”作为联邦可信人工智能的标准诊断类别。

</details>


### [353] [Explainable deep reinforcement learning reveals energy-efficient control strategies for turbulent drag reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00949)
*Federica Tonti,Ricardo Vinuesa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种结合多智能体深度强化学习（MARL）和可解释深度学习（XDL）的方法，通过SHAP引导的奖励设计来减少壁面湍流中的阻力。基于摩擦系数和壁面压力波动组合的SHAP策略表现最佳，实现了34.44%的减阻率和34.01%的净节能率，且归一化输入功率仅为0.43%。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统壁湍流减阻方法（如对壁控制）能耗较高，且缺乏对控制策略可解释性的理解。本文旨在通过可解释人工智能方法指导强化学习奖励设计，在提升减阻效果的同时显著降低能耗。

Method: 结合多智能体深度强化学习（MARL）和可解释深度学习（XDL），使用SHAP值作为奖励信号。比较了三种SHAP引导策略：基于预测速度场的U-net的SHAP归因、基于预测摩擦系数的U-net的SHAP归因，以及基于摩擦系数和壁面压力波动两个U-net组合的SHAP归因。

Result: 组合SHAP策略实现最佳性能：减阻率34.44%，净节能率34.01%，归一化输入功率仅0.43%。相对对壁控制，减阻和净节能分别提升49.41%和48.52%。能耗从直接壁面剪切应力基线的5.90%降至0.43%。

Conclusion: 该策略形成的节能控制策略与压力门控驱动一致，主要在壁面压力接近零时激活，且时间尺度与近壁湍流结构的生命周期相当。这证明了可解释人工智能可以显著提升强化学习在流体控制中的效率和可解释性。

Original Abstract: We propose a method combining Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning (MARL) and eXplainable Deep Learning (XDL) to reduce drag in wall-bounded turbulent flows. Taking as a baseline the results of training agents directly targeting wall-shear stress and opposition control, three SHAP-guided approaches are compared. In the first, the reward is computed from SHAP attributions of a U-net predicting the future velocity field; in the second, from SHAP attributions of a U-net predicting the skin-friction coefficient; in the third, from a combination of SHAP attributions of two U-nets predicting the skin-friction coefficient and the wall pressure fluctuations, respectively. The combined SHAP strategy based on skin-friction coefficient and wall-pressure fluctuations achieves the best overall performance, achieving a DR of 34.44% and a NES of 34.01% with only 0.43% normalized input power. Relative to opposition control, drag reduction and net energy saving increase by 49.41% and 48.52%, respectively. Compared with the direct wall-shear-stress baseline, the proposed strategy simultaneously improves performance while reducing the normalized actuation cost from 5.90% to 0.43%. Analysis of the results reveals that the energetically efficient policy is consistent with pressure-gated actuation, activating predominantly at near-zero wall pressure, and operates on a temporal timescale comparable to the lifetime of the near-wall turbulent structures.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出了一种结合多智能体深度强化学习（MARL）和可解释深度学习（XDL）的方法，以减少壁面边界湍流中的阻力。以直接以壁面剪切应力和对壁控制为目标的智能体训练结果作为基线，比较了三种SHAP引导的方法。第一种方法中，奖励值由预测未来速度场的U-net的SHAP归因计算得到；第二种方法中，奖励值由预测摩擦系数的U-net的SHAP归因计算得到；第三种方法中，奖励值由分别预测摩擦系数和壁面压力波动的两个U-net的SHAP归因组合计算得到。基于摩擦系数和壁面压力波动组合的SHAP策略实现了最佳整体性能，达到了34.44%的减阻率和34.01%的净节能率，且归一化输入功率仅为0.43%。与对壁控制相比，减阻和净节能分别提升了49.41%和48.52%。与直接壁面剪切应力基线相比，所提出的策略在提升性能的同时，将归一化驱动成本从5.90%降低至0.43%。结果分析表明，该节能策略与压力门控驱动一致，主要在壁面压力接近零时激活，且其运行的时间尺度与近壁湍流结构的生命周期相当。

</details>


### [354] [COLLIE: Guiding Skill Discovery in Semantically Coherent Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00950)
*Yao Luan,Ni Mu,Hanfei Ge,Yiqin Yang,Bo Xu,Qing-Shan Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: COLLIE是一种引导式技能发现框架，通过利用密集无监督数据构建语义连贯的技能隐空间，无需额外训练引导模型，即可用稀疏在线人类反馈实现多样化、对齐人类意图的技能学习。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有的引导式技能发现方法通常需要训练额外的引导模型，并依赖预定义规则或专家演示，在稀疏在线人类反馈场景下效果不佳。

Method: 提出COLLIE框架，利用密集无监督数据构建语义连贯的技能隐空间，该空间具有良好的结构特性，使得在稀疏在线反馈下也能实现可靠引导；利用语义连贯性实现免训练的引导信号构建，无需在技能学习之外训练额外模型。

Result: 理论分析验证了免训练引导信号的有效性；在多种基于状态和基于像素的任务中，COLLIE能够学习多样化且与人类意图对齐的技能，避免危险行为，并在极小人工反馈下取得优越的下游任务性能。

Conclusion: COLLIE通过语义连贯的技能隐空间和免训练引导信号，有效解决了引导式技能发现中依赖额外模型和预定义规则的问题，实现了高效、安全、对齐人类意图的技能学习。

Original Abstract: Unsupervised skill discovery (USD) aims to learn diverse behaviors without reward functions, but often results in task-irrelevant or hazardous behaviors due to uniform exploration. Guided skill discovery (GSD) addresses this issue by incorporating human intent to focus exploration on meaningful regions. However, existing GSD methods typically require training additional guidance models, and rely on pre-defined rules or expert demonstration, which can be ineffective under sparse, online-collected human feedback. To overcome this, we propose COLLIE, a GSD framework that leverages dense unsupervised data to construct a semantically coherent skill latent space. This latent space is well-structured, enabling reliable guidance with sparse online feedback. Moreover, its semantic coherence property enables training-free construction of guidance signals, eliminating the need for additional model training beyond skill learning. Theoretical analysis justifies the effectiveness of our training-free guidance signal, while experiments across diverse state-based and pixel-based tasks show that COLLIE learns diverse, human-aligned skills, avoids hazardous behaviors, and achieves superior downstream performance with minimal human feedback.

中文摘要翻译: 无监督技能发现旨在无需奖励函数的情况下学习多样化行为，但由于均匀探索策略，常常导致与任务无关甚至危险的行为。引导式技能发现通过引入人类意图，将探索聚焦于有意义的区域，从而解决了这一问题。然而，现有的引导式技能发现方法通常需要训练额外的引导模型，并依赖预定义规则或专家演示，这在稀疏的在线收集人类反馈场景下效果不佳。为克服这一局限，我们提出了COLLIE，一种引导式技能发现框架，该框架利用密集的无监督数据构建语义连贯的技能隐空间。该隐空间结构良好，能够在稀疏在线反馈下实现可靠引导。此外，其语义连贯性特性使得无需训练即可构建引导信号，从而消除了在技能学习之外训练额外模型的需求。理论分析证明了我们免训练引导信号的有效性，而在多种基于状态和基于像素的任务上的实验表明，COLLIE能够学习多样化且与人类意图对齐的技能，避免危险行为，并在极小人工反馈下实现优越的下游任务性能。

</details>


### [355] [When Parallelism Pays Off: Cohesion-Aware Task Partitioning for Multi-Agent Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00953)
*Xu Yang,Lunyiu Nie,Ethan Chandra,Stanislav Gannutin,Fangru Lin,Swarat Chaudhuri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Co-Coder，将多智能体LLM编排建模为图分割问题，通过社区检测和依赖感知调度，在代码生成任务中实现更优的并行效率、加速比和成本控制。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有多智能体LLM系统在增加智能体数量时引入通信开销，可能抵消并行化带来的效率收益。需要一种理论上有依据且实际高效的方法来编排多智能体协作，平衡计算收益与通信成本。

Method: 将多智能体编排形式化为图分割问题，刻画通信与计算的权衡。具体实现Co-Coder：从静态分析构建依赖图，隔离结构枢纽文件，通过社区检测分割图，并由依赖感知调度器执行任务。

Result: 在DevEval和CodeProjectEval的28个真实世界任务上，Co-Coder相比顺序基线、基于文件的并行基线以及Claude Code with Agent Teams，通过率提升最高14.0%，加速比最高2.10倍，API成本降低最高35%，在依赖密集的项目上收益最大。

Conclusion: Cohesion-aware编排能使并行编码智能体既在理论上可解释又在实践中高效，为多智能体系统的设计提供了更通用的原则。

Original Abstract: Multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) systems offer a way to decompose complex tasks, such as coding, through parallelization and context isolation. However, adding agents in practice introduces inter-agent communication overhead, which incurs extra cost and can sometimes offset the efficiency gains. We formalize multi-agent orchestration as a graph partitioning problem that captures the communication-to-computation trade-off: task decomposition can shorten critical-path computation, but cross-agent dependencies require costly context transfer. We instantiate this view in repository-level software engineering and present Cohesion-aware Coder (Co-Coder), which builds dependency graphs from static analysis, isolates structural hub files, partitions the graph via community detection, and executes the partition with a dependency-aware scheduler.
  Across 28 real-world tasks on DevEval and CodeProjectEval, Co-Coder advances the Pareto-frontier over sequential and file-based parallel baselines as well as Claude Code with Agent Teams, lifting pass rate by up to 14.0%, achieving up to a 2.10x wall-clock speedup, and reducing API cost by up to 35%, with the largest gains on the most dependency-dense projects. Co-coder demonstrates how cohesion-aware orchestration can make parallel coding agents both theoretically grounded and practically efficient, suggesting a broader design principle for multi-agent systems.

中文摘要翻译: 多智能体大语言模型（LLM）系统提供了一种通过并行化和上下文隔离来分解复杂任务（例如编码）的方法。然而，在实践中增加智能体会引入智能体间的通信开销，这会产生额外成本，有时甚至会抵消效率提升。我们将多智能体编排形式化为一个图分割问题，以刻画通信与计算之间的权衡：任务分解可以缩短关键路径上的计算时间，但跨智能体的依赖关系需要昂贵的上下文传输。我们在仓库级别的软件工程场景中实例化这一观点，提出了Cohesion-aware Coder（Co-Coder），它通过静态分析构建依赖图，隔离结构枢纽文件，通过社区检测分割图，并由依赖感知调度器执行分割后的任务。在DevEval和CodeProjectEval上的28个真实世界任务中，Co-Coder相比顺序基线、基于文件的并行基线以及Claude Code with Agent Teams，推进了帕累托前沿，通过率提升最高达14.0%，墙钟时间加速比最高达2.10倍，API成本降低最高达35%，且在依赖最密集的项目上收益最大。Co-Coder证明了凝聚力感知编排能够使并行编码智能体既具有理论基础又具有实践效率，为多智能体系统提出了更广泛的设计原则。

</details>


### [356] [CryoProt: A Protein Pretraining Framework with Cross-Box Interactions on Cryo-EM Density Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00955)
*Dan Luo,Xuan Lin,Peng Zhou,Junwen Zhu,Tengfei Ma,Xiangxiang Zeng,Yiping Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CryoProt是一个面向冷冻电镜密度图的蛋白质预训练框架，通过多头潜在注意力机制建模跨box的相互作用，并在多个下游任务上取得最优性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有方法缺乏针对冷冻电镜密度图的通用蛋白质预训练框架，且通常将密度图划分为局部box区域独立建模，忽略了捕获全局结构上下文所需的跨box交互。

Method: 提出CryoProt框架，核心是引入基于多头潜在注意力（MLA）的Map Encoder，通过共享潜在空间实现box级表示的交互，显式建模密度图中的跨box依赖关系；并采用多任务预训练策略学习可迁移的通用表示。

Result: 在多个基准测试上一致优于现有最先进方法，相比最佳基线提升高达12%，证明了建模跨box交互的重要性。

Conclusion: CryoProt有效解决了冷冻电镜密度图中的跨box交互建模问题，为蛋白质相关属性预测提供了通用的预训练框架，在不需要密度图的下游任务中也能隐式推理。

Original Abstract: Despite the growing availability of cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) density maps, effectively leveraging them for protein representation remains challenging. First, current methods lack a general-purpose protein pretraining framework tailored for cryo-EM density maps, designed for protein-related property prediction. Second, existing approaches typically partition density maps into local box regions and model them independently, overlooking interactions across boxes which are essential for capturing global structural context in cryo-EM density map. To address these challenges, we propose CryoProt, a protein pretraining framework designed for cryo-EM density maps. CryoProt introduces a Map Encoder based on multi-head latent attention (MLA), where box-level representations interact through a shared latent space, enabling explicit modeling of cross-box dependencies within the density map. Furthermore, we adopt a multi-task pretraining strategy to learn generalizable representations that can be effectively transferred to diverse downstream tasks, such as protein flexibility prediction, where cryo-EM density maps are not required and can be inferred implicitly by the pretrained model. Experimental results demonstrate that CryoProt consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods across multiple benchmarks, achieving up to 12% improvement over the best-performing baselines, highlighting the importance of modeling cross-box interactions in cryo-EM data. The source code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CryoProt.

中文摘要翻译: 尽管冷冻电镜密度图的可获取性日益增长，但如何有效利用它们进行蛋白质表示学习仍面临挑战。首先，现有方法缺乏针对冷冻电镜密度图设计的通用蛋白质预训练框架以用于蛋白质相关属性预测。其次，现有方法通常将密度图划分为局部box区域并独立建模，忽略了对于捕获冷冻电镜密度图中全局结构上下文至关重要的跨box交互。为解决这些问题，我们提出CryoProt——一个面向冷冻电镜密度图的蛋白质预训练框架。CryoProt引入基于多头潜在注意力（MLA）的Map Encoder，通过共享潜在空间实现box级表示的交互，从而显式建模密度图中的跨box依赖关系。此外，我们采用多任务预训练策略来学习可泛化的表示，这些表示可以有效地迁移到多种下游任务（如蛋白质柔性预测），这些任务不需要冷冻电镜密度图输入，而由预训练模型隐式推理得到。实验结果表明，CryoProt在多个基准测试上一致优于现有最先进方法，相比最佳基线提升高达12%，突显了在冷冻电镜数据中建模跨box交互的重要性。源代码已在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CryoProt公开。

</details>


### [357] [Optimal-Point Variance Reduction For Bayesian Optimization With Regret Guarantee](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00956)
*Shion Takeno*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为最优方差缩减（OVR）的一步前瞻贝叶斯优化方法，通过后验采样和蒙特卡洛近似实现，并给出了其贝叶斯期望简单遗憾上界的理论保证。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有一步前瞻BO方法（如熵搜索）虽有经验有效性，但计算上常依赖难以处理的近似，且遗憾界理论保障不足。

Method: 提出最优方差缩减（OVR）方法，仅需后验采样和蒙特卡洛近似；通过正则化改进以促进探索，形成正则化OVR。

Result: 获得了OVR中蒙特卡洛估计在输入域上的均匀误差界；证明了正则化OVR的贝叶斯期望简单遗憾上界是收敛的；数值实验验证了有效性。

Conclusion: OVR方法兼具计算可行性与理论保证，为一步前瞻BO提供了新的有效方案。

Original Abstract: This paper studies a one-step lookahead Bayesian optimization (BO) method and its theoretical guarantee. Although the empirical effectiveness of one-step lookahead BO methods, such as entropy search, has been studied extensively, they often rely on computationally intractable approximations, and their regret guarantees remain underdeveloped. Thus, this paper proposes a one-step lookahead BO method called optimal-point variance reduction (OVR), which requires only posterior sampling and Monte Carlo approximations. We obtain a uniform error bound over an input domain for the Monte Carlo estimation in OVR. Furthermore, we show that the regularized OVR, with the slight modification to promote exploration, achieves a vanishing Bayesian expected simple regret upper bound. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of OVR through numerical experiments.

中文摘要翻译: 本文研究了一步前瞻贝叶斯优化方法及其理论保证。尽管一步前瞻BO方法（如熵搜索）的经验有效性已被广泛研究，但它们通常依赖计算上难以处理的近似，且其遗憾保证尚不完善。因此，本文提出了一种名为最优方差缩减的一步前瞻BO方法，该方法仅需后验采样和蒙特卡洛近似。我们获得了OVR中蒙特卡洛估计在输入域上的均匀误差界。此外，我们证明了通过微小修改以促进探索的正则化OVR，具有收敛的贝叶斯期望简单遗憾上界。最后，我们通过数值实验展示了OVR的有效性。

</details>


### [358] [UME: A Unified Meta-Generalization Framework for Cross-Domain ETA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00979)
*Duo Wang,Qiong Wu,Jianguo Wu,Ruiyu Xu,Jinhui Yi,Zhonggen Sun,Zhentao Zhang,Yu Zhang,Ke Xing,Yongjun Yin,Zishuo Li,Jianwen Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对即时物流ETA预测中现有跨域模型泛化能力差、特征空间不一致、冷启动域需单独建模等挑战，提出统一元泛化框架UME，通过双分支架构、超网络元学习器和知识蒸馏，实现零样本预测和跨域知识迁移，在美团骑手平台部署并显著优于基线方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有跨域ETA预测模型面临三大实际部署挑战：(1) 无法泛化到完全未见过的域，冷启动阶段零样本预测失败；(2) 新域因缺乏历史数据导致离线统计特征结构性缺失，而现有方法假设跨域特征空间一致；(3) 特征缺失迫使工业系统将成熟域和冷启动域分开建模，阻碍知识迁移并增加维护开销。

Method: 提出UME（统一元泛化框架），核心包括：(1) 统一双分支架构；(2) 基于超网络（hypernetwork）的元学习机制，利用域级知识和实例级上下文，动态调制三个元模块（特征门控、专家注意力、最终预测），以捕获跨域相关性并促进域内适应；(3) 引入知识蒸馏策略进一步提升性能。

Result: 在美团骑手（Keeta）国际外卖配送平台部署，大量离线实验和在线A/B测试表明UME显著优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: UME通过统一元泛化框架有效解决了跨域ETA预测中的零样本泛化、特征结构性缺失和冷启动建模等难题，在实际工业平台中取得了显著效果。

Original Abstract: Accurate Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) prediction on checkout page is crucial in instant logistics for enhancing user satisfaction, optimizing dispatching, and controlling operational costs. In international on-demand delivery platforms, where ETA data originates from diverse countries or regions with different patterns, multi-domain modeling is of great importance and has been widely adopted. However, existing methods still face three critical challenges in real-world deployment. First, current multi-domain models struggle to generalize to completely unseen domains, failing to achieve zero-shot prediction during the initial cold-start phase. Second, cross-domain feature spaces are often assumed to be consistent, whereas new domains commonly suffer from structural missingness of offline (statistical) features due to the lack of historical data. Third, such feature missingness often compels industrial systems to model mature and cold-start domains separately, hindering knowledge transfer and increasing maintenance overhead. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{UME}, a \textbf{U}nified \textbf{M}eta-generalization framework for \textbf{E}TA. Specifically, UME integrates a unified dual-branch architecture with a novel meta-learning mechanism that employs a hypernetwork-based meta learner. By leveraging domain-level knowledge and instance-level context, the meta learner empowers three meta modules to dynamically modulate feature gating, expert attention, and final prediction, capturing cross-domain correlations and facilitating intra-domain adaptation. A knowledge distillation strategy is further introduce to enhance performance. UME has now been deployed in Meituan-keeta delivery platform (the largest international food delivery platform in China). Extensive offline experiments and online A/B tests demonstrate that UME significantly outperforms existing baselines.

中文摘要翻译: 在即时物流中，结账页面上的准确预计到达时间（ETA）预测对于提升用户满意度、优化调度和控制运营成本至关重要。在跨国按需配送平台中，ETA数据来自不同国家或地区，具有不同的模式，因此多域建模具有重要意义并被广泛采用。然而，现有方法在实际部署中仍面临三个关键挑战。首先，当前的多域模型难以泛化到完全未见过的域，在初始冷启动阶段无法实现零样本预测。第二，跨域特征空间通常被假设为一致的，而新域由于缺乏历史数据，常常面临离线（统计）特征的结构性缺失。第三，这种特征缺失往往迫使工业系统将成熟域和冷启动域分开建模，阻碍了知识迁移并增加了维护开销。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了\textbf{UME}——一种用于ETA的\textbf{统一元泛化框架}。具体地说，UME集成了一种统一的双分支架构与一种新颖的元学习机制，该机制采用基于超网络的元学习器。通过利用域级知识和实例级上下文，元学习器赋能三个元模块动态地调制特征门控、专家注意力和最终预测，从而捕获跨域相关性并促进域内适应。进一步引入知识蒸馏策略以增强性能。UME目前已部署在美团骑手配送平台（中国最大的国际外卖配送平台）上。大量的离线实验和在线A/B测试表明，UME显著优于现有的基线方法。

</details>


### [359] [Profiling Privacy Preservation Against Gradient Inversion Attacks in Tabular Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00986)
*Ivo Osterberg Nilsson,Maximilian Birr Engvall,Viktor Valadi,Teddy Lazebnik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了表格数据联邦学习（FL）中梯度反转攻击（GIA）的风险，发现小批量客户端和FT-Transformer架构更安全，而架构本身可作为联邦学习中的隐私变量。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 联邦学习中客户端共享的模型更新（如梯度或模型增量）可能通过梯度反转攻击泄露私有数据，现有研究对表格数据FL场景下的这一风险缺乏系统评估。

Method: 在诚实但好奇的服务器威胁模型下，系统评估了不同FL协议（FedSGD、FedAvg）、客户端批量大小、训练阶段、攻击者假设、模型架构（MLP、ResNet、FT-Transformer）以及多种分类与回归任务下的GIA风险；使用MIMIC-IV和基准数据集，区分数值/类别恢复、基线可恢复性、特征级恢复和精确匹配率等指标，并通过匹配客户端数据暴露量而非通信轮次来公平对比攻击效果。

Result: 小批量客户端和代表少量不同记录的更新最易受攻击；更大的本地批量和更强的聚合能降低但无法消除信息泄露；FT-Transformer持续比独热基线更难被反转，MLP家族内部的可重构性差异显著；聚合重建准确率可能高估稀疏数据中的完整记录恢复，EMR和基线对比至关重要。

Conclusion: 架构可作为表格数据联邦学习中的实用隐私变量，FT-Transformer提供更强的隐私保护。

Original Abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables multiple data holders to train machine learning models collaboratively without centralizing raw data, making it useful in privacy sensitive domains such as healthcare and institutional data sharing. FL keeps data local to clients while communicating only model updates, such as gradients or model deltas. Nevertheless, these updates can expose private client data through gradient inversion attacks (GIAs). We study this risk for tabular FL under an honest-but-curious server threat model across FL protocols, client batch sizes, training stages, attacker assumptions, model architectures, and binary classification, multiclass classification, and regression tasks. We use MIMIC-IV and complementary benchmark datasets. Our evaluation distinguishes numerical and categorical recovery, baseline recoverability, feature level recovery, and exact match rate (EMR). We evaluate FedSGD gradients and FedAvg model deltas with an exposure aligned protocol, comparing attacked models after matched client data exposure rather than matched communication rounds. We compare multilayer perceptron (MLP), ResNet, and FT-Transformer models, and isolate architecture effects through an MLP grid over width, depth, activation, normalization, and dropout. The results show that small client batches and updates representing few distinct records are most vulnerable. Larger local batches and stronger aggregation reduce reconstruction but do not eliminate leakage. FT-Transformer is consistently harder to invert than one-hot baselines, while reconstructability also varies substantially within the MLP family. These findings identify architecture as a practical privacy variable in tabular FL. We also show that aggregate reconstruction accuracy can overstate complete record recovery in sparse data, making EMR and baseline comparisons essential.

中文摘要翻译: 联邦学习（FL）使多个数据持有者能够在不集中原始数据的情况下协作训练机器学习模型，这在隐私敏感领域（如医疗保健和机构数据共享）中非常有用。FL将数据保留在客户端本地，仅通信模型更新（如梯度或模型增量）。然而，这些更新可能通过梯度反转攻击（GIA）暴露私有客户端数据。我们在诚实但好奇的服务器威胁模型下，针对表格数据FL研究了这一风险，涵盖FL协议、客户端批量大小、训练阶段、攻击者假设、模型架构以及二分类、多分类和回归任务。我们使用MIMIC-IV和互补的基准数据集。我们的评估区分了数值和类别恢复、基线可恢复性、特征级恢复和精确匹配率（EMR）。我们使用暴露对齐的协议评估FedSGD梯度和FedAvg模型增量，在匹配客户端数据暴露量而非匹配通信轮次后比较被攻击的模型。我们比较了多层感知机（MLP）、ResNet和FT-Transformer模型，并通过MLP网格（覆盖宽度、深度、激活函数、归一化和丢弃率）隔离架构效应。结果表明，小批量客户端和代表少量不同记录的更新最为脆弱。更大的本地批量和更强的聚合能降低重建效果，但无法消除信息泄露。FT-Transformer持续比独热基线更难被反转，而MLP家族内部的可重构性也差异显著。这些发现将架构识别为表格数据FL中的一种实用隐私变量。我们还表明，聚合重建准确率可能高估稀疏数据中的完整记录恢复，这使得EMR和基线对比变得至关重要。

</details>


### [360] [Data Enrichment for Symbolic Regression Using Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00988)
*Simon De Reuver,Tamas Kristof Toth,Teddy Lazebnik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个物理引导的潜扩散框架，用于为符号回归模型进行数据增强。该框架结合变分自编码器、条件潜扩散模型和物理信息残差校正器，在稀疏、有噪声或物理不完整的观测数据上生成受物理约束的合成场，从而提升符号回归的方程发现能力，无需额外的领域专业知识。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 符号回归在时空测量稀疏、噪声大或物理信息不完整时可靠性急剧下降；数据增强虽能缓解这一问题，但若不能保持目标系统的物理结构，反而会误导方程发现，且传统数据增强方法依赖狭窄的领域专业知识和技术能力，实用性受限。

Method: 提出一个物理引导的潜扩散框架，包含三个核心组件：1) 变分自编码器用于提取潜表示；2) 条件潜扩散模型用于生成合成数据；3) 物理信息残差校正器用于确保生成的合成场受控制方程约束。

Result: 在热传导、不可压缩Navier-Stokes流和移动单质量牛顿引力势三个物理系统上，以GPLearn、DEAP和PySR为下游SR后端进行实验，结果表明物理校正的数据增强在稀疏观测场景下能持续提高方程恢复能力。

Conclusion: 生成式数据增强可以在无需额外领域专业知识的情况下，增强方程发现能力。

Original Abstract: Symbolic regression (SR) offers a route to scientific discovery by converting observations into interpretable governing equations. However, despite its promise, its reliability degrades sharply when spatiotemporal measurements are sparse, noisy, or physically incomplete, as commonly occurring in practice. Data enrichment (DE) has been shown to be able to mitigate this limitation, yet additional samples can mislead equation discovery unless they preserve the physical structure of the target system. Such implication of DE requires narrow domain expertise as well as technical fluidity, highly limiting its practical usefulness. In this study, we introduce a physics-guided latent diffusion framework for DE for down the line SR models. The proposed framework combines a variational autoencoder, a conditional latent diffusion model, and a physics-informed residual corrector to complete sparse observations with synthetic fields constrained by governing relations. We evaluate the approach on heat conduction, incompressible Navier-Stokes flow, and a moving single-mass Newtonian gravitational potential, using GPLearn, DEAP, and PySR as downstream SR backends. Our results reveal that physics-corrected enrichment consistently improves recovery in sparse regimes across physical dynamics and SR models. These results show that generative enrichment can strengthen equation discovery without additional domain expertise.

中文摘要翻译: 符号回归通过将观测数据转化为可解释的控制方程，为科学发现提供了一条途径。然而，尽管其前景广阔，当时空测量数据稀疏、含噪声或物理信息不完整时（这在实践中很常见），其可靠性会急剧下降。数据增强已被证明能够缓解这一局限性，但除非增强样本能够保留目标系统的物理结构，否则额外的样本反而可能误导方程发现。数据增强的这一要求既需要狭窄的领域专业知识，又需要技术熟练度，极大地限制了其实用性。在本研究中，我们提出了一种物理引导的潜扩散框架，用于为下游符号回归模型进行数据增强。该框架结合了变分自编码器、条件潜扩散模型和物理信息残差校正器，通过受控制方程约束的合成场来补全稀疏观测数据。我们在热传导、不可压缩Navier-Stokes流和移动单质量牛顿引力势三个系统上，使用GPLearn、DEAP和PySR作为下游符号回归后端进行评估。结果表明，物理校正的数据增强在稀疏观测场景下，能够持续提高跨物理动力学和符号回归模型的方程恢复能力。这些结果说明，生成式数据增强可以在无需额外领域专业知识的情况下，增强方程发现能力。

</details>


### [361] [Trust Functions: Near-Lossless Weak-to-Strong Generalization by Learning When to Trust the Weak Teacher](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01000)
*Arda Uzunoglu,Alvin Zhang,Daniel Khashabi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出信任函数（trust functions）解决弱到强泛化问题，通过筛选可靠的弱标签实现近乎无损的弱到强泛化，并支持迭代式弱到强链条以持续放大性能增益。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 在可靠标签稀缺的场景下，如何利用较弱的教师模型提供的弱监督信号来训练更强的学生模型，核心挑战在于识别哪些弱标签足够可靠以作为训练信号。

Method: 提出信任函数（trust functions），为每个弱标签分配一个标量信任分数，并基于这些分数过滤弱监督信号，仅保留可靠标签用于训练学生模型。

Result: 在多个领域（世界知识、定量推理、策略游戏）中，信任过滤方法训练出的学生模型能够匹配甚至超越使用真实标签训练的结果，实现近乎无损的弱到强泛化；此外，信任函数支持迭代式弱到强链条，通过将学生模型作为下一轮的教师模型，持续放大性能增益。

Conclusion: 信任函数是一种有效的弱到强泛化方法，通过数据选择视角解决了弱标签可靠性问题，并在多个领域证明了其有效性，同时支持迭代式增强。

Original Abstract: Weak-to-strong generalization studies how to improve a strong student using supervision from a weaker teacher when reliable labels are scarce. We view this primarily as a data selection problem, where the key challenge is to identify which weak labels are reliable enough to serve as a training signal. To address this, we introduce trust functions that assign each weak label a scalar trust score and use these scores to filter weak supervision. Across several domains, including world knowledge, quantitative reasoning, and strategy games, trust filtering yields students that match and sometimes surpass ground-truth supervision, achieving near-lossless weak-to-strong generalization. Moreover, trust functions enable an iterative weak-to-strong chain that compounds gains by training a student and reusing it as the next teacher, amplifying the gains. There are several mechanisms to which advantage of trust functions can be attributed.

中文摘要翻译: 弱到强泛化研究的是当可靠标签稀缺时，如何利用较弱的教师提供的监督信号来改进更强的学生模型。我们将此主要视为一个数据选择问题，其关键挑战在于识别哪些弱标签足够可靠以作为训练信号。为此，我们引入了信任函数，为每个弱标签分配一个标量信任分数，并使用这些分数来过滤弱监督信号。在多个领域（包括世界知识、定量推理和策略游戏）中，信任过滤方法训练出的学生模型能够匹配甚至超越使用真实标签监督的结果，实现了近乎无损的弱到强泛化。此外，信任函数还支持一种迭代式弱到强链条，通过训练学生模型并将其复用为下一轮的教师模型来累积增益，从而放大性能提升。信任函数优势的发挥可归因于多种机制。

</details>


### [362] [Beyond Task-Agnostic: Task-Aware Grouping for Communication-Efficient Multi-Task MoE Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01007)
*Zhiyao Xu,Aoxue Liu,Zhanjie Ding,Dan Zhao,Yong Jiang,Qing Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出任务感知的专家分组（TACG）和通用专家共享复制（GESR）框架，通过任务特定的共激活模式优化MoE模型分布式推理中的跨GPU通信和负载均衡，在多个开源MoE模型上平均降低31.39%的通信成本，并保持高公平性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有方法从全局聚合的路由轨迹中推导单一部署方案，忽视了多任务服务中异构的、任务特定的共激活模式，导致通信优化效果不佳。观察到专家共激活具有强任务条件性：同一任务族中紧密耦合的专家对在另一任务族中往往不相关。

Method: 提出TACG：利用任务族特定的调度和共激活轨迹推导每个专家的任务族偏好，重新加权共激活图以使族内局部性主导分组，在精确容量约束下将每个专家分配到主GPU。进一步提出GESR：识别共激活轮廓一致中心的通用专家，将其复制到少量辅助GPU，并在服务时应用局部性和负载感知的选择策略。

Result: 在三个代表性开源MoE模型上，相比基线平均降低31.39%的通信成本，平均Jain公平指数达0.9975；即使在推理数据发生严重分布偏移时仍保持优势，持续优于强基线方法。

Conclusion: 基于任务感知的共激活分组和通用专家复制能够有效提升MoE模型分布式推理的效率与公平性，对实际多任务服务场景具有重要价值。

Original Abstract: Sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale capacity via conditional computation, but distributed inference suffers from cross-GPU expert communication and routing-induced load imbalance. Existing placement methods reduce this cost by co-locating frequently co-activated experts; however, they derive a single deployment plan from globally aggregated routing traces, thereby averaging away the heterogeneous, task-specific co-activation patterns that actually drive communication in multi-task serving. We observe that expert co-activation is strongly task-conditioned: pairs tightly coupled in one task family are often uncorrelated in another, so effective deployment should group experts by task-aware co-activation rather than by a task-agnostic average. Based on this insight, we propose \emph{Task-Aware Coactivation Grouping} (TACG), a deployment-time framework that uses family-specific dispatch and co-activation traces to derive per-expert task-family preferences, reweights the co-activation graph so that intra-family locality dominates grouping, and assigns each expert to a primary GPU under exact capacity constraints. To keep the static placement robust under online workload skew, we further introduce \emph{Generic Expert Shared Replication} (GESR), a lightweight companion that identifies generic experts with consistently central co-activation profiles, replicates them across a small set of secondary GPUs, and applies locality- and load-aware selection at serving time. Experiments on three representative open-source MoE models demonstrate that our framework reduces the average communication cost by 31.39\% over the baseline, while preserving an average Jain fairness index of 0.9975. This advantage persists even under severe distribution shifts in the inference data, consistently outperforming strong baselines.

中文摘要翻译: 稀疏激活的混合专家（MoE）模型通过条件计算扩展容量，但分布式推理面临跨GPU专家通信和路由引起的负载不均衡问题。现有放置方法通过共定位频繁共激活的专家来降低这一成本；然而，它们从全局聚合的路由轨迹中推导单一部署方案，从而平均化了在多任务服务中实际驱动通信的异构、任务特定的共激活模式。我们观察到专家共激活具有强任务条件性：在同一任务族中紧密耦合的专家对在另一任务族中往往不相关，因此有效的部署应基于任务感知的共激活而非任务无关的平均值进行专家分组。基于这一见解，我们提出任务感知共激活分组（TACG），这是一个部署时框架，利用任务族特定的调度和共激活轨迹推导每个专家的任务族偏好，重新加权共激活图以使族内局部性主导分组，并在精确容量约束下将每个专家分配到主GPU。为保持静态部署在在线工作负载偏移下的鲁棒性，我们进一步引入通用专家共享复制（GESR），一个轻量级辅助方法，它识别具有持续中心共激活轮廓的通用专家，将其复制到少量辅助GPU上，并在服务时应用局部性和负载感知的选择策略。在三个代表性开源MoE模型上的实验表明，我们的框架相比基线平均降低了31.39%的通信成本，同时保持了平均0.9975的Jain公平指数。即使在推理数据发生严重分布偏移时，该优势依然存在，持续优于强基线方法。

</details>


### [363] [MedGym:A Unified Continuous-Time Benchmark for Dynamic Medical Treatment Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01028)
